## `src/domain/customNode.ts`

```typescript
/**
 * v1 natural-language assist — ONE custom node only.
 * Full-workflow synthesis is a spec violation (ROX §15 / §43).
 */
import { createNodeFromDef } from "../graph/factory";
import { uid } from "../app/id";
import { DEFINITIONS_BY_ID } from "./nodeLibrary";
import type { NodeInstance } from "./types";

export interface CustomNodeDraft {
  title: string;
  purpose: string;
  identity: string;
  mission: string;
  procedures: string;
}

export function draftCustomNode(instruction: string): CustomNodeDraft {
  const text = instruction.trim().replace(/^make (me )?a custom node (that|to|which)\s+/i, "").trim();
  const title = deriveTitle(text);
  return {
    title,
    purpose: text || "Accomplish the stated job.",
    identity: `You are MJ ${title}, a specialist custom agent.`,
    mission: text || "Complete the assigned job without leaving this identity.",
    procedures: [
      "1. Restate the job as a testable outcome.",
      "2. Use only granted tools and MCP servers.",
      "3. Verify the output against the purpose.",
      "4. Emit the deliverable. Mark unknowns. Never invent tools or secrets.",
    ].join("\n"),
  };
}

function deriveTitle(text: string): string {
  const cleaned = text.replace(/[^\w\s-]/g, " ").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
  if (!cleaned) return "Custom Agent";
  const words = cleaned.split(" ").slice(0, 4).map((w) => w.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + w.slice(1));
  return words.join(" ") || "Custom Agent";
}

export function generateCustomNode(instruction: string, x = 280, y = 180): NodeInstance {
  const def = DEFINITIONS_BY_ID.get("agent.custom") ?? DEFINITIONS_BY_ID.get("agent.synthesizer")!;
  const draft = draftCustomNode(instruction);
  const node = createNodeFromDef(def, uid("n"), x, y);
  node.title = draft.title;
  node.purpose = draft.purpose;
  node.rolePrompt = {
    version: 1,
    sections: {
      ...node.rolePrompt.sections,
      identity: draft.identity,
      mission: draft.mission,
      procedures: draft.procedures,
      invariants: `You are ${draft.title}. You never act outside this identity. You do not fabricate results or expose secrets.`,
    },
  };
  node.feedbackLoop = "OFF";
  node.evolutionMode = "OFF";
  return node;
}
```

```typescript
const COMPAT: Record<DataType, DataType[]> = {

  Markdown: ["Markdown", "Text"],
  JSON: ["JSON", "Object", "Array", "Text"],
  Object: ["Object", "JSON", "WorkflowContext", "RepositoryContext", "AgentResult"],
  Array: ["Array", "JSON"],
  Image: ["Image", "File"],
  File: ["File", "Image"],
  URL: ["URL", "Text"],
  BrowserSession: ["BrowserSession"],
  AgentResult: ["AgentResult", "Text", "Markdown", "Object"],
  Evaluation: ["Evaluation", "JSON", "Object"],
  Boolean: ["Boolean", "Text", "Number"],
  Number: ["Number", "Text"],
  Stream: ["Stream", "Text"],
  Event: ["Event", "JSON"],
  WorkflowContext: ["WorkflowContext", "Object", "any"],
  RepositoryContext: ["RepositoryContext", "Object"],
  Error: ["Error", "Text"],
};

export function portsCompatible(source: DataType, target: DataType): boolean {
  if (source === "any" || target === "any") return true;
  if (source === target) return true;
  return (COMPAT[source] ?? []).includes(target);
}
```

```typescript
/**
 * MJ 6.0 — Structured organization event vocabulary (spec §31).
 *
 * V5 emitted a handful of execution events. V6 needs a vocabulary rich enough to
 * reconstruct *why* an organization did what it did, not just that it did it.
 * Every event carries actor / authority / policy / evidence so §32's traceability
 * requirement is satisfiable by construction.
 */

export type OrgEventKind =
  // --- Mission lifecycle (§1) ---
  | "MISSION_CREATED"
  | "MISSION_PLANNED"
  | "MISSION_STARTED"
  | "MISSION_PAUSED"
  | "MISSION_RESUMED"
  | "MISSION_CHECKPOINTED"
  | "MISSION_ROLLED_BACK"
  | "MISSION_COMPLETED"
  | "MISSION_FAILED"
  | "MISSION_ABORTED"
  // --- Organization (§3) ---
  | "ORG_CREATED"
  | "ORG_REORGANIZED"
  | "TEAM_SPAWNED"
  | "TEAM_RETIRED"
  // --- Agents (§3, §9) ---
  | "AGENT_SPAWNED"
  | "AGENT_ASSIGNED"
  | "AGENT_REPLACED"
  | "AGENT_PAUSED"
  | "AGENT_RESUMED"
  | "AGENT_RETIRED"
  | "AGENT_FAILED"
  | "AGENT_RECOVERED"
  | "AGENT_STALLED"
  // --- Tasks (§3) ---
  | "TASK_CREATED"
  | "TASK_DELEGATED"
  | "TASK_REASSIGNED"
  | "TASK_SPLIT"
  | "TASK_MERGED"
  | "TASK_COMPLETED"
  | "TASK_FAILED"
  // --- Arbitration (§6, §7) ---
  | "HARNESS_SELECTED"
  | "HARNESS_SWITCHED"
  | "CAPABILITY_GAP_DETECTED"
  // --- Negotiation (§8) ---
  | "NEGOTIATION_OPENED"
  | "NEGOTIATION_PROPOSAL"
  | "NEGOTIATION_CHALLENGE"
  | "NEGOTIATION_REJECTION"
  | "NEGOTIATION_CLARIFICATION"
  | "NEGOTIATION_RESOLVED"
  // --- Graph (§4, §17, §30) ---
  | "GRAPH_MUTATION_PROPOSED"
  | "GRAPH_MUTATED"
  | "GRAPH_MUTATION_REJECTED"
  | "GRAPH_ROLLED_BACK"
  | "TOPOLOGY_CHANGED"
  // --- Execution (§24) ---
  | "EXECUTION_LEVEL_STARTED"
  | "NODE_QUEUED"
  | "NODE_STARTED"
  | "NODE_SUCCEEDED"
  | "NODE_FAILED"
  | "NODE_SKIPPED"
  | "TOOL_CALLED"
  | "TOOL_RESULT"
  // --- Artifacts (§12, §13) ---
  | "ARTIFACT_CREATED"
  | "ARTIFACT_VERSIONED"
  | "ARTIFACT_APPROVED"
  | "ARTIFACT_REJECTED"
  | "ARTIFACT_ROLLED_BACK"
  // --- Failure & repair (§15, §16, §17) ---
  | "FAILURE_DETECTED"
  | "FAILURE_CLASSIFIED"
  | "REPAIR_STARTED"
  | "REPAIR_STRATEGY_SELECTED"
  | "REPAIR_COMPLETED"
  | "REPAIR_EXHAUSTED"
  /** MAST: an agent produced output identical to its previous attempt. */
  | "STEP_REPETITION_DETECTED"
  /** MAST: an agent reported success with nothing to show for it. */
  | "PREMATURE_TERMINATION_DETECTED"
  // --- Evaluation (§18, §19) ---
  | "EVALUATION_STARTED"
  | "EVALUATION_SCORED"
  | "EVALUATION_PASSED"
  | "EVALUATION_FAILED"
  | "EVALUATION_REGRESSION"
  | "HOLDOUT_PASSED"
  | "HOLDOUT_FAILED"
  // --- Governance (§10, §11, §32, §33) ---
  | "APPROVAL_REQUIRED"
  | "APPROVAL_GRANTED"
  | "APPROVAL_REJECTED"
  | "POLICY_CHECKED"
  | "POLICY_DENIED"
  | "RISK_CLASSIFIED"
  | "BUDGET_WARNING"
  | "BUDGET_BREACHED"
  | "KILL_SWITCH_ENGAGED"
  | "PERMISSION_DENIED"
  | "FORBIDDEN_ACTION_BLOCKED"
  // --- Supervisor (§5) ---
  | "SUPERVISOR_OBSERVATION"
  | "SUPERVISOR_RECOMMENDATION"
  // --- Memory (§20, §21) ---
  | "MEMORY_WRITTEN"
  | "MEMORY_RETRIEVED";

export type EventLevel = "INFO" | "DEBUG" | "WARN" | "ERROR" | "AUDIT" | "SECURITY" | "EVOLUTION";

/** Who or what caused the event. §32 requires this be non-null for every action. */
export interface EventActor {
  /** "user", "supervisor", "governor", "reorganizer", "planner", or an agent slot id. */
  id: string;
  kind: "user" | "system" | "agent" | "supervisor" | "governor" | "planner" | "reorganizer" | "evaluator";
  label: string;
}

/** Why the actor was permitted to do it. §32: authority + policy + reason + evidence. */
export interface EventAuthority {
  /** Charter id, mission id, or "user:direct" when a human acts directly. */
  source: string;
  autonomyMode: string;
  /** The specific rule or policy clause that permitted this. */
  policy: string;
  reason: string;
  /** Pointers to the observations that justified the action. */
  evidence: string[];
}

export interface OrgEvent {
  id: string;
  seq: number;
  missionId: string;
  orgId?: string;
  ts: string;
  kind: OrgEventKind;
  level: EventLevel;
  actor: EventActor;
  authority?: EventAuthority;
  nodeId?: string;
  agentSlotId?: string;
  taskId?: string;
  artifactId?: string;
  executionId?: string;
  data: Record<string, unknown>;
  /** Set when this event belongs to a checkpoint boundary. */
  checkpointId?: string;
  /** Hash-chained (§32). Hash of prev + canonical(this). */
  prevHash?: string;
  hash?: string;
}

export const ORG_EVENT_KINDS: OrgEventKind[] = [
  "MISSION_CREATED", "MISSION_PLANNED", "MISSION_STARTED", "MISSION_PAUSED", "MISSION_RESUMED",
  "MISSION_CHECKPOINTED", "MISSION_ROLLED_BACK", "MISSION_COMPLETED", "MISSION_FAILED", "MISSION_ABORTED",
  "ORG_CREATED", "ORG_REORGANIZED", "TEAM_SPAWNED", "TEAM_RETIRED",
  "AGENT_SPAWNED", "AGENT_ASSIGNED", "AGENT_REPLACED", "AGENT_PAUSED", "AGENT_RESUMED",
  "AGENT_RETIRED", "AGENT_FAILED", "AGENT_RECOVERED", "AGENT_STALLED",
  "TASK_CREATED", "TASK_DELEGATED", "TASK_REASSIGNED", "TASK_SPLIT", "TASK_MERGED",
  "TASK_COMPLETED", "TASK_FAILED",
  "HARNESS_SELECTED", "HARNESS_SWITCHED", "CAPABILITY_GAP_DETECTED",
  "NEGOTIATION_OPENED", "NEGOTIATION_PROPOSAL", "NEGOTIATION_CHALLENGE", "NEGOTIATION_REJECTION",
  "NEGOTIATION_CLARIFICATION", "NEGOTIATION_RESOLVED",
  "GRAPH_MUTATION_PROPOSED", "GRAPH_MUTATED", "GRAPH_MUTATION_REJECTED", "GRAPH_ROLLED_BACK", "TOPOLOGY_CHANGED",
  "EXECUTION_LEVEL_STARTED", "NODE_QUEUED", "NODE_STARTED", "NODE_SUCCEEDED", "NODE_FAILED",
  "NODE_SKIPPED", "TOOL_CALLED", "TOOL_RESULT",
  "ARTIFACT_CREATED", "ARTIFACT_VERSIONED", "ARTIFACT_APPROVED", "ARTIFACT_REJECTED", "ARTIFACT_ROLLED_BACK",
  "FAILURE_DETECTED", "FAILURE_CLASSIFIED", "REPAIR_STARTED", "REPAIR_STRATEGY_SELECTED",
  "REPAIR_COMPLETED", "REPAIR_EXHAUSTED",
  "STEP_REPETITION_DETECTED", "PREMATURE_TERMINATION_DETECTED",
  "EVALUATION_STARTED", "EVALUATION_SCORED", "EVALUATION_PASSED", "EVALUATION_FAILED",
  "EVALUATION_REGRESSION", "HOLDOUT_PASSED", "HOLDOUT_FAILED",
  "APPROVAL_REQUIRED", "APPROVAL_GRANTED", "APPROVAL_REJECTED", "POLICY_CHECKED", "POLICY_DENIED",
  "RISK_CLASSIFIED", "BUDGET_WARNING", "BUDGET_BREACHED", "KILL_SWITCH_ENGAGED",
```

## `src/domain/evolutionEngine.ts`

```typescript
/**
 * Evolution engine — ports the vendored hermes-agent-self-evolution contract.
 *
 * Source of truth:
 *   vendor/hermes-agent-self-evolution/evolution/core/fitness.py
 *   vendor/hermes-agent-self-evolution/evolution/core/constraints.py
 *   vendor/hermes-agent-self-evolution/evolution/core/config.py
 *   vendor/hermes-agent-self-evolution/evolution/skills/skill_module.py
 *
 * No weight updates. Skills are SKILL.md text. Accept requires:
 *   1. every constraint passes
 *   2. holdoutPassed
 *   3. regressionPassed
 *   4. candidate composite > baseline
 * Bundled skills are never written.
 */

import { skillHasValidStructure, type HermesSkill } from "./hermesSkill";

export const EVOLUTION_CONFIG = {
  iterations: 10,
  populationSize: 5,
  maxSkillSize: 15_000,
  maxToolDescSize: 500,
  maxParamDescSize: 200,
  maxPromptGrowth: 0.2,
  evalDatasetSize: 20,
  trainRatio: 0.5,
  valRatio: 0.25,
  holdoutRatio: 0.25,
  tbliteRegressionThreshold: 0.02,
} as const;

export interface FitnessScore {
  correctness: number;
  procedureFollowing: number;
  conciseness: number;
  lengthPenalty: number;
  feedback: string;
  composite: number;
}

export interface ConstraintResult {
  passed: boolean;
  constraintName: string;
  message: string;
  details?: string;
}

export interface GateResult {
  constraints: ConstraintResult[];
  constraintsPassed: boolean;
  holdoutPassed: boolean;
  regressionPassed: boolean;
  baseline: FitnessScore;
  candidate: FitnessScore;
  accepted: boolean;
  reason: string;
}

function clamp01(n: number): number {
  return Math.min(1, Math.max(0, n));
}

export function compositeOf(s: Omit<FitnessScore, "composite">): number {
  const raw = 0.5 * s.correctness + 0.3 * s.procedureFollowing + 0.2 * s.conciseness;
  return Math.max(0, raw - s.lengthPenalty);
}

export function lengthPenalty(artifactSize: number, maxSize: number): number {
  const ratio = artifactSize / Math.max(1, maxSize);
  if (ratio <= 0.9) return 0;
  return Math.min(0.3, (ratio - 0.9) * 3.0);
}

/** Fast heuristic metric — same contract as skill_fitness_metric (DSPy path). */
export function skillFitnessMetric(_taskInput: string, expectedBehavior: string, agentOutput: string): number {
  if (!agentOutput.trim()) return 0;
  const expectedWords = new Set(expectedBehavior.toLowerCase().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean));
  const outputWords = new Set(agentOutput.toLowerCase().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean));
  if (expectedWords.size === 0) return 0.5;
  let overlap = 0;
  for (const w of expectedWords) if (outputWords.has(w)) overlap += 1;
  return clamp01(0.3 + 0.7 * (overlap / expectedWords.size));
}

export function scoreFitness(args: {
  taskInput: string;
  expectedBehavior: string;
  agentOutput: string;
  skillText: string;
}): FitnessScore {
  const overlap = skillFitnessMetric(args.taskInput, args.expectedBehavior, args.agentOutput);
  const procedure = skillFitnessMetric(args.skillText.slice(0, 800), args.expectedBehavior, args.agentOutput);
  const conciseness = args.agentOutput.length > 4000 ? 0.4 : args.agentOutput.length < 40 ? 0.5 : 0.8;
  const lp = lengthPenalty(args.skillText.length, EVOLUTION_CONFIG.maxSkillSize);
  const partial = {
    correctness: overlap,
    procedureFollowing: procedure,
    conciseness,
    lengthPenalty: lp,
    feedback: overlap < 0.5
      ? "Low keyword overlap with expected behavior. Tighten the procedure and name the done-when."
      : "Procedure coverage is acceptable. Prefer smaller, evidenced edits.",
  };
  return { ...partial, composite: compositeOf(partial) };
}

export function validateConstraints(artifactText: string, artifactType: "skill" | "tool_description" | "param_description", baselineText?: string): ConstraintResult[] {
  const results: ConstraintResult[] = [];
  const size = artifactText.length;
  const limit =
    artifactType === "tool_description"
      ? EVOLUTION_CONFIG.maxToolDescSize
      : artifactType === "param_description"
        ? EVOLUTION_CONFIG.maxParamDescSize
        : EVOLUTION_CONFIG.maxSkillSize;
  results.push({
    passed: size <= limit,
    constraintName: "size_limit",
    message: size <= limit ? `Size OK: ${size}/${limit} chars` : `Size exceeded: ${size}/${limit} chars (${size - limit} over)`,
  });
  if (baselineText !== undefined) {
    const growth = (size - baselineText.length) / Math.max(1, baselineText.length);
    results.push({
      passed: growth <= EVOLUTION_CONFIG.maxPromptGrowth,
      constraintName: "growth_limit",
      message: growth <= EVOLUTION_CONFIG.maxPromptGrowth
        ? `Growth OK: ${(growth * 100).toFixed(1)}% (max ${(EVOLUTION_CONFIG.maxPromptGrowth * 100).toFixed(0)}%)`
        : `Growth exceeded: ${(growth * 100).toFixed(1)}% (max ${(EVOLUTION_CONFIG.maxPromptGrowth * 100).toFixed(0)}%)`,
    });
  }
  results.push({
    passed: Boolean(artifactText.trim()),
    constraintName: "non_empty",
    message: artifactText.trim() ? "Artifact is non-empty" : "Artifact is empty",
  });
  if (artifactType === "skill") {
    const struct = skillHasValidStructure(artifactText);
    results.push({
      passed: struct.ok,
      constraintName: "skill_structure",
      message: struct.ok
        ? "Skill has valid frontmatter (name + description)"
        : `Skill missing: ${struct.missing.join(", ")}`,
    });
  }
  return results;
}

export function gateCandidate(args: {
  baselineText: string;
  candidateText: string;
  artifactType?: "skill" | "tool_description" | "param_description";
  taskInput: string;
  expectedBehavior: string;
  baselineOutput: string;
  candidateOutput: string;
  bundled: boolean;
}): GateResult {
  if (args.bundled) {
    return {
      constraints: [{ passed: false, constraintName: "bundled_readonly", message: "Curator never writes bundled Hermes skills." }],
      constraintsPassed: false,
      holdoutPassed: false,
      regressionPassed: false,
      baseline: scoreFitness({ taskInput: args.taskInput, expectedBehavior: args.expectedBehavior, agentOutput: args.baselineOutput, skillText: args.baselineText }),
      candidate: scoreFitness({ taskInput: args.taskInput, expectedBehavior: args.expectedBehavior, agentOutput: args.candidateOutput, skillText: args.candidateText }),
      accepted: false,
      reason: "Bundled skills are read-only.",
    };
  }
  const constraints = validateConstraints(args.candidateText, args.artifactType ?? "skill", args.baselineText);
  const constraintsPassed = constraints.every((c) => c.passed);
  const baseline = scoreFitness({
    taskInput: args.taskInput,
    expectedBehavior: args.expectedBehavior,
    agentOutput: args.baselineOutput,
    skillText: args.baselineText,
  });
  const candidate = scoreFitness({
    taskInput: args.taskInput,
    expectedBehavior: args.expectedBehavior,
    agentOutput: args.candidateOutput,
    skillText: args.candidateText,
  });
  const holdoutPassed = candidate.composite >= 0.45;
  const regressionPassed = candidate.composite + EVOLUTION_CONFIG.tbliteRegressionThreshold >= baseline.composite;
  const accepted = constraintsPassed && holdoutPassed && regressionPassed && candidate.composite > baseline.composite;
  let reason = "Pending gates.";
  if (!constraintsPassed) reason = "Constraint failed: " + constraints.filter((c) => !c.passed).map((c) => c.constraintName).join(", ");
  else if (!holdoutPassed) reason = "Holdout failed.";
  else if (!regressionPassed) reason = "Regression vs baseline.";
  else if (!(candidate.composite > baseline.composite)) reason = "No improvement over baseline.";
  else reason = "All gates passed.";
  return { constraints, constraintsPassed, holdoutPassed, regressionPassed, baseline, candidate, accepted, reason };
}

export function proposeSkillEdit(skill: HermesSkill, evidence: string[]): { nextBody: string; trigger: string } {
  const extra = evidence.length
    ? `\n\n## Learned corrections\n\n${evidence.map((e) => `- ${e}`).join("\n")}\n`
    : "\n\n## Learned corrections\n\n- Prefer explicit done-when checks after every tool call.\n";
  return { nextBody: skill.body + extra, trigger: "trace-failure" };
}
```

## `src/domain/hermesSkill.ts`

```typescript
/**
 * Hermes Agent skill contract — wraps the vendored SKILL.md schema.
 *
 * Source of truth:
 *   vendor/hermes-agent/agent/skill_utils.py  (parse_frontmatter, platforms, environments)
 *   vendor/hermes-agent-self-evolution/evolution/skills/skill_module.py  (load_skill, reassemble_skill)
 *
 * A skill is a folder containing SKILL.md with YAML frontmatter:
 *   ---
 *   name: apple-notes
 *   description: "…"
 *   version: 1.0.1
 *   platforms: [macos]
 *   metadata:
 *     hermes:
 *       tags: […]
 *   ---
 *   # Body (procedure markdown)
 *
 * Bundled skills under vendor/hermes-agent/skills are READ-ONLY.
 * Curator / evolution never writes them. User and learned skills live
 * in the MJ skill store (native: {appData}/skills, preview: localDb).
 */

export type SkillOrigin = "bundled" | "user" | "learned" | "evolution";

export interface HermesFrontmatter {
  name: string;
  description: string;
  version?: string;
  author?: string;
  license?: string;
  platforms?: string[];
  environments?: string[];
  metadata?: {
    hermes?: {
      tags?: string[];
      related_skills?: string[];
      fallback_for_toolsets?: string[];
      requires_toolsets?: string[];
      fallback_for_tools?: string[];
      requires_tools?: string[];
      config?: Array<{ key: string; description: string; default?: unknown; prompt?: string }>;
    };
  };
  prerequisites?: Record<string, unknown>;
}

export interface HermesSkill {
  path?: string;
  raw: string;
  frontmatter: HermesFrontmatter;
  body: string;
  origin: SkillOrigin;
  bundled: boolean;
}

const FRONTMATTER_RE = /^---\s*\n([\s\S]*?)\n---\s*\n?/;

export function parseFrontmatter(content: string): { frontmatter: Record<string, unknown>; body: string } {
  let src = content;
  if (src.charCodeAt(0) === 0xfeff) src = src.slice(1);
  if (!src.startsWith("---")) return { frontmatter: {}, body: src };
  const m = FRONTMATTER_RE.exec(src);
  if (!m) return { frontmatter: {}, body: src };
  return { frontmatter: parseSimpleYaml(m[1]), body: src.slice(m[0].length) };
}

/** Minimal YAML subset used by SKILL.md frontmatter (mirrors skill_utils fallback). */
function parseSimpleYaml(yaml: string): Record<string, unknown> {
  const root: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  const stack: Array<{ indent: number; obj: Record<string, unknown> }> = [{ indent: -1, obj: root }];
  const lines = yaml.replace(/\r\n/g, "\n").split("\n");
  for (const raw of lines) {
    if (!raw.trim() || raw.trim().startsWith("#")) continue;
    const indent = raw.match(/^\s*/)?.[0].length ?? 0;
    const line = raw.trim();
    while (stack.length > 1 && indent <= stack[stack.length - 1].indent) stack.pop();
    const cur = stack[stack.length - 1].obj;
    if (line.startsWith("- ")) {
      continue;
    }
    const colon = line.indexOf(":");
    if (colon < 0) continue;
    const key = line.slice(0, colon).trim();
    let value = line.slice(colon + 1).trim();
    if (!value) {
      const child: Record<string, unknown> = {};
      cur[key] = child;
      stack.push({ indent, obj: child });
      continue;
    }
    if ((value.startsWith("[") && value.endsWith("]")) || (value.startsWith("\"") && value.endsWith("\"")) || (value.startsWith("'") && value.endsWith("'"))) {
      try {
        cur[key] = JSON.parse(value.replace(/'/g, "\""));
        continue;
      } catch {
        /* fall through */
      }
    }
    if ((value.startsWith("\"") && value.endsWith("\"")) || (value.startsWith("'") && value.endsWith("'"))) {
      value = value.slice(1, -1);
    }
    cur[key] = value;
  }
  return root;
}

export function loadSkill(raw: string, origin: SkillOrigin = "user", path?: string): HermesSkill {
  const { frontmatter, body } = parseFrontmatter(raw);
  const name = String(frontmatter.name ?? (path ? path.split(/[\\/]/).slice(-2, -1)[0] : "unnamed"));
  const description = String(frontmatter.description ?? "");
  return {
    path,
    raw,
    frontmatter: { ...frontmatter, name, description } as HermesFrontmatter,
    body: body.trim(),
    origin,
    bundled: origin === "bundled",
  };
}

export function reassembleSkill(frontmatter: HermesFrontmatter, body: string): string {
  const yaml: string[] = [];
  yaml.push(`name: ${frontmatter.name}`);
  yaml.push(`description: ${JSON.stringify(frontmatter.description)}`);
  if (frontmatter.version) yaml.push(`version: ${frontmatter.version}`);
  if (frontmatter.author) yaml.push(`author: ${frontmatter.author}`);
  if (frontmatter.license) yaml.push(`license: ${frontmatter.license}`);
  if (frontmatter.platforms?.length) yaml.push(`platforms: [${frontmatter.platforms.join(", ")}]`);
  if (frontmatter.environments?.length) yaml.push(`environments: [${frontmatter.environments.join(", ")}]`);
  if (frontmatter.metadata?.hermes) {
    yaml.push("metadata:");
    yaml.push("  hermes:");
    const h = frontmatter.metadata.hermes;
    if (h.tags?.length) yaml.push(`    tags: [${h.tags.join(", ")}]`);
    if (h.related_skills?.length) yaml.push(`    related_skills: [${h.related_skills.join(", ")}]`);
  }
  return `---\n${yaml.join("\n")}\n---\n\n${body.trim()}\n`;
}

export function skillHasValidStructure(text: string): { ok: boolean; missing: string[] } {
  const missing: string[] = [];
  const stripped = text.replace(/^\uFEFF/, "").trim();
  if (!stripped.startsWith("---")) missing.push("YAML frontmatter (---)");
  const head = stripped.slice(0, 500);
  if (!/name\s*:/.test(head)) missing.push("name field");
  if (!/description\s*:/.test(head)) missing.push("description field");
  return { ok: missing.length === 0, missing };
}

export const HERMES_PLUGIN_HOOKS = [
  "on_session_start",
  "pre_llm_call",
  "post_llm_call",
  "on_session_end",
] as const;

export type HermesPluginHook = (typeof HERMES_PLUGIN_HOOKS)[number];

export interface HookContext {
  hook: HermesPluginHook;
  nodeKey?: string;
  executionId?: string;
  payload?: Record<string, unknown>;
}

export function runPluginHook(ctx: HookContext): Record<string, unknown> {
  return {
    hook: ctx.hook,
    applied: true,
    vendor: "hermes-agent",
    at: new Date().toISOString(),
    nodeKey: ctx.nodeKey ?? null,
    executionId: ctx.executionId ?? null,
  };
}

export const BUNDLED_SKILLS_ROOT = "vendor/hermes-agent/skills";
export const ESSENTIAL_SKILLS = new Set(["hermes-agent"]);
```

## `src/domain/memoryScopes.ts`

```typescript
/**
 * MJ 6.0 — Scoped organizational memory (spec §20, §21).
 *
 * §20's hard rule: "Never dump all historical memory into an agent context."
 * So every memory record carries a scope, and retrieval is always scoped + ranked +
 * token-capped. Cross-scope retrieval is possible but explicit and bounded.
 */

export type MemoryScopeName =
  | "mission"
  | "team"
  | "agent"
  | "artifact"
  | "decision"
  | "failure"
  | "constitution";

export const MEMORY_SCOPES: MemoryScopeName[] = [
  "mission", "team", "agent", "artifact", "decision", "failure", "constitution",
];

export const MEMORY_SCOPE_LABEL: Record<MemoryScopeName, string> = {
  mission: "Mission memory — what happened in this mission",
  team: "Team memory — what the team discovered",
  agent: "Agent memory — what this agent learned",
  artifact: "Artifact memory — lineage and versions",
  decision: "Decision memory — decisions and their rationale",
  failure: "Failure memory — what failed and which repair worked",
  constitution: "Constitution — shared coordination rules evolved across missions",
};

/** What each scope is allowed to remember. Keeps scopes from bleeding together. */
export const MEMORY_SCOPE_KINDS: Record<MemoryScopeName, string[]> = {
  mission: ["progress", "blocker", "outcome", "cost", "intervention"],
  team: ["discovery", "convention", "handoff", "conflict"],
  agent: ["technique", "tooling", "pitfall", "preference"],
  artifact: ["version", "lineage", "approval", "rollback"],
  decision: ["decision", "rationale", "alternative-rejected", "vote"],
  failure: ["failure", "classification", "repair-applied", "repair-outcome"],
  constitution: ["rule", "norm", "coordination", "amendment"],
};

export interface ScopedMemory {
  id: string;
  scope: MemoryScopeName;
  /** Scope key: mission id, team id, slot id, artifact lineage id, or "*". */
  scopeKey: string;
  kind: string;
  content: string;
  /** Rough token estimate, used for budget-aware retrieval. */
  tokens: number;
  /** Retrieval relevance signal, 0–1. Decays unless reinforced. */
  salience: number;
  timesReinforced: number;
  missionId?: string;
  /** Evidence pointer so the memory is not an unsourced assertion. */
  sourceEventId?: string;
  tags: string[];
  createdAt: string;
  lastUsedAt?: string;
}

export function estimateTokens(text: string): number {
  return Math.max(1, Math.ceil(text.length / 4));
}

export interface RetrievalQuery {
  /** Primary scope to read from. */
  scope: MemoryScopeName;
  scopeKey: string;
  /** Additional scopes permitted, each contributing at most `crossScopeBudget`. */
  allowCrossScope?: MemoryScopeName[];
  /** Free-text relevance hint. */
  query?: string;
  /** Max characters to return. Hard cap — this is the §20 guarantee. */
  maxChars?: number;
  /** Max records regardless of size. */
  maxRecords?: number;
  /** Restrict to these kinds. */
  kinds?: string[];
}

export interface RetrievalResult {
  records: ScopedMemory[];
  totalConsidered: number;
  /** Why these were chosen. Surfaced in the flight recorder (§20, §32). */
  rationale: string;
  truncated: boolean;
}

const STOPWORDS = new Set([
  "the", "a", "an", "and", "or", "but", "if", "then", "of", "to", "in", "on", "for",
  "with", "is", "are", "was", "were", "be", "been", "it", "this", "that", "these",
  "those", "as", "at", "by", "from", "we", "you", "they", "i", "not", "do", "does",
]);

function terms(text: string): string[] {
  return text
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9\s-]/g, " ")
    .split(/\s+/)
    .filter((w) => w.length > 2 && !STOPWORDS.has(w));
}

/** Lightweight lexical overlap. No embeddings required, deterministic, testable. */
export function lexicalOverlap(query: string, doc: string): number {
  const qt = terms(query);
  if (!qt.length) return 0;
  const dt = new Set(terms(doc));
  let hits = 0;
  for (const t of new Set(qt)) if (dt.has(t)) hits += 1;
  return hits / new Set(qt).size;
}

/**
 * Ranked, capped retrieval.
 * ranking = 0.5*relevance + 0.3*salience + 0.2*recency
 * Cross-scope records must clear a higher bar, so local memory dominates.
 */
export function retrieve(
  all: ScopedMemory[],
  q: RetrievalQuery,
  now = Date.now(),
): RetrievalResult {
  const maxChars = q.maxChars ?? 6000;
  const maxRecords = q.maxRecords ?? 12;

  const inPrimary = all.filter(
    (m) => m.scope === q.scope && m.scopeKey === q.scopeKey,
  );
  const cross = (q.allowCrossScope ?? []).length
    ? all.filter(
        (m) => m.scope !== q.scope && q.allowCrossScope!.includes(m.scope),
      )
    : [];

  const relevanceOf = (m: ScopedMemory): number => {
    if (!q.query) return 0.4;
    return lexicalOverlap(q.query, `${m.content} ${m.tags.join(" ")}`);
  };

  const recencyOf = (m: ScopedMemory): number => {
    const t = new Date(m.lastUsedAt ?? m.createdAt).getTime();
    const ageDays = (now - t) / 86_400_000;
    return Math.pow(0.5, Math.max(0, ageDays) / 30);
  };

  const rankOf = (m: ScopedMemory): number =>
    0.5 * relevanceOf(m) + 0.3 * m.salience + 0.2 * recencyOf(m);

  const considered = [...inPrimary, ...cross].filter(
    (m) => !q.kinds || q.kinds.includes(m.kind),
  );

  const scored = considered
    .map((m) => ({ m, r: rankOf(m) * (m.scope === q.scope ? 1 : 0.7) }))
    .sort((a, b) => b.r - a.r);

  const picked: ScopedMemory[] = [];
  let chars = 0;
  let truncated = false;
  for (const { m } of scored) {
    if (picked.length >= maxRecords || chars + m.content.length > maxChars) {
      truncated = true;
      break;
    }
    picked.push(m);
    chars += m.content.length;
  }

  const primaryCount = picked.filter((m) => m.scope === q.scope).length;
  const rationale =
    `Retrieved ${picked.length}/${considered.length} records ` +
    `(${primaryCount} from ${q.scope}:${q.scopeKey}` +
    `${picked.length - primaryCount ? `, ${picked.length - primaryCount} cross-scope` : ""}) ` +
    `capped at ${maxChars} chars${truncated ? " — truncated" : ""}.`;

  return { records: picked, totalConsidered: considered.length, rationale, truncated };
}

/** Reinforce records that were actually retrieved and used. */
export function reinforce(records: ScopedMemory[], now = Date.now()): void {
  for (const r of records) {
    r.timesReinforced += 1;
    r.salience = Math.min(1, r.salience + 0.05);
    r.lastUsedAt = new Date(now).toISOString();
  }
}

/** Salience decays so stale memory stops crowding out fresh evidence. */
export function decaySalience(records: ScopedMemory[], now = Date.now()): void {
  for (const r of records) {
    const ageDays = (now - new Date(r.createdAt).getTime()) / 86_400_000;
    if (ageDays > 30) r.salience = Math.max(0.1, r.salience * 0.98);
  }
}
```

## `src/domain/mission.ts`

```typescript
/**
 * MJ 6.0 — Mission, the new top-level primitive (spec §1).
 *
 * In V5 the `Workflow` was the unit of work and the user pressed Run. In V6 a
 * `Mission` owns an `Organization`, which compiles down to *phases*, and each phase
 * compiles down to a V5-style `WorkflowGraph`. The graph is still the source of truth
 * for execution (§30); the Mission is the source of truth for intent.
 */
import type { RiskPolicy } from "./risk";
import { DEFAULT_RISK_POLICY } from "./risk";

export type MissionStatus =
  | "DRAFT"
  | "PLANNING"
  | "READY"
  | "RUNNING"
  | "PAUSED"
  | "BLOCKED"
  | "REPAIRING"
  | "VERIFYING"
  | "COMPLETED"
  | "FAILED"
  | "ABORTED";

export const MISSION_STATUSES: MissionStatus[] = [
  "DRAFT", "PLANNING", "READY", "RUNNING", "PAUSED",
  "BLOCKED", "REPAIRING", "VERIFYING", "COMPLETED", "FAILED", "ABORTED",
];

export const MISSION_STATUS_COLOR: Record<MissionStatus, string> = {
  DRAFT: "#7a7a7a",
  PLANNING: "#7ab8c9",
  READY: "#9b8ec4",
  RUNNING: "#c9a66b",
  PAUSED: "#8a8a5a",
  BLOCKED: "#e8834a",
  REPAIRING: "#e8a04a",
  VERIFYING: "#7ac98a",
  COMPLETED: "#4c8",
  FAILED: "#e8341c",
  ABORTED: "#a04040",
};

/** Terminal states — no further autonomous transitions. */
export const TERMINAL_STATUSES: MissionStatus[] = ["COMPLETED", "FAILED", "ABORTED"];

export function isTerminal(s: MissionStatus): boolean {
  return TERMINAL_STATUSES.includes(s);
}

export type MissionPriority = "LOW" | "NORMAL" | "HIGH" | "URGENT";

export const MISSION_PRIORITIES: MissionPriority[] = ["LOW", "NORMAL", "HIGH", "URGENT"];

/**
 * How a success criterion is checked. Independent verification (§18) means at
 * least one criterion should be machine-checked rather than self-reported.
 */
export type CriterionKind =
  | "RUBRIC" // judged by an independent evaluator against an anchored rubric
  | "CONTAINS" // output must contain these substrings
  | "NOT_CONTAINS" // output must not contain these
  | "COMMAND_EXIT" // a shell command must exit 0
  | "ARTIFACT_EXISTS" // a named artifact must exist and be non-empty
  | "HUMAN" // a human must sign off
  | "REGRESSION"; // a holdout suite must still pass

export const CRITERION_KIND_LABEL: Record<CriterionKind, string> = {
  RUBRIC: "Rubric score",
  CONTAINS: "Output contains",
  NOT_CONTAINS: "Output excludes",
  COMMAND_EXIT: "Command exits 0",
  ARTIFACT_EXISTS: "Artifact exists",
  HUMAN: "Human sign-off",
  REGRESSION: "Regression suite",
};

export interface SuccessCriterion {
  id: string;
  statement: string;
  kind: CriterionKind;
  /** Relative weight when rolling up to the mission score (§19). */
  weight: number;
  /** Rubric id when kind = RUBRIC. */
  rubricId?: string;
  /** Substrings / command / artifact name depending on kind. */
  expects?: string[];
  /** For RUBRIC: minimum mean score 0–5. */
  minScore?: number;
  /** Blocking criteria must pass for the mission to complete. */
  blocking: boolean;
  met: boolean;
  /** Evidence recorded when checked. */
  evidence?: string;
  checkedAt?: string;
}

export interface MissionBudget {
  maxCostUsd: number;
  maxTokens: number;
  maxWallClockMs: number;
  maxConcurrentAgents: number;
  maxRetries: number;
  maxBrowserSessions: number;
  deadlineIso?: string;
}

export interface Mission {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  objective: string;
  description: string;
  constraints: string[];
  successCriteria: SuccessCriterion[];
  deadline?: string;
  budget: MissionBudget;
  riskPolicy: RiskPolicy;
  /** Charter governing the organization (governance ceiling). */
  charterId: string;
  approvalPolicyId: string;
  allowedHarnesses: string[];
  allowedTools: string[];
  allowedMcpServers: string[];
  /** Role-pack slugs / definition ids the org may staff from. */
  allowedAgents: string[];
  preferredFramework: string;
  workspace: string;
  artifactIds: string[];
  status: MissionStatus;
  priority: MissionPriority;
  /** Current organization instance, set once planned. */
  orgId?: string;
  /** Template this mission was instantiated from (§27). */
  templateId?: string;
  tags: string[];
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
  /** Set when the mission entered a terminal state. */
  endedAt?: string;
}

export const DEFAULT_MISSION_BUDGET: MissionBudget = {
  maxCostUsd: 5,
  maxTokens: 2_000_000,
  maxWallClockMs: 30 * 60_000,
  maxConcurrentAgents: 6,
  maxRetries: 3,
  maxBrowserSessions: 0,
};

export function defaultRiskPolicy(id: string): RiskPolicy {
  return { id, tier: "R1_REVERSIBLE", ...DEFAULT_RISK_POLICY };
}

let critSeq = 0;
export function makeCriterion(
  statement: string,
  kind: CriterionKind = "RUBRIC",
  opts: Partial<SuccessCriterion> = {},
): SuccessCriterion {
  critSeq += 1;
  return {
    id: `crit-${Date.now().toString(36)}-${critSeq}`,
    statement,
    kind,
    weight: 1,
    blocking: true,
    met: false,
    ...opts,
  };
}

/** Allowed status transitions. Enforced so the UI can never lie about state. */
const TRANSITIONS: Record<MissionStatus, MissionStatus[]> = {
  DRAFT: ["PLANNING", "ABORTED"],
  PLANNING: ["READY", "DRAFT", "FAILED", "ABORTED"],
  READY: ["RUNNING", "DRAFT", "ABORTED"],
  RUNNING: ["PAUSED", "BLOCKED", "REPAIRING", "VERIFYING", "COMPLETED", "FAILED", "ABORTED"],
  PAUSED: ["RUNNING", "ABORTED", "FAILED"],
  BLOCKED: ["RUNNING", "REPAIRING", "ABORTED", "FAILED"],
  REPAIRING: ["RUNNING", "BLOCKED", "FAILED", "ABORTED"],
  VERIFYING: ["RUNNING", "REPAIRING", "COMPLETED", "FAILED", "ABORTED"],
  COMPLETED: [],
  FAILED: ["REPAIRING"],
  ABORTED: [],
};

export function canTransition(from: MissionStatus, to: MissionStatus): boolean {
  return TRANSITIONS[from].includes(to);
}

export function assertTransition(from: MissionStatus, to: MissionStatus): void {
  if (!canTransition(from, to)) {
    throw new Error(`Illegal mission transition ${from} → ${to}`);
  }
}
```

## `src/domain/missionTemplates.ts`

```typescript
/**
 * MJ 6.0 — Mission & organization template library (spec §27, §28).
 *
 * "Templates are starting structures, not immutable workflows" (§28). Each template
 * seeds a Mission + a phase decomposition; the planner is free to deviate, and the
 * reorganizer is expected to deviate when evidence says so.
 */
import type { MissionBudget } from "./mission";
import { DEFAULT_MISSION_BUDGET, makeCriterion } from "./mission";
import type { ParallelismClass } from "./organization";
import type { RiskClass } from "./risk";
import type { TaskKind } from "./reputation";

export type TopologyPattern =
  | "pipeline"
  | "hierarchy"
  | "debate"
  | "map-reduce"
  | "swarm"
  | "pair"
  | "council"
  | "shadow"
  | "loop"
  | "gate"
  | "blackboard";

export const TOPOLOGY_PATTERNS: TopologyPattern[] = [
  "pipeline", "hierarchy", "debate", "map-reduce", "swarm", "pair",
  "council", "shadow", "loop", "gate", "blackboard",
];

export const TOPOLOGY_LABEL: Record<TopologyPattern, string> = {
  pipeline: "Pipeline — sequential specialist stages",
  hierarchy: "Hierarchy — supervisor assigns, specialists execute",
  debate: "Debate — proposal vs critic, judge binds",
  "map-reduce": "Map–reduce — fan out, synthesize",
  swarm: "Swarm — peers in parallel, explicit merge",
  pair: "Pair — driver + navigator",
  council: "Council — independent scorers, judge binds",
  shadow: "Shadow — same task on two harnesses, diff",
  loop: "Loop — bounded revision cycles",
  gate: "Gate — produce, verify, gate",
  blackboard: "Blackboard — shared state, opportunistic posting",
};

/** Which parallelism class each topology implies for its worker stage (§24). */
export const TOPOLOGY_PARALLELISM: Record<TopologyPattern, ParallelismClass> = {
  pipeline: "SEQUENTIAL",
  hierarchy: "DEPENDENCY_BOUND",
  debate: "PARALLEL_SAFE",
  "map-reduce": "PARALLEL_SAFE",
  swarm: "PARALLEL_SAFE",
  pair: "SEQUENTIAL",
  council: "PARALLEL_SAFE",
  shadow: "PARALLEL_SAFE",
  loop: "SEQUENTIAL",
  gate: "SEQUENTIAL",
  blackboard: "PARALLEL_SAFE",
};

export interface TemplatePhase {
  name: string;
  rationale: string;
  topology: TopologyPattern;
  /** Role keys staffed into this phase. Duplicates = parallel peers. */
  roles: string[];
  taskKind: TaskKind;
  riskClass: RiskClass;
  parallelism: ParallelismClass;
  /** Writes an artifact with this name. */
  produces?: string;
  /** Consumes artifacts with these names. */
  consumes?: string[];
}

export interface MissionTemplate {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  category: string;
  description: string;
  frameworkId: string;
  phases: TemplatePhase[];
  /** Criterion templates. `{subject}` is replaced with the mission objective. */
  criteria: Array<{ statement: string; kind: "RUBRIC" | "CONTAINS" | "COMMAND_EXIT" | "ARTIFACT_EXISTS" | "HUMAN" | "REGRESSION"; blocking: boolean; weight: number; rubricId?: string }>;
  budget: MissionBudget;
  tags: string[];
}

const t = (
  id: string,
  name: string,
  category: string,
  description: string,
  frameworkId: string,
  phases: TemplatePhase[],
  criteria: MissionTemplate["criteria"],
  budget: Partial<MissionBudget> = {},
  tags: string[] = [],
): MissionTemplate => ({
  id,
  name,
  category,
  description,
  frameworkId,
  phases,
  criteria,
  budget: { ...DEFAULT_MISSION_BUDGET, ...budget },
  tags,
});

export const MISSION_TEMPLATES: MissionTemplate[] = [
  t(
    "mtpl.software-development",
    "Software Development",
    "engineering",
    "Spec → architecture → implementation → test → security → review → release gate. The §36 demo shape.",
    "fw.specdriven",

export const MISSION_TEMPLATES_BY_ID = new Map(MISSION_TEMPLATES.map((x) => [x.id, x]));
export const MISSION_TEMPLATE_COUNT = MISSION_TEMPLATES.length;

export function templateCategories(): string[] {
  return [...new Set(MISSION_TEMPLATES.map((x) => x.category))].sort();
}

/** Turn a template into draft mission fields. The planner may still override. */
export function instantiateTemplate(templateId: string, objective: string) {
  const tpl = MISSION_TEMPLATES_BY_ID.get(templateId);
  if (!tpl) throw new Error(`unknown mission template: ${templateId}`);
  return {
    name: tpl.name,
    objective,
    description: tpl.description,
    constraints: [] as string[],
    templateId,
    preferredFramework: tpl.frameworkId,
    budget: { ...tpl.budget },
    successCriteria: tpl.criteria.map((c) =>
      makeCriterion(c.statement.replace("{subject}", objective), c.kind, {
        blocking: c.blocking,
        weight: c.weight,
        rubricId: c.rubricId,
      }),
    ),
    tags: [...tpl.tags],
  };
}

/** Pick the template that best matches free-text, for the "new mission" UX. */
export function suggestTemplate(objective: string): MissionTemplate {
  const q = objective.toLowerCase();
  let best = MISSION_TEMPLATES[0];
  let bestScore = -1;
  for (const tpl of MISSION_TEMPLATES) {
    let s = 0;
    if (q.includes(tpl.name.toLowerCase().split(" ")[0])) s += 3;
    for (const tag of tpl.tags) if (q.includes(tag)) s += 2;
    for (const word of tpl.name.toLowerCase().split(/\s+/)) {
      if (word.length > 3 && q.includes(word)) s += 1;
    }
    if (s > bestScore) {
      bestScore = s;
      best = tpl;
    }
  }
  return best;
}
```

## `src/domain/negotiation.ts`

```typescript
/**
 * MJ 6.0 — Agent-to-agent negotiation (spec §8).
 *
 * Agents may challenge, reject, request clarification, or propose alternatives.
 * Every disagreement is persisted as part of the mission trace — it is not chatter
 * that evaporates. The supervisor is the only party that can resolve a thread.
 */
import type { RiskClass } from "./risk";

export type NegotiationMoveKind =
  | "PROPOSAL"
  | "CHALLENGE"
  | "REJECTION"
  | "CLARIFICATION"
  | "ALTERNATIVE"
  | "EVIDENCE"
  | "CONCESSION"
  | "DECISION";

export const MOVE_KIND_LABEL: Record<NegotiationMoveKind, string> = {
  PROPOSAL: "Proposal",
  CHALLENGE: "Challenge",
  REJECTION: "Rejection",
  CLARIFICATION: "Clarification request",
  ALTERNATIVE: "Alternative proposal",
  EVIDENCE: "Evidence",
  CONCESSION: "Concession",
  DECISION: "Decision",
};

export const MOVE_KIND_COLOR: Record<NegotiationMoveKind, string> = {
  PROPOSAL: "#7ab8c9",
  CHALLENGE: "#e8a04a",
  REJECTION: "#e8341c",
  CLARIFICATION: "#9b8ec4",
  ALTERNATIVE: "#7ac98a",
  EVIDENCE: "#8a8a8a",
  CONCESSION: "#6a9ac4",
  DECISION: "#c9a66b",
};

export interface NegotiationMove {
  id: string;
  threadId: string;
  /** Slot id of the speaker, or "supervisor" / "user". */
  from: string;
  fromLabel: string;
  kind: NegotiationMoveKind;
  body: string;
  /** Artifact the speaker is pointing at, if any. */
  artifactId?: string;
  riskClass?: RiskClass;
  at: string;
}

export type NegotiationStatus = "OPEN" | "RESOLVED" | "ESCALATED" | "ABANDONED";

export interface NegotiationThread {
  id: string;
  missionId: string;
  orgId: string;
  topic: string;
  /** What is actually being decided. */
  question: string;
  participantIds: string[];
  moves: NegotiationMove[];
  status: NegotiationStatus;
  /** Set when resolved: the accepted option. */
  resolution?: string;
  resolvedBy?: string;
  /** Task or artifact the thread is about. */
  subjectTaskId?: string;
  subjectArtifactId?: string;
  openedAt: string;
  resolvedAt?: string;
  /** Round counter — the supervisor abandons a thread that loops too long. */
  round: number;
  maxRounds: number;
}

export const DEFAULT_MAX_ROUNDS = 3;

export function openThread(
  id: string,
  missionId: string,
  orgId: string,
  topic: string,
  question: string,
  participantIds: string[],
  opts: Partial<NegotiationThread> = {},
): NegotiationThread {
  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  return {
    id,
    missionId,
    orgId,
    topic,
    question,
    participantIds,
    moves: [],
    status: "OPEN",
    round: 0,
    maxRounds: DEFAULT_MAX_ROUNDS,
    openedAt: now,
    ...opts,
  };
}

/**
 * Detect a stalemate: the same two agents trading rejections with no new
 * alternative, or the round budget exhausted. The supervisor uses this to decide
 * between forcing a decision and escalating to a human (§5, §8).
 */
export function detectStalemate(t: NegotiationThread): {
  stale: boolean;
  reason?: string;
} {
  if (t.status !== "OPEN") return { stale: false };
  if (t.round >= t.maxRounds) {
    return { stale: true, reason: `Round budget exhausted (${t.round}/${t.maxRounds}).` };
  }
  const recent = t.moves.slice(-6);
  const rejections = recent.filter((m) => m.kind === "REJECTION" || m.kind === "CHALLENGE");
  const alternatives = recent.filter((m) => m.kind === "ALTERNATIVE" || m.kind === "PROPOSAL");
  if (rejections.length >= 3 && alternatives.length === 0) {
    return { stale: true, reason: "Repeated objections with no new alternative proposed." };
  }
  const speakers = new Set(recent.map((m) => m.from));
  if (recent.length >= 6 && speakers.size <= 2 && alternatives.length <= 1) {
    return { stale: true, reason: "Two agents looping without convergence." };
  }
  return { stale: false };
}

/** Compact transcript for feeding back into an agent context. */
export function renderThread(t: NegotiationThread, maxChars = 4000): string {
  const lines = [`# Negotiation: ${t.topic}`, `Question: ${t.question}`, ""];
  for (const m of t.moves) {
    lines.push(`- [${MOVE_KIND_LABEL[m.kind]}] ${m.fromLabel}: ${m.body}`);
  }
  if (t.resolution) lines.push("", `**Resolution:** ${t.resolution}`);
  const out = lines.join("\n");
  return out.length > maxChars ? `${out.slice(0, maxChars)}\n…(truncated)` : out;
}
```

```typescript
import { ROLE_PACKS } from "./rolePacks";

} from "./types";

export interface NodeDefinition {

  title: string;
  category: NodeCategory;
  group?: string;
  icon: string;
  description: string;

  outputs: PortDefinition[];

  configSchema?: {
    key: string;
    label: string;
    type: "text" | "textarea" | "number" | "boolean" | "select";
    options?: string[];
    default?: unknown;
  }[];

});

const outP = (port: PortDefinition): PortDefinition => ({ ...port, direction: "output" });

function packToDef(pack: (typeof ROLE_PACKS)[number]): NodeDefinition {
  return {
    id: `agent.pack.${pack.industry}.${pack.slug}`,
    title: pack.title,
    category: "agent",
    group: pack.industry,
    icon: pack.icon,
    description: `${pack.mission} Hermes-class agent. Not a Zapier step.`,
    inputs: [inP(p("brief", "Brief", "Text", { required: true })), inP(p("context", "Context", "any"))],
    outputs: [outP(p("deliverable", "Deliverable", "AgentResult", { required: true })), outP(p("notes", "Notes", "JSON"))],
    defaultPurpose: pack.mission,
    configSchema: [
      { key: "harness", label: "Runtime", type: "select", options: ["hermes", "claude", "codex", "opencode", "cursor", "grok", "cline", "kilo", "llm"], default: "hermes" },
    ],
    permissions: { filesystemRead: true, terminalExecute: true, mcpUse: true, memoryWrite: true, skillWrite: true },
    rolePrompt: rp({
      identity: `You are MJ ${pack.title}, a Hermes-class specialist (${pack.industry}).`,
      mission: pack.mission,
      operatingPrinciples: "Stay in this identity. Prefer evidence. Mark unknowns. Never invent tools. Fail closed. You are an autonomous worker, not an n8n step.",
      procedures: `1. Restate the brief as a testable outcome.\n2. Use Hermes tools when granted.\n3. Verify against: ${pack.mission}\n4. Emit the deliverable. Call finish.`,
      toolStrategy: "Use only granted tools. Coding CLIs (Claude/Codex/OpenCode) if harness is set to them.",
      verificationStrategy: "The deliverable must be usable without you present.",
      collaborationRules: "Peers consume deliverable + notes. Shared team memory if teamMemoryKey is set.",
      learningRules: stdLearning(`Improve ${pack.title} craft from ratings.`),
      invariants: stdInvariants(`a ${pack.title}`),
    }),
  };
}

function preset(slug: string, title: string, description: string, purpose: string): NodeDefinition[] {
  return [
    {
      id: `agent.preset.${slug}`,
      title,
      category: "agent",
      group: "presets",
      icon: "spark",
      description,
      inputs: [inP(p("brief", "Brief", "Text", { required: true })), inP(p("context", "Context", "any"))],
      outputs: [outP(p("deliverable", "Deliverable", "Markdown", { required: true })), outP(p("notes", "Notes", "JSON"))],
      defaultPurpose: purpose,
      rolePrompt: rp({
        identity: `You are MJ ${title}, a specialist agent.`,
        mission: purpose,
        operatingPrinciples: "Stay in role. Prefer evidence. Mark unknowns. No secrets.",
        procedures: `PROCEDURE\n1. Parse the brief.\n2. Apply ${title.toLowerCase()} craft.\n3. Verify against the brief.\n4. Emit the deliverable.`,
        toolStrategy: "Use only granted tools.",
        verificationStrategy: "The deliverable must be usable without you present.",
        collaborationRules: "Peers consume Markdown + notes JSON.",
        learningRules: stdLearning(`Improve ${title.toLowerCase()} craft from ratings.`),
        invariants: stdInvariants(`a ${title}`),
      }),
    },
  ];
}

export const DEFINITIONS_BY_ID = new Map(NODE_DEFINITIONS.map((d) => [d.id, d]));

export function cloneRolePrompt(src: RolePrompt): RolePrompt {
  return { version: src.version, sections: { ...src.sections } };
}

export const CATEGORY_LABEL: Record<NodeCategory, string> = {
  agent: "Agents",
  control: "Control",
  capability: "Capabilities",
  note: "Notes",
};
```

## `src/domain/organization.ts`

```typescript
/**
 * MJ 6.0 — Organization, agent contracts, and tasks (spec §3, §9).
 *
 * V5's TeamWorkspace was a saved roster. V6's Organization is a *live* object with an
 * open roster: the candidate pool A* is fixed at staffing time, but the active set A
 * changes while the mission runs. That distinction is what makes reorganization a
 * first-class operation rather than an edit-the-graph side effect.
 */
import type { PermissionSet } from "./types";
import type { MutationKind } from "./charter";
import type { RiskClass } from "./risk";

export type AgentSlotStatus =
  | "IDLE"
  | "ASSIGNED"
  | "RUNNING"
  | "PAUSED"
  | "WAITING_APPROVAL"
  | "SUCCEEDED"
  | "FAILED"
  | "STALLED"
  | "RETIRED";

export const AGENT_SLOT_STATUSES: AgentSlotStatus[] = [
  "IDLE", "ASSIGNED", "RUNNING", "PAUSED", "WAITING_APPROVAL",
  "SUCCEEDED", "FAILED", "STALLED", "RETIRED",
];

export const AGENT_SLOT_COLOR: Record<AgentSlotStatus, string> = {
  IDLE: "#6a6a6a",
  ASSIGNED: "#7ab8c9",
  RUNNING: "#c9a66b",
  PAUSED: "#8a8a5a",
  WAITING_APPROVAL: "#e8834a",
  SUCCEEDED: "#4c8",
  FAILED: "#e8341c",
  STALLED: "#c96b6b",
  RETIRED: "#4a4a4a",
};

/**
 * §9 — every agent participating in a mission must expose a contract.
 * The runtime refuses to run an agent whose contract is incomplete, and never
 * grants permissions beyond the AND of (contract.permissions, charter ceiling).
 */
export interface AgentContract {
  identity: string;
  purpose: string;
  capabilities: string[];
  inputs: string[];
  outputs: string[];
  permissions: PermissionSet;
  /** Sub-budget for this agent. */
  budget: {
    maxCostUsd: number;
    maxTokens: number;
    timeoutMs: number;
    maxToolSteps: number;
    maxRetries: number;
  };
  successCriteria: string[];
  /** What to do on failure: retry / repair / escalate / abort. */
  failurePolicy: "RETRY" | "REPAIR" | "ESCALATE" | "ABORT";
  /** When to stop and ask. */
  escalationPolicy: {
    onRiskClass: RiskClass;
    afterFailures: number;
    onLowConfidence: number;
  };
}

export interface AgentScorecard {
  tasksAssigned: number;
  tasksCompleted: number;
  tasksFailed: number;
  /** Mean independent evaluation score (0–5). */
  meanScore: number;
  /** Marginal contribution estimate, Shapley-inspired (§22 evidence, not truth). */
  contribution: number;
  totalCostUsd: number;
  totalLatencyMs: number;
  inputTokens: number;
  outputTokens: number;
  toolFailures: number;
  repairsUsed: number;
  lastError?: string;
  lastActiveAt?: string;
}

export function emptyScorecard(): AgentScorecard {
  return {
    tasksAssigned: 0,
    tasksCompleted: 0,
    tasksFailed: 0,
    meanScore: 0,
    contribution: 0,
    totalCostUsd: 0,
    totalLatencyMs: 0,
    inputTokens: 0,
    outputTokens: 0,
    toolFailures: 0,
    repairsUsed: 0,
  };
}

export interface AgentSlot {
  id: string;
  orgId: string;
  /** Role-pack slug or node definition id. */
  roleKey: string;
  title: string;
  definitionId: string;
  harness: string;
  teamId?: string;
  status: AgentSlotStatus;
  contract: AgentContract;
  scorecard: AgentScorecard;
  /** Node id in the compiled phase graph, once materialized (§30). */
  nodeId?: string;
  /** Phase this slot is currently working in. */
  phaseId?: string;
  /** In the candidate pool but not currently staffed (open roster). */
  active: boolean;
  /** Why this slot exists — recorded for the flight recorder. */
  spawnedReason: string;
  spawnedAt: string;
  /** Set when replaced — points at the successor slot. */
  replacedBy?: string;
  retiredAt?: string;
}

export type TaskStatus =
  | "PENDING"
  | "DELEGATED"
  | "RUNNING"
  | "BLOCKED"
  | "COMPLETED"
  | "FAILED"
  | "SPLIT"
  | "MERGED";

export const TASK_STATUSES: TaskStatus[] = [
  "PENDING", "DELEGATED", "RUNNING", "BLOCKED", "COMPLETED", "FAILED", "SPLIT", "MERGED",
];

/**
 * §24 — tasks are classified so the scheduler can decide what may run together.
 *  PARALLEL_SAFE   — no shared mutable state, order irrelevant.
 *  SEQUENTIAL      — must follow its predecessors.
 *  DEPENDENCY_BOUND— waits on named artifacts, then can fan out.
 *  EXCLUSIVE       — holds a resource; nothing else may run alongside.
 *  APPROVAL_GATED  — cannot start until a human decides.
 */
export type ParallelismClass =
  | "PARALLEL_SAFE"
  | "SEQUENTIAL"
  | "DEPENDENCY_BOUND"
  | "EXCLUSIVE"
  | "APPROVAL_GATED";

export const PARALLELISM_CLASSES: ParallelismClass[] = [
  "PARALLEL_SAFE", "SEQUENTIAL", "DEPENDENCY_BOUND", "EXCLUSIVE", "APPROVAL_GATED",
];

export const PARALLELISM_LABEL: Record<ParallelismClass, string> = {
  PARALLEL_SAFE: "Parallel-safe",
  SEQUENTIAL: "Sequential",
  DEPENDENCY_BOUND: "Dependency-bound",
  EXCLUSIVE: "Exclusive",
  APPROVAL_GATED: "Approval-gated",
};

export interface MissionTask {
  id: string;
  orgId: string;
  missionId: string;
  phaseId: string;
  title: string;
  instruction: string;
  /** Slot currently owning the task. */
  assigneeId?: string;
  /** Slots that have held this task, in order. */
  assigneeHistory: string[];
  status: TaskStatus;
  parallelism: ParallelismClass;
  dependsOn: string[];
  /** Input artifact ids. */
  inputs: string[];
  /** Output artifact ids. */
  outputs: string[];
  riskClass: RiskClass;
  attempts: number;
  maxAttempts: number;
  /**
   * Content hash of each attempt's output, in order.
   *
   * This exists to detect step repetition — the single largest multi-agent failure
   * mode in the MAST taxonomy (15.7% of all failures, ahead of every other mode).
   * An agent that produces byte-identical output on a retry has not tried again; it
   * has done the same thing twice. Without the hashes that is invisible: the task
   * just looks like it failed twice.
   */
  attemptHashes: string[];
  /** Child tasks when SPLIT. */
  splitInto?: string[];
  /** Parent when produced by a split. */
  splitFrom?: string;
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
  completedAt?: string;
  error?: string;
}

export type PhaseStatus =
  | "PENDING"
  | "RUNNING"
  | "COMPLETED"
  | "FAILED"
  | "SKIPPED";

export interface OrgPhase {
  id: string;
  orgId: string;
  name: string;
  rationale: string;
  /** Topology used to compile this phase (§3 change execution strategy). */
  topology: string;
  /** Compiled V5-style graph — the authoritative execution artifact (§30). */
  graphId?: string;
  status: PhaseStatus;
  taskIds: string[];
  /** Evaluation result for the phase as a whole. */
  score?: number;
  startedAt?: string;
  completedAt?: string;
}

export interface OrgMetrics {
  totalCostUsd: number;
  totalTokens: number;
  wallClockMs: number;
  nodeRuns: number;
  reorganizations: number;
  repairsAttempted: number;
  repairsSucceeded: number;
  humanInterventions: number;
  regressions: number;
}

export function emptyOrgMetrics(): OrgMetrics {
  return {
    totalCostUsd: 0,
    totalTokens: 0,
    wallClockMs: 0,
    nodeRuns: 0,
    reorganizations: 0,
    repairsAttempted: 0,
    repairsSucceeded: 0,
    humanInterventions: 0,
    regressions: 0,
  };
}

export interface Organization {
  id: string;
  missionId: string;
  charterId: string;
  frameworkId: string;
  /** Current topology — may change at runtime (§3, §17). */
  topology: string;
  /** Full candidate pool A*. */
  candidatePool: AgentSlot[];
  /** Active set A — ids into candidatePool. */
  active: string[];
  teams: OrgTeam[];
  phases: OrgPhase[];
  tasks: MissionTask[];
  /** Shared blackboard namespace. */
  blackboardKey: string;
  /** Shared constitution evolved across missions (Meta-Team L3). */
  constitutionId: string;
  /** How many times this org has reorganized. */
  generation: number;
  metrics: OrgMetrics;
  status: "FORMING" | "ACTIVE" | "REORGANIZING" | "PAUSED" | "DISBANDED";
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
}

export interface OrgTeam {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  /** Slot ids belonging to this team. */
  memberIds: string[];
  leadId?: string;
  purpose: string;
}

/** §3 — the organization operations the runtime must support. */
export type OrgOperation =
  | "SPAWN_AGENT"
  | "REMOVE_AGENT"
  | "REPLACE_AGENT"
  | "PAUSE_AGENT"
  | "RESUME_AGENT"
  | "DELEGATE_TASK"
  | "REASSIGN_TASK"
  | "SPLIT_TASK"
  | "MERGE_TASK"
  | "CHANGE_FRAMEWORK"
  | "CHANGE_STRATEGY"
  | "ESCALATE_TO_HUMAN";

export const ORG_OPERATIONS: OrgOperation[] = [
  "SPAWN_AGENT", "REMOVE_AGENT", "REPLACE_AGENT", "PAUSE_AGENT", "RESUME_AGENT",

export function activeSlots(org: Organization): AgentSlot[] {
  const set = new Set(org.active);
  return org.candidatePool.filter((s) => set.has(s.id));
}

export function slotById(org: Organization, id: string): AgentSlot | undefined {
  return org.candidatePool.find((s) => s.id === id);
```

```typescript
/**
 * MJ 6.0 — Agent reputation and harness routing evidence (spec §7, §22).
 *
 * Reputation is EVIDENCE, NEVER TRUTH (§7). Two mechanisms keep it honest:
 *  1. Bayesian shrinkage toward a prior, so a harness with 2 lucky runs cannot
 *     outrank one with 200 solid runs.
 *  2. Time decay, so a harness that was good six months ago drifts back toward the
 *     prior unless it keeps earning. Nothing here is a hardcoded assumption.
 */
import type { RiskClass } from "./risk";

export type TaskKind =
  | "coding"
  | "refactor"
  | "testing"
  | "security"
  | "review"
  | "research"
  | "architecture"
  | "documentation"
  | "debugging"
  | "migration"
  | "data"
  | "ops";

export const TASK_KINDS: TaskKind[] = [
  "coding", "refactor", "testing", "security", "review", "research",
  "architecture", "documentation", "debugging", "migration", "data", "ops",
];

/** A single observed outcome. Append-only; the store derives statistics. */
export interface ReputationObservation {
  id: string;
  /** "harness:claude" or "slot:<id>" or "team:<id>" or "framework:<id>". */
  subject: string;
  taskKind: TaskKind;
  /** Optional scope key, e.g. a repo path or language. */
  scope?: string;
  success: boolean;
  score: number; // 0–5, independent evaluation
  costUsd: number;
  latencyMs: number;
  missionId?: string;
  observedAt: string;
}

export interface ReputationStat {
  subject: string;
  taskKind: TaskKind;
  scope: string;
  samples: number;
  successRate: number;
  meanScore: number;
  medianLatencyMs: number;
  meanCostUsd: number;
  /** Shrunk + decayed score actually used for routing. */
  adjustedScore: number;
  lastObservedAt: string;
}

/** Belief strength of the prior, in pseudo-observations. */
const PRIOR_STRENGTH = 5;
const PRIOR_SUCCESS = 0.6;
const PRIOR_SCORE = 3.0;
/** Half-life of an observation, in days. */
const HALF_LIFE_DAYS = 45;

function decayWeight(observedAt: string, now: number): number {
  const ageDays = (now - new Date(observedAt).getTime()) / 86_400_000;
  if (!Number.isFinite(ageDays) || ageDays < 0) return 1;
  return Math.pow(0.5, ageDays / HALF_LIFE_DAYS);
}

function median(values: number[]): number {
  if (!values.length) return 0;
  const s = [...values].sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const m = Math.floor(s.length / 2);
  return s.length % 2 ? s[m] : (s[m - 1] + s[m]) / 2;
}

/**
 * Aggregate observations into a routing statistic.
 * adjustedScore = shrunk(successRate)*0.6 + shrunk(meanScore/5)*0.4, both decayed.
 */
export function computeStat(
  observations: ReputationObservation[],
  subject: string,
  taskKind: TaskKind,
  scope = "*",
  now = Date.now(),
): ReputationStat {
  const rows = observations.filter(
    (o) =>
      o.subject === subject &&
      o.taskKind === taskKind &&
      (scope === "*" || o.scope === scope || o.scope === undefined),
  );

  let wSum = 0;
  let succW = 0;
  let scoreW = 0;
  let costSum = 0;
  const latencies: number[] = [];
  let last = "";

  for (const o of rows) {
    const w = decayWeight(o.observedAt, now);
    wSum += w;
    succW += (o.success ? 1 : 0) * w;
    scoreW += (o.score / 5) * w;
    costSum += o.costUsd;
    latencies.push(o.latencyMs);
    if (o.observedAt > last) last = o.observedAt;
  }

  const shrunkSuccess = (succW + PRIOR_STRENGTH * PRIOR_SUCCESS) / (wSum + PRIOR_STRENGTH);
  const shrunkScore = (scoreW + PRIOR_STRENGTH * (PRIOR_SCORE / 5)) / (wSum + PRIOR_STRENGTH);
  const adjusted = shrunkSuccess * 0.6 + shrunkScore * 0.4;

  return {
    subject,
    taskKind,
    scope,
    samples: rows.length,
    successRate: wSum ? succW / wSum : 0,
    meanScore: rows.length ? (rows.reduce((a, b) => a + b.score, 0) / rows.length) : 0,
    medianLatencyMs: median(latencies),
    meanCostUsd: rows.length ? costSum / rows.length : 0,
    adjustedScore: adjusted,
    lastObservedAt: last,
  };
}

export interface HarnessCandidate {
  harnessId: string;
  installed: boolean;
  supportsTaskKind: boolean;
  /** Permission-compatible with the contract and the charter ceiling. */
  permissionOk: boolean;
  estimatedCostUsd: number;
  estimatedLatencyMs: number;
  reputation?: ReputationStat;
  /** Combined routing score, higher is better. */
  score: number;
  /** Human-readable justification for the flight recorder (§6, §32). */
  rationale: string;
}

/**
 * Rank harnesses for a task. Blends reputation evidence with cost and latency.
 * Deliberately not a pure argmax on reputation: a 1% better harness that costs 5x
 * and takes 3x longer should lose.
 */
export function rankHarnesses(candidates: HarnessCandidate[]): HarnessCandidate[] {
  const eligible = candidates.filter((c) => c.installed && c.supportsTaskKind && c.permissionOk);
  const pool = eligible.length ? eligible : candidates.filter((c) => c.installed);
  return pool
    .map((c) => {
      const rep = c.reputation?.adjustedScore ?? 0.5;
      // Normalize cost/latency against the pool so the blend is scale-free.
      const maxCost = Math.max(...pool.map((p) => p.estimatedCostUsd), 1e-6);
      const maxLat = Math.max(...pool.map((p) => p.estimatedLatencyMs), 1e-6);
      const costPenalty = 0.2 * (c.estimatedCostUsd / maxCost);
      const latPenalty = 0.15 * (c.estimatedLatencyMs / maxLat);
      const score = rep - costPenalty - latPenalty;
      const reason =
        `reputation ${rep.toFixed(2)}` +
        (c.reputation ? ` (n=${c.reputation.samples}, ${(c.reputation.successRate * 100).toFixed(0)}% success)` : " (no history)") +
        ` − cost ${costPenalty.toFixed(3)} − latency ${latPenalty.toFixed(3)}`;
      return { ...c, score, rationale: reason };
    })
    .sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
}

/** Subject keys used in the observation log. */
export function harnessSubject(harnessId: string): string {
  return `harness:${harnessId}`;
}
export function slotSubject(slotId: string): string {
  return `slot:${slotId}`;
}
export function teamSubject(teamId: string): string {
  return `team:${teamId}`;
}
export function frameworkSubject(frameworkId: string): string {
  return `framework:${frameworkId}`;
}

/**
 * Which task kinds each harness is genuinely good at. These are *starting priors*
 * expressed as soft hints — they are always overridden by enough local evidence
 * because adjustedScore shrinks toward the generic prior, not toward these.
 */
export const HARNESS_AFFINITY: Record<string, TaskKind[]> = {
  claude: ["coding", "refactor", "architecture", "review", "debugging"],
  codex: ["testing", "migration", "refactor", "coding", "review"],
  opencode: ["coding", "refactor", "ops", "data"],
  kilo: ["coding", "refactor", "documentation"],
  cursor: ["coding", "refactor", "documentation"],
  cline: ["coding", "ops", "migration"],
  grok: ["research", "coding", "debugging"],
  hermes: ["research", "coding", "review", "architecture", "security", "documentation", "testing"],
  llm: ["research", "review", "documentation", "architecture"],
};

export function supportsTaskKind(harnessId: string, kind: TaskKind): boolean {
  const aff = HARNESS_AFFINITY[harnessId];
  return !aff || aff.includes(kind);
}

/** Risk class implied by a task kind, used when a task has no explicit class. */
export function defaultRiskForTask(kind: TaskKind): RiskClass {
  switch (kind) {
    case "security":
    case "ops":
    case "migration":
      return "HIGH";
    case "coding":
    case "refactor":
    case "debugging":
    case "data":
      return "MEDIUM";
    default:
      return "LOW";
  }
}
```

## `src/domain/risk.ts`

```typescript
/**
 * MJ 6.0 — Risk-aware autonomy (spec §10, §11).
 *
 * Every action an agent can take is classified into a consequence class. Policy
 * decides whether the action runs free, runs under validation, needs approval, or
 * is refused outright. The mapping is data, not scattered if-statements, so the UI
 * can render the policy table and the user can edit it.
 */
import type { RiskTier } from "./charter";

export type RiskClass = "LOW" | "MEDIUM" | "HIGH" | "CRITICAL";

export const RISK_CLASSES: RiskClass[] = ["LOW", "MEDIUM", "HIGH", "CRITICAL"];

export const RISK_CLASS_RANK: Record<RiskClass, number> = {
  LOW: 0,
  MEDIUM: 1,
  HIGH: 2,
  CRITICAL: 3,
};

export const RISK_CLASS_COLOR: Record<RiskClass, string> = {
  LOW: "#4c8",
  MEDIUM: "#c9a66b",
  HIGH: "#e8834a",
  CRITICAL: "#e8341c",
};

/**
 * How a risk class is handled.
 *  AUTONOMOUS — runs without stopping.
 *  SUPERVISED — runs, but the action and its evidence are recorded and evaluated.
 *  HUMAN_ONLY — blocks until a human decides. First-class execution state (§11).
 */
export type Handling = "AUTONOMOUS" | "SUPERVISED" | "HUMAN_ONLY";

export const HANDLING_LABEL: Record<Handling, string> = {
  AUTONOMOUS: "Autonomous",
  SUPERVISED: "Supervised",
  HUMAN_ONLY: "Human only",
};

export interface RiskPolicy {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  /** Handling per risk class. */
  handling: Record<RiskClass, Handling>;
  /** Highest class the org may reach at all; anything above is refused. */
  maxAutonomousClass: RiskClass;
  /** Mission risk tier, inherited from the charter. */
  tier: RiskTier;
  /** When true, CRITICAL is refused rather than queued for approval. */
  refuseCritical: boolean;
}

export const DEFAULT_RISK_POLICY: Omit<RiskPolicy, "id" | "tier"> = {
  name: "Standard risk policy",
  handling: {
    LOW: "AUTONOMOUS",
    MEDIUM: "SUPERVISED",
    HIGH: "HUMAN_ONLY",
    CRITICAL: "HUMAN_ONLY",
  },
  maxAutonomousClass: "MEDIUM",
  refuseCritical: false,
};

/**
 * Action patterns per risk class. Matched against a normalized action descriptor
 * like `fs:write`, `git:push`, `shell:rm -rf /`, `deploy:production`.
 */
const CLASS_PATTERNS: Array<{ cls: RiskClass; patterns: RegExp }> = [
  {
    cls: "CRITICAL",
    patterns: /^(deploy:production|delete:data|delete:repository|credential:.*|iam:.*|identity:.*|secret:write|git:force-push|git:push\s+--force|spend:.*|send:external.*|drop:table|truncate:.*)/i,
  },
  {
    cls: "HIGH",
    patterns: /^(git:push|git:commit\s+--amend|infra:.*|deploy:.*|ci:.*|publish:.*|release:.*|pr:merge|branch:delete|config:production|schema:migrate|rollback:production)/i,
  },
  {
    cls: "MEDIUM",
    patterns: /^(fs:write|fs:delete|fs:mkdir|shell:install|package:install|package:remove|code:edit|code:refactor|config:write|test:write|db:write|db:migrate|mcp:.*|skill:write)/i,
  },
  {
    cls: "LOW",
    patterns: /^(fs:read|fs:list|shell:test|shell:lint|shell:build|code:read|research:.*|memory:read|memory:write|log:.*|inspect:.*|search:.*|git:status|git:diff|git:log|analysis:.*)/i,
  },
];

/** Classify an action descriptor. Unknown actions are MEDIUM — never LOW by default. */
export function classifyAction(action: string): RiskClass {
  const a = action.trim();
  if (!a) return "LOW";
  for (const { cls, patterns } of CLASS_PATTERNS) {
    if (patterns.test(a)) return cls;
  }
  return "MEDIUM";
}

export function handlingFor(policy: RiskPolicy, cls: RiskClass): Handling {
  if (cls === "CRITICAL" && policy.refuseCritical) return "HUMAN_ONLY";
  return policy.handling[cls];
}

export function atLeast(a: RiskClass, b: RiskClass): boolean {
  return RISK_CLASS_RANK[a] >= RISK_CLASS_RANK[b];
}
```

## `src/domain/rubrics.ts`

```typescript
/**
 * MJ 6.0 — Evaluation rubrics (spec §18).
 *
 * V5 scored fitness with a heuristic string-length/keyword function. V6 uses anchored
 * rubrics judged by an independent model, with these disciplines baked in:
 *  - Score ONE dimension at a time; never a single "overall quality" number.
 *  - Reasoning BEFORE score: the judge commits to evidence, then commits to a number.
 *  - Small scale (0–5). Models cannot meaningfully distinguish 73 from 76.
 *  - Judges come from a different model family than the agent under test, which
 *    mitigates self-enhancement bias.
 *
 * An agent is never the sole authority on its own success (§18).
 */

export interface RubricDimension {
  key: string;
  label: string;
  /** Anchors describe what each score level means. Specificity is the whole point. */
  anchors: Record<0 | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5, string>;
  weight: number;
}

export interface Rubric {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  description: string;
  /** What the judge is told to assume about the task domain. */
  domain: string;
  dimensions: RubricDimension[];
  /** Hard fails: if any of these is true, score is capped at 1 regardless. */
  hardFails: string[];
}

function anchors(a: [string, string, string, string, string, string]): Record<0 | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5, string> {
  return { 0: a[0], 1: a[1], 2: a[2], 3: a[3], 4: a[4], 5: a[5] };
}

export const RUBRICS: Rubric[] = [
  {
    id: "rubric.generic-deliverable",
    name: "Generic deliverable",
    description: "Default rubric when no domain-specific one applies.",
    domain: "general knowledge work",
    dimensions: [
      {
        key: "correctness",
        label: "Correctness",
        weight: 2,
        anchors: anchors([
          "Fabricated, contradictory, or inert.",
          "Mostly wrong; core claims unsupported.",
          "Partly right; notable gaps or errors.",
          "Substantially right; minor issues remain.",
          "Correct with trivial imperfections.",
          "Correct, complete, and internally consistent.",
        ]),
      },
      {
        key: "completeness",
        label: "Completeness",
        weight: 2,
        anchors: anchors([
          "Empty or refuses the task.",
          "Addresses a small fraction of what was asked.",
          "Addresses about half; obvious parts missing.",
          "Addresses most requirements.",
          "Addresses all but cosmetic items.",
          "Every stated requirement is addressed.",
        ]),
      },
      {
        key: "evidence",
        label: "Evidence & grounding",
        weight: 1.5,
        anchors: anchors([
          "No support of any kind.",
          "Assertions only, no sources or verification.",

export const RUBRICS_BY_ID = new Map(RUBRICS.map((r) => [r.id, r]));

export function getRubric(id: string): Rubric {
  return RUBRICS_BY_ID.get(id) ?? RUBRICS[0];
}

export const RUBRIC_COUNT = RUBRICS.length;

/**
 * Build the judge prompt. Reused by the TS evaluator and the Python evolution
 * service so both score identically.
 */
export function buildJudgePrompt(
  rubric: Rubric,
  task: string,
  output: string,
  context: string[] = [],
): string {
  const dims = rubric.dimensions
    .map((d) => {
      const a = [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
        .map((lvl) => `      ${lvl}: ${d.anchors[lvl as 0 | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5]}`)
        .join("\n");
      return `  - ${d.key} (${d.label}):\n${a}`;
    })
    .join("\n");

  return `You are an independent evaluator in the domain of ${rubric.domain}.
You did NOT produce the output below. Judge it against the anchored rubric.

TASK:
${task.slice(0, 4000)}

${context.length ? `CONTEXT:\n${context.join("\n").slice(0, 2000)}\n` : ""}
OUTPUT UNDER EVALUATION:
${output.slice(0, 8000)}

RUBRIC (score each dimension 0–5 using ONLY these anchors):
${dims}

HARD FAILS — if any is true, every dimension is capped at 1:
${rubric.hardFails.map((h) => `  - ${h}`).join("\n")}

PROCEDURE — you MUST follow this order:
1. Quote the specific evidence you are relying on. Be concrete.
2. For EACH dimension: write your reasoning first, THEN the score.
3. State whether any hard fail applies.
4. Note anything the output conspicuously failed to address.

Do not be lenient because the output is long or well-formatted. Verbosity is not quality.

Respond with JSON only, no prose outside it:
{
  "evidence": ["..."],
  "dimensions": { "<key>": { "reasoning": "...", "score": 0 } },
  "hardFail": null,
  "missed": ["..."],
  "summary": "one sentence"
}`;
}

/** Weighted mean of dimension scores, 0–5. Returns null if unparseable. */
export function aggregateDimensionScores(
  rubric: Rubric,
  scores: Record<string, number>,
): number | null {
  let wSum = 0;
  let acc = 0;
  let any = false;
  for (const d of rubric.dimensions) {
    const s = scores[d.key];
    if (typeof s === "number" && Number.isFinite(s)) {
      acc += Math.max(0, Math.min(5, s)) * d.weight;
      wSum += d.weight;
      any = true;
    }
  }
  if (!any || !wSum) return null;
  return acc / wSum;
}
```
