## `src/domain/scorecard.ts`

```typescript
/**
 * MJ 6.0 — Mission success score (spec §19).
 *
 * Deliberately multi-dimensional. §19: "Do not collapse everything into one
 * meaningless number." We expose a headline composite for at-a-glance use, but the
 * UI always renders the dimensions separately, and a mission can pass the composite
 * while still failing a blocking dimension.
 */

export type ScoreDimension =
  | "goalCompletion"
  | "quality"
  | "tests"
  | "security"
  | "cost"
  | "latency"
  | "autonomy"
  | "regression";

export interface DimensionScore {
  dimension: ScoreDimension;
  /** Normalized 0–100. */
  value: number;
  weight: number;
  /** Raw evidence, e.g. "18/20 criteria met". */
  detail: string;
  blocking: boolean;
  passed: boolean;
}

export const DIMENSION_LABEL: Record<ScoreDimension, string> = {
  goalCompletion: "Goal completion",
  quality: "Quality",
  tests: "Tests",
  security: "Security",
  cost: "Cost efficiency",
  latency: "Latency",
  autonomy: "Autonomy",
  regression: "Regression-freedom",
};

export const DIMENSION_HELP: Record<ScoreDimension, string> = {
  goalCompletion: "Weighted share of blocking success criteria that were met.",
  quality: "Mean independent rubric score across evaluated artifacts.",
  tests: "Share of test/check commands that passed.",
  security: "Security review outcome; penalized by unresolved HIGH/CRITICAL findings.",
  cost: "1 − (spend / budget), clamped. Rewards getting there cheaply.",
  latency: "1 − (elapsed / deadline-or-ceiling), clamped.",
  autonomy: "1 − (human interventions / interventions allowed). Higher = ran more on its own.",
  regression: "1 − (regressions / artifacts evaluated). Any regression is a hard smell.",
};

export interface MissionScore {
  dimensions: DimensionScore[];
  /** Weighted composite 0–100. Shown, but never alone. */
  composite: number;
  /** True only if every blocking dimension passed. */
  passed: boolean;
  humanInterventions: number;
  regressionCount: number;
  computedAt: string;
}

export interface ScoreInputs {
  criteriaMet: number;
  criteriaTotal: number;
  blockingFailed: number;
  meanRubricScore: number; // 0–5
  testsRun: number;
  testsPassed: number;
  securityFindings: number;
  unresolvedHighOrCritical: number;
  costUsd: number;
  costBudgetUsd: number;
  elapsedMs: number;
  budgetMs: number;
  humanInterventions: number;
  interventionsAllowed: number;
  artifactsEvaluated: number;
  regressions: number;
}

function dim(
  dimension: ScoreDimension,
  value: number,
  weight: number,
  detail: string,
  blocking: boolean,
  passed: boolean,
): DimensionScore {
  return { dimension, value: clamp(value), weight, detail, blocking, passed };
}

function clamp(n: number, lo = 0, hi = 100): number {
  if (!Number.isFinite(n)) return lo;
  return Math.max(lo, Math.min(hi, n));
}

export function computeMissionScore(i: ScoreInputs): MissionScore {
  const goalCompletion = i.criteriaTotal ? (i.criteriaMet / i.criteriaTotal) * 100 : 0;
  const quality = (i.meanRubricScore / 5) * 100;
  const tests = i.testsRun ? (i.testsPassed / i.testsRun) * 100 : (i.blockingFailed ? 0 : 100);
  const security =
    i.unresolvedHighOrCritical > 0
      ? clamp(100 - i.unresolvedHighOrCritical * 35 - i.securityFindings * 5)
      : clamp(100 - i.securityFindings * 8);
  const cost = i.costBudgetUsd > 0 ? clamp((1 - i.costUsd / i.costBudgetUsd) * 100) : 100;
  const latency = i.budgetMs > 0 ? clamp((1 - i.elapsedMs / i.budgetMs) * 100) : 100;
  const autonomy =
    i.interventionsAllowed > 0
      ? clamp((1 - i.humanInterventions / i.interventionsAllowed) * 100)
      : i.humanInterventions === 0
        ? 100
        : 0;
  const regression = i.artifactsEvaluated
    ? clamp((1 - i.regressions / i.artifactsEvaluated) * 100)
    : 100;

  const dimensions: DimensionScore[] = [
    dim("goalCompletion", goalCompletion, 3, `${i.criteriaMet}/${i.criteriaTotal} criteria met`, true, i.blockingFailed === 0 && goalCompletion >= 99),
    dim("quality", quality, 2, `${i.meanRubricScore.toFixed(2)}/5 mean rubric`, true, quality >= 70),
    dim("tests", tests, 2, `${i.testsPassed}/${i.testsRun} checks passed`, true, i.testsRun === 0 || tests >= 99),
    dim("security", security, 2, `${i.unresolvedHighOrCritical} unresolved high/critical`, true, i.unresolvedHighOrCritical === 0),
    dim("cost", cost, 1, `$${i.costUsd.toFixed(2)} / $${i.costBudgetUsd.toFixed(2)}`, false, true),
    dim("latency", latency, 1, `${(i.elapsedMs / 60000).toFixed(1)}m / ${(i.budgetMs / 60000).toFixed(0)}m`, false, true),
    dim("autonomy", autonomy, 1, `${i.humanInterventions} interventions`, false, true),
    dim("regression", regression, 2, `${i.regressions} regressions`, true, i.regressions === 0),
  ];

  const wSum = dimensions.reduce((a, d) => a + d.weight, 0);
  const composite = wSum ? dimensions.reduce((a, d) => a + d.value * d.weight, 0) / wSum : 0;
  const passed = dimensions.filter((d) => d.blocking).every((d) => d.passed);

  return {
    dimensions,
    composite,
    passed,
    humanInterventions: i.humanInterventions,
    regressionCount: i.regressions,
    computedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  };
}

export function renderScorecard(s: MissionScore): string {
  const lines = [
    `Composite ${s.composite.toFixed(0)}/100 — ${s.passed ? "PASSED" : "FAILED"}`,
    "",
  ];
  for (const d of s.dimensions) {
    const bar = "█".repeat(Math.round(d.value / 10)).padEnd(10, "░");
    lines.push(
      `${DIMENSION_LABEL[d.dimension].padEnd(20)} ${bar} ${d.value.toFixed(0).padStart(3)}  ${d.detail}${d.blocking ? " *" : ""}`,
    );
  }
  lines.push("", "* blocking dimension");
  return lines.join("\n");
}

```


## `src/domain/teams.ts`

```typescript
/**
 * MJ 6.0 — Teams.
 *
 * Two changes from V5:
 *  1. Persistence moved from `localStorage` to SQLite (via `src/ipc/v6.ts`). V5 kept
 *     teams in the browser profile while every other object was in SQLite, so teams
 *     vanished with the WebView cache and never appeared in a backup.
 *  2. `instantiateTeam` now implements every wiring pattern the framework declares.
 *     V5 collapsed 35 frameworks / 10 patterns into two shapes — a fan-out and a
 *     chain — so `debate`, `council`, `shadow`, `hierarchy`, `loop` and `gate` were
 *     declared but never actually wired differently.
 */
import { createNodeFromDef } from "../graph/factory";
import { AGENT_FRAMEWORKS, type AgentFramework } from "./frameworks";
import { DEFINITIONS_BY_ID } from "./nodeLibrary";
import type { Connection, NodeInstance, WorkflowGraph } from "./types";
import { GRAPH_SCHEMA_VERSION } from "./types";
import { v6 } from "../ipc/v6";

export interface TeamMember {
  definitionId: string;
  title: string;
  harness: string;
  purpose?: string;
}

export interface TeamWorkspace {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  description: string;
  /** Shared memory namespace so the same team remembers across tasks. */
  memoryKey: string;
  frameworkId: string;
  members: TeamMember[];
  /** Mission template this team is designed for, if any (§27). */
  templateId?: string;
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
}

export function teamFromFramework(
  fw: AgentFramework,
  name?: string,
): Omit<TeamWorkspace, "id" | "createdAt" | "updatedAt"> {
  const members: TeamMember[] = fw.roster
    .filter((id) => DEFINITIONS_BY_ID.has(id))
    .map((id) => {
      const def = DEFINITIONS_BY_ID.get(id)!;
      return {
        definitionId: id,
        title: def.title,
        harness: def.category === "agent" ? "hermes" : "",
      };
    });
  return {
    name: name || fw.name,
    description: fw.description,
    memoryKey: `team:${(name || fw.id).toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-")}`,
    frameworkId: fw.id,
    members,
  };
}

function rand(): string {
  return Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8);
}

/**
 * Materialize a team + task into a graph, honouring the framework's declared pattern.
 * Returns nodes plus logical wires as [fromKey, fromPort, toKey, toPort] where keys
 * are the `templateKey` markers set on each node.
 */
export function instantiateTeam(
  team: TeamWorkspace,
  task: string,
): { nodes: NodeInstance[]; wires: Array<[string, string, string, string]> } {
  const fw = AGENT_FRAMEWORKS.find((f) => f.id === team.frameworkId);
  const pattern = fw?.pattern ?? "pipeline";

  const nodes: NodeInstance[] = [];
  const wires: Array<[string, string, string, string]> = [];

  const startDef = DEFINITIONS_BY_ID.get("control.start");
  const endDef = DEFINITIONS_BY_ID.get("control.end");
  if (!startDef || !endDef) return { nodes, wires };

  const start = createNodeFromDef(startDef, `n-start-${rand()}`, 60, 260);
  start.templateKey = "s";
  start.config.initialPayload = JSON.stringify({ task }, null, 2);
  nodes.push(start);

  const agents: NodeInstance[] = [];
  team.members.forEach((m, i) => {
    const def = DEFINITIONS_BY_ID.get(m.definitionId);
    if (!def) return;
    const col = i % 5;
    const row = Math.floor(i / 5);
    const n = createNodeFromDef(def, `n-${i}-${rand()}`, 340 + col * 300, 60 + row * 240);
    n.templateKey = `m${i}`;
    n.title = m.title;
    if (def.category === "agent") {
      n.config.harness = m.harness || "hermes";
      n.config.teamMemoryKey = team.memoryKey;
      n.purpose = m.purpose || task;
      n.memoryEnabled = true;
    }
    agents.push(n);
    nodes.push(n);
  });

  const end = createNodeFromDef(endDef, `n-end-${rand()}`, 340 + Math.min(Math.max(agents.length, 1), 5) * 300, 260);
  end.templateKey = "e";
  nodes.push(end);

  const wire = (a: NodeInstance, ap: string, b: NodeInstance, bp: string) => {
    wires.push([String(a.templateKey), ap, String(b.templateKey), bp]);
  };
  const port = (n: NodeInstance, dir: "in" | "out", idx = 0) =>
    dir === "in" ? n.inputs[idx]?.id ?? "input" : n.outputs[idx]?.id ?? "output";

  if (agents.length === 0) {
    wire(start, "payload", end, "result");
    return { nodes, wires };
  }

  const isAgent = (n: NodeInstance) => n.definitionId.startsWith("agent.");
  const agentNodes = agents.filter(isAgent);
  const controlNodes = agents.filter((n) => !isAgent(n));

  switch (pattern) {
    case "map-reduce":
    case "swarm": {
      // Peers fan out in parallel; the last member reduces.
      if (agentNodes.length < 2) break;
      const reducer = agentNodes[agentNodes.length - 1];
      const peers = agentNodes.slice(0, -1);
      for (const p of peers) wire(start, "payload", p, port(p, "in"));
      for (const p of peers) wire(p, port(p, "out"), reducer, port(reducer, "in"));
      wire(reducer, port(reducer, "out"), end, "result");
      break;
    }
    case "council": {
      // Independent scorers; the last member binds as judge.
      if (agentNodes.length < 2) break;
      const judge = agentNodes[agentNodes.length - 1];
      const scorers = agentNodes.slice(0, -1);
      for (const s of scorers) wire(start, "payload", s, port(s, "in"));
      for (const s of scorers) wire(s, port(s, "out"), judge, port(judge, "in"));
      wire(judge, port(judge, "out"), end, "result");
      break;
    }
    case "shadow": {
      // Two variants of the same task in parallel, then a diff.
      if (agentNodes.length < 2) break;
      const variants = agentNodes.slice(0, 2);
      const synth = agentNodes[2] ?? agentNodes[agentNodes.length - 1];
      for (const v of variants) wire(start, "payload", v, port(v, "in"));
      for (const v of variants) wire(v, port(v, "out"), synth, port(synth, "in"));
      wire(synth, port(synth, "out"), end, "result");
      break;
    }
    case "debate": {
      // Proponent → critics (parallel) → proponent rebuttal → judge.
      if (agentNodes.length < 3) break;
      const proponent = agentNodes[0];
      const critics = agentNodes.slice(1, -1);
      const judge = agentNodes[agentNodes.length - 1];
      wire(start, "payload", proponent, port(proponent, "in"));
      for (const c of critics) wire(proponent, port(proponent, "out"), c, port(c, "in"));
      for (const c of critics) wire(c, port(c, "out"), judge, port(judge, "in"));
      wire(judge, port(judge, "out"), end, "result");
      break;
    }
    case "hierarchy": {
      // Supervisor opens, specialists work in parallel, supervisor closes.
      if (agentNodes.length < 2) break;
      const supervisor = agentNodes[0];
      const workers = agentNodes.slice(1);
      wire(start, "payload", supervisor, port(supervisor, "in"));
      for (const w of workers) wire(supervisor, port(supervisor, "out"), w, port(w, "in"));
      for (const w of workers) wire(w, port(w, "out"), supervisor, "input2");
      wire(supervisor, port(supervisor, "out"), end, "result");
      break;
    }
    case "pair": {
      // Driver → navigator → (tester if present).
      if (agentNodes.length < 2) break;
      const driver = agentNodes[0];
      const navigator = agentNodes[1];
      wire(start, "payload", driver, port(driver, "in"));
      wire(driver, port(driver, "out"), navigator, port(navigator, "in"));
      const tail = agentNodes[2];
      if (tail) {
        wire(navigator, port(navigator, "out"), tail, port(tail, "in"));
        wire(tail, port(tail, "out"), end, "result");
      } else {
        wire(navigator, port(navigator, "out"), end, "result");
      }
      break;
    }
    case "loop": {
      // Worker iterates; the last member verifies and the loop edge returns to it.
      if (agentNodes.length < 2) break;
      const worker = agentNodes[0];
      const verifier = agentNodes[agentNodes.length - 1];
      wire(start, "payload", worker, port(worker, "in"));
      wire(worker, port(worker, "out"), verifier, port(verifier, "in"));
      // The scheduler reads the `item` port as the loop-back edge.
      wire(verifier, "item", worker, port(worker, "in"));
      wire(verifier, port(verifier, "out"), end, "result");
      break;
    }
    case "gate": {
      // Produce sequentially, then gate (approval node if the roster has one).
      const gateNode = controlNodes.find((n) => n.definitionId === "control.approval");
      let prev: NodeInstance = start;
      let prevPort = "payload";
      for (const a of agentNodes) {
        wire(prev, prevPort, a, port(a, "in"));
        prev = a;
        prevPort = port(a, "out");
      }
      if (gateNode) {
        wire(prev, prevPort, gateNode, port(gateNode, "in"));
        wire(gateNode, port(gateNode, "out"), end, "result");
      } else {
        wire(prev, prevPort, end, "result");
      }
      break;
    }
    case "pipeline":
    default: {
      // Sequential chain through every member, control nodes included.
      let prev: NodeInstance = start;
      let prevPort = "payload";
      for (const a of agents) {
        wire(prev, prevPort, a, port(a, "in"));
        prev = a;
        prevPort = port(a, "out");
      }
      wire(prev, prevPort, end, "result");
      break;
    }
  }

  return { nodes, wires };
}

/** Resolve the logical wires returned above into real graph connections. */
export function teamToGraph(team: TeamWorkspace, task: string): WorkflowGraph {
  const { nodes, wires } = instantiateTeam(team, task);
  const byKey = new Map(nodes.map((n) => [String(n.templateKey), n]));
  const connections: Connection[] = [];
  for (const [fromKey, fromPort, toKey, toPort] of wires) {
    const a = byKey.get(fromKey);
    const b = byKey.get(toKey);
    if (!a || !b) continue;
    // A target port that does not exist on the node would create an invalid edge.
    const targetOk = b.inputs.some((p) => p.id === toPort) || toPort === "result";
    const targetPort = targetOk ? toPort : b.inputs[0]?.id ?? "input";
    connections.push({
      id: `c-${connections.length}-${rand()}`,
      sourceNodeId: a.id,
      sourcePortId: fromPort,
      targetNodeId: b.id,
      targetPortId: targetPort,
      dataType: "AgentResult",
      status: "idle",
    });
  }
  return {
    schemaVersion: GRAPH_SCHEMA_VERSION,
    id: `team-${team.id}`,
    name: team.name,
    nodes,
    connections,
    viewport: { x: 0, y: 0, zoom: 0.75 },
    groups: [],
    notes: [],
  };
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------- persistence
// V6: SQLite through Tauri, localStorage only as a browser fallback.

export async function loadTeams(): Promise<TeamWorkspace[]> {
  try {
    return await v6.teamList();
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

export async function saveTeam(team: TeamWorkspace): Promise<{ id: string }> {
  return v6.teamSave(team);
}

export async function deleteTeam(id: string): Promise<void> {
  await v6.teamDelete(id);
}

export function newTeam(body: Omit<TeamWorkspace, "id" | "createdAt" | "updatedAt">): TeamWorkspace {
  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  return {
    ...body,
    id: `team-${Date.now().toString(36)}-${rand()}`,
    createdAt: now,
    updatedAt: now,
  };
}
```

```typescript
export function templateFullyResolvable(id: string): boolean {
  const t = WORKFLOW_TEMPLATES.find((x) => x.id === id);
  if (!t) return false;
  return t.steps.every((s) => DEFINITIONS_BY_ID.has(s.defId));
}

export function loadTemplate(id: string): {
  instances: NodeInstance[];
  wires: Array<[string, string, string, string]>;
  skipped: string[];
} {
  const t = WORKFLOW_TEMPLATES.find((x) => x.id === id);
  if (!t) return { instances: [], wires: [], skipped: [id] };
  const skipped: string[] = [];
  const instances: NodeInstance[] = [];
  for (const step of t.steps) {
    const def = DEFINITIONS_BY_ID.get(step.defId);
    if (!def) {
      skipped.push(step.defId);
      continue;
    }
    const node = createNodeFromDef(def, `n-${step.key}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 7)}`, step.x, step.y);
    node.templateKey = step.key;
    if (step.purpose) node.purpose = step.purpose;
    instances.push(node);
  }
  return { instances, wires: t.wires, skipped };
}
```

## `src/engine/arbitration.ts`

```typescript
/**
 * MJ 6.0 — Agent arbitration layer (spec §6, §7).
 *
 * One common interface over every coding-agent CLI, so orchestration logic is
 * written once. Selection considers task type, language/framework, available tools,
 * permissions, historical success, latency, cost and prior failures — and treats
 * history as evidence, never as truth.
 */
import type { HarnessId } from "../domain/harness";
import { HARNESSES, HARNESS_BY_ID } from "../domain/harness";
import type { TaskKind } from "../domain/reputation";
import type { ReputationObservation, ReputationStat } from "../domain/reputation";
import { computeStat, defaultRiskForTask, harnessSubject, rankHarnesses, supportsTaskKind } from "../domain/reputation";
import type { HarnessCandidate } from "../domain/reputation";
import type { RiskClass } from "../domain/risk";
import type { AgentContract } from "../domain/organization";
import type { PermissionSet } from "../domain/types";

/**
 * §6 — the common interface. Every adapter implements exactly this; no orchestration
 * logic is duplicated per harness.
 */
export interface CodingAgentHarness {
  id: HarnessId;
  name: string;
  /** Capability claims, used for gap detection. */
  capabilities: HarnessCapability[];
  /** Whether the binary is present and authenticated on this machine. */
  detect(): Promise<HarnessAvailability>;
  /** Run one task. Returns raw output plus whatever telemetry the CLI exposes. */
  execute(req: HarnessExecutionRequest): Promise<HarnessExecutionResult>;
  /** Rough cost/latency model, used for routing before any call is made. */
  estimate(req: HarnessEstimateRequest): { costUsd: number; latencyMs: number };
  /** Translate a failure into a normalized class the repair ladder understands. */
  normalizeError(err: unknown): { class: string; retryable: boolean; detail: string };
}

export type HarnessCapability =
  | "code-edit"
  | "code-read"
  | "shell"
  | "test-run"
  | "git"
  | "web-search"
  | "mcp-client"
  | "multi-file-refactor"
  | "long-context";

export interface HarnessAvailability {
  installed: boolean;
  authenticated: boolean;
  version?: string;
  path?: string;
  /** Why it is unavailable, when it is. */
  reason?: string;
}

export interface HarnessExecutionRequest {
  /** Fully composed prompt: system + role + purpose + contract + context. */
  prompt: string;
  cwd?: string;
  timeoutMs: number;
  permissions: PermissionSet;
  contract: AgentContract;
  signal?: { aborted: boolean };
}

export interface HarnessExecutionResult {
  ok: boolean;
  output: string;
  error?: string;
  exitCode?: number;
  latencyMs: number;
  /** Model actually used, when the CLI reports it. */
  model?: string;
  harnessId: HarnessId;
}

export interface HarnessEstimateRequest {
  taskKind: TaskKind;
  promptChars: number;
  /** Expected output size multiplier. */
  expectedOutputRatio?: number;
}

/** Rough per-harness cost/latency profiles. Evidence-based defaults, not truth. */
const PROFILE: Record<
  HarnessId,
  { costPerKChar: number; baseLatencyMs: number; msPerKChar: number; capabilities: HarnessCapability[] }
> = {
  hermes: { costPerKChar: 0.0012, baseLatencyMs: 4_000, msPerKChar: 900, capabilities: ["code-edit", "code-read", "shell", "test-run", "git", "mcp-client", "multi-file-refactor", "long-context"] },
  claude: { costPerKChar: 0.0015, baseLatencyMs: 6_000, msPerKChar: 1_100, capabilities: ["code-edit", "code-read", "shell", "test-run", "git", "mcp-client", "multi-file-refactor", "long-context"] },
  codex: { costPerKChar: 0.0012, baseLatencyMs: 5_000, msPerKChar: 950, capabilities: ["code-edit", "code-read", "shell", "test-run", "git", "multi-file-refactor", "long-context"] },
  opencode: { costPerKChar: 0.0009, baseLatencyMs: 4_500, msPerKChar: 880, capabilities: ["code-edit", "code-read", "shell", "test-run", "git", "multi-file-refactor"] },
  cursor: { costPerKChar: 0.0014, baseLatencyMs: 5_500, msPerKChar: 1_000, capabilities: ["code-edit", "code-read", "shell", "test-run", "git", "multi-file-refactor"] },
  grok: { costPerKChar: 0.0011, baseLatencyMs: 5_000, msPerKChar: 920, capabilities: ["code-edit", "code-read", "shell", "web-search", "long-context"] },
  cline: { costPerKChar: 0.0013, baseLatencyMs: 6_500, msPerKChar: 1_050, capabilities: ["code-edit", "code-read", "shell", "test-run", "git"] },
  kilo: { costPerKChar: 0.001, baseLatencyMs: 5_200, msPerKChar: 900, capabilities: ["code-edit", "code-read", "shell", "test-run", "git"] },
  llm: { costPerKChar: 0.0006, baseLatencyMs: 2_500, msPerKChar: 700, capabilities: ["code-read"] },
};

/**
 * Concrete adapter. All of them shell out through the same Tauri command, so the
 * only real difference between harnesses is argv, capabilities and cost profile.
 */
class CliHarnessAdapter implements CodingAgentHarness {
  readonly id: HarnessId;
  readonly name: string;
  readonly capabilities: HarnessCapability[];

  constructor(id: HarnessId) {
    this.id = id;
    const spec = HARNESS_BY_ID.get(id)!;
    this.name = spec.name;
    this.capabilities = PROFILE[id].capabilities;
  }

  async detect(): Promise<HarnessAvailability> {
    try {
      const { ipc } = await import("../ipc/client");
      const list = await ipc.cliProvidersDetect();
      const hit = list.find((d) => d.id === this.id);
      if (!hit) {
        const spec = HARNESS_BY_ID.get(this.id)!;
        return {
          installed: false,
          authenticated: false,
          reason: `${spec.name} not detected. ${spec.install}`,
        };
      }
      return {
        installed: Boolean(hit.installed),
        authenticated: hit.auth_state !== "missing" && hit.auth_state !== "unauthenticated",
        version: hit.version ?? undefined,
        path: hit.executable ?? undefined,
        reason: hit.installed ? undefined : "binary not found on PATH",
      };
    } catch (e) {
      return {
        installed: false,
        authenticated: false,
        reason: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e),
      };
    }
  }

  async execute(req: HarnessExecutionRequest): Promise<HarnessExecutionResult> {
    const t0 = Date.now();
    if (req.signal?.aborted) {
      return { ok: false, output: "", error: "aborted before start", harnessId: this.id, latencyMs: 0 };
    }
    try {
      const { ipc } = await import("../ipc/client");
      const timeoutSec = Math.max(30, Math.round(req.timeoutMs / 1000));
      const r = (await ipc.cliInvoke(this.id, req.prompt, req.cwd, timeoutSec)) as {
        stdout?: string;
        stderr?: string;
        code?: number | null;
      };
      const text = String(r.stdout ?? "");
      const errText = String(r.stderr ?? "");
      const ok = (r.code ?? 1) === 0 && text.trim().length > 0;
      return {
        ok,
        output: text,
        error: ok ? undefined : errText || `exit code ${r.code ?? "?"} with no output`,
        exitCode: r.code ?? undefined,
        latencyMs: Date.now() - t0,
        harnessId: this.id,
      };
    } catch (e) {
      return {
        ok: false,
        output: "",
        error: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e),
        latencyMs: Date.now() - t0,
        harnessId: this.id,
      };
    }
  }

  estimate(req: HarnessEstimateRequest): { costUsd: number; latencyMs: number } {
    const p = PROFILE[this.id];
    const k = req.promptChars / 1000;
    const outK = k * (req.expectedOutputRatio ?? 0.6);
    return {
      costUsd: (k + outK) * p.costPerKChar,
      latencyMs: p.baseLatencyMs + (k + outK) * p.msPerKChar,
    };
  }

  normalizeError(err: unknown): { class: string; retryable: boolean; detail: string } {
    const d = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
    const lower = d.toLowerCase();
    if (/not on path|not installed|enoent|command not found|spawn/.test(lower)) {
      return { class: "HARNESS_UNAVAILABLE", retryable: false, detail: d };
    }
    if (/auth|unauthorized|401|403|login/.test(lower)) {
      return { class: "HARNESS_UNAVAILABLE", retryable: false, detail: d };
    }
    if (/timeout|timed out|deadline/.test(lower)) {
      return { class: "TIMEOUT_LOOP", retryable: true, detail: d };
    }
    if (/permission|denied|not granted/.test(lower)) {
      return { class: "PERMISSION_DENIAL", retryable: false, detail: d };
    }
    if (/tool|mcp/.test(lower)) {
      return { class: "TOOL_FAILURE_LOOP", retryable: true, detail: d };
    }
    return { class: "UNKNOWN", retryable: true, detail: d };
  }
}

export const ADAPTERS: CodingAgentHarness[] = HARNESSES.map((h) => new CliHarnessAdapter(h.id));

export function adapterFor(id: HarnessId): CodingAgentHarness {
  return ADAPTERS.find((a) => a.id === id) ?? ADAPTERS[0];
}

export interface SelectionContext {
  taskKind: TaskKind;
  /** Free-text about the repo/language/framework, used for scope matching. */
  scope?: string;
  requiredCapabilities: HarnessCapability[];
  permissions: PermissionSet;
  promptChars: number;
  /** Harnesses that have already failed on this task — penalised, not banned. */
  exclude?: HarnessId[];
  /** Hard-allowed list from the mission/charter. Empty means no restriction. */
  allowed?: HarnessId[];
  observations?: ReputationObservation[];
  riskClass?: RiskClass;
}

export interface SelectionResult {
  harnessId: HarnessId;
  adapter: CodingAgentHarness;
  ranked: HarnessCandidate[];
  rationale: string;
  estimatedCostUsd: number;
  estimatedLatencyMs: number;
  /** True when nothing qualified and we fell back to the in-process runtime. */
  fallback: boolean;
}

/**
 * §6 — capability analysis → harness selection.
 * Returns a full ranking, not just a winner, so the flight recorder can show why.
 */
export async function selectHarness(ctx: SelectionContext): Promise<SelectionResult> {
  const candidates: HarnessCandidate[] = [];
  const allowedSet = new Set(ctx.allowed ?? []);
  const now = Date.now();

  for (const adapter of ADAPTERS) {
    if (adapter.id === "llm") continue; // llm is the fallback, never a routing target
    if (allowedSet.size && !allowedSet.has(adapter.id)) continue;
    const availability = await adapter.detect();
    const supportsTask = supportsTaskKind(adapter.id, ctx.taskKind);
    const capabilityOk = ctx.requiredCapabilities.every((c) => adapter.capabilities.includes(c));
    const permissionOk = permissionsSatisfied(adapter, ctx.permissions);
    const est = adapter.estimate({ taskKind: ctx.taskKind, promptChars: ctx.promptChars });
    const rep = ctx.observations
      ? computeStat(ctx.observations, harnessSubject(adapter.id), ctx.taskKind, ctx.scope ?? "*", now)
      : undefined;

    candidates.push({
      harnessId: adapter.id,
      installed: availability.installed && availability.authenticated,
      supportsTaskKind: supportsTask && capabilityOk,
      permissionOk,
      estimatedCostUsd: est.costUsd,
      estimatedLatencyMs: est.latencyMs,
      reputation: rep,
      score: 0,
      rationale: "",
    });
  }

  let ranked = rankHarnesses(candidates);

  // Penalise harnesses that already failed on this exact task.
  if (ctx.exclude?.length) {
    ranked = ranked.map((c) =>
      ctx.exclude!.includes(c.harnessId as HarnessId)
        ? { ...c, score: c.score - 0.5, rationale: `${c.rationale} − already failed on this task` }
        : c,
    ).sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
  }

  if (!ranked.length) {
    const fallback = adapterFor("llm");
    const est = fallback.estimate({ taskKind: ctx.taskKind, promptChars: ctx.promptChars });
    return {
      harnessId: "llm",
      adapter: fallback,
      ranked: [],
      rationale:
        "No installed coding-agent harness met the capability and permission requirements. " +
        "Falling back to the in-process MJ Hermes loop (needs a provider key or Ollama).",
      estimatedCostUsd: est.costUsd,
      estimatedLatencyMs: est.latencyMs,
      fallback: true,
    };
  }

  const best = ranked[0];
  return {
    harnessId: best.harnessId as HarnessId,
    adapter: adapterFor(best.harnessId as HarnessId),
    ranked,
    rationale:
      `Selected ${HARNESS_BY_ID.get(best.harnessId as HarnessId)?.name ?? best.harnessId}. ${best.rationale}. ` +
      `Alternatives: ${ranked.slice(1, 3).map((c) => `${c.harnessId} (${c.score.toFixed(2)})`).join(", ") || "none"}`,
    estimatedCostUsd: best.estimatedCostUsd,
    estimatedLatencyMs: best.estimatedLatencyMs,
    fallback: false,
  };
}

function permissionsSatisfied(adapter: CodingAgentHarness, p: PermissionSet): boolean {
  // A harness that can shell but is denied terminalExecute cannot be used for shell work.
  if (adapter.capabilities.includes("shell") && !p.terminalExecute) return false;
  if (adapter.capabilities.includes("mcp-client") && !p.mcpUse) return false;
  return true;
}

/** Turn a harness run into a reputation observation. */
export function observationFromRun(
  harnessId: HarnessId,
  taskKind: TaskKind,
  ok: boolean,
  score: number,
  costUsd: number,
  latencyMs: number,
  missionId?: string,
  scope?: string,
): ReputationObservation {
  return {
    id: `obs-${Date.now().toString(36)}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6)}`,
    subject: harnessSubject(harnessId),
    taskKind,
    scope,
    success: ok,
    score,
    costUsd,
    latencyMs,
    missionId,
    observedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  };
}

export function reputationTableFor(
  observations: ReputationObservation[],
  taskKind: TaskKind,
  scope = "*",
): ReputationStat[] {
  return ADAPTERS.filter((a) => a.id !== "llm").map((a) =>
    computeStat(observations, harnessSubject(a.id), taskKind, scope),
  );
}

export function riskForTask(kind: TaskKind, explicit?: RiskClass): RiskClass {
  return explicit ?? defaultRiskForTask(kind);
}
```

## `src/engine/audit.ts`

```typescript
/**
 * MJ 6.0 — Hash-chained audit ledger (spec §32).
 *
 * Append-only. Each entry commits to the previous one, so removing or editing a
 * record invalidates every hash after it. This is what makes "no silent autonomous
 * mutations" (§32) verifiable rather than merely asserted.
 */
import { canonicalize, hashString } from "../domain/artifact";
import type { EventLevel, OrgEvent, OrgEventKind } from "../domain/events";
import { levelForKind } from "../domain/events";

export const GENESIS_HASH = "0".repeat(64);

export interface AuditEntry {
  seq: number;
  ts: string;
  kind: OrgEventKind;
  level: EventLevel;
  missionId: string;
  /** Actor is mandatory — an entry without an actor is not a governance record. */
  actor: string;
  authority?: string;
  policy?: string;
  reason?: string;
  evidence: string[];
  data: Record<string, unknown>;
  prevHash: string;
  hash: string;
}

export function entryHash(
  prev: string,
  e: Omit<AuditEntry, "hash" | "prevHash">,
): string {
  return hashString(
    `${prev}|${canonicalize({
      seq: e.seq,
      ts: e.ts,
      kind: e.kind,
      level: e.level,
      missionId: e.missionId,
      actor: e.actor,
      authority: e.authority ?? null,
      policy: e.policy ?? null,
      reason: e.reason ?? null,
      evidence: e.evidence,
      data: e.data,
    })}`,
  );
}

export class AuditLedger {
  private entries: AuditEntry[] = [];
  private seq = 0;

  append(input: {
    kind: OrgEventKind;
    missionId: string;
    actor: string;
    level?: EventLevel;
    authority?: string;
    policy?: string;
    reason?: string;
    evidence?: string[];
    data?: Record<string, unknown>;
  }): AuditEntry {
    const prev = this.entries.length ? this.entries[this.entries.length - 1].hash : GENESIS_HASH;
    this.seq += 1;
    const base = {
      seq: this.seq,
      ts: new Date().toISOString(),
      kind: input.kind,
      level: input.level ?? levelForKind(input.kind),
      missionId: input.missionId,
      actor: input.actor,
      authority: input.authority,
      policy: input.policy,
      reason: input.reason,
      evidence: input.evidence ?? [],
      data: input.data ?? {},
    };
    const hash = entryHash(prev, base);
    const entry: AuditEntry = { ...base, prevHash: prev, hash };
    this.entries.push(entry);
    return entry;
  }

  /** Record an event that already exists in the flight recorder. */
  appendEvent(ev: OrgEvent): AuditEntry {
    return this.append({
      kind: ev.kind,
      missionId: ev.missionId,
      actor: ev.actor ? `${ev.actor.kind}:${ev.actor.id}` : "unknown",
      level: ev.level,
      authority: ev.authority?.source,
      policy: ev.authority?.policy,
      reason: ev.authority?.reason ?? (ev.data.reason as string | undefined),
      evidence: ev.authority?.evidence ?? [],
      data: ev.data,
    });
  }

  all(): AuditEntry[] {
    return [...this.entries];
  }

  get head(): string {
    return this.entries.length ? this.entries[this.entries.length - 1].hash : GENESIS_HASH;
  }

  /** Verify chain integrity. Returns the seq of the first bad entry, or null. */
  verify(): { ok: boolean; brokenAt?: number; reason?: string } {
    let prev = GENESIS_HASH;
    for (const e of this.entries) {
      if (e.prevHash !== prev) {
        return { ok: false, brokenAt: e.seq, reason: `prevHash mismatch at seq ${e.seq}` };
      }
      const expected = entryHash(prev, {
        seq: e.seq,
        ts: e.ts,
        kind: e.kind,
        level: e.level,
        missionId: e.missionId,
        actor: e.actor,
        authority: e.authority,
        policy: e.policy,
        reason: e.reason,
        evidence: e.evidence,
        data: e.data,
      });
      if (expected !== e.hash) {
        return { ok: false, brokenAt: e.seq, reason: `hash mismatch at seq ${e.seq}` };
      }
      prev = e.hash;
    }
    return { ok: true };
  }

  filter(pred: (e: AuditEntry) => boolean): AuditEntry[] {
    return this.entries.filter(pred);
  }

  byMission(missionId: string): AuditEntry[] {
    return this.entries.filter((e) => e.missionId === missionId);
  }

  count(): number {
    return this.entries.length;
  }
}

/** Render the ledger as a plain-text evidence pack for export. */
export function exportLedger(ledger: AuditLedger): string {
  const v = ledger.verify();
  const lines = [
    "MJ 6.0 — AUDIT LEDGER EXPORT",
    `entries: ${ledger.count()}`,
    `chain: ${v.ok ? "INTACT" : `BROKEN at seq ${v.brokenAt} (${v.reason})`}`,
    `head: ${ledger.head}`,
    "",
  ];
  for (const e of ledger.all()) {
    lines.push(
      `#${e.seq} ${e.ts} [${e.level}] ${e.kind}`,
      `    actor:     ${e.actor}`,
      ...(e.authority ? [`    authority: ${e.authority}`] : []),
      ...(e.policy ? [`    policy:    ${e.policy}`] : []),
      ...(e.reason ? [`    reason:    ${e.reason}`] : []),
      ...(e.evidence.length ? [`    evidence:  ${e.evidence.join(" | ")}`] : []),
      `    prev:      ${e.prevHash}`,
      `    hash:      ${e.hash}`,
      "",
    );
  }
  return lines.join("\n");
}
```

## `src/engine/blackboard.ts`

```typescript
/**
 * MJ 6.0 — Blackboard: typed shared state for an organization (topology support).
 *
 * A blackboard is not just a memory bag. Entries are typed, versioned, and can be
 * *claimed* so two peers do not silently overwrite each other's contribution. This
 * is what makes the `blackboard` and `swarm` topologies safe to run in parallel.
 */

export type BlackboardEntryKind =
  | "finding"
  | "hypothesis"
  | "question"
  | "decision"
  | "artifact-ref"
  | "warning"
  | "partial-result";

export const BLACKBOARD_KINDS: BlackboardEntryKind[] = [
  "finding", "hypothesis", "question", "decision", "artifact-ref", "warning", "partial-result",
];

export interface BlackboardEntry {
  id: string;
  blackboardKey: string;
  kind: BlackboardEntryKind;
  topic: string;
  content: string;
  /** Slot id that wrote it. */
  authorId: string;
  authorLabel: string;
  /** Slot ids that have claimed this entry (read + building on it). */
  claimedBy: string[];
  version: number;
  /** Confidence the author assigns, 0–1. Advisory, never authoritative. */
  confidence: number;
  /** Entries this one responds to — drives the "conflict" detection in §5. */
  respondsTo?: string[];
  supersedes?: string[];
  artifactId?: string;
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
}

export interface BlackboardConflict {
  topic: string;
  entryIds: string[];
  reason: string;
}

export interface Blackboard {
  key: string;
  missionId: string;
  entries: BlackboardEntry[];
  updatedAt: string;
}

export function createBlackboard(key: string, missionId: string): Blackboard {
  return { key, missionId, entries: [], updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() };
}

export function postToBlackboard(
  bb: Blackboard,
  e: Omit<BlackboardEntry, "id" | "version" | "createdAt" | "updatedAt">,
): BlackboardEntry {
  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  const prev = bb.entries.filter((x) => x.topic === e.topic && x.authorId === e.authorId).pop();
  const entry: BlackboardEntry = {
    ...e,
    id: `bb-${bb.entries.length + 1}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 7)}`,
    version: prev ? prev.version + 1 : 1,
    createdAt: now,
    updatedAt: now,
  };
  bb.entries.push(entry);
  bb.updatedAt = now;
  return entry;
}

export function claimEntry(bb: Blackboard, entryId: string, slotId: string): boolean {
  const e = bb.entries.find((x) => x.id === entryId);
  if (!e) return false;
  if (e.claimedBy.includes(slotId)) return true;
  e.claimedBy.push(slotId);
  bb.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
  return true;
}

/**
 * Topics where two or more authors assert materially different content.
 * Feeds the supervisor's "conflicting results" detection (§5).
 */
export function findConflicts(bb: Blackboard): BlackboardConflict[] {
  const byTopic = new Map<string, BlackboardEntry[]>();
  for (const e of bb.entries) {
    if (e.kind === "question" || e.kind === "artifact-ref") continue;
    const list = byTopic.get(e.topic) ?? [];
    list.push(e);
    byTopic.set(e.topic, list);
  }

  const conflicts: BlackboardConflict[] = [];
  for (const [topic, list] of byTopic) {
    const live = list.filter((e) => !e.supersedes?.length);
    const authors = new Set(live.map((e) => e.authorId));
    if (authors.size < 2) continue;
    const normalized = live.map((e) => e.content.trim().toLowerCase());
    const distinct = new Set(normalized);
    if (distinct.size < 2) continue;
    // Cheap disagreement signal: low lexical overlap between the two strongest claims.
    const scored = live.sort((a, b) => b.confidence - a.confidence);
    const a = scored[0];
    const b = scored.find((x) => x.authorId !== a.authorId && x.content.trim().toLowerCase() !== a.content.trim().toLowerCase());
    if (!b) continue;
    const overlap = lexicalOverlap(a.content, b.content);
    if (overlap < 0.35) {
      conflicts.push({
        topic,
        entryIds: [a.id, b.id],
        reason: `${a.authorLabel} and ${b.authorLabel} assert materially different conclusions (overlap ${(overlap * 100).toFixed(0)}%).`,
      });
    }
  }
  return conflicts;
}

function lexicalOverlap(a: string, b: string): number {
  const ta = new Set(a.toLowerCase().split(/\W+/).filter((w) => w.length > 3));
  const tb = new Set(b.toLowerCase().split(/\W+/).filter((w) => w.length > 3));
  if (!ta.size || !tb.size) return 0;
  let hits = 0;
  for (const t of ta) if (tb.has(t)) hits += 1;
  return hits / Math.min(ta.size, tb.size);
}

/** Render the board for an agent context, newest last, capped. */
export function renderBlackboard(bb: Blackboard, maxChars = 6000): string {
  const lines = [`# Blackboard (${bb.entries.length} entries)`, ""];
  for (const e of bb.entries) {
    lines.push(
      `## [${e.kind}] ${e.topic} — ${e.authorLabel} (v${e.version}, conf ${e.confidence.toFixed(2)})`,
      e.content,
      "",
    );
  }
  const out = lines.join("\n");
  return out.length > maxChars ? `${out.slice(0, maxChars)}\n…(truncated)` : out;
}

/** Unanswered questions — the supervisor flags these as gaps. */
export function openQuestions(bb: Blackboard): BlackboardEntry[] {
  const answeredTopics = new Set(
    bb.entries.filter((e) => e.kind === "finding" || e.kind === "decision").map((e) => e.topic),
  );
  return bb.entries.filter((e) => e.kind === "question" && !answeredTopics.has(e.topic));
}
```

## `src/engine/checkpoint.ts`

```typescript
/**
 * MJ 6.0 — Checkpoints, pause and resume (spec §25, §26).
 *
 * §25's hard requirement: "Never duplicate completed work because of a process
 * restart." So a checkpoint is a complete, restorable snapshot — not a log cursor —
 * and resume re-derives the runnable frontier from task state rather than replaying.
 */
import type { AgentSlot, MissionTask, Organization, OrgPhase } from "../domain/organization";
import type { Mission, MissionStatus } from "../domain/mission";
import type { Artifact } from "../domain/artifact";
import type { ScopedMemory } from "../domain/memoryScopes";
import type { NegotiationThread } from "../domain/negotiation";
import type { RepairAttempt } from "./repair";
import type { GraphMutation } from "./graphEvolution";
import type { AuditEntry } from "./audit";
import type { WorkflowGraph } from "../domain/types";

export type CheckpointTrigger =
  | "AFTER_PLANNING"
  | "AFTER_PHASE"
  | "AFTER_ARTIFACT"
  | "BEFORE_RISKY_ACTION"
  | "BEFORE_MUTATION"
  | "ON_PAUSE"
  | "ON_APPROVAL_WAIT"
  | "MANUAL"
  | "ON_FAILURE";

export const CHECKPOINT_TRIGGERS: CheckpointTrigger[] = [
  "AFTER_PLANNING", "AFTER_PHASE", "AFTER_ARTIFACT", "BEFORE_RISKY_ACTION",
  "BEFORE_MUTATION", "ON_PAUSE", "ON_APPROVAL_WAIT", "MANUAL", "ON_FAILURE",
];

export const CHECKPOINT_TRIGGER_LABEL: Record<CheckpointTrigger, string> = {
  AFTER_PLANNING: "After planning",
  AFTER_PHASE: "After a phase completed",
  AFTER_ARTIFACT: "After an artifact was created",
  BEFORE_RISKY_ACTION: "Before a risky action",
  BEFORE_MUTATION: "Before a graph mutation",
  ON_PAUSE: "On pause",
  ON_APPROVAL_WAIT: "Waiting on approval",
  MANUAL: "Manual",
  ON_FAILURE: "On failure",
};

/** §25 — the full restorable state. */
export interface MissionCheckpoint {
  id: string;
  missionId: string;
  orgId: string;
  trigger: CheckpointTrigger;
  label: string;

  mission: Mission;
  org: Organization;
  /** Deep copies so later mutation cannot retroactively edit a checkpoint. */
  slots: AgentSlot[];
  tasks: MissionTask[];
  phases: OrgPhase[];
  artifacts: Artifact[];
  /** Graph version per phase. */
  graphVersions: Record<string, number>;
  phaseGraphs: Record<string, WorkflowGraph>;

  memory: ScopedMemory[];
  negotiations: NegotiationThread[];
  repairs: RepairAttempt[];
  mutations: GraphMutation[];
  audit: AuditEntry[];

  /** Open approvals at checkpoint time. */
  pendingApprovalIds: string[];
  /** Ledger totals, so spend is not lost or double counted on resume. */
  totals: {
    costUsd: number;
    inputTokens: number;
    outputTokens: number;
    elapsedMs: number;
    nodeRuns: number;
    reorganizations: number;
    humanInterventions: number;
    regressions: number;
  };

  status: MissionStatus;
  createdAt: string;
  /** Seq of the last event included, for the flight recorder. */
  eventSeq: number;
}

let cpSeq = 0;

export function createCheckpoint(
  input: Omit<MissionCheckpoint, "id" | "createdAt">,
): MissionCheckpoint {
  cpSeq += 1;
  return {
    ...input,
    id: `cp-${Date.now().toString(36)}-${cpSeq}`,
    createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    // Structural clone so the checkpoint is genuinely immutable in practice.
    slots: clone(input.slots),
    tasks: clone(input.tasks),
    phases: clone(input.phases),
    artifacts: clone(input.artifacts),
    memory: clone(input.memory),
    negotiations: clone(input.negotiations),
    repairs: clone(input.repairs),
    mutations: clone(input.mutations),
    audit: clone(input.audit),
    phaseGraphs: clone(input.phaseGraphs),
    mission: clone(input.mission),
    org: clone(input.org),
  };
}

function clone<T>(v: T): T {
  return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(v)) as T;
}

/**
 * §25 — validate a checkpoint before resuming. Refuses to resume from state that
 * cannot be trusted, rather than resuming and corrupting the mission.
 */
export function validateCheckpoint(cp: MissionCheckpoint): { ok: boolean; problems: string[] } {
  const problems: string[] = [];

  if (!cp.mission?.id) problems.push("checkpoint has no mission");
  if (!cp.org?.id) problems.push("checkpoint has no organization");
  if (cp.mission.id !== cp.org.missionId) {
    problems.push(`mission/org mismatch: ${cp.mission.id} vs ${cp.org.missionId}`);
  }

  const slotIds = new Set(cp.slots.map((s) => s.id));
  for (const id of cp.org.active) {
    if (!slotIds.has(id)) problems.push(`active roster references unknown slot ${id}`);
  }
  for (const t of cp.tasks) {
    if (t.assigneeId && !slotIds.has(t.assigneeId)) {
      problems.push(`task ${t.id} assigned to unknown slot ${t.assigneeId}`);
    }
    for (const d of t.dependsOn) {
      if (!cp.tasks.some((x) => x.id === d)) {
        problems.push(`task ${t.id} depends on unknown task ${d}`);
      }
    }
  }

  const artifactIds = new Set(cp.artifacts.map((a) => a.id));
  for (const a of cp.artifacts) {
    for (const p of a.parentArtifacts) {
      if (!artifactIds.has(p)) problems.push(`artifact ${a.id} references unknown parent ${p}`);
    }
  }

  if (cp.totals.costUsd < 0) problems.push("negative cost in totals");

  return { ok: problems.length === 0, problems };
}

/**
 * §25 — "recover safe agents" then resume.
 * A slot that was RUNNING when the process died is NOT safe to resume: we cannot
 * know how far it got. It is reset to ASSIGNED so its task re-runs from the start,
 * while COMPLETED work is left alone. That is what prevents duplicate completion.
 */
export function recoverCheckpoint(cp: MissionCheckpoint): {
  resumableTasks: string[];
  requeuedTasks: string[];
  recoveredSlots: string[];
  notes: string[];
} {
  const resumableTasks: string[] = [];
  const requeuedTasks: string[] = [];
  const recoveredSlots: string[] = [];
  const notes: string[] = [];

  for (const slot of cp.slots) {
    if (slot.status === "RUNNING") {
      slot.status = "ASSIGNED";
      recoveredSlots.push(slot.id);
      notes.push(`${slot.title} was RUNNING at checkpoint; reset to ASSIGNED (progress unknown).`);
    } else if (slot.status === "STALLED") {
      slot.status = "ASSIGNED";
      recoveredSlots.push(slot.id);
      notes.push(`${slot.title} was STALLED; reset to ASSIGNED.`);
    } else if (slot.status === "WAITING_APPROVAL") {
      notes.push(`${slot.title} is waiting on approval; preserved.`);
    }
  }

  for (const t of cp.tasks) {
    if (t.status === "COMPLETED") {
      // Completed work is never redone (§25).
      continue;
    }
    if (t.status === "RUNNING") {
      t.status = "DELEGATED";
      requeuedTasks.push(t.id);
      notes.push(`Task "${t.title}" was RUNNING; requeued from the start of its last attempt.`);
    } else if (t.status === "PENDING" || t.status === "DELEGATED" || t.status === "BLOCKED") {
      resumableTasks.push(t.id);
    }
  }

  return { resumableTasks, requeuedTasks, recoveredSlots, notes };
}

/** Which tasks are runnable right now: dependencies met, not terminal. */
export function runnableTasks(tasks: MissionTask[]): MissionTask[] {
  const done = new Set(
    tasks.filter((t) => t.status === "COMPLETED" || t.status === "MERGED").map((t) => t.id),
  );
  return tasks.filter(
    (t) =>
      (t.status === "PENDING" || t.status === "DELEGATED" || t.status === "BLOCKED") &&
      t.dependsOn.every((d) => done.has(d)),
  );
}

/** Deadlock detection: undone tasks whose dependencies can never be satisfied. */
export function deadlockedTasks(tasks: MissionTask[]): string[] {
  const byId = new Map(tasks.map((t) => [t.id, t]));
  const terminal = new Set(["COMPLETED", "MERGED", "FAILED", "SPLIT"]);
  const out: string[] = [];

  for (const t of tasks) {
    if (terminal.has(t.status)) continue;
    const seen = new Set<string>();
    const walk = (id: string, depth: number): boolean => {
      if (depth > 32) return true;
      if (seen.has(id)) return true;
      seen.add(id);
      const cur = byId.get(id);
      if (!cur) return true;
      if (cur.status === "FAILED") return true;
      if (cur.status === "COMPLETED" || cur.status === "MERGED") return false;
      return cur.dependsOn.some((d) => walk(d, depth + 1));
    };
    if (t.dependsOn.some((d) => walk(d, 0))) out.push(t.id);
  }
  return [...new Set(out)];
}

export class CheckpointStore {
  private cps: MissionCheckpoint[] = [];

  add(cp: MissionCheckpoint): MissionCheckpoint {
    this.cps.push(cp);
    this.cps.sort((a, b) => a.createdAt.localeCompare(b.createdAt));
    return cp;
  }

  forMission(missionId: string): MissionCheckpoint[] {
    return this.cps.filter((c) => c.missionId === missionId);
  }

  latest(missionId: string): MissionCheckpoint | undefined {
    const list = this.forMission(missionId);
    return list[list.length - 1];
  }

  /** Latest checkpoint of a given trigger, e.g. the last post-planning state. */
  latestOf(missionId: string, trigger: CheckpointTrigger): MissionCheckpoint | undefined {
    const list = this.forMission(missionId).filter((c) => c.trigger === trigger);
    return list[list.length - 1];
  }

  get(id: string): MissionCheckpoint | undefined {
    return this.cps.find((c) => c.id === id);
  }

  all(): MissionCheckpoint[] {
    return [...this.cps];
  }

  remove(id: string): void {
    this.cps = this.cps.filter((c) => c.id !== id);
  }
}
```

## `src/engine/controlRuntime.ts`

```typescript
import { safeEvaluate } from "./expression";
import type { Connection, NodeInstance } from "../domain/types";

export interface ControlResult {
  ports: Record<string, unknown>;
  skipTargets?: string[];
}

export function runControlNode(
  node: NodeInstance,
  collected: Record<string, unknown>,
  outgoing: Connection[],
): ControlResult {
  const id = node.definitionId;
  const first = Object.values(collected)[0];

  if (id === "control.start") {
    let payload: unknown = {};
    try { payload = JSON.parse(String(node.config.initialPayload || "{}")); } catch { payload = {}; }
    return { ports: { payload, "*": payload } };
  }
  if (id === "control.end") {
    return { ports: { result: first, "*": first } };
  }
  if (id === "control.wait") {
    return { ports: { out: first, "*": first } };
  }
  if (id === "control.sequential") {
    return { ports: { output: first, "*": first } };
  }
  if (id === "control.parallel") {
    return { ports: { branch: first, "*": first } };
  }
  if (id === "control.merge") {
    const mode = String(node.config.mode ?? "object");
    const vals = Object.values(collected);
    const out = mode === "array" ? vals : Object.assign({}, ...vals.map((v, i) => (v && typeof v === "object" && !Array.isArray(v) ? v as object : { [`in${i}`]: v })));
    return { ports: { out, "*": out } };
  }
  if (id === "control.split") {
    const items = Array.isArray(first) ? first : (first && typeof first === "object" ? Object.values(first as object) : [first]);
    return { ports: { items, "*": items } };
  }
  if (id === "control.fallback") {
    const out = collected.primary ?? collected.backup ?? first;
    return { ports: { out, "*": out } };
  }
  if (id === "control.retry") {
    return { ports: { out: first, "*": first } };
  }
  if (id === "control.condition") {
    let ok = false;
    try { ok = Boolean(safeEvaluate(String(node.config.expression || "Boolean(input)"), first)); }
    catch { ok = Boolean(first); }
    const skip = outgoing.filter((c) => c.sourcePortId === (ok ? "else" : "then")).map((c) => c.targetNodeId);
    return { ports: { then: ok ? first : undefined, else: ok ? undefined : first, "*": first }, skipTargets: skip };
  }
  if (id === "control.switch") {
    const key = String(node.config.keyPath || "input.route");
    const val = pick(first, key.replace(/^input\.?/, ""));
    const route = String(val ?? "default");
    const port = route === "A" || route === "caseA" ? "caseA" : route === "B" || route === "caseB" ? "caseB" : "default";
    const skip = outgoing.filter((c) => c.sourcePortId !== port && c.sourceNodeId === node.id).map((c) => c.targetNodeId);
    return { ports: { [port]: first, "*": first }, skipTargets: skip };
  }
  if (id === "control.loop") {
    const items = Array.isArray(first) ? first : [first];
    const max = Math.min(Number(node.config.maxIterations ?? 20), items.length);
    return { ports: { item: items[0], done: items.slice(0, max), "*": items.slice(0, max) } };
  }
  if (id === "control.approval") {
    return { ports: { approved: first, "*": first } };
  }
  return { ports: { "*": first ?? { passthrough: node.title } } };
}

function pick(input: unknown, path: string): unknown {
  if (!path) return input;
  let cur: unknown = input;
  for (const part of path.split(".").filter(Boolean)) {
    if (cur && typeof cur === "object") cur = (cur as Record<string, unknown>)[part];
    else return undefined;
  }
  return cur;
}
```

## `src/engine/cost.ts`

```typescript
/**
 * MJ 6.0 — Real cost accounting.
 *
 * V5 declared `let cost = 0` in the scheduler and never assigned it, so every run
 * reported $0.0000. V6 computes actual spend from a pricing table, and treats an
 * unknown model as an error the operator must resolve rather than as zero.
 */

export interface ModelPrice {
  /** USD per 1M input tokens. */
  inputPerMTok: number;
  /** USD per 1M output tokens. */
  outputPerMTok: number;
}

/**
 * Public list pricing, USD per 1M tokens. Deliberately a data table: override
 * locally in Settings if your negotiated rates differ.
 */
export const PRICING: Record<string, ModelPrice> = {
  // Anthropic
  "claude-opus-4": { inputPerMTok: 15, outputPerMTok: 75 },
  "claude-sonnet-4": { inputPerMTok: 3, outputPerMTok: 15 },
  "claude-haiku-4": { inputPerMTok: 0.8, outputPerMTok: 4 },
  "claude-sonnet-4.5": { inputPerMTok: 3, outputPerMTok: 15 },
  // OpenAI
  "gpt-4.1": { inputPerMTok: 2, outputPerMTok: 8 },
  "gpt-4.1-mini": { inputPerMTok: 0.4, outputPerMTok: 1.6 },
  "gpt-4o": { inputPerMTok: 2.5, outputPerMTok: 10 },
  "o3": { inputPerMTok: 2, outputPerMTok: 8 },
  "o4-mini": { inputPerMTok: 0.4, outputPerMTok: 1.6 },
  // Google
  "gemini-2.5-pro": { inputPerMTok: 1.25, outputPerMTok: 10 },
  "gemini-2.5-flash": { inputPerMTok: 0.15, outputPerMTok: 0.6 },
  // Others
  "grok-4": { inputPerMTok: 3, outputPerMTok: 15 },
  "llama3.1": { inputPerMTok: 0, outputPerMTok: 0 },
  "llama3.2": { inputPerMTok: 0, outputPerMTok: 0 },
};

/** Fallback when the exact model id is unknown but the family is recognisable. */
const FAMILY_FALLBACK: Array<[RegExp, ModelPrice]> = [
  [/opus/i, PRICING["claude-opus-4"]],
  [/sonnet/i, PRICING["claude-sonnet-4"]],
  [/haiku/i, PRICING["claude-haiku-4"]],
  [/gpt-4\.1-mini|o4-mini/i, PRICING["gpt-4.1-mini"]],
  [/gpt-4|o3/i, PRICING["gpt-4.1"]],
  [/gemini.*flash/i, PRICING["gemini-2.5-flash"]],
  [/gemini/i, PRICING["gemini-2.5-pro"]],
  [/grok/i, PRICING["grok-4"]],
  [/llama|mistral|qwen|phi|deepseek|ollama/i, { inputPerMTok: 0, outputPerMTok: 0 }],
];

export function priceFor(model: string): ModelPrice | null {
  const exact = PRICING[model];
  if (exact) return exact;
  for (const [re, p] of FAMILY_FALLBACK) {
    if (re.test(model)) return p;
  }
  return null;
}

export function isLocalModel(model: string): boolean {
  return /llama|mistral|qwen|phi|deepseek|ollama|local/i.test(model);
}

/**
 * Cost for a call. Unknown cloud models return null so the caller can surface a
 * warning instead of silently reporting zero.
 */
export function estimateCost(
  model: string,
  inputTokens: number,
  outputTokens: number,
): number | null {
  const p = priceFor(model);
  if (!p) return null;
  return (inputTokens / 1_000_000) * p.inputPerMTok + (outputTokens / 1_000_000) * p.outputPerMTok;
}

export interface CostLedgerEntry {
  label: string;
  model: string;
  inputTokens: number;
  outputTokens: number;
  costUsd: number;
  /** True when the model had no price and cost was recorded as 0 — never hidden. */
  unpriced: boolean;
}

export class CostLedger {
  private entries: CostLedgerEntry[] = [];
  private warned = new Set<string>();

  record(label: string, model: string, inputTokens: number, outputTokens: number): CostLedgerEntry {
    const c = estimateCost(model, inputTokens, outputTokens);
    const unpriced = c === null;
    if (unpriced && !isLocalModel(model) && !this.warned.has(model)) {
      this.warned.add(model);
      console.warn(`[mj.cost] no price entry for model "${model}" — recording $0 and flagging it.`);
    }
    const entry: CostLedgerEntry = {
      label,
      model,
      inputTokens,
      outputTokens,
      costUsd: c ?? 0,
      unpriced,
    };
    this.entries.push(entry);
    return entry;
  }

  get totalUsd(): number {
    return this.entries.reduce((a, e) => a + e.costUsd, 0);
  }
  get totalInputTokens(): number {
    return this.entries.reduce((a, e) => a + e.inputTokens, 0);
  }
  get totalOutputTokens(): number {
    return this.entries.reduce((a, e) => a + e.outputTokens, 0);
  }
  get unpricedModels(): string[] {
    return [...new Set(this.entries.filter((e) => e.unpriced).map((e) => e.model))];
  }
  all(): CostLedgerEntry[] {
    return [...this.entries];
  }
  reset(): void {
    this.entries = [];
  }
}

/** Rough token estimate from text, used before a call is made. */
export function estimateTokens(text: string): number {
  return Math.max(1, Math.ceil(text.length / 4));
}
```

## `src/engine/evaluator.ts`

```typescript
/**
 * MJ 6.0 — Independent evaluation (spec §18).
 *
 * V5 scored fitness heuristically (string length, keyword presence) unless the
 * Python bridge happened to be running. V6 always judges with anchored rubrics, and
 * applies the disciplines that make LLM-as-judge actually usable:
 *   - reasoning BEFORE score
 *   - one dimension at a time, never a single "overall quality" number
 *   - 0–5 scale (models cannot distinguish 73 from 76)
 *   - judges from a different model family than the agent under test
 *   - adjudicate when judges disagree beyond a threshold
 *   - hard fails cap the score regardless of dimensions
 *
 * An agent is never the sole authority on its own success.
 */
import type { Rubric } from "../domain/rubrics";
import { buildJudgePrompt, getRubric } from "../domain/rubrics";
import { ipc } from "../ipc/client";

export interface JudgeRequest {
  rubricId: string;
  task: string;
  output: string;
  context?: string[];
  /** Model that produced the output, so we can avoid judging it with itself. */
  producerModel?: string;
  /** Model family of the producer, e.g. "anthropic" | "openai". */
  producerFamily?: string;
  /** Additional evidence the judge should see (tool log, test output). */
  trajectory?: string[];
}

export interface JudgeVerdict {
  judgeId: string;
  judgeModel: string;
  /** Dimension key → score 0–5. */
  dimensionScores: Record<string, number>;
  reasoning: Record<string, string>;
  evidence: string[];
  hardFail: string | null;
  missed: string[];
  summary: string;
  /** Weighted aggregate, 0–5. */
  score: number;
  raw: string;
  latencyMs: number;
}

export interface EvaluationResult {
  verdicts: JudgeVerdict[];
  /** Mean of adjudicated scores, 0–5. */
  score: number;
  /** Max pairwise disagreement on any dimension, 0–5. */
  disagreement: number;
  passed: boolean;
  adjudicated: boolean;
  hardFail: string | null;
  rubricId: string;
  evaluatedAt: string;
  notes: string[];
}

/** Which family a model belongs to, used to avoid self-enhancement bias. */
export function modelFamily(model: string): string {
  const m = model.toLowerCase();
  if (m.includes("claude")) return "anthropic";
  if (m.includes("gpt") || m.includes("o1") || m.includes("o3") || m.includes("o4")) return "openai";
  if (m.includes("gemini")) return "google";
  if (m.includes("grok")) return "xai";
  if (m.includes("llama") || m.includes("mistral") || m.includes("qwen")) return "open-weights";
  return "unknown";
}

/** Candidate judge models, ordered by preference for a given producer family. */
export function pickJudgeModels(
  available: string[],
  producerFamily: string | undefined,
  count: number,
  requireDifferentFamily: boolean,
): string[] {
  const pool = available.length
    ? available
    : ["claude-sonnet-4", "gpt-4.1", "gemini-2.5-pro", "grok-4"];

  const scored = pool.map((m) => {
    const fam = modelFamily(m);
    let s = 0;
    if (requireDifferentFamily && producerFamily && fam === producerFamily) s -= 100;
    // Prefer strong-but-not-absurdly-expensive judges.
    if (/opus|o3|gpt-4\.1$|claude-sonnet|gemini-2\.5-pro/.test(m)) s += 3;
    if (/haiku|mini|flash/.test(m)) s -= 2;
    return { m, s };
  });
  scored.sort((a, b) => b.s - a.s);

  const out: string[] = [];
  const families = new Set<string>();
  for (const { m } of scored) {
    if (out.length >= count) break;
    const fam = modelFamily(m);
    // Prefer distinct families among judges too, for genuine independence.
    if (out.length > 0 && families.has(fam) && out.length < count) continue;
    out.push(m);
    families.add(fam);
  }
  // Relax the distinct-family rule if the pool is too small.
  for (const { m } of scored) {
    if (out.length >= count) break;
    if (!out.includes(m)) out.push(m);
  }
  return out.slice(0, Math.max(1, count));
}

const JUDGE_JSON = /\{[\s\S]*\}/;

function parseVerdict(raw: string, judgeModel: string, rubric: Rubric, latencyMs: number): JudgeVerdict {
  const match = raw.match(JUDGE_JSON);
  const fallback: JudgeVerdict = {
    judgeId: `${judgeModel}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6)}`,
    judgeModel,
    dimensionScores: {},
    reasoning: {},
    evidence: [],
    hardFail: null,
    missed: [],
    summary: "Judge output could not be parsed.",
    score: 0,
    raw,
    latencyMs,
  };
  if (!match) return fallback;
  let parsed: Record<string, unknown>;
  try {
    parsed = JSON.parse(match[0]) as Record<string, unknown>;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }

  const dimsRaw = (parsed.dimensions ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
  const dimensionScores: Record<string, number> = {};
  const reasoning: Record<string, string> = {};
  for (const d of rubric.dimensions) {
    const v = dimsRaw[d.key];
    if (typeof v === "number") {
      dimensionScores[d.key] = Math.max(0, Math.min(5, v));
    } else if (v && typeof v === "object") {
      const o = v as Record<string, unknown>;
      if (typeof o.score === "number") dimensionScores[d.key] = Math.max(0, Math.min(5, o.score));
      if (typeof o.reasoning === "string") reasoning[d.key] = o.reasoning;
    }
  }

  const hardFail = typeof parsed.hardFail === "string" ? parsed.hardFail : null;
  let wSum = 0;
  let acc = 0;
  for (const d of rubric.dimensions) {
    const s = dimensionScores[d.key];
    if (typeof s === "number") {
      acc += s * d.weight;
      wSum += d.weight;
    }
  }
  let score = wSum ? acc / wSum : 0;
  if (hardFail) score = Math.min(score, 1);

  return {
    judgeId: `${judgeModel}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6)}`,
    judgeModel,
    dimensionScores,
    reasoning,
    evidence: Array.isArray(parsed.evidence) ? parsed.evidence.map(String) : [],
    hardFail,
    missed: Array.isArray(parsed.missed) ? parsed.missed.map(String) : [],
    summary: typeof parsed.summary === "string" ? parsed.summary : "",
    score,
    raw,
    latencyMs,
  };
}

export interface EvaluateOptions {
  judges?: string[];
  judgeCount?: number;
  requireDifferentFamily?: boolean;
  acceptScore?: number;
  maxDisagreement?: number;
  /** Abort signal so a paused or killed mission stops burning tokens. */
  signal?: { aborted: boolean };
  /**
   * Injectable judge backend. Present only for the headless §39 acceptance run;
   * production routes through ipc.llmChat and a missing provider fails closed.
   */
  llm?: (prompt: string, model: string) => Promise<string>;
}

/**
 * Run the judges and adjudicate.
 * Never throws on judge failure — a judge error is recorded as a note and lowers
 * confidence, but does not fabricate a passing score.
 */
export async function evaluate(
  req: JudgeRequest,
  opts: EvaluateOptions = {},
): Promise<EvaluationResult> {
  const rubric = getRubric(req.rubricId);
  const judgeCount = opts.judgeCount ?? 2;
  const acceptScore = opts.acceptScore ?? 3.5;
  const maxDisagreement = opts.maxDisagreement ?? 1.5;
  const requireDifferentFamily = opts.requireDifferentFamily ?? true;

  const judges = (opts.judges && opts.judges.length ? opts.judges : []).length
    ? opts.judges!
    : pickJudgeModels(opts.judges ?? [], req.producerFamily, judgeCount, requireDifferentFamily);

  const context = [...(req.context ?? [])];
  if (req.trajectory?.length) {
    context.push("EXECUTION TRAJECTORY (tool calls and results):", ...req.trajectory.slice(-20));
  }

  const prompt = buildJudgePrompt(rubric, req.task, req.output, context);

  const verdicts: JudgeVerdict[] = [];
  const notes: string[] = [];

  for (const model of judges) {
    if (opts.signal?.aborted) {
      notes.push(`Evaluation aborted before judge ${model} ran.`);
      break;
    }
    const t0 = Date.now();
    try {
      const raw = opts.llm
        ? await opts.llm(prompt, model)
        : String(
            ((await ipc.llmChat({
        provider: providerForModel(model),
        model,
        messages: [{ role: "user", content: prompt }],
        system: "You are a strict independent evaluator. Respond with JSON only.",
        max_tokens: 1500,
        temperature: 0,
        secret_ref: `provider.${providerForModel(model)}.production`,
            })) as { content?: string }).content ?? "",
          );
      if (!raw.trim()) throw new Error("empty judge response");
      verdicts.push(parseVerdict(raw, model, rubric, Date.now() - t0));
    } catch (e) {
      notes.push(`Judge ${model} failed: ${e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)}`);
    }
  }

  if (!verdicts.length) {
    return {
      verdicts: [],
      score: 0,
      disagreement: 0,
      passed: false,
      adjudicated: false,
      hardFail: null,
      rubricId: rubric.id,
      evaluatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      notes: [...notes, "No judge produced a verdict. Not scored — and not assumed to pass."],
    };
  }

  // Disagreement = max spread on any shared dimension.
  let disagreement = 0;
  for (const d of rubric.dimensions) {
    const vals = verdicts
      .map((v) => v.dimensionScores[d.key])
      .filter((n): n is number => typeof n === "number");
    if (vals.length >= 2) {
      disagreement = Math.max(disagreement, Math.max(...vals) - Math.min(...vals));
    }
  }

  const mean = verdicts.reduce((a, v) => a + v.score, 0) / verdicts.length;
  const hardFail = verdicts.find((v) => v.hardFail)?.hardFail ?? null;

  let score = mean;
  let adjudicated = false;
  if (disagreement > maxDisagreement && verdicts.length >= 2) {
    // Judges disagree materially: take the stricter view rather than the average.
    // Averaging across a genuine disagreement hides a real defect.
    score = Math.min(...verdicts.map((v) => v.score));
    adjudicated = true;
    notes.push(
      `Judges disagreed by ${disagreement.toFixed(2)} (> ${maxDisagreement}). Adopted the stricter score ${score.toFixed(2)}.`,
    );
  }

  return {
    verdicts,
    score,
    disagreement,
    passed: score >= acceptScore && !hardFail,
    adjudicated,
    hardFail,
    rubricId: rubric.id,
    evaluatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    notes,
  };
}

export function providerForModel(model: string): string {
  switch (modelFamily(model)) {
    case "anthropic":
      return "anthropic";
    case "openai":
      return "openai";
    case "google":
      return "google";
    case "xai":
      return "openrouter";
    default:
      return "ollama";
  }
}

/** Render a result for the UI / flight recorder. */
export function renderEvaluation(r: EvaluationResult): string {
  const lines = [
    `Score ${r.score.toFixed(2)}/5 — ${r.passed ? "PASSED" : "FAILED"} (${r.rubricId})`,
    `Judges: ${r.verdicts.map((v) => v.judgeModel).join(", ") || "none"}`,
  ];
  if (r.disagreement) lines.push(`Disagreement: ${r.disagreement.toFixed(2)}`);
  if (r.hardFail) lines.push(`HARD FAIL: ${r.hardFail}`);
  for (const v of r.verdicts) {
    lines.push(`  ${v.judgeModel}: ${v.score.toFixed(2)} — ${v.summary}`);
    for (const [k, s] of Object.entries(v.dimensionScores)) {
      lines.push(`      ${k}: ${s}${v.reasoning[k] ? ` — ${v.reasoning[k].slice(0, 120)}` : ""}`);
    }
  }
  for (const n of r.notes) lines.push(`note: ${n}`);
  return lines.join("\n");
}
```

## `src/engine/expression.ts`

```typescript
const BLOCKED = new Set([
  "this",
  "window",
  "document",
  "globalThis",
  "global",
  "process",
  "require",
  "eval",
  "Function",
  "constructor",
  "prototype",
  "__proto__",
  "fetch",
  "XMLHttpRequest",
  "import",
  "export",
]);

const WHITELIST_CALLS = new Set(["String", "Number", "Boolean", "Math", "Array", "Object", "JSON"]);

export function safeEvaluate(expr: string, input: unknown): unknown {
  const src = expr.trim();
  if (!src) throw new Error("empty expression");
  if (src.length > 600) throw new Error("expression too long");
  if (/[;`\\]/.test(src)) throw new Error("illegal character");

  const tokens = src.match(/[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*|["'][^"']*["']|[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?|[=!<>]=?|&&|\|\||[()[\].,+\-*/%?:]|true|false|null/g);
  if (!tokens || tokens.join("") !== src.replace(/\s+/g, "")) {
    throw new Error("malformed expression");
  }

  for (const t of tokens) {
    if (/^[A-Za-z_]/.test(t) && !["input", "true", "false", "null", "undefined"].includes(t) && !WHITELIST_CALLS.has(t)) {
      if (BLOCKED.has(t)) throw new Error(`blocked identifier: ${t}`);
    }
    if (BLOCKED.has(t)) throw new Error(`blocked identifier: ${t}`);
  }
  if (/\bconstructor\b|\b__proto__\b|\bprototype\b/.test(src)) throw new Error("blocked property");

  const fn = new Function(
    "input",
    "String",
    "Number",
    "Boolean",
    "Math",
    "Array",
    "Object",
    "JSON",
    `"use strict"; return (${src});`,
  );
  return fn(input, String, Number, Boolean, Math, Array, Object, JSON);
}
```
