## `src/engine/failureClassifier.ts`

```typescript
/**
 * MJ 6.0 — Failure detection & classification (spec §15).
 *
 * V5's error handling was `catch → DLQ row → continue`. V6 classifies *why* something
 * failed, because the repair strategy depends entirely on the class and blind retry
 * is explicitly forbidden (§16: "Do not retry blindly").
 */
import type { MissionTask, Organization } from "../domain/organization";

export type FailureClass =
  | "REPEATED_FAILURE"
  | "TIMEOUT_LOOP"
  | "TOOL_FAILURE_LOOP"
  | "SAME_TASK_DUPLICATION"
  | "CONTRADICTORY_OUTPUTS"
  | "AGENT_STARVATION"
  | "DEPENDENCY_DEADLOCK"
  | "BUDGET_EXHAUSTION"
  | "PERMISSION_DENIAL"
  | "INVALID_ARTIFACT_STATE"
  | "REGRESSION"
  | "HARNESS_UNAVAILABLE"
  /** MAST: an agent repeats work it has already done. 15.7% of all failures. */
  | "STEP_REPETITION"
  /** MAST: an agent reports completion before the work is actually done. 6.2%. */
  | "PREMATURE_TERMINATION"
  | "UNKNOWN";

export const FAILURE_CLASSES: FailureClass[] = [
  "REPEATED_FAILURE", "TIMEOUT_LOOP", "TOOL_FAILURE_LOOP", "SAME_TASK_DUPLICATION",
  "CONTRADICTORY_OUTPUTS", "AGENT_STARVATION", "DEPENDENCY_DEADLOCK", "BUDGET_EXHAUSTION",
  "PERMISSION_DENIAL", "INVALID_ARTIFACT_STATE", "REGRESSION", "HARNESS_UNAVAILABLE",
  "STEP_REPETITION", "PREMATURE_TERMINATION", "UNKNOWN",
];

export const FAILURE_CLASS_LABEL: Record<FailureClass, string> = {
  REPEATED_FAILURE: "Same task failing repeatedly",
  TIMEOUT_LOOP: "Repeated timeouts",
  TOOL_FAILURE_LOOP: "Tool failing in a loop",
  SAME_TASK_DUPLICATION: "Duplicate work on the same task",
  CONTRADICTORY_OUTPUTS: "Agents produced contradictory outputs",
  AGENT_STARVATION: "Agent has no work but mission is not done",
  DEPENDENCY_DEADLOCK: "Circular or unresolvable dependency",
  BUDGET_EXHAUSTION: "Budget or step ceiling exhausted",
  PERMISSION_DENIAL: "Action denied by permission policy",
  INVALID_ARTIFACT_STATE: "Artifact failed validation",
  REGRESSION: "Previously passing check now fails",
  HARNESS_UNAVAILABLE: "Required harness not installed or not authenticated",
  STEP_REPETITION: "Agent repeated work it had already done",
  PREMATURE_TERMINATION: "Reported success before the work was finished",
  UNKNOWN: "Unclassified failure",
};

export interface FailureSignal {
  id: string;
  class: FailureClass;
  severity: "WARN" | "ERROR" | "CRITICAL";
  /** What was observed, verbatim. */
  observation: string;
  /** Slot / task / artifact the signal is about. */
  subjectType: "agent" | "task" | "artifact" | "organization" | "resource";
  subjectId: string;
  /** Counts and thresholds that produced the classification. */
  metrics: Record<string, number>;
  detectedAt: string;
  /** Human-readable suggested next step. */
  suggestedAction: string;
}

let sigSeq = 0;
function makeSignal(
  cls: FailureClass,
  severity: FailureSignal["severity"],
  observation: string,
  subjectType: FailureSignal["subjectType"],
  subjectId: string,
  metrics: Record<string, number>,
  suggestedAction: string,
): FailureSignal {
  sigSeq += 1;
  return {
    id: `sig-${Date.now().toString(36)}-${sigSeq}`,
    class: cls,
    severity,
    observation,
    subjectType,
    subjectId,
    metrics,
    detectedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    suggestedAction,
  };
}

/** Classify a single agent error string. Fast path used at the moment of failure. */
export function classifyError(error: string, attempts: number): FailureClass {
  const e = error.toLowerCase();
  if (/not on path|not installed|enoent|command not found/.test(e)) return "HARNESS_UNAVAILABLE";
  if (/auth|unauthorized|401|403|api key|login/.test(e)) return "HARNESS_UNAVAILABLE";
  if (/permission|not granted|forbidden|denied/.test(e)) return "PERMISSION_DENIAL";
  if (/timeout|timed out|deadline exceeded|etimedout/.test(e)) {
    return attempts >= 2 ? "TIMEOUT_LOOP" : "UNKNOWN";
  }
  if (/tool error|tool failed|unknown tool/.test(e)) {
    return attempts >= 2 ? "TOOL_FAILURE_LOOP" : "UNKNOWN";
  }
  if (/budget|ceiling|exhausted|limit reached/.test(e)) return "BUDGET_EXHAUSTION";
  if (attempts >= 2) return "REPEATED_FAILURE";
  return "UNKNOWN";
}

export interface SupervisorInput {
  org: Organization;
  /** Slots currently holding tasks. */
  busySlotIds: string[];
  /** Wall-clock ms since each slot last produced output. */
  lastOutputAgoMs: Record<string, number>;
  /** Tool-call errors per slot over the recent window. */
  toolErrors: Record<string, number>;
  /** Artifact ids that failed validation. */
  invalidArtifactIds: string[];
  /** Checks that used to pass and now fail. */
  regressions: string[];
  /** Blackboard conflicts detected. */
  conflictingTopics: Array<{ topic: string; entryIds: string[] }>;
  /** Budget utilization 0–1. */
  budgetUtilization: number;
  /** Tasks currently blocked with no runnable predecessor. */
  deadlockedTaskIds: string[];
  /** Higher-severity signals seen earlier, to avoid re-raising. */
  alreadyRaised?: FailureClass[];
  /** Stall threshold in ms. */
  stallAfterMs?: number;
}

/**
 * The supervisor's detection pass (§5). Pure function of observable state, so it is
 * unit-testable and can be replayed from the flight recorder.
 */
export function detectFailures(input: SupervisorInput): FailureSignal[] {
  const out: FailureSignal[] = [];
  const raised = new Set(input.alreadyRaised ?? []);
  const stallAfterMs = input.stallAfterMs ?? 120_000;
  const push = (s: FailureSignal) => {
    if (raised.has(s.class)) return;
    raised.add(s.class);
    out.push(s);
  };

  // 1. Repeated failure — an agent that keeps failing and has completed nothing.
  //
  // Counting only *distinct failed tasks* was wrong: a slot owns one task per phase,
  // so an agent that fails the same task through the whole repair ladder never
  // reached the threshold and stayed invisible to the supervisor. Repair attempts
  // are failures too (§5 "repeated failures", §16 the ladder).
  for (const slot of input.org.candidatePool) {
    const sc = slot.scorecard;
    const failedOwnTasks = input.org.tasks.filter(
      (t) => t.assigneeId === slot.id && t.status === "FAILED",
    );
    const retriedToExhaustion = failedOwnTasks.some((t) => (t.attempts ?? 0) >= 2);
    const repeated = sc.tasksFailed >= 2 || retriedToExhaustion || (sc.tasksFailed >= 1 && sc.repairsUsed >= 1);
    if (repeated && sc.tasksCompleted === 0) {
      push(
        makeSignal(
          "REPEATED_FAILURE",
          "ERROR",
          `${slot.title} failed ${sc.tasksFailed} task(s) across ${sc.repairsUsed} repair attempt(s) and completed none. Last error: ${sc.lastError ?? "none recorded"}`,
          "agent",
          slot.id,
          {
            failed: sc.tasksFailed,
            completed: sc.tasksCompleted,
            repairsUsed: sc.repairsUsed,
            attempts: failedOwnTasks.reduce((m, t) => Math.max(m, t.attempts ?? 0), 0),
          },
          "Reassign the task to a different agent or harness; do not retry unchanged.",
        ),
      );
    }
  }

  // 2. Stalled agents — running but silent past the stall threshold.
  for (const slotId of input.busySlotIds) {
    const ago = input.lastOutputAgoMs[slotId];
    if (typeof ago === "number" && ago > stallAfterMs) {
      const slot = input.org.candidatePool.find((s) => s.id === slotId);
      push(
        makeSignal(
          "TIMEOUT_LOOP",
          "WARN",
          `${slot?.title ?? slotId} has produced no output for ${Math.round(ago / 1000)}s.`,
          "agent",
          slotId,
          { silentMs: ago, thresholdMs: stallAfterMs },
          "Interrupt, capture partial state, and either resume with a shorter budget or replace.",
        ),
      );
    }
  }

  // 3. Tool failure loops.
  for (const [slotId, count] of Object.entries(input.toolErrors)) {
    if (count >= 3) {
      const slot = input.org.candidatePool.find((s) => s.id === slotId);
      push(
        makeSignal(
          "TOOL_FAILURE_LOOP",
          "ERROR",
          `${slot?.title ?? slotId} hit ${count} tool errors in the recent window.`,
          "agent",
          slotId,
          { toolErrors: count },
          "Remove the failing tool from the agent's catalog or grant the permission it needs.",
        ),
      );
    }
  }

  // 4. Duplicate work — two live slots on the same task with the same instruction.
  const byTask = new Map<string, MissionTask[]>();
  for (const t of input.org.tasks) {
    if (t.status === "RUNNING" || t.status === "DELEGATED") {
      const list = byTask.get(t.instruction) ?? [];
      list.push(t);
      byTask.set(t.instruction, list);
    }
  }
  for (const [instruction, list] of byTask) {
    const distinctOwners = new Set(list.map((t) => t.assigneeId));
    if (list.length > 1 && distinctOwners.size === list.length) {
      push(
        makeSignal(
          "SAME_TASK_DUPLICATION",
          "WARN",
          `${list.length} agents are working the same instruction: "${instruction.slice(0, 80)}"`,
          "task",
          list[0].id,
          { duplicates: list.length },
          "Merge the duplicates and consolidate onto one owner.",
        ),
      );
    }
  }

  // 4b. Step repetition — one agent doing the same thing twice.
  //
  // MAST finds this to be the single largest multi-agent failure mode at 15.7%,
  // ahead of disobeying the task spec (11.8%) and premature termination (6.2%).
  // Rule 4 above only catches *two agents* colliding; this catches the far more
  // common case of one agent looping on its own output.
  for (const t of input.org.tasks) {
    const hashes = t.attemptHashes ?? [];
    if (hashes.length < 2) continue;
    const last = hashes[hashes.length - 1];
    const repeated = hashes.filter((h) => h === last).length;
    if (repeated < 2) continue;
    const slot = input.org.candidatePool.find((x) => x.id === t.assigneeId);
    push(
      makeSignal(
        "STEP_REPETITION",
        "ERROR",
        `${slot?.title ?? t.assigneeId ?? "Agent"} produced identical output on ${repeated} of ${hashes.length} attempts of "${t.title}". Retrying will reproduce the same result.`,
        "task",
        t.id,
        { attempts: hashes.length, repeated },
        "Change what the agent sees — different context, decomposition, or owner — rather than asking again.",
      ),
    );
  }

  // 4c. Premature termination — declared done with nothing to show for it.
  //
  // MAST: 6.2% of failures are agents stopping early, and 8.2% are verification
  // that never meaningfully happened. A COMPLETED task that produced no artifacts
  // and was never evaluated is the cheapest possible place to catch both.
  for (const t of input.org.tasks) {
    if (t.status !== "COMPLETED") continue;
    if ((t.outputs?.length ?? 0) > 0) continue;
    push(
      makeSignal(
        "PREMATURE_TERMINATION",
        "WARN",
        `"${t.title}" is marked COMPLETED but produced no artifacts — it declared success rather than demonstrating it.`,
        "task",
        t.id,
        { attempts: t.attempts, outputs: t.outputs?.length ?? 0 },
        "Require an artifact or an independent evaluation before a task may close.",
      ),
    );
  }

  // 5. Contradictory outputs — from blackboard conflicts.
  if (input.conflictingTopics.length) {
    const c = input.conflictingTopics[0];
    push(
      makeSignal(
        "CONTRADICTORY_OUTPUTS",
        "ERROR",
        `Agents disagree on "${c.topic}".`,
        "organization",
        input.org.id,
        { conflicts: input.conflictingTopics.length },
        "Open a negotiation thread or fork a debate; do not silently pick one.",
      ),
    );
  }

  // 6. Starvation — active agents with no task while tasks remain undone.
  const undone = input.org.tasks.filter(
    (t) => t.status === "PENDING" || t.status === "DELEGATED" || t.status === "BLOCKED",
  );
  const idle = input.org.candidatePool.filter(
    (s) => s.active && s.status === "IDLE" && !input.busySlotIds.includes(s.id),
  );
  if (undone.length > 0 && idle.length > 0 && input.busySlotIds.length === 0) {
    push(
      makeSignal(
        "AGENT_STARVATION",
        "WARN",
        `${idle.length} active agents idle while ${undone.length} tasks remain.`,
        "organization",
        input.org.id,
        { idle: idle.length, undone: undone.length },
        "Delegate pending work or retire surplus agents.",
      ),
    );
  }

  // 7. Dependency deadlock.
  if (input.deadlockedTaskIds.length) {
    push(
      makeSignal(
        "DEPENDENCY_DEADLOCK",
        "CRITICAL",
        `${input.deadlockedTaskIds.length} tasks cannot run: unresolvable dependencies.`,
        "task",
        input.deadlockedTaskIds[0],
        { deadlocked: input.deadlockedTaskIds.length },
        "Break the cycle by relaxing a dependency or splitting the task.",
      ),
    );
  }

  // 8. Budget exhaustion.
  if (input.budgetUtilization >= 1) {
    push(
      makeSignal(
        "BUDGET_EXHAUSTION",
        "CRITICAL",
        `Budget utilization ${(input.budgetUtilization * 100).toFixed(0)}%.`,
        "resource",
        input.org.id,
        { utilization: input.budgetUtilization },
        "Stop work and ask the human to raise the ceiling or narrow the scope.",
      ),
    );
  }

  // 9. Invalid artifact state.
  if (input.invalidArtifactIds.length) {
    push(
      makeSignal(
        "INVALID_ARTIFACT_STATE",
        "ERROR",
        `${input.invalidArtifactIds.length} artifacts failed validation.`,
        "artifact",
        input.invalidArtifactIds[0],
        { invalid: input.invalidArtifactIds.length },
        "Roll back to the last known-good version and re-run the producing agent.",
      ),
    );
  }

  // 10. Regressions.
  if (input.regressions.length) {
    push(
      makeSignal(
        "REGRESSION",
        "CRITICAL",
        `${input.regressions.length} previously passing checks now fail: ${input.regressions.slice(0, 3).join("; ")}`,
        "organization",
        input.org.id,
        { regressions: input.regressions.length },
        "Reject the last mutation and roll back to the pre-mutation checkpoint.",
      ),
    );
  }

  return out;
}

/**
 * Which capability is missing, inferred from the failure. Used by the reorganizer
 * to decide between ADD_VERIFIER, SPAWN_SPECIALIST and SWAP_HARNESS.
 */
export function inferMissingCapability(fc: FailureClass, errorText = ""): string | null {
  const e = errorText.toLowerCase();
  if (fc === "PERMISSION_DENIAL") {
    if (/fs|file|write/.test(e)) return "filesystemWrite";
    if (/shell|terminal|exec/.test(e)) return "terminalExecute";
    if (/browser/.test(e)) return "browserControl";
    if (/mcp/.test(e)) return "mcpUse";
    if (/network|http/.test(e)) return "networkAccess";
    return "permission-escalation";
  }
  if (fc === "HARNESS_UNAVAILABLE") return "harness-installation";
  if (fc === "INVALID_ARTIFACT_STATE") return "verification";
  if (fc === "CONTRADICTORY_OUTPUTS") return "arbitration";
  if (fc === "REGRESSION") return "regression-detection";
  if (fc === "TIMEOUT_LOOP" || fc === "TOOL_FAILURE_LOOP") return "tooling";
  return null;
}

export function severityRank(s: FailureSignal["severity"]): number {
  return s === "CRITICAL" ? 3 : s === "ERROR" ? 2 : 1;
}

```


## `src/engine/flightRecorder.ts`

```typescript
/**
 * MJ 6.0 — Mission flight recorder (spec §14).
 *
 * The goal is explicitly NOT log viewing; it is time-travel debugging. So every
 * event carries enough state to rebuild the organization at that instant, and the
 * recorder can materialize a full snapshot at any seq — which is what "replay from
 * checkpoint, inspect state / inputs / outputs / decisions / evidence" requires.
 */
import type { EventLevel, OrgEvent, OrgEventKind, EventActor, EventAuthority } from "../domain/events";
import { levelForKind } from "../domain/events";
import type { MissionCheckpoint } from "./checkpoint";

export interface RecordedEvent extends OrgEvent {
  seq: number;
  /** Snapshot of the things this event touched, for inspection without replay. */
  snapshot?: Record<string, unknown>;
}

export interface ReplayFrame {
  seq: number;
  event: RecordedEvent;
  /** Reconstructed state after applying this event. */
  state: {
    missionStatus?: string;
    orgStatus?: string;
    activeAgents: string[];
    runningTasks: string[];
    completedTasks: string[];
    failedTasks: string[];
    artifacts: number;
    openApprovals: string[];
    costUsd: number;
    notes: string[];
  };
}

export class FlightRecorder {
  private events: RecordedEvent[] = [];
  private seq = 0;
  private checkpoints: MissionCheckpoint[] = [];

  record(input: {
    kind: OrgEventKind;
    missionId: string;
    actor: EventActor;
    orgId?: string;
    level?: EventLevel;
    authority?: EventAuthority;
    nodeId?: string;
    agentSlotId?: string;
    taskId?: string;
    artifactId?: string;
    executionId?: string;
    data?: Record<string, unknown>;
    snapshot?: Record<string, unknown>;
    checkpointId?: string;
  }): RecordedEvent {
    this.seq += 1;
    const ev: RecordedEvent = {
      id: `ev-${this.seq}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6)}`,
      seq: this.seq,
      ts: new Date().toISOString(),
      kind: input.kind,
      level: input.level ?? levelForKind(input.kind),
      missionId: input.missionId,
      orgId: input.orgId,
      actor: input.actor,
      authority: input.authority,
      nodeId: input.nodeId,
      agentSlotId: input.agentSlotId,
      taskId: input.taskId,
      artifactId: input.artifactId,
      executionId: input.executionId,
      data: input.data ?? {},
      snapshot: input.snapshot,
      checkpointId: input.checkpointId,
    };
    this.events.push(ev);
    return ev;
  }

  addCheckpoint(cp: MissionCheckpoint): void {
    this.checkpoints.push(cp);
  }

  all(): RecordedEvent[] {
    return [...this.events];
  }

  forMission(missionId: string): RecordedEvent[] {
    return this.events.filter((e) => e.missionId === missionId);
  }

  byKind(kinds: OrgEventKind[]): RecordedEvent[] {
    const set = new Set(kinds);
    return this.events.filter((e) => set.has(e.kind));
  }

  range(fromSeq: number, toSeq: number): RecordedEvent[] {
    return this.events.filter((e) => e.seq >= fromSeq && e.seq <= toSeq);
  }

  /**
   * Rebuild organization state by folding events up to `seq`.
   * Deterministic: same events in, same state out. That is what makes replay useful.
   */
  stateAt(missionId: string, seq: number): ReplayFrame["state"] {
    const state: ReplayFrame["state"] = {
      activeAgents: [],
      runningTasks: [],
      completedTasks: [],
      failedTasks: [],
      artifacts: 0,
      openApprovals: [],
      costUsd: 0,
      notes: [],
    };
    const active = new Set<string>();
    const running = new Set<string>();
    const completed = new Set<string>();
    const failed = new Set<string>();
    const approvals = new Set<string>();
    let artifacts = 0;
    let cost = 0;

    for (const e of this.forMission(missionId)) {
      if (e.seq > seq) break;
      const d = e.data as Record<string, unknown>;
      switch (e.kind) {
        case "MISSION_STARTED":
          state.missionStatus = "RUNNING";
          break;
        case "MISSION_PAUSED":
          state.missionStatus = "PAUSED";
          break;
        case "MISSION_COMPLETED":
          state.missionStatus = "COMPLETED";
          break;
        case "MISSION_FAILED":
          state.missionStatus = "FAILED";
          break;
        case "MISSION_ABORTED":
          state.missionStatus = "ABORTED";
          break;
        case "ORG_CREATED":
          state.orgStatus = "FORMING";
          break;
        case "ORG_REORGANIZED":
          state.orgStatus = "REORGANIZING";
          state.notes.push(`reorganization: ${String(d.summary ?? "")}`);
          break;
        case "AGENT_SPAWNED":
          if (e.agentSlotId) active.add(e.agentSlotId);
          break;
        case "AGENT_RETIRED":
        case "AGENT_REPLACED":
          if (e.agentSlotId) active.delete(e.agentSlotId);
          break;
        case "TASK_DELEGATED":
        case "TASK_REASSIGNED":
          if (e.taskId) {
            running.add(e.taskId);
            completed.delete(e.taskId);
          }
          break;
        case "TASK_COMPLETED":
          if (e.taskId) {
            running.delete(e.taskId);
            completed.add(e.taskId);
          }
          break;
        case "TASK_FAILED":
          if (e.taskId) {
            running.delete(e.taskId);
            failed.add(e.taskId);
          }
          break;
        case "ARTIFACT_CREATED":
        case "ARTIFACT_VERSIONED":
          artifacts += 1;
          break;
        case "APPROVAL_REQUIRED":
          if (e.taskId) approvals.add(e.taskId);
          break;
        case "APPROVAL_GRANTED":
        case "APPROVAL_REJECTED":
          if (e.taskId) approvals.delete(e.taskId);
          break;
        case "NODE_SUCCEEDED":
        case "NODE_FAILED":
          if (typeof d.costUsd === "number") cost += d.costUsd;
          break;
        case "BUDGET_BREACHED":
          state.notes.push(`budget breach: ${String(d.ceiling ?? "")}`);
          break;
        default:
          break;
      }
    }

    state.activeAgents = [...active];
    state.runningTasks = [...running];
    state.completedTasks = [...completed];
    state.failedTasks = [...failed];
    state.artifacts = artifacts;
    state.openApprovals = [...approvals];
    state.costUsd = cost;
    return state;
  }

  /** Full replay frames from `fromSeq` to `toSeq`. */
  replay(missionId: string, fromSeq = 0, toSeq = Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER): ReplayFrame[] {
    return this.forMission(missionId)
      .filter((e) => e.seq >= fromSeq && e.seq <= toSeq)
      .map((event) => ({ seq: event.seq, event, state: this.stateAt(missionId, event.seq) }));
  }

  /** Checkpoint at or before a seq — the anchor for "replay from checkpoint". */
  checkpointAtOrBefore(missionId: string, seq: number): MissionCheckpoint | undefined {
    const ts = this.events.find((e) => e.seq === seq)?.ts;
    if (!ts) return undefined;
    const eligible = this.checkpoints
      .filter((c) => c.missionId === missionId && c.createdAt <= ts)
      .sort((a, b) => b.createdAt.localeCompare(a.createdAt));
    return eligible[0];
  }

  checkpointsFor(missionId: string): MissionCheckpoint[] {
    return this.checkpoints.filter((c) => c.missionId === missionId);
  }

  decisionTrail(missionId: string): RecordedEvent[] {
    return this.forMission(missionId).filter(
      (e) =>
        e.authority !== undefined ||
        e.kind === "APPROVAL_GRANTED" ||
        e.kind === "APPROVAL_REJECTED" ||
        e.kind === "GRAPH_MUTATED" ||
        e.kind === "REPAIR_STRATEGY_SELECTED" ||
        e.kind === "NEGOTIATION_RESOLVED" ||
        e.kind === "HARNESS_SELECTED",
    );
  }

  count(): number {
    return this.events.length;
  }

  export(missionId: string): string {
    const lines = [`MJ 6.0 — FLIGHT RECORDER: ${missionId}`, `events: ${this.forMission(missionId).length}`, ""];
    for (const e of this.forMission(missionId)) {
      lines.push(
        `#${e.seq} ${e.ts} [${e.level}] ${e.kind}`,
        `    actor:  ${e.actor.kind}:${e.actor.id} (${e.actor.label})`,
      );
      if (e.authority) {
        lines.push(
          `    authority: ${e.authority.source} · policy ${e.authority.policy}`,
          `    reason:    ${e.authority.reason}`,
          `    evidence:  ${e.authority.evidence.join(" | ") || "none"}`,
        );
      }
      const keys = Object.keys(e.data);
      if (keys.length) {
        lines.push(`    data:   ${keys.map((k) => `${k}=${JSON.stringify(e.data[k])}`).join(" ").slice(0, 400)}`);
      }
      lines.push("");
    }
    return lines.join("\n");
  }
}

/** Human-readable one-line summary per event kind, for the timeline UI. */
export function describeEvent(e: RecordedEvent): string {
  const d = e.data as Record<string, unknown>;
  const who = e.actor.label;
  switch (e.kind) {
    case "AGENT_SPAWNED":
      return `${who} spawned ${String(d.title ?? d.roleKey ?? "agent")}`;
    case "AGENT_FAILED":
      return `${who} failed: ${String(d.error ?? "unknown error")}`;
    case "HARNESS_SELECTED":
      return `Harness ${String(d.harnessId ?? "")} selected — ${String(d.rationale ?? "")}`;
    case "HARNESS_SWITCHED":
      return `Harness switched ${String(d.from ?? "")} → ${String(d.to ?? "")}`;
    case "TASK_DELEGATED":
      return `Task "${String(d.title ?? "")}" delegated to ${String(d.assignee ?? "")}`;
    case "GRAPH_MUTATED":
      return `Graph v${String(d.previousGraphVersion ?? "?")} → v${String(d.newGraphVersion ?? "?")}: ${String(d.summary ?? "")}`;
    case "APPROVAL_REQUIRED":
      return `Approval required (${String(d.riskClass ?? "")}): ${String(d.what ?? "")}`;
    case "REPAIR_STRATEGY_SELECTED":
      return `Repair: ${String(d.strategy ?? "")} — ${String(d.why ?? "")}`;
    case "EVALUATION_SCORED":
      return `Scored ${typeof d.score === "number" ? d.score.toFixed(2) : "?"}/5 by ${String(d.judges ?? "")}`;
    case "ARTIFACT_VERSIONED":
      return `Artifact ${String(d.name ?? "")} → v${String(d.version ?? "")}`;
    default:
      return e.kind;
  }
}

## `src/engine/governor.ts`

```typescript
/**
 * MJ 6.0 — Governor (spec §10, §32, §33).
 *
 * The single chokepoint every autonomous action passes through. Nothing in the
 * organization — not the supervisor, not the reorganizer, not an agent — may act
 * without a decision from here. Every decision is recorded with actor, authority,
 * policy, reason and evidence (§32).
 */
import type { Charter, EscalationTrigger } from "../domain/charter";
import { forbiddenActionMatches, reconcileRiskPolicy } from "../domain/charter";
import type { RiskClass, RiskPolicy } from "../domain/risk";
import { classifyAction, handlingFor, RISK_CLASS_RANK } from "../domain/risk";
import type { PermissionSet } from "../domain/types";

export type Decision = "ALLOW" | "SUPERVISE" | "REQUIRE_APPROVAL" | "DENY";

export const DECISION_LABEL: Record<Decision, string> = {
  ALLOW: "Allowed",
  SUPERVISE: "Allowed under supervision",
  REQUIRE_APPROVAL: "Human approval required",
  DENY: "Denied",
};

export interface PolicyCheckRequest {
  /** Normalized action descriptor, e.g. `fs:write`, `git:push`, `deploy:production`. */
  action: string;
  riskClass?: RiskClass;
  actorId: string;
  actorLabel: string;
  /** Permission the action needs, if any. */
  requiredPermission?: keyof PermissionSet;
  /** Permissions the actor holds. */
  actorPermissions?: PermissionSet;
  /** Estimated cost of this action, for budget projection. */
  estimatedCostUsd?: number;
  evidence?: string[];
  reason?: string;
}

export interface PolicyCheckResult {
  decision: Decision;
  riskClass: RiskClass;
  /** Policy clause that produced the decision. */
  policy: string;
  reason: string;
  /** Escalation trigger raised, if any. */
  trigger?: EscalationTrigger;
  action: string;
}

export interface GovernorState {
  charter: Charter;
  riskPolicy: RiskPolicy;
  /** §10 — what the charter tightened when the mission policy was reconciled. */
  reconciledNotes: string[];
  spentUsd: number;
  inputTokens: number;
  outputTokens: number;
  nodeRuns: number;
  reorganizations: number;
  concurrentAgents: number;
  startedAt: number;
  killSwitch: boolean;
  /** Set when budget/step ceilings are crossed; cleared by a human. */
  trippedCeilings: string[];
  escalations: number;
}

export function createGovernorState(charter: Charter, riskPolicy: RiskPolicy): GovernorState {
  // §10/§11: the charter's consequence tier is the ceiling on the mission policy.
  const { policy, notes } = reconcileRiskPolicy(charter, riskPolicy);
  return {
    charter,
    riskPolicy: policy,
    reconciledNotes: notes,
    spentUsd: 0,
    inputTokens: 0,
    outputTokens: 0,
    nodeRuns: 0,
    reorganizations: 0,
    concurrentAgents: 0,
    startedAt: Date.now(),
    killSwitch: false,
    trippedCeilings: notes.map((n) => `charter-clamp: ${n}`),
    escalations: 0,
  };
}

export function engageKillSwitch(s: GovernorState, reason: string): void {
  s.killSwitch = true;
  s.trippedCeilings.push(`kill-switch: ${reason}`);
}

export function releaseKillSwitch(s: GovernorState): void {
  s.killSwitch = false;
}

/** Budget check. Returns the ceilings that are breached or approaching. */
export function checkBudget(s: GovernorState): {
  breached: string[];
  warning: string[];
  fractions: Record<string, number>;
} {
  const c = s.charter.ceilings;
  const elapsed = Date.now() - s.startedAt;
  const raw: Record<string, number> = {
    cost: s.spentUsd / Math.max(c.maxCostUsd, 1e-9),
    inputTokens: s.inputTokens / Math.max(c.maxInputTokens, 1),
    outputTokens: s.outputTokens / Math.max(c.maxOutputTokens, 1),
    wallClock: elapsed / Math.max(c.maxWallClockMs, 1),
    nodeRuns: s.nodeRuns / Math.max(c.maxNodeRuns, 1),
    reorganizations: s.reorganizations / Math.max(c.maxReorganizations, 1),
    concurrentAgents: s.concurrentAgents / Math.max(c.maxConcurrentAgents, 1),
  };
  const breached: string[] = [];
  const warning: string[] = [];
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(raw)) {
    if (v >= 1) breached.push(k);
    else if (v >= c.warnAtFraction) warning.push(k);
  }
  return { breached, warning, fractions: raw };
}

/**
 * The one gate. Order matters: kill switch → forbidden → permission ceiling →
 * risk class handling → budget → concurrency.
 */
export function checkPolicy(s: GovernorState, req: PolicyCheckRequest): PolicyCheckResult {
  const action = req.action.trim();
  const riskClass = req.riskClass ?? classifyAction(action);

  if (s.killSwitch) {
    return {
      decision: "DENY",
      riskClass,
      policy: "kill-switch",
      reason: "Kill switch engaged. All autonomous action is suspended until a human releases it.",
      trigger: "RISK_TIER_EXCEEDED",
      action,
    };
  }

  const forbidden = forbiddenActionMatches(s.charter.forbiddenActions, action);
  if (forbidden) {
    return {
      decision: "DENY",
      riskClass,
      policy: `forbidden:${forbidden}`,
      reason: `Action "${action}" matches forbidden rule "${forbidden}". This is never permitted.`,
      trigger: "FORBIDDEN_ACTION_ATTEMPTED",
      action,
    };
  }

  if (req.requiredPermission) {
    const ceilingOk = s.charter.permissionCeiling[req.requiredPermission];
    const actorOk = req.actorPermissions ? req.actorPermissions[req.requiredPermission] : true;
    if (!ceilingOk || !actorOk) {
      return {
        decision: "DENY",
        riskClass,
        policy: `permission:${req.requiredPermission}`,
        reason: !ceilingOk
          ? `Charter ceiling forbids "${req.requiredPermission}". An agent cannot inherit it.`
          : `Actor ${req.actorLabel} does not hold "${req.requiredPermission}".`,
        trigger: "PERMISSION_ESCALATION_REQUESTED",
        action,
      };
    }
  }

  const budget = checkBudget(s);
  if (budget.breached.length) {
    return {
      decision: "REQUIRE_APPROVAL",
      riskClass,
      policy: `ceiling:${budget.breached.join(",")}`,
      reason: `Budget/step ceiling reached (${budget.breached.join(", ")}). Continuing requires a human decision.`,
      trigger: "BUDGET_BREACH",
      action,
    };
  }

  if (
    s.concurrentAgents + 1 > s.charter.ceilings.maxConcurrentAgents &&
    (action.startsWith("agent:") || action.startsWith("task:"))
  ) {
    return {
      decision: "SUPERVISE",
      riskClass,
      policy: "concurrency-limit",
      reason: `Concurrency ceiling ${s.charter.ceilings.maxConcurrentAgents} reached; this action will queue.`,
      action,
    };
  }

  const handling = handlingFor(s.riskPolicy, riskClass);
  const aboveAutonomous = RISK_CLASS_RANK[riskClass] > RISK_CLASS_RANK[s.riskPolicy.maxAutonomousClass];

  if (handling === "HUMAN_ONLY" || aboveAutonomous) {
    return {
      decision: "REQUIRE_APPROVAL",
      riskClass,
      policy: aboveAutonomous ? `risk:above-max-autonomous` : `risk:${riskClass}→HUMAN_ONLY`,
      reason:
        `Action "${action}" is classified ${riskClass}. Policy routes ${riskClass} to human approval` +
        (aboveAutonomous ? `, and it exceeds the max autonomous class ${s.riskPolicy.maxAutonomousClass}.` : "."),
      trigger: "RISK_TIER_EXCEEDED",
      action,
    };
  }

  if (handling === "SUPERVISED") {
    return {
      decision: "SUPERVISE",
      riskClass,
      policy: `risk:${riskClass}→SUPERVISED`,
      reason: `Action "${action}" is ${riskClass}. Permitted, recorded, and independently evaluated.`,
      action,
    };
  }

  if (budget.warning.length) {
    return {
      decision: "ALLOW",
      riskClass,
      policy: `risk:${riskClass}→AUTONOMOUS`,
      reason: `Allowed. Note: approaching ceiling on ${budget.warning.join(", ")}.`,
      trigger: "BUDGET_WARN",
      action,
    };
  }

  return {
    decision: "ALLOW",
    riskClass,
    policy: `risk:${riskClass}→AUTONOMOUS`,
    reason: req.reason ?? `Action "${action}" is ${riskClass} and within all ceilings.`,
    action,
  };
}

/** Whether a reorganization is permitted without asking (§17, §32). */
export function mayReorganize(
  s: GovernorState,
  mutationAllowedByCharter: boolean,
): { allowed: boolean; reason: string } {
  if (s.killSwitch) return { allowed: false, reason: "Kill switch engaged." };
  if (!mutationAllowedByCharter) {
    return { allowed: false, reason: "Charter does not permit this mutation kind." };
  }
  if (s.charter.autonomyMode !== "CHARTERED") {
    return {
      allowed: false,
      reason: `Autonomy mode is ${s.charter.autonomyMode}; reorganizations require human approval.`,
    };
  }
  if (s.reorganizations + 1 > s.charter.ceilings.maxReorganizations) {
    return { allowed: false, reason: "Reorganization ceiling reached." };
  }
  return { allowed: true, reason: "Within charter ceilings; chartered autonomy applies." };
}

/** Apply spend. Returns any ceilings newly tripped. */
export function recordSpend(
  s: GovernorState,
  usd: number,
  inputTokens: number,
  outputTokens: number,
): { breached: string[] } {
  s.spentUsd += usd;
  s.inputTokens += inputTokens;
  s.outputTokens += outputTokens;
  s.nodeRuns += 1;
  const { breached } = checkBudget(s);
  for (const b of breached) {
    if (!s.trippedCeilings.includes(b)) s.trippedCeilings.push(b);
  }
  return { breached };
}

/** §11 — the payload a human sees when an approval is requested. */
export interface ApprovalRequestPayload {
  what: string;
  whyRequired: string;
  requestedBy: string;
  whatChanges: string;
  riskClass: RiskClass;
  policy: string;
  evidence: string[];
  expectedOutcome: string;
}

export function buildApprovalPayload(
  result: PolicyCheckResult,
  actorLabel: string,
  opts: { whatChanges?: string; expectedOutcome?: string; evidence?: string[] } = {},
): ApprovalRequestPayload {
  return {
    what: result.action,
    whyRequired: result.reason,
    requestedBy: actorLabel,
    whatChanges: opts.whatChanges ?? result.action,
    riskClass: result.riskClass,
    policy: result.policy,
    evidence: opts.evidence ?? [],
    expectedOutcome: opts.expectedOutcome ?? "Action proceeds as requested.",
  };
}

## `src/engine/graphEvolution.ts`

```typescript
/**
 * MJ 6.0 — Dynamic graph evolution (spec §4, §17, §30).
 *
 * The graph is mutable, but never silently. §4 requires every mutation to record:
 *   previous graph version, new graph version, reason, triggering evidence,
 *   requesting agent, decision authority, timestamp, evaluation result, rollback target.
 *
 * `GraphMutation` is exactly that record. There is no code path that mutates a
 * phase graph without creating one.
 */
import type { WorkflowGraph } from "../domain/types";
import type { EvaluationResult } from "./evaluator";

export type MutationStatus =
  | "PROPOSED"
  | "POLICY_APPROVED"
  | "POLICY_DENIED"
  | "APPLIED"
  | "EVALUATION_FAILED"
  | "REGRESSION_REJECTED"
  | "ROLLED_BACK"
  | "HUMAN_REJECTED";

export const MUTATION_STATUS_LABEL: Record<MutationStatus, string> = {
  PROPOSED: "Proposed",
  POLICY_APPROVED: "Approved by policy",
  POLICY_DENIED: "Denied by policy",
  APPLIED: "Applied",
  EVALUATION_FAILED: "Rejected — evaluation failed",
  REGRESSION_REJECTED: "Rejected — regression",
  ROLLED_BACK: "Rolled back",
  HUMAN_REJECTED: "Rejected by human",
};

export interface GraphMutation {
  id: string;
  missionId: string;
  orgId: string;
  phaseId: string;

  /** Topology-level description of what changed. */
  kind: string;
  summary: string;

  previousGraphVersion: number;
  newGraphVersion: number;
  /** Pre-mutation graph, kept verbatim so rollback is exact. */
  previousGraph: WorkflowGraph;
  newGraph: WorkflowGraph;

  reason: string;
  /** Observable evidence, e.g. failure signal ids. */
  triggeringEvidence: string[];

  /** Who asked for this. An agent id, or "supervisor" / "user". */
  requestingAgent: string;
  /** Who allowed it: "charter:<id>", "user:<id>", "supervisor". */
  decisionAuthority: string;
  /** Policy clause consulted. */
  policy: string;

  proposedAt: string;
  decidedAt?: string;
  appliedAt?: string;

  status: MutationStatus;
  evaluationResult?: EvaluationResult;
  /** Set on rejection — the version to restore. */
  rollbackTarget: number;
  /** Score before and after, when measurable. */
  scoreBefore?: number;
  scoreAfter?: number;
  /** Human note when decided by a person. */
  decisionNote?: string;
}

let mutSeq = 0;
export function newGraphMutation(input: Omit<GraphMutation, "id" | "proposedAt" | "status">): GraphMutation {
  mutSeq += 1;
  return {
    ...input,
    id: `mut-${Date.now().toString(36)}-${mutSeq}`,
    proposedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    status: "PROPOSED",
  };
}

/**
 * §17 — a self-healing graph change must pass policy check, evaluation and
 * regression before activation. Returns whether it may be applied.
 */
export function mayApply(m: GraphMutation): { ok: boolean; reason: string } {
  if (m.status !== "POLICY_APPROVED" && m.status !== "PROPOSED") {
    return { ok: false, reason: `Mutation is ${m.status}; only proposed mutations can be applied.` };
  }
  const ev = m.evaluationResult;
  if (ev && !ev.passed && ev.verdicts.length > 0) {
    return { ok: false, reason: `Evaluation failed (${ev.score.toFixed(2)}/5).` };
  }
  if (typeof m.scoreBefore === "number" && typeof m.scoreAfter === "number") {
    if (m.scoreAfter < m.scoreBefore) {
      return {
        ok: false,
        reason: `Regression: score fell ${m.scoreBefore.toFixed(2)} → ${m.scoreAfter.toFixed(2)}.`,
      };
    }
  }
  return { ok: true, reason: "Policy, evaluation and regression checks passed." };
}

export function applyMutation(m: GraphMutation): GraphMutation {
  return { ...m, status: "APPLIED", appliedAt: new Date().toISOString() };
}

export function rejectMutation(
  m: GraphMutation,
  status: Extract<MutationStatus, "POLICY_DENIED" | "EVALUATION_FAILED" | "REGRESSION_REJECTED" | "HUMAN_REJECTED">,
  note?: string,
): GraphMutation {
  return { ...m, status, decidedAt: new Date().toISOString(), decisionNote: note };
}

export class GraphVersionStore {
  private versions = new Map<string, WorkflowGraph[]>();

  constructor(private key: string) {}

  push(graph: WorkflowGraph): number {
    const list = this.versions.get(this.key) ?? [];
    const next = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(graph)) as WorkflowGraph;
    list.push(next);
    this.versions.set(this.key, list);
    return list.length;
  }

  get(version: number): WorkflowGraph | undefined {
    const list = this.versions.get(this.key) ?? [];
    return list[version - 1];
  }

  current(): WorkflowGraph | undefined {
    const list = this.versions.get(this.key) ?? [];
    return list[list.length - 1];
  }

  currentVersion(): number {
    return (this.versions.get(this.key) ?? []).length;
  }

  history(): WorkflowGraph[] {
    return [...(this.versions.get(this.key) ?? [])];
  }

  /**
   * Restore a previous version by appending it as a new head — never destructive,
   * so every rollback is itself recorded and reversible.
   * Returns the restored graph and its new version number.
   */
  rollbackTo(version: number): { graph: WorkflowGraph; version: number } | undefined {
    const target = this.get(version);
    if (!target) return undefined;
    const newVersion = this.push(target);
    return { graph: this.get(newVersion)!, version: newVersion };
  }
}

/** Render a mutation for the flight recorder — §4's required fields, visible. */
export function renderMutation(m: GraphMutation): string {
  const lines = [
    `MUTATION ${m.id} — ${MUTATION_STATUS_LABEL[m.status]}`,
    `  kind:        ${m.kind}`,
    `  summary:     ${m.summary}`,
    `  graph:       v${m.previousGraphVersion} → v${m.newGraphVersion} (rollback target v${m.rollbackTarget})`,
    `  reason:      ${m.reason}`,
    `  evidence:    ${m.triggeringEvidence.join(" | ") || "none"}`,
    `  requestedBy: ${m.requestingAgent}`,
    `  authority:   ${m.decisionAuthority}`,
    `  policy:      ${m.policy}`,
    `  proposedAt:  ${m.proposedAt}`,
  ];
  if (typeof m.scoreBefore === "number" && typeof m.scoreAfter === "number") {
    lines.push(`  score:       ${m.scoreBefore.toFixed(2)} → ${m.scoreAfter.toFixed(2)}`);
  }
  if (m.evaluationResult) {
    lines.push(`  evaluation:  ${m.evaluationResult.score.toFixed(2)}/5 (${m.evaluationResult.passed ? "passed" : "failed"})`);
  }
  if (m.decisionNote) lines.push(`  note:        ${m.decisionNote}`);
  return lines.join("\n");
}

## `src/engine/harnessRunner.ts`

```typescript
import { composeNodePrompt } from "../domain/composer";
import { defaultHarness, HARNESS_BY_ID, type HarnessId } from "../domain/harness";
import type { NodeInstance } from "../domain/types";
import { ipc } from "../ipc/client";
import { detectHost } from "../app/desktop";

export interface HarnessRunResult {
  text: string;
  via: string;
  harness: HarnessId;
  code: number | null;
}

export function harnessOf(node: NodeInstance): HarnessId {
  const raw = String(node.config.harness ?? node.providers[0]?.cliProviderId ?? defaultHarness());
  if (HARNESS_BY_ID.has(raw as HarnessId)) return raw as HarnessId;
  return defaultHarness();
}

function crewIds(node: NodeInstance): HarnessId[] {
  const raw = String(node.config.crew ?? "");
  const listed = raw
    .split(/[,\s]+/)
    .map((s) => s.trim())
    .filter((s): s is HarnessId => HARNESS_BY_ID.has(s as HarnessId) && s !== "llm");
  if (node.definitionId === "agent.crew" && listed.length === 0) {
    return ["claude", "codex", "opencode"];
  }
  return listed;
}

async function invokeOne(hid: HarnessId, prompt: string, timeout: number, cwd?: string): Promise<HarnessRunResult> {
  const spec = HARNESS_BY_ID.get(hid)!;
  if (hid === "llm") {
    throw new Error("LLM path is handled by the scheduler, not the harness runner.");
  }
  if (detectHost() !== "tauri") {
    throw new Error(
      `${spec.name} cannot run in a browser preview. Build the native MJ app (see INSTALL-ON-LAPTOP.md), install ${spec.name} (${spec.install}), then Run.`,
    );
  }
  const detected = await ipc.cliProvidersDetect();
  const hit = detected.find((d) => d.id === hid || spec.bins.includes(d.invocation) || spec.bins.includes(d.id));
  if (!hit?.installed) {
    throw new Error(`${spec.name} is not on PATH. Install it locally, then restart MJ.\n${spec.install}`);
  }
  const r = (await ipc.cliInvoke(hid, prompt, cwd, timeout)) as { stdout?: string; stderr?: string; code?: number | null };
  const text = String(r.stdout || r.stderr || "").trim();
  if (!text) {
    throw new Error(`${spec.name} returned empty output (code ${r.code ?? "?"}). Auth the CLI: ${spec.install}`);
  }
  return { text, via: spec.name, harness: hid, code: r.code ?? 0 };
}

export async function runHarnessAgent(
  node: NodeInstance,
  _collected: Record<string, unknown>,
  composed: ReturnType<typeof composeNodePrompt>,
  cwd?: string,
): Promise<HarnessRunResult> {
  const prompt = [
    composed.system,
    "",
    composed.user,
    "",
    "You are a real coding agent, not a Zapier step. Use tools. Edit files. Run commands. Return the deliverable.",
  ].join("\n");
  const timeout = Math.max(60, Math.round((node.contract.timeoutMs || 180000) / 1000));
  const team = crewIds(node);

  if (team.length > 0) {
    const parts: string[] = [];
    const used: string[] = [];
    const failed: string[] = [];
    for (const hid of team) {
      try {
        const r = await invokeOne(hid, prompt, timeout, cwd);
        used.push(r.via);
        parts.push(`## ${r.via}\n\n${r.text}`);
      } catch (e) {
        failed.push(`${hid}: ${e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)}`);
        parts.push(`## ${hid} — FAILED\n\n${e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)}`);
      }
    }
    if (used.length === 0) {
      throw new Error(`Crew ran nobody. Install at least one CLI.\n${failed.join("\n")}`);
    }
    return {
      text: parts.join("\n\n---\n\n"),
      via: `crew:${used.join("+")}`,
      harness: harnessOf(node),
      code: 0,
    };
  }

  return invokeOne(harnessOf(node), prompt, timeout, cwd);
}

## `src/engine/hermesRuntime.ts`

```typescript
/**
 * In-process Hermes-class runtime for every agent node.
 *
 * Vendored Hermes Agent (Nous) is the model: session, skills, memory, tools, bounded loop.
 * We do not copy 200 Python files into 200 nodes. We instantiate ONE runtime per node
 * with that node's identity (role pack) and permission-gated tools.
 *
 * Backends:
 *   harness=hermes → this loop (LLM or local Ollama as the model)
 *   harness=claude|codex|… → those CLIs already have their own tool loop; we inject identity
 */
import { composeNodePrompt } from "../domain/composer";
import type { NodeInstance } from "../domain/types";
import { ipc, nodeKeyOf } from "../ipc/client";
import { detectHost } from "../app/desktop";
import { harnessOf, runHarnessAgent } from "./harnessRunner";

export interface HermesRun {
  text: string;
  via: string;
  steps: number;
  toolsUsed: string[];
}

const TOOL_RE = /```tool\s*([\s\S]*?)```/i;

function toolCatalog(node: NodeInstance): string {
  const p = node.permissions;
  const lines = [
    "You are a Hermes-class agent. You may call tools by emitting a fenced block:",
    "```tool",
    '{"name":"finish","args":{"output":"final deliverable"}}',
    "```",
    "Available tools:",
    '- finish {output}  — end the loop with the deliverable',
    '- remember {content, kind?} — write memory (no secrets)',
  ];
  if (p.skillWrite) lines.push('- skill_write {name, procedure} — persist a SKILL.md-shaped procedure');
  if (p.filesystemRead) lines.push('- fs_read {path}  - fs_list {path}');
  if (p.filesystemWrite) lines.push('- fs_write {path, content}');
  if (p.terminalExecute) lines.push('- shell {program, args, cwd?}');
  if (p.mcpUse) lines.push('- mcp {serverId, tool, arguments}');
  if (p.browserControl) lines.push('- browser_navigate {url}  (fails closed if Chromium is not attached)');
  lines.push("Do not pretend a tool succeeded. If a tool errors, change approach or finish with the failure.");
  return lines.join("\n");
}

async function execTool(node: NodeInstance, name: string, args: Record<string, unknown>, nodeKey: string): Promise<string> {
  const p = node.permissions;
  switch (name) {
    case "finish":
      return String(args.output ?? "");
    case "remember": {
      if (!p.memoryWrite && !node.memoryEnabled) return "memory disabled";
      await ipc.memoryAdd(nodeKey, String(args.kind ?? "working"), String(args.content ?? ""), ["hermes"], 0.6);
      return "remembered";
    }
    case "skill_write": {
      if (!p.skillWrite) return "skillWrite not granted";
      await ipc.skillUpsert({
        nodeKey,
        name: String(args.name ?? "skill"),
        description: String(args.description ?? args.name ?? "skill"),
        procedure: String(args.procedure ?? ""),
        origin: "learned",
      });
      return "skill saved";
    }
    case "fs_read": {
      if (!p.filesystemRead) return "filesystemRead not granted";
      return ipc.fsRead(String(args.path ?? ""));
    }
    case "fs_list": {
      if (!p.filesystemRead) return "filesystemRead not granted";
      return JSON.stringify(await ipc.fsList(String(args.path ?? ".")), null, 2);
    }
    case "fs_write": {
      if (!p.filesystemWrite) return "filesystemWrite not granted";
      await ipc.fsWrite(String(args.path ?? ""), String(args.content ?? ""));
      return "written";
    }
    case "shell": {
      if (!p.terminalExecute) return "terminalExecute not granted";
      const r = await ipc.shellExec(String(args.program ?? ""), (args.args as string[]) ?? [], args.cwd as string | undefined, 60);
      return JSON.stringify(r);
    }
    case "mcp": {
      if (!p.mcpUse) return "mcpUse not granted";
      const r = await ipc.mcpCall(String(args.serverId ?? ""), String(args.tool ?? ""), args.arguments ?? {});
      return JSON.stringify(r);
    }
    case "browser_navigate": {
      if (!p.browserControl) return "browserControl not granted";
      const sess = await ipc.browserSessionCreate() as { sessionId?: string };
      const r = await ipc.browserNavigate(String(sess.sessionId ?? ""), String(args.url ?? ""));
      return JSON.stringify(r);
    }
    default:
      return `unknown tool: ${name}`;
  }
}

function parseTool(text: string): { name: string; args: Record<string, unknown> } | null {
  const m = text.match(TOOL_RE);
  if (!m) return null;
  try {
    const j = JSON.parse(m[1]) as { name?: string; args?: Record<string, unknown> };
    if (!j.name) return null;
    return { name: j.name, args: j.args ?? {} };
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export async function runHermesNode(
  node: NodeInstance,
  collected: Record<string, unknown>,
  composed: ReturnType<typeof composeNodePrompt>,
  execId: string,
  workflowId: string,
): Promise<HermesRun> {
  const hid = harnessOf(node);
  const teamKey = String(node.config.teamMemoryKey ?? "");
  const nodeKey = teamKey || nodeKeyOf(workflowId, node.id);

  // Coding CLIs are already full agents. Inject identity; do not wrap a second loop.
  if (hid !== "hermes" && hid !== "llm") {
    const ran = await runHarnessAgent(node, collected, composed);
    return { text: ran.text, via: ran.via, steps: 1, toolsUsed: [hid] };
  }

  if (hid === "hermes" && detectHost() === "tauri") {
    const detected = await ipc.cliProvidersDetect();
    const hermesCli = detected.find((d) => d.id === "hermes" && d.installed);
    if (hermesCli) {
      const ran = await runHarnessAgent(
        { ...node, config: { ...node.config, harness: "hermes" } },
        collected,
        composed,
      );
      return { text: ran.text, via: "hermes-cli", steps: 1, toolsUsed: ["hermes"] };
    }
  }

  const toolsUsed: string[] = [];
  const transcript: Array<{ role: string; content: string }> = [
    { role: "user", content: `${composed.user}\n\n${toolCatalog(node)}` },
  ];
  let finalText = "";
  const maxSteps = Math.max(1, Number(node.config.maxToolSteps ?? 8));

  for (let step = 0; step < maxSteps; step++) {
    const provider = await resolveLlm(node);
    if (!provider) {
      throw new Error(
        `${node.title} is a Hermes-class agent. Install Claude Code/Codex/OpenCode and set harness to that CLI, or set harness=llm/hermes and save a provider key / run Ollama.`,
      );
    }
    const r = await ipc.llmChat({
      provider: provider.provider,
      base_url: provider.base_url,
      model: provider.model,
      messages: transcript,
      system: composed.system,
      max_tokens: 1800,
      temperature: 0.2,
      secret_ref: provider.secret_ref,
    }) as { content?: string };
    const content = String(r.content ?? "").trim();
    if (!content) throw new Error("Hermes loop: empty model content");
    transcript.push({ role: "assistant", content });
    const call = parseTool(content);
    if (!call || call.name === "finish") {
      finalText = call?.name === "finish" ? String(call.args.output ?? content) : content;
      break;
    }
    toolsUsed.push(call.name);
    let result: string;
    try {
      result = await execTool(node, call.name, call.args, nodeKey);
    } catch (e) {
      result = `tool error: ${e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)}`;
    }
    if (call.name === "finish") {
      finalText = result || content;
      break;
    }
    transcript.push({ role: "user", content: `TOOL RESULT (${call.name}):\n${result.slice(0, 8000)}` });
    finalText = content;
  }

  if (!finalText.trim()) throw new Error("Hermes loop ended with empty deliverable.");
  await ipc.eventEmit(execId, "HERMES_LOOP", "INFO", node.id, { steps: transcript.length, toolsUsed });
  return { text: finalText, via: `hermes:${hid}`, steps: Math.floor(transcript.length / 2), toolsUsed };
}

async function resolveLlm(node: NodeInstance): Promise<{
  provider: string; model: string; secret_ref: string; base_url?: string;
} | null> {
  const p = node.providers[0];
  const kind = p?.kind && p.kind !== "cli-agent" ? p.kind : "openai";
  const model = p?.model ?? (kind === "anthropic" ? "claude-sonnet-4" : kind === "ollama" ? "llama3.1" : "gpt-4.1");
  const secret_ref = p?.secretRef ?? `provider.${kind === "ollama" ? "ollama.local" : `${kind}.production`}`;
  if (kind === "ollama") {
    return { provider: "ollama", model, secret_ref, base_url: String(node.config.endpoint ?? "http://127.0.0.1:11434") };
  }
  const exists = await ipc.secretExists([secret_ref]);
  if (!exists[secret_ref]) {
    const ollama = await ipc.secretExists(["provider.ollama.local"]);
    if (ollama["provider.ollama.local"]) {
      return { provider: "ollama", model: "llama3.1", secret_ref: "provider.ollama.local", base_url: "http://127.0.0.1:11434" };
    }
    return null;
  }
  return { provider: kind, model, secret_ref };
}
