## `src/engine/missionController.ts`

```typescript
/**
 * MJ 6.0 — Mission controller.
 *
 * Owns the active OrganizationRuntime plus the human approval queue. The UI talks to
 * this; the runtime never reaches into React. Approvals are first-class execution
 * state (§11), so an unresolved approval genuinely blocks the run — it is not a
 * notification that floats past while work continues.
 */
import type { Mission, MissionStatus } from "../domain/mission";
import type { Charter } from "../domain/charter";
import type { Organization } from "../domain/organization";
import { planMission, type MissionPlan } from "./missionPlanner";
import { OrganizationRuntime, type ApprovalPayload, type MissionOutcome, type RuntimeCallbacks } from "./orgRuntime";
import { defaultCharter } from "../domain/charter";
import { v6 } from "../ipc/v6";
import { uid } from "../app/id";

export interface QueuedApproval extends ApprovalPayload {
  queuedAt: string;
  resolved?: { approved: boolean; by: string; note?: string };
}

export interface ControllerState {
  missionId?: string;
  status?: MissionStatus;
  running: boolean;
  approvals: QueuedApproval[];
  events: Array<{ kind: string; data: Record<string, unknown>; at: string }>;
  lastOutcome?: MissionOutcome;
  error?: string;
}

type Listener = (s: ControllerState) => void;

class MissionController {
  private runtime?: OrganizationRuntime;
  private listeners = new Set<Listener>();
  private state: ControllerState = { running: false, approvals: [], events: [] };

  subscribe(fn: Listener): () => void {
    this.listeners.add(fn);
    fn(this.state);
    return () => this.listeners.delete(fn);
  }

  getState(): ControllerState {
    return this.state;
  }

  private set(patch: Partial<ControllerState>): void {
    this.state = { ...this.state, ...patch };
    this.listeners.forEach((l) => l(this.state));
  }

  private pushEvent(kind: string, data: Record<string, unknown>): void {
    const events = [...this.state.events, { kind, data, at: new Date().toISOString() }];
    this.set({ events: events.slice(-500) });
  }

  /** Produce a plan without running anything (§2: inspectable before execution). */
  plan(mission: Mission): MissionPlan {
    return planMission(mission);
  }

  defaultCharter(name?: string): Charter {
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    return {
      ...defaultCharter(name),
      id: uid("charter"),
      createdAt: now,
      updatedAt: now,
    };
  }

  /** Build the organization from a plan and persist mission + org. */
  async formOrganization(mission: Mission, plan: MissionPlan, charter: Charter): Promise<Organization> {
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const org: Organization = {
      id: uid("org"),
      missionId: mission.id,
      charterId: charter.id,
      frameworkId: plan.frameworkId,
      topology: plan.phases[0]?.topology ?? "pipeline",
      candidatePool: [],
      active: [],
      teams: [],
      phases: [],
      tasks: [],
      blackboardKey: `org:${mission.id}`,
      constitutionId: `constitution:${plan.frameworkId}`,
      generation: 0,
      metrics: {
        totalCostUsd: 0, totalTokens: 0, wallClockMs: 0, nodeRuns: 0,
        reorganizations: 0, repairsAttempted: 0, repairsSucceeded: 0,
        humanInterventions: 0, regressions: 0,
      },
      status: "FORMING",
      createdAt: now,
      updatedAt: now,
    };
    mission.orgId = org.id;
    mission.charterId = charter.id;

    await v6.charterSave(charter);
    await v6.missionSave(mission);
    await v6.orgSave(mission.id, org);
    return org;
  }

  async start(mission: Mission, charter: Charter, callbacks: RuntimeCallbacks = {}): Promise<MissionOutcome> {
    const plan = planMission(mission);
    const org = await this.formOrganization(mission, plan, charter);

    const runtime = new OrganizationRuntime(
      mission,
      org,
      charter,
      plan,
      {
        request: (payload) => this.requestApproval(payload),
      },
      {
        ...callbacks,
        onEvent: (kind, data) => {
          this.pushEvent(kind, data);
          this.set({ status: runtime.mission.status });
          callbacks.onEvent?.(kind, data);
        },
      },
    );

    this.runtime = runtime;
    this.set({ missionId: mission.id, status: mission.status, running: true, error: undefined });

    try {
      const outcome = await runtime.run();
      // Persist the durable results.
      await v6.missionSave(runtime.mission);
      await v6.orgSave(mission.id, runtime.org);
      for (const a of outcome.artifacts) await v6.artifactSave(a);
      if (outcome.score) await v6.scorecardSave(mission.id, outcome.score);
      for (const cp of runtime.checkpoints.all()) await v6.checkpointSave(cp);
      for (const n of runtime.negotiator.all(mission.id)) await v6.negotiationSave(n);
      this.set({ running: false, status: outcome.status, lastOutcome: outcome });
      return outcome;
    } catch (e) {
      const msg = e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e);
      this.set({ running: false, error: msg });
      throw e;
    }
  }

  /** §11 — queue the approval and wait for a human. */
  private requestApproval(payload: ApprovalPayload): Promise<{ approved: boolean; by: string; note?: string }> {
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      const queued: QueuedApproval = { ...payload, queuedAt: new Date().toISOString() };
      (queued as { resolve?: unknown }).resolve = resolve;
      this.approvalResolvers.set(payload.id, resolve);
      this.set({ approvals: [...this.state.approvals, queued] });
    });
  }

  private approvalResolvers = new Map<
    string,
    (r: { approved: boolean; by: string; note?: string }) => void
  >();

  decide(approvalId: string, approved: boolean, by = "user", note?: string): void {
    const resolve = this.approvalResolvers.get(approvalId);
    this.approvalResolvers.delete(approvalId);
    this.set({
      approvals: this.state.approvals.map((a) =>
        a.id === approvalId ? { ...a, resolved: { approved, by, note } } : a,
      ),
    });
    resolve?.({ approved, by, note });
  }

  pause(): void {
    this.runtime?.pause();
    this.set({ status: this.runtime?.mission.status });
  }

  resume(): void {
    this.runtime?.resume();
    this.set({ status: this.runtime?.mission.status });
  }

  abort(reason: string): void {
    this.runtime?.abort(reason);
    this.set({ running: false, status: this.runtime?.mission.status });
  }

  rollback(checkpointId: string): { ok: boolean; notes: string[] } {
    if (!this.runtime) return { ok: false, notes: ["no active mission"] };
    return this.runtime.rollback(checkpointId);
  }

  snapshot() {
    return this.runtime?.state();
  }

  runtimeRef(): OrganizationRuntime | undefined {
    return this.runtime;
  }

  clearEvents(): void {
    this.set({ events: [] });
  }
}

export const missionController = new MissionController();

```


## `src/engine/missionPlanner.ts`

```typescript
/**
 * MJ 6.0 — Mission planner (spec §2).
 *
 * Goal + constraints + criteria + budget + deadline + risk policy → a proposed
 * organization. §2 requires the plan be inspectable BEFORE execution, so `plan()`
 * is pure: it returns a plan object and touches nothing. Nothing runs until the
 * human accepts it.
 */
import type { Mission } from "../domain/mission";
import type { AgentContract } from "../domain/organization";
import type { ParallelismClass } from "../domain/organization";
import { defaultPermissionCeiling } from "../domain/charter";
import type { RiskClass } from "../domain/risk";
import type { TaskKind } from "../domain/reputation";
import type { TopologyPattern } from "../domain/missionTemplates";
import { MISSION_TEMPLATES, suggestTemplate, TOPOLOGY_PARALLELISM } from "../domain/missionTemplates";
import type { HarnessId } from "../domain/harness";

export interface PlannedAgent {
  id: string;
  roleKey: string;
  title: string;
  purpose: string;
  phaseId: string;
  harnessPreference: HarnessId[];
  capabilities: string[];
  contract: AgentContract;
}

export interface PlannedPhase {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  rationale: string;
  topology: TopologyPattern;
  roles: string[];
  taskKind: TaskKind;
  riskClass: RiskClass;
  parallelism: ParallelismClass;
  produces?: string;
  consumes?: string[];
  /** Approval gate at the end of this phase. */
  gate: boolean;
}

export interface ApprovalCheckpoint {
  id: string;
  phaseId: string;
  what: string;
  why: string;
  riskClass: RiskClass;
  blocking: boolean;
}

export interface PlanRisk {
  id: string;
  description: string;
  likelihood: "LOW" | "MEDIUM" | "HIGH";
  impact: "LOW" | "MEDIUM" | "HIGH";
  mitigation: string;
}

export interface MissionPlan {
  id: string;
  missionId: string;
  templateId?: string;
  frameworkId: string;
  phases: PlannedPhase[];
  staffing: PlannedAgent[];
  /** roleKey → ranked harness preferences. */
  harnessPlan: Record<string, HarnessId[]>;
  toolsRequired: string[];
  mcpServersRequired: string[];
  browserRequired: boolean;
  workspaceRequirements: string[];
  verificationStrategy: string[];
  approvalCheckpoints: ApprovalCheckpoint[];
  risks: PlanRisk[];
  estimatedCostUsd: number;
  estimatedDurationMs: number;
  rationale: string;
  /** 0–1. Low confidence means the planner wants a human to review before running. */
  confidence: number;
  createdAt: string;
}

/** Keyword → role and task-kind hints, used when there is no template. */
const ROLE_HINTS: Array<{ re: RegExp; roles: string[]; taskKind: TaskKind }> = [
  { re: /\b(security|vulnerab|pentest|threat|exploit|cve)\b/i, roles: ["agent.security"], taskKind: "security" },
  { re: /\b(test|qa|coverage|regression)\b/i, roles: ["agent.tester", "agent.qa"], taskKind: "testing" },
  { re: /\b(architect|design|system design|schema)\b/i, roles: ["agent.architect"], taskKind: "architecture" },
  { re: /\b(refactor|migrat|port|upgrade)\b/i, roles: ["agent.coder", "agent.reviewer"], taskKind: "migration" },
  { re: /\b(research|investigat|analy[sz]e|compare|survey|market)\b/i, roles: ["agent.researcher", "agent.synthesizer"], taskKind: "research" },
  { re: /\b(doc|readme|explain|write-up|changelog)\b/i, roles: ["agent.docs"], taskKind: "documentation" },
  { re: /\b(debug|bug|crash|incident|outage|fix)\b/i, roles: ["agent.debugger", "agent.tester"], taskKind: "debugging" },
  { re: /\b(data|pipeline|etl|sql|warehouse|metric)\b/i, roles: ["agent.preset.data-analyst"], taskKind: "data" },
  { re: /\b(deploy|infra|kubernetes|terraform|release|ship)\b/i, roles: ["agent.preset.sre"], taskKind: "ops" },
  { re: /\b(legal|compliance|contract|gdpr)\b/i, roles: ["agent.preset.legal"], taskKind: "review" },
  { re: /\b(finance|budget|cost|pricing|revenue)\b/i, roles: ["agent.preset.finance"], taskKind: "data" },
  { re: /\b(review|critique|audit)\b/i, roles: ["agent.reviewer", "agent.critic"], taskKind: "review" },
];

const TITLE_FOR: Record<string, string> = {
  "agent.planner": "Planner",
  "agent.researcher": "Researcher",
  "agent.synthesizer": "Synthesizer",
  "agent.architect": "Architect",
  "agent.coder": "Coder",
  "agent.tester": "Tester",
  "agent.qa": "QA",
  "agent.reviewer": "Reviewer",
  "agent.critic": "Critic",
  "agent.judge": "Judge",
  "agent.security": "Security Analyst",
  "agent.debugger": "Debugger",
  "agent.docs": "Technical Writer",
  "agent.supervisor": "Supervisor",
  "agent.router": "Router",
  "agent.crew": "Agent Crew",
  "agent.local": "Local Model Agent",
  "agent.custom": "Custom Agent",
  "agent.reflection": "Reflection Agent",
  "agent.preset.sre": "SRE",
  "agent.preset.legal": "Legal Counsel",
  "agent.preset.pm": "Product Manager",
  "agent.preset.data-analyst": "Data Analyst",
  "agent.preset.finance": "Finance Analyst",
  "control.approval": "Human Approval",
};

export function titleForRole(roleKey: string): string {
  return TITLE_FOR[roleKey] ?? roleKey.replace(/^agent\./, "").replace(/[-.]/g, " ");
}

const HARNESS_PREFERENCE: Record<TaskKind, HarnessId[]> = {
  coding: ["claude", "codex", "opencode"],
  refactor: ["claude", "codex", "opencode"],
  testing: ["codex", "claude", "opencode"],
  security: ["claude", "opencode", "codex"],
  review: ["codex", "claude", "opencode"],
  research: ["hermes", "llm", "grok"],
  architecture: ["claude", "hermes", "llm"],
  documentation: ["claude", "hermes", "llm"],
  debugging: ["claude", "codex", "opencode"],
  migration: ["codex", "claude", "opencode"],
  data: ["opencode", "codex", "claude"],
  ops: ["claude", "opencode", "codex"],
};

let planSeq = 0;
let phaseSeq = 0;

function contractFor(
  roleKey: string,
  purpose: string,
  taskKind: TaskKind,
  riskClass: RiskClass,
  mission: Mission,
): AgentContract {
  const ceiling = defaultPermissionCeiling();
  const capByKind: Record<TaskKind, string[]> = {
    coding: ["code-edit", "code-read", "shell", "test-run", "git"],
    refactor: ["code-edit", "code-read", "shell", "test-run", "git", "multi-file-refactor"],
    testing: ["code-read", "shell", "test-run"],
    security: ["code-read", "shell"],
    review: ["code-read"],
    research: ["code-read"],
    architecture: ["code-read"],
    documentation: ["code-read"],
    debugging: ["code-read", "shell", "test-run"],
    migration: ["code-edit", "code-read", "shell", "test-run", "git", "multi-file-refactor"],
    data: ["code-read", "shell"],
    ops: ["code-read", "shell", "git"],
  };
  const needsWrite = ["coding", "refactor", "migration", "testing", "debugging"].includes(taskKind);
  return {
    identity: `${titleForRole(roleKey)} on mission "${mission.name}"`,
    purpose,
    capabilities: capByKind[taskKind] ?? ["code-read"],
    inputs: ["task instruction", "upstream artifacts", "blackboard context"],
    outputs: ["artifact", "status report"],
    permissions: {
      ...ceiling,
      filesystemWrite: needsWrite && ceiling.filesystemWrite,
      terminalExecute: (needsWrite || taskKind === "ops") && ceiling.terminalExecute,
      networkAccess: false,
      browserControl: false,
      workflowModify: false,
      evolutionAccept: false,
    },
    budget: {
      maxCostUsd: Math.max(0.15, mission.budget.maxCostUsd / 8),
      maxTokens: Math.max(20_000, Math.floor(mission.budget.maxTokens / 8)),
      timeoutMs: Math.min(600_000, Math.max(60_000, Math.floor(mission.budget.maxWallClockMs / 6))),
      maxToolSteps: 8,
      maxRetries: mission.budget.maxRetries,
    },
    successCriteria: [],
    failurePolicy: riskClass === "CRITICAL" || riskClass === "HIGH" ? "ESCALATE" : "REPAIR",
    escalationPolicy: {
      onRiskClass: riskClass === "LOW" ? "MEDIUM" : riskClass === "MEDIUM" ? "HIGH" : "CRITICAL",
      afterFailures: 2,
      onLowConfidence: mission.riskPolicy ? 0.55 : 0.55,
    },
  };
}

/**
 * Produce a plan. Pure — no side effects, nothing persisted, nothing started.
 */
export function planMission(mission: Mission): MissionPlan {
  planSeq += 1;
  phaseSeq = 0;
  const text = `${mission.name} ${mission.objective} ${mission.description}`.toLowerCase();

  // Prefer an explicit template, else infer one from the text.
  const template =
    MISSION_TEMPLATES.find((t) => t.id === mission.templateId) ??
    (mission.templateId ? undefined : suggestTemplate(mission.objective));

  const phases: PlannedPhase[] = [];
  const staffing: PlannedAgent[] = [];
  const harnessPlan: Record<string, HarnessId[]> = {};
  const toolsRequired = new Set<string>();
  const mcpServers = new Set<string>();
  const verification: string[] = [];
  const approvals: ApprovalCheckpoint[] = [];
  const risks: PlanRisk[] = [];

  if (template) {
    for (const tp of template.phases) {
      phaseSeq += 1;
      const pid = `phase-${phaseSeq}`;
      phases.push({
        id: pid,
        name: tp.name,
        rationale: tp.rationale,
        topology: tp.topology,
        roles: tp.roles,
        taskKind: tp.taskKind,
        riskClass: tp.riskClass,
        parallelism: tp.parallelism ?? TOPOLOGY_PARALLELISM[tp.topology],
        produces: tp.produces,
        consumes: tp.consumes,
        gate: tp.riskClass === "HIGH" || tp.riskClass === "CRITICAL",
      });
      tp.roles.forEach((roleKey, i) => {
        const purpose = `${tp.name}: contribute as ${titleForRole(roleKey)} toward "${mission.objective}".`;
        staffing.push({
          id: `slot-${pid}-${i}`,
          roleKey,
          title: titleForRole(roleKey),
          purpose,
          phaseId: pid,
          harnessPreference: mission.allowedHarnesses.length
            ? (mission.allowedHarnesses as HarnessId[])
            : HARNESS_PREFERENCE[tp.taskKind],
          capabilities: [],
          contract: contractFor(roleKey, purpose, tp.taskKind, tp.riskClass, mission),
        });
        harnessPlan[roleKey] = mission.allowedHarnesses.length
          ? (mission.allowedHarnesses as HarnessId[])
          : HARNESS_PREFERENCE[tp.taskKind];
      });
      if (tp.riskClass === "HIGH" || tp.riskClass === "CRITICAL") {
        approvals.push({
          id: `appr-${pid}`,
          phaseId: pid,
          what: `${tp.name} outcome`,
          why: `${tp.name} is classified ${tp.riskClass}; policy routes ${tp.riskClass} to human approval.`,
          riskClass: tp.riskClass,
          blocking: tp.riskClass === "CRITICAL",
        });
      }
    }
  } else {
    // Infer phases from the objective text.
    const matched = ROLE_HINTS.filter((h) => h.re.test(text));
    const primary: TaskKind = matched[0]?.taskKind ?? "coding";

    const scaffold: Array<{ name: string; rationale: string; topology: TopologyPattern; roles: string[]; kind: TaskKind }> = [
      {
        name: "Research",
        rationale: "Establish what exists before proposing anything.",
        topology: "map-reduce",
        roles: ["agent.researcher", "agent.researcher", "agent.synthesizer"],
        kind: "research",
      },
      {
        name: "Plan",
        rationale: "A contract before an implementation prevents rework.",
        topology: "council",
        roles: ["agent.planner", "agent.critic", "agent.judge"],
        kind: "architecture",
      },
      {
        name: "Execute",
        rationale: "Do the work identified by the plan.",
        topology: "hierarchy",
        roles: ["agent.supervisor", ...(matched[0]?.roles ?? ["agent.coder"])],
        kind: primary,
      },
      {
        name: "Verify",
        rationale: "Independent verification, not self-reported success.",
        topology: "gate",
        roles: ["agent.tester", "agent.qa"],
        kind: "testing",
      },
      {
        name: "Review",
        rationale: "A second pair of eyes catches what tests cannot.",
        topology: "debate",
        roles: ["agent.reviewer", "agent.critic", "agent.judge"],
        kind: "review",
      },
    ];

    for (const s of scaffold) {
      phaseSeq += 1;
      const pid = `phase-${phaseSeq}`;
      const riskClass: RiskClass =
        s.kind === "ops" || s.kind === "migration" ? "HIGH" : s.kind === "coding" || s.kind === "testing" ? "MEDIUM" : "LOW";
      phases.push({
        id: pid,
        name: s.name,
        rationale: s.rationale,
        topology: s.topology,
        roles: s.roles,
        taskKind: s.kind,
        riskClass,
        parallelism: TOPOLOGY_PARALLELISM[s.topology],
        gate: riskClass === "HIGH",
      });
      s.roles.forEach((roleKey, i) => {
        const purpose = `${s.name}: contribute as ${titleForRole(roleKey)} toward "${mission.objective}".`;
        staffing.push({
          id: `slot-${pid}-${i}`,
          roleKey,
          title: titleForRole(roleKey),
          purpose,
          phaseId: pid,
          harnessPreference: HARNESS_PREFERENCE[s.kind],
          capabilities: [],
          contract: contractFor(roleKey, purpose, s.kind, riskClass, mission),
        });
        harnessPlan[roleKey] = HARNESS_PREFERENCE[s.kind];
      });
    }
    if (mission.successCriteria.some((c) => c.kind === "HUMAN")) {
      const last = phases[phases.length - 1];
      approvals.push({
        id: `appr-${last.id}`,
        phaseId: last.id,
        what: "Final deliverable sign-off",
        why: "A success criterion requires human sign-off.",
        riskClass: "HIGH",
        blocking: true,
      });
    }
  }

  // Tools, MCP, browser, workspace — derived from the work, not assumed.
  for (const s of staffing) {
    for (const c of s.contract.capabilities) toolsRequired.add(c);
  }
  if (staffing.some((s) => s.roleKey === "agent.security")) mcpServers.add("mcp.github");
  if (/git|repo|branch|commit|pull request/i.test(text)) mcpServers.add("mcp.git");
  if (/file|read|write|directory/i.test(text)) mcpServers.add("mcp.filesystem");
  const browserRequired = /\b(browse|website|url|web page|scrape|screenshot)\b/i.test(text);

  const workspaceRequirements = [
    `Writable workspace at ${mission.workspace || "(default artifacts dir)"}`,
    ...(toolsRequired.has("git") ? ["Git repository available for diff/branch work"] : []),
    ...(browserRequired ? ["Chromium session available (browser capability)"] : []),
  ];

  verification.push(
    "Each produced artifact is scored by an independent judge against an anchored rubric.",
    "Judges come from a different model family than the producing agent.",
  );
  const cmdCriteria = mission.successCriteria.filter((c) => c.kind === "COMMAND_EXIT");
  if (cmdCriteria.length) {
    verification.push(`${cmdCriteria.length} machine-checkable command criteria will be executed, not self-reported.`);
  }
  const rubricCriteria = mission.successCriteria.filter((c) => c.kind === "RUBRIC");
  if (rubricCriteria.length) {
    verification.push(`${rubricCriteria.length} rubric criteria will be judged independently.`);
  }
  if (!cmdCriteria.length && !rubricCriteria.length) {
    verification.push(
      "WARNING: no machine-checkable or rubric criteria were supplied. Acceptance will rest on the generic rubric only.",
    );
    risks.push({
      id: "risk-no-verification",
      description: "Mission has no machine-checkable or rubric success criteria.",
      likelihood: "HIGH",
      impact: "HIGH",
      mitigation: "Add at least one COMMAND_EXIT or RUBRIC criterion before running.",
    });
  }

  // Risks.
  if (browserRequired) {
    risks.push({
      id: "risk-browser",
      description: "Mission needs browser control, which is not fully wired in this build.",
      likelihood: "HIGH",
      impact: "MEDIUM",
      mitigation: "Remove the browser requirement, or grant browserControl and attach a Chromium profile.",
    });
  }
  if (mission.budget.maxCostUsd < 2) {
    risks.push({
      id: "risk-budget",
      description: `Budget of $${mission.budget.maxCostUsd.toFixed(2)} is small for ${phases.length} phases.`,
      likelihood: "MEDIUM",
      impact: "MEDIUM",
      mitigation: "Narrow scope, use cheaper harnesses, or raise the ceiling.",
    });
  }
  if (mission.deadline) {
    const ms = new Date(mission.deadline).getTime() - Date.now();
    if (ms < mission.budget.maxWallClockMs) {
      risks.push({
        id: "risk-deadline",
        description: "Deadline is tighter than the wall-clock budget.",
        likelihood: "MEDIUM",
        impact: "HIGH",
        mitigation: "Reduce phases, or raise maxConcurrentAgents to shorten the critical path.",
      });
    }
  }
  const critical = phases.filter((p) => p.riskClass === "CRITICAL");
  if (critical.length) {
    risks.push({
      id: "risk-critical",
      description: `${critical.length} phase(s) are CRITICAL (${critical.map((p) => p.name).join(", ")}).`,
      likelihood: "HIGH",
      impact: "HIGH",
      mitigation: "Human approval is mandatory at each critical gate.",
    });
  }

  // Estimates.
  const perAgentCost = mission.budget.maxCostUsd / Math.max(1, staffing.length);
  const estimatedCostUsd = staffing.length * Math.min(perAgentCost, 1.2);
  const criticalPath = phases.filter((p) => p.parallelism === "SEQUENTIAL" || p.parallelism === "APPROVAL_GATED").length;
  const parallelPhases = phases.length - criticalPath;
  const perPhaseMs = Math.min(600_000, mission.budget.maxWallClockMs / Math.max(1, criticalPath));
  const estimatedDurationMs = criticalPath * perPhaseMs + parallelPhases * (perPhaseMs / Math.max(1, mission.budget.maxConcurrentAgents));

  const confidence =
    (template ? 0.75 : 0.5) +
    (rubricCriteria.length || cmdCriteria.length ? 0.1 : -0.2) +
    (mission.constraints.length ? 0.05 : 0) -
    Math.min(0.2, risks.length * 0.05);

  return {
    id: `plan-${Date.now().toString(36)}-${planSeq}`,
    missionId: mission.id,
    templateId: template?.id,
    frameworkId: template?.frameworkId ?? "fw.pipeline",
    phases,
    staffing,
    harnessPlan,
    toolsRequired: [...toolsRequired],
    mcpServersRequired: [...mcpServers],
    browserRequired,
    workspaceRequirements,
    verificationStrategy: verification,
    approvalCheckpoints: approvals,
    risks,
    estimatedCostUsd,
    estimatedDurationMs,
    rationale:
      template
        ? `Used template "${template.name}" (${template.id}) because it matches the objective shape. ${phases.length} phases, ${staffing.length} agent slots.`
        : `No template matched; inferred ${phases.length} phases from the objective text. ${staffing.length} agent slots.`,
    confidence: Math.max(0, Math.min(1, confidence)),
    createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  };
}

/** Render the plan for the inspector (§2: inspectable before execution). */
export function renderPlan(p: MissionPlan): string {
  const lines = [
    `PLAN ${p.id}`,
    `framework: ${p.frameworkId}`,
    `confidence: ${(p.confidence * 100).toFixed(0)}%`,
    `estimate: $${p.estimatedCostUsd.toFixed(2)}, ~${(p.estimatedDurationMs / 60000).toFixed(0)} min`,
    "",
    p.rationale,
    "",
    "PHASES",
  ];
  for (const ph of p.phases) {
    lines.push(
      `  ${ph.name} [${ph.topology}] ${ph.riskClass} · ${ph.parallelism}${ph.gate ? " · GATED" : ""}`,
      `      why:   ${ph.rationale}`,
      `      roles: ${ph.roles.map((r) => titleForRole(r)).join(", ")}`,
    );
  }
  lines.push("", "STAFFING");
  for (const s of p.staffing) {
    lines.push(`  ${s.title} (${s.roleKey}) → harness pref: ${s.harnessPreference.join(" > ") || "auto"}`);
  }
  if (p.approvalCheckpoints.length) {
    lines.push("", "APPROVAL GATES");
    for (const a of p.approvalCheckpoints) {
      lines.push(`  [${a.riskClass}] ${a.what} — ${a.why}${a.blocking ? " (blocking)" : ""}`);
    }
  }
  lines.push("", "VERIFICATION");
  for (const v of p.verificationStrategy) lines.push(`  - ${v}`);
  if (p.risks.length) {
    lines.push("", "RISKS");
    for (const r of p.risks) {
      lines.push(`  [${r.likelihood}/${r.impact}] ${r.description}`);
      lines.push(`      mitigation: ${r.mitigation}`);
    }
  }
  lines.push("", "REQUIREMENTS");
  lines.push(`  tools:     ${p.toolsRequired.join(", ") || "none"}`);
  lines.push(`  mcp:       ${p.mcpServersRequired.join(", ") || "none"}`);
  lines.push(`  browser:   ${p.browserRequired ? "required" : "not required"}`);
  for (const w of p.workspaceRequirements) lines.push(`  workspace: ${w}`);
  return lines.join("\n");
}
```

## `src/engine/negotiation.ts`

```typescript
/**
 * MJ 6.0 — Negotiation runtime (spec §8).
 *
 * Agents may challenge, reject, request clarification, or propose alternatives.
 * Every move is recorded and becomes part of the mission trace. The supervisor is
 * the only party that can resolve a thread; if it cannot, it escalates to a human.
 */
import type { NegotiationMove, NegotiationMoveKind, NegotiationThread } from "../domain/negotiation";
import { DEFAULT_MAX_ROUNDS, detectStalemate, renderThread } from "../domain/negotiation";
import type { AgentSlot } from "../domain/organization";
import { ipc } from "../ipc/client";

export interface NegotiationDeps {
  /** Compose a prompt for an agent to reply within a thread. */
  askAgent(slot: AgentSlot, prompt: string): Promise<string>;
  onMove?(thread: NegotiationThread, move: NegotiationMove): void;
}

let moveSeq = 0;

export class Negotiator {
  private threads: NegotiationThread[] = [];

  constructor(private deps: NegotiationDeps) {}

  open(input: {
    missionId: string;
    orgId: string;
    topic: string;
    question: string;
    participantIds: string[];
    subjectTaskId?: string;
    subjectArtifactId?: string;
    maxRounds?: number;
  }): NegotiationThread {
    const t: NegotiationThread = {
      id: `neg-${Date.now().toString(36)}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6)}`,
      missionId: input.missionId,
      orgId: input.orgId,
      topic: input.topic,
      question: input.question,
      participantIds: input.participantIds,
      moves: [],
      status: "OPEN",
      round: 0,
      maxRounds: input.maxRounds ?? DEFAULT_MAX_ROUNDS,
      subjectTaskId: input.subjectTaskId,
      subjectArtifactId: input.subjectArtifactId,
      openedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    };
    this.threads.push(t);
    return t;
  }

  get(id: string): NegotiationThread | undefined {
    return this.threads.find((t) => t.id === id);
  }

  all(missionId?: string): NegotiationThread[] {
    return missionId ? this.threads.filter((t) => t.missionId === missionId) : [...this.threads];
  }

  addMove(
    threadId: string,
    from: string,
    fromLabel: string,
    kind: NegotiationMoveKind,
    body: string,
    opts: { artifactId?: string } = {},
  ): NegotiationMove | null {
    const t = this.get(threadId);
    if (!t || t.status !== "OPEN") return null;
    moveSeq += 1;
    const m: NegotiationMove = {
      id: `mv-${moveSeq}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 5)}`,
      threadId,
      from,
      fromLabel,
      kind,
      body,
      artifactId: opts.artifactId,
      at: new Date().toISOString(),
    };
    t.moves.push(m);
    this.deps.onMove?.(t, m);
    return m;
  }

  /**
   * Run one negotiation round: each participant responds to the transcript so far.
   * Round count is bounded; the supervisor resolves or escalates when exhausted.
   */
  async runRound(threadId: string, slots: AgentSlot[]): Promise<{
    moved: number;
    stale: boolean;
    reason?: string;
  }> {
    const t = this.get(threadId);
    if (!t || t.status !== "OPEN") return { moved: 0, stale: false };

    const transcript = renderThread(t);
    let moved = 0;

    for (const slotId of t.participantIds) {
      const slot = slots.find((s) => s.id === slotId);
      if (!slot) continue;
      const lastFromThis = [...t.moves].reverse().find((m) => m.from === slotId);
      const alreadySpokeThisRound = lastFromThis && t.moves.indexOf(lastFromThis) >= t.moves.length - t.participantIds.length;

      const prompt = [
        `You are ${slot.title} (${slot.roleKey}) in a structured negotiation.`,
        "",
        `QUESTION UNDER NEGOTIATION: ${t.question}`,
        "",
        transcript,
        "",
        alreadySpokeThisRound
          ? "You have already spoken this round. Reply ONLY if you have a materially new objection, an alternative, or a concession. If not, reply with exactly: NO_CHANGE"
          : "Respond concisely. Choose exactly one of: PROPOSE, CHALLENGE, REJECT, CLARIFY, ALTERNATIVE, CONCEDE.",
        "",
        "Format:",
        "<VERB>: <your point, one or two sentences, specific and evidence-based>",
      ].join("\n");

      let reply = "";
      try {
        reply = (await this.deps.askAgent(slot, prompt)).trim();
      } catch (e) {
        reply = `ERROR: ${e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)}`;
      }
      if (!reply || reply === "NO_CHANGE" || /^NO_CHANGE/i.test(reply)) continue;

      const kind = classifyMove(reply);
      this.addMove(threadId, slot.id, slot.title, kind, stripVerb(reply));
      moved += 1;
    }

    t.round += 1;

    const { stale, reason } = detectStalemate(t);
    return { moved, stale, reason };
  }

  /** Supervisor binds a decision. Only the supervisor (or a human) may call this. */
  resolve(threadId: string, resolution: string, resolvedBy: string): NegotiationThread | null {
    const t = this.get(threadId);
    if (!t) return null;
    t.status = "RESOLVED";
    t.resolution = resolution;
    t.resolvedBy = resolvedBy;
    t.resolvedAt = new Date().toISOString();
    this.addMove(threadId, resolvedBy, resolvedBy, "DECISION", resolution);
    return t;
  }

  escalate(threadId: string, reason: string): NegotiationThread | null {
    const t = this.get(threadId);
    if (!t) return null;
    t.status = "ESCALATED";
    t.resolution = `Escalated: ${reason}`;
    t.resolvedAt = new Date().toISOString();
    return t;
  }

  abandon(threadId: string): void {
    const t = this.get(threadId);
    if (t) t.status = "ABANDONED";
  }
}

function classifyMove(reply: string): NegotiationMoveKind {
  const head = reply.split(/[:\-—]/, 1)[0].trim().toUpperCase();
  if (head.includes("PROPOSE")) return "PROPOSAL";
  if (head.includes("ALTERNATIVE") || head.includes("ALT")) return "ALTERNATIVE";
  if (head.includes("REJECT")) return "REJECTION";
  if (head.includes("CHALLENGE") || head.includes("OBJECT")) return "CHALLENGE";
  if (head.includes("CLARIFY") || head.includes("QUESTION")) return "CLARIFICATION";
  if (head.includes("CONCEDE") || head.includes("AGREE")) return "CONCESSION";
  if (head.includes("EVIDENCE")) return "EVIDENCE";
  // Fall back on content rather than guessing "proposal" for everything.
  if (/\b(reject|unacceptable|no,|disagree strongly)\b/i.test(reply)) return "REJECTION";
  if (/\b(however|but|risk|concern|fails?)\b/i.test(reply)) return "CHALLENGE";
  if (/\?$/.test(reply.trim())) return "CLARIFICATION";
  return "PROPOSAL";
}

function stripVerb(reply: string): string {
  return reply.replace(/^[A-Z_]+[:—-]\s*/, "").trim() || reply.trim();
}

/** Persist negotiation history alongside other mission memory. */
export async function persistThread(t: NegotiationThread): Promise<void> {
  try {
    await ipc.memoryAdd(
      `negotiation:${t.missionId}`,
      "decision",
      renderThread(t),
      ["negotiation", t.topic],
      0.7,
    );
  } catch {
    /* negotiation persistence must not break the run */
  }
}
```

## `src/engine/orgGraphSync.ts`

```typescript
/**
 * MJ 6.0 — Graph ↔ organization synchronization (spec §30).
 *
 * "There must be one authoritative execution state." In V6 that state is the
 * compiled phase graph. The Organization is the *source of truth for intent*; the
 * graph is the *source of truth for execution*. This module is the only place
 * translations happen, in both directions:
 *
 *   Mission → Organization → Graph        (compile)
 *   Graph → Organization state update     (sync back)
 */
import { createNodeFromDef } from "../graph/factory";
import { DEFINITIONS_BY_ID } from "../domain/nodeLibrary";
import type { Connection, NodeInstance, WorkflowGraph } from "../domain/types";
import type { AgentSlot, Organization, OrgPhase, MissionTask, ParallelismClass } from "../domain/organization";
import type { TopologyPattern } from "../domain/missionTemplates";
import { compileTopology } from "./topology";
import { GRAPH_SCHEMA_VERSION } from "../domain/types";

export interface CompileOptions {
  originX?: number;
  originY?: number;
  xGap?: number;
  yGap?: number;
}

const START = "control.start";
const END = "control.end";
const APPROVAL = "control.approval";

function defOr(id: string, fallback: string) {
  return DEFINITIONS_BY_ID.get(id) ?? DEFINITIONS_BY_ID.get(fallback);
}

/**
 * Compile one phase of an organization into an executable WorkflowGraph.
 * Uses the real topology compiler for every pattern, so a `swarm` phase produces a
 * genuine fan-out/fan-in graph rather than a chain (which is what V5 produced).
 */
export function compilePhaseToGraph(
  org: Organization,
  phase: OrgPhase,
  opts: CompileOptions = {},
): WorkflowGraph {
  const ox = opts.originX ?? 80;
  const oy = opts.originY ?? 80;
  const xGap = opts.xGap ?? 320;
  const yGap = opts.yGap ?? 180;

  const slotForTask = new Map<string, AgentSlot>();
  const tasks = org.tasks.filter((t) => t.phaseId === phase.id);
  for (const t of tasks) {
    const slot = org.candidatePool.find((s) => s.id === t.assigneeId);
    if (slot) slotForTask.set(t.id, slot);
  }

  const roleKeys = phase.taskIds.length
    ? tasks.map((t) => slotForTask.get(t.id)?.definitionId ?? "agent.coder")
    : org.candidatePool
        .filter((s) => s.phaseId === phase.id && s.active)
        .map((s) => s.definitionId);

  const roles = roleKeys.length ? roleKeys : ["agent.coder"];
  const plan = compileTopology(phase.topology as TopologyPattern, roles);

  const nodes: NodeInstance[] = [];
  const connections: Connection[] = [];
  const nodeIdByIndex = new Map<number, string>();

  // Start node.
  const startDef = defOr(START, START);
  if (startDef) {
    const start = createNodeFromDef(startDef, `${phase.id}-start`, ox, oy + 120);
    start.config.initialPayload = JSON.stringify({ phase: phase.name, mission: org.missionId }, null, 2);
    nodes.push(start);
    nodeIdByIndex.set(-1, start.id);
  }

  // One node per stage member, laid out by level.
  let roleCursor = 0;
  plan.stages.forEach((stage, si) => {
    stage.roleKeys.forEach((roleKey, ri) => {
      const slot =
        org.candidatePool.find((s) => s.definitionId === roleKey && s.phaseId === phase.id) ??
        org.candidatePool.find((s) => s.definitionId === roleKey);
      const def = defOr(roleKey, "agent.coder");
      if (!def) return;
      const id = `${phase.id}-n${roleCursor}`;
      const n = createNodeFromDef(def, id, ox + 300 + si * xGap, oy + ri * yGap);
      n.title = slot?.title ?? n.title;
      if (slot) {
        n.purpose = slot.contract.purpose;
        n.config.harness = slot.harness;
        n.config.teamMemoryKey = org.blackboardKey;
        n.permissions = { ...slot.contract.permissions };
        n.contract.timeoutMs = slot.contract.budget.timeoutMs;
        n.memoryEnabled = true;
        slot.nodeId = n.id;
      }
      n.groupId = phase.id;
      nodes.push(n);
      nodeIdByIndex.set(roleCursor, n.id);
      roleCursor += 1;
    });
  });

  // Wire stages according to the compiled plan.
  const nodesByStage = new Map<string, string[]>();
  let cursor = 0;
  for (const stage of plan.stages) {
    const ids: string[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < stage.roleKeys.length; i++) {
      const id = nodeIdByIndex.get(cursor);
      if (id) ids.push(id);
      cursor += 1;
    }
    nodesByStage.set(stage.id, ids);
  }

  const conn = (a: string, b: string, sourcePort: string, targetPort: string) => {
    connections.push({
      id: `${phase.id}-c${connections.length}`,
      sourceNodeId: a,
      sourcePortId: sourcePort,
      targetNodeId: b,
      targetPortId: targetPort,
      dataType: "AgentResult",
      status: "idle",
    });
  };

  const startId = nodeIdByIndex.get(-1);
  const firstStage = plan.stages[0];
  if (startId && firstStage) {
    for (const target of nodesByStage.get(firstStage.id) ?? []) {
      conn(startId, target, "payload", "input");
    }
  }
  for (const stage of plan.stages) {
    const from = nodesByStage.get(stage.id) ?? [];
    for (const nextId of stage.next) {
      const to = nodesByStage.get(nextId) ?? [];
      for (const a of from) for (const b of to) conn(a, b, "output", "input");
    }
    // Loop edges are rendered as a `item` → body connection for the visual graph;
    // the scheduler owns the actual iteration.
    if (stage.loopBackTo) {
      const back = nodesByStage.get(stage.loopBackTo) ?? [];
      for (const a of from) for (const b of back) conn(a, b, "item", "input");
    }
  }

  // Approval gate: append a human approval node when the phase is gated.
  const needsGate = phase.taskIds.some((id) => {
    const t = org.tasks.find((x) => x.id === id);
    return t?.parallelism === "APPROVAL_GATED";
  }) || phase.name.toLowerCase().includes("gate") || phase.name.toLowerCase().includes("approval") || phase.name.toLowerCase().includes("publish") || phase.name.toLowerCase().includes("cutover") || phase.name.toLowerCase().includes("release");

  if (needsGate) {
    const apprDef = defOr(APPROVAL, APPROVAL);
    if (apprDef) {
      const g = createNodeFromDef(apprDef, `${phase.id}-gate`, ox + 300 + plan.stages.length * xGap, oy + 60);
      g.title = `${phase.name} — human approval`;
      nodes.push(g);
      const lastStage = plan.stages[plan.stages.length - 1];
      for (const a of nodesByStage.get(lastStage.id) ?? []) conn(a, g.id, "output", "input");
      nodeIdByIndex.set(9999, g.id);
    }
  }

  const endDef = defOr(END, END);
  if (endDef) {
    const e = createNodeFromDef(endDef, `${phase.id}-end`, ox + 300 + (plan.stages.length + 1) * xGap, oy + 120);
    nodes.push(e);
    const tailId = nodeIdByIndex.get(9999) ?? [...nodeIdByIndex.values()].filter((v) => v !== startId).pop();
    if (tailId) conn(tailId, e.id, "output", "result");
  }

  return {
    schemaVersion: GRAPH_SCHEMA_VERSION,
    id: `${org.id}:${phase.id}`,
    name: `${phase.name}`,
    nodes,
    connections,
    viewport: { x: 0, y: 0, zoom: 0.7 },
    groups: [],
    notes: [],
  };
}

/**
 * Graph → Organization. After a run (or a user edit on the canvas), fold node
 * state back into slots and tasks so there is never a divergent view.
 */
export function syncGraphToOrg(
  org: Organization,
  graph: WorkflowGraph,
  nodeStatus: Record<string, string>,
  nodeOutput: Record<string, string>,
): { updatedSlots: string[]; updatedTasks: string[]; notes: string[] } {
  const updatedSlots: string[] = [];
  const updatedTasks: string[] = [];
  const notes: string[] = [];

  const nodesById = new Map(graph.nodes.map((n) => [n.id, n]));

  for (const slot of org.candidatePool) {
    if (!slot.nodeId) continue;
    const node = nodesById.get(slot.nodeId);
    if (!node) {
      notes.push(`Slot ${slot.title} referenced missing node ${slot.nodeId}; detached.`);
      slot.nodeId = undefined;
      continue;
    }
    const status = nodeStatus[node.id];
    if (status) {
      const mapped = mapNodeStatusToSlot(status);
      if (mapped && mapped !== slot.status) {
        slot.status = mapped;
        updatedSlots.push(slot.id);
      }
    }
    // Keep the contract's purpose aligned if the user edited the node.
    if (node.purpose && node.purpose !== slot.contract.purpose) {
      slot.contract.purpose = node.purpose;
      updatedSlots.push(slot.id);
    }
    if (node.config.harness && node.config.harness !== slot.harness) {
      notes.push(`${slot.title}: harness changed ${slot.harness} → ${String(node.config.harness)} via canvas edit.`);
      slot.harness = String(node.config.harness);
      updatedSlots.push(slot.id);
    }
  }

  for (const task of org.tasks) {
    const slot = org.candidatePool.find((s) => s.id === task.assigneeId);
    if (!slot?.nodeId) continue;
    const status = nodeStatus[slot.nodeId];
    if (!status) continue;
    const mapped = mapNodeStatusToTask(status);
    if (mapped && mapped !== task.status) {
      task.status = mapped;
      task.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
      if (mapped === "COMPLETED") task.completedAt = new Date().toISOString();
      updatedTasks.push(task.id);
    }
    const out = nodeOutput[slot.nodeId];
    if (out && task.status === "COMPLETED" && !task.outputs.length) {
      notes.push(`Task "${task.title}" completed; output captured for artifact creation.`);
    }
  }

  org.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
  return { updatedSlots: [...new Set(updatedSlots)], updatedTasks: [...new Set(updatedTasks)], notes };
}

function mapNodeStatusToSlot(status: string): AgentSlot["status"] | undefined {
  switch (status) {
    case "queued":
      return "ASSIGNED";
    case "running":
    case "streaming":
      return "RUNNING";
    case "waiting":
      return "WAITING_APPROVAL";
    case "succeeded":
      return "SUCCEEDED";
    case "failed":
      return "FAILED";
    case "paused":
      return "PAUSED";
    case "blocked":
      return "STALLED";
    default:
      return undefined;
  }
}

function mapNodeStatusToTask(status: string): MissionTask["status"] | undefined {
  switch (status) {
    case "queued":
      return "DELEGATED";
    case "running":
    case "streaming":
      return "RUNNING";
    case "waiting":
      return "BLOCKED";
    case "succeeded":
      return "COMPLETED";
    case "failed":
      return "FAILED";
    default:
      return undefined;
  }
}

/** Parallelism class for a task, derived from its phase topology (§24). */
export function parallelismForTask(
  org: Organization,
  task: MissionTask,
): ParallelismClass {
  if (task.parallelism) return task.parallelism;
  const phase = org.phases.find((p) => p.id === task.phaseId);
  return phase ? "SEQUENTIAL" : "SEQUENTIAL";
}
```

/**
 * MJ 6.0 — Organization runtime (spec §3, §36).
 *
 * The loop V6 exists to provide:
 *
 *   Mission → plan → form organization → staff → execute phases → observe
 *          → evaluate → repair → reorganize → verify → outcome
 *
 * Everything here goes through the governor, writes to the flight recorder, and
 * leaves an auditable trail. There is no path that mutates the organization
 * silently (§4, §32).
 */
import type { Mission, MissionStatus, SuccessCriterion } from "../domain/mission";
import { assertTransition, isTerminal } from "../domain/mission";
import type {
  AgentSlot,
  AgentContract,
  MissionTask,
  Organization,
  OrgPhase,
  ParallelismClass,
} from "../domain/organization";
import { emptyScorecard } from "../domain/organization";
import type { Charter, MutationKind } from "../domain/charter";
import { applyPermissionCeiling } from "../domain/charter";
import type { Artifact, ArtifactContentType } from "../domain/artifact";
import type { PermissionSet } from "../domain/types";
import { artifactHash } from "../domain/artifact";
import type { RiskClass } from "../domain/risk";
import { classifyAction } from "../domain/risk";
import type { ScopedMemory } from "../domain/memoryScopes";
import { estimateTokens, retrieve } from "../domain/memoryScopes";
import type { EvaluationResult } from "./evaluator";
import { evaluate } from "./evaluator";
import type { MissionPlan, PlannedAgent } from "./missionPlanner";
import { titleForRole } from "./missionPlanner";
import { compilePhaseToGraph, syncGraphToOrg } from "./orgGraphSync";
import { runGraph, type RunOptions, type RunResult } from "./scheduler";
import { v6 } from "../ipc/v6";
import { CostLedger } from "./cost";
import { AuditLedger, exportLedger } from "./audit";
import { buildProvenanceManifest } from "./provenanceExport";
import type { ProvenanceManifest } from "./provenanceExport";
import { FlightRecorder } from "./flightRecorder";
import { CheckpointStore, createCheckpoint, recoverCheckpoint, runnableTasks, deadlockedTasks, validateCheckpoint, type CheckpointTrigger, type MissionCheckpoint } from "./checkpoint";
import { ResourceManager, poolFromBudget } from "./resourceManager";
import { checkBudget, createGovernorState, checkPolicy, engageKillSwitch, recordSpend, buildApprovalPayload, type GovernorState } from "./governor";
import type { PolicyCheckResult } from "./governor";
import { createBlackboard, postToBlackboard, renderBlackboard, type Blackboard } from "./blackboard";
import { observe, type SupervisorReport, type SupervisorRecommendation } from "./supervisor";
import { classifyError } from "./failureClassifier";
import { completeRepair, newRepairAttempt, nextStrategy, repairWorked, type RepairAttempt, type RepairStrategy } from "./repair";
import { GraphVersionStore, newGraphMutation, mayApply, applyMutation, rejectMutation, type GraphMutation } from "./graphEvolution";
import { Negotiator } from "./negotiation";
import { selectHarness, adapterFor, observationFromRun, type SelectionContext } from "./arbitration";
import type { HarnessId } from "../domain/harness";

import type { WorkflowGraph } from "../domain/types";
import { computeMissionScore, renderScorecard, type MissionScore, type ScoreInputs } from "../domain/scorecard";

export interface ApprovalResolver {
  request(payload: ApprovalPayload): Promise<{ approved: boolean; by: string; note?: string }>;
}

export interface ApprovalPayload {
  id: string;
  what: string;
  whyRequired: string;
  requestedBy: string;
  whatChanges: string;
  riskClass: RiskClass;
  policy: string;
  evidence: string[];
  expectedOutcome: string;
}

export interface MissionOutcome {
  missionId: string;
  status: MissionStatus;
  score?: MissionScore;
  artifacts: Artifact[];
  costUsd: number;
  durationMs: number;
  checkpoints: number;
  reorganizations: number;
  repairs: number;
  humanInterventions: number;
  regressions: number;
  scorecard: string;
  audit: string;
  flight: string;
  /** Machine-readable provenance manifest for every artifact (EU AI Act Art. 50). */
