}

export interface RuntimeCallbacks {
  onEvent?(kind: string, data: Record<string, unknown>): void;
  onPhaseStart?(phase: OrgPhase): void;
  onPhaseEnd?(phase: OrgPhase, result: RunResult): void;
  onApprovalRequired?(payload: ApprovalPayload): void;
  onRepair?(attempt: RepairAttempt): void;
  onMutation?(mutation: GraphMutation): void;
  /**
   * Injectable agent executor forwarded to the scheduler. Present only for the
   * headless §39 acceptance run; the desktop app always uses real harnesses.
   */
  nodeRunner?: RunOptions["nodeRunner"];
  /** Injectable judge backend, forwarded to the evaluator. */
  evaluationLlm?: (prompt: string, model: string) => Promise<string>;
}

const TASK_KIND_BY_ROLE: Record<string, TaskKind> = {
  "agent.security": "security",
  "agent.tester": "testing",
  "agent.qa": "testing",
  "agent.architect": "architecture",
  "agent.researcher": "research",
  "agent.synthesizer": "research",
  "agent.docs": "documentation",
  "agent.debugger": "debugging",
  "agent.reviewer": "review",
  "agent.critic": "review",
  "agent.judge": "review",
  "agent.preset.sre": "ops",
  "agent.preset.legal": "review",
  "agent.preset.data-analyst": "data",
  "agent.preset.finance": "data",
  "agent.preset.pm": "research",
};

function taskKindFor(roleKey: string, phase?: OrgPhase): TaskKind {
  return TASK_KIND_BY_ROLE[roleKey] ?? (phase?.taskIds.length ? "coding" : "coding");
}

/**
 * The permission a task actually needs to do its job.
 *
 * Deriving this from the risk class was wrong: it demanded `filesystemWrite` from
 * every task above LOW, so security analysts, reviewers and judges — agents that
 * only ever read — were denied on principle. Permissions follow the work, not the
 * consequence tier.
 */
function requiredPermissionFor(taskKind: TaskKind): keyof PermissionSet & string {
  switch (taskKind) {
    case "coding":
    case "refactor":
    case "migration":
    case "documentation":
      return "filesystemWrite";
    case "testing":
    case "debugging":
    case "ops":
    case "data":
      return "terminalExecute";
    case "security":
    case "review":
    case "research":
    case "architecture":
    default:
      return "filesystemRead";
  }
}

export class OrganizationRuntime {
  readonly ledger = new AuditLedger();
  readonly recorder = new FlightRecorder();
  readonly checkpoints = new CheckpointStore();
  readonly cost = new CostLedger();
  readonly resources: ResourceManager;
  readonly governor: GovernorState;
  readonly blackboard: Blackboard;
  readonly negotiator: Negotiator;

  private graphVersions = new Map<string, GraphVersionStore>();
  private phaseGraphs = new Map<string, WorkflowGraph>();
  private artifacts: Artifact[] = [];
  private memory: ScopedMemory[] = [];
  private repairs: RepairAttempt[] = [];
  private pendingAudit: Array<Record<string, unknown>> = [];
  private mutations: GraphMutation[] = [];
  private observations: Array<import("../domain/reputation").ReputationObservation> = [];
  private signal = { aborted: false, paused: false };
  private lastReport?: SupervisorReport;
  private approvals: ApprovalPayload[] = [];
  private nodeStatus: Record<string, string> = {};
  private nodeOutput: Record<string, string> = {};
  private lastOutputAt: Record<string, number> = {};
  private toolErrors: Record<string, number> = {};
  private busySlotIds: string[] = [];

  constructor(
    public mission: Mission,
    public org: Organization,
    public charter: Charter,
    public plan: MissionPlan,
    private approvalResolver: ApprovalResolver,
    private callbacks: RuntimeCallbacks = {},
  ) {
    this.resources = new ResourceManager(poolFromBudget(mission.budget));
    this.governor = createGovernorState(charter, mission.riskPolicy);
    this.blackboard = createBlackboard(org.blackboardKey, mission.id);
    this.negotiator = new Negotiator({
      askAgent: (slot, prompt) => this.askAgent(slot, prompt),
      onMove: (thread, move) => {
        this.emit("NEGOTIATION_PROPOSAL", {
          threadId: thread.id,
          moveKind: move.kind,
          from: move.fromLabel,
          body: move.body,
        });
      },
    });
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- events

  private emit(
    kind: import("../domain/events").OrgEventKind,
    data: Record<string, unknown> = {},
    opts: { actor?: string; actorKind?: string; policy?: string; reason?: string; evidence?: string[] } = {},
  ): void {
    const actorLabel = opts.actor ?? "supervisor";
    const actorKind = opts.actorKind ?? "supervisor";
    this.recorder.record({
      kind,
      missionId: this.mission.id,
      orgId: this.org.id,
      actor: { id: actorKind === "supervisor" ? "supervisor" : opts.actor ?? "supervisor", kind: actorKind as never, label: actorLabel },
      authority: {
        source: `charter:${this.charter.id}`,
        autonomyMode: this.charter.autonomyMode,
        policy: opts.policy ?? "runtime",
        reason: opts.reason ?? "",
        evidence: opts.evidence ?? [],
      },
      data,
    });
    const ledgerEntry = this.ledger.append({
      kind,
      missionId: this.mission.id,
      actor: `${actorKind}:${actorKind === "supervisor" ? "supervisor" : opts.actor ?? "supervisor"}`,
      policy: opts.policy,
      reason: opts.reason,
      evidence: opts.evidence ?? [],
      data,
    });
    // Queue for durable storage; flushed at phase boundaries and at run end.
    this.pendingAudit.push(ledgerEntry as unknown as Record<string, unknown>);
    this.callbacks.onEvent?.(kind, data);
  }

  /** Persist the in-memory audit chain to the append-only ledger table. */
  async flushAudit(): Promise<void> {
    const batch = this.pendingAudit;
    this.pendingAudit = [];
    for (const entry of batch) {
      try {
        await v6.auditAppend(entry);
      } catch {
        // Never lose the chain: keep the entry queued if the write failed.
        this.pendingAudit.push(entry);
      }
    }
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------ lifecycle

  async run(): Promise<MissionOutcome> {
    this.transition("PLANNING");
    this.emit("MISSION_PLANNED", {
      planId: this.plan.id,
      phases: this.plan.phases.length,
      slots: this.plan.staffing.length,
      confidence: this.plan.confidence,
      estimatedCostUsd: this.plan.estimatedCostUsd,
    }, { policy: "planner", reason: this.plan.rationale });
    this.checkpoint("AFTER_PLANNING");

    this.transition("READY");
    this.staff();
    this.emit("ORG_CREATED", {
      orgId: this.org.id,
      slots: this.org.candidatePool.length,
      framework: this.org.frameworkId,
      topology: this.org.topology,
    }, { reason: `Staffed ${this.org.candidatePool.length} agent slots from the plan.` });

    this.transition("RUNNING");
    this.emit("MISSION_STARTED", { missionId: this.mission.id, objective: this.mission.objective });

    try {
      for (const phase of this.org.phases) {
        if (this.signal.aborted) break;
        while (this.signal.paused) {
          if (this.signal.aborted) break;
          await sleep(120);
        }
        if (this.signal.aborted) break;

        await this.runPhase(phase);

        const budget = checkBudget(this.governor);
        if (budget.breached.length) {
          this.emit("BUDGET_BREACHED", { breached: budget.breached, fractions: budget.fractions });
          const ok = await this.requestApproval({
            id: `appr-budget-${this.approvals.length + 1}`,
            what: `Continue mission past the ${budget.breached.join(", ")} ceiling`,
            whyRequired: "A mission ceiling was reached; continuing requires a human decision.",
            requestedBy: "supervisor",
            whatChanges: "Raises the effective ceiling for this mission.",
            riskClass: "HIGH",
            policy: `ceiling:${budget.breached.join(",")}`,
            evidence: budget.breached.map((b) => `${b}=${(budget.fractions[b] ?? 0).toFixed(2)}`),
            expectedOutcome: "Mission continues with additional budget.",
          });
          if (!ok) {
            this.transition("BLOCKED");
            break;
          }
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      this.emit("MISSION_FAILED", { error: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e) });
      this.transition("FAILED");
    }

    // Verification pass (§18, §19).
    if (!isTerminal(this.mission.status)) {
      this.transition("VERIFYING");
      const outcome = await this.verify();
      this.mission.status = outcome.status;
      this.mission.endedAt = new Date().toISOString();
      await this.flushAudit();
      return outcome;
    }

    const outcome = this.verify();
    await this.flushAudit();
    return outcome;
  }

  private transition(to: MissionStatus): void {
    assertTransition(this.mission.status, to);
    this.mission.status = to;
    this.mission.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
    if (isTerminal(to)) this.mission.endedAt = new Date().toISOString();
  }

  // -------------------------------------------------------------- staffing

  private staff(): void {
    for (const planned of this.plan.staffing) {
      this.spawnAgent(planned, `Planned staffing for phase ${planned.phaseId}`);
    }
    // Every planned slot starts active; the supervisor retires underperformers.
    this.org.active = this.org.candidatePool.map((s) => s.id);
    for (const phase of this.plan.phases) {
      this.org.phases.push({
        id: phase.id,
        orgId: this.org.id,
        name: phase.name,
        rationale: phase.rationale,
        topology: phase.topology,
        status: "PENDING",
        taskIds: [],
      });
      this.createTasks(phase);
    }
  }

  private spawnAgent(planned: PlannedAgent, reason: string): AgentSlot {
    const permissions = applyPermissionCeiling(
      planned.contract.permissions,
      this.charter.permissionCeiling,
    );
    const contract: AgentContract = { ...planned.contract, permissions };
    const slot: AgentSlot = {
      id: planned.id,
      orgId: this.org.id,
      roleKey: planned.roleKey,
      title: planned.title || titleForRole(planned.roleKey),
      definitionId: planned.roleKey,
      harness: planned.harnessPreference[0] ?? "hermes",
      status: "IDLE",
      contract,
      scorecard: emptyScorecard(),
      phaseId: planned.phaseId,
      active: true,
      spawnedReason: reason,
      spawnedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    };
    this.org.candidatePool.push(slot);
    this.emit("AGENT_SPAWNED", {
      slotId: slot.id,
      title: slot.title,
      roleKey: slot.roleKey,
      harness: slot.harness,
      reason,
    }, { actor: "supervisor", actorKind: "supervisor", reason, policy: "planner.staffing" });
    return slot;
  }

  private createTasks(phase: MissionPlan["phases"][number]): void {
    phase.roles.forEach((roleKey, i) => {
      const slot = this.org.candidatePool.find(
        (s) => s.roleKey === roleKey && s.phaseId === phase.id && s.active,
      );
      const task: MissionTask = {
        id: `task-${phase.id}-${i}`,
        orgId: this.org.id,
        missionId: this.mission.id,
        phaseId: phase.id,
        title: `${phase.name}: ${titleForRole(roleKey)}`,
        instruction: `${phase.rationale} Work as ${titleForRole(roleKey)} toward: ${this.mission.objective}`,
        assigneeId: slot?.id,
        attemptHashes: [],
        assigneeHistory: slot ? [slot.id] : [],
        status: "PENDING",
        parallelism: phase.parallelism as ParallelismClass,
        dependsOn: [],
        inputs: [],
        outputs: [],
        riskClass: phase.riskClass,
        attempts: 0,
        maxAttempts: this.mission.budget.maxRetries + 1,
        createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      };
      this.org.tasks.push(task);
      const orgPhase = this.org.phases.find((p) => p.id === phase.id);
      orgPhase?.taskIds.push(task.id);
      this.emit("TASK_CREATED", { taskId: task.id, title: task.title, phase: phase.name });
      if (slot) {
        task.status = "DELEGATED";
        this.emit("TASK_DELEGATED", {
          taskId: task.id,
          title: task.title,
          assignee: slot.title,
        }, { actor: slot.title, actorKind: "agent", reason: "Planned assignment." });
      }
    });
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------- phase loop

  private async runPhase(phase: OrgPhase): Promise<void> {
    phase.status = "RUNNING";
    phase.startedAt = new Date().toISOString();
    this.callbacks.onPhaseStart?.(phase);
    this.emit("EXECUTION_LEVEL_STARTED", {
      phase: phase.name,
      topology: phase.topology,
      tasks: phase.taskIds.length,
    });

    // 1. Compile the phase to a graph (§30).
    const graph = compilePhaseToGraph(this.org, phase);
    const store = this.graphStoreFor(phase.id);
    const version = store.push(graph);
    this.phaseGraphs.set(phase.id, graph);
    this.emit("GRAPH_MUTATED", {
      phase: phase.name,
      previousGraphVersion: Math.max(0, version - 1),
      newGraphVersion: version,
      summary: `Compiled phase "${phase.name}" to an executable graph (${graph.nodes.length} nodes).`,
      reason: "Initial compilation from the organization plan.",
    }, { policy: "compiler", reason: "Phase compilation." });

    // 2. Select harnesses per task via the arbitration layer (§6, §7).
    await this.assignHarnesses(phase);

    // 3. Governance gate per task (§10, §11).
    for (const taskId of phase.taskIds) {
      const task = this.org.tasks.find((t) => t.id === taskId);
      if (!task) continue;
      const decision = await this.gateTask(task);
      if (decision === "BLOCK") {
        task.status = "BLOCKED";
        task.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
      }
    }

    // 4. Execute with real concurrency (§24).
    const runnable = runnableTasks(this.org.tasks.filter((t) => t.phaseId === phase.id));
    this.busySlotIds = runnable
      .map((t) => t.assigneeId)
      .filter((x): x is string => Boolean(x));

    for (const id of this.busySlotIds) {
      this.lastOutputAt[id] = Date.now();
      const hold = this.resources.acquire("executionSlot", 1, id);
      if (!hold.ok) {
        this.emit("POLICY_DENIED", { slot: id, reason: hold.reason });
      }
    }

    const concurrency = Math.max(
      1,
      Math.min(this.mission.budget.maxConcurrentAgents, this.charter.ceilings.maxConcurrentAgents),
    );

    const result = await runGraph({
      graph,
      workflowId: this.org.id,
      maxConcurrency: concurrency,
      signal: this.signal,
      costLedger: this.cost,
      onEvent: (kind, level, nodeId, data) => {
        this.nodeStatus[nodeId ?? ""] = kind.includes("SUCCEEDED")
          ? "succeeded"
          : kind.includes("FAILED")
            ? "failed"
            : kind.includes("WAITING")
              ? "waiting"
              : "running";
        if (typeof data.error === "string" && nodeId) {
          const slot = this.org.candidatePool.find((s) => s.nodeId === nodeId);
          if (slot) {
            this.toolErrors[slot.id] = (this.toolErrors[slot.id] ?? 0) + 1;
            slot.scorecard.lastError = data.error;
          }
        }
        this.emit(kind as never, { ...data, level });
      },
      nodeRunner: this.callbacks.nodeRunner,
      approvalResolver: (payload) =>
        this.approvalResolver.request({ ...payload, riskClass: payload.riskClass as RiskClass }),
    });

    this.busySlotIds = [];
    for (const id of this.org.candidatePool.map((s) => s.id)) {
      this.resources.releaseAllFor(id);
    }

    await this.flushAudit();
    this.callbacks.onPhaseEnd?.(phase, result);

    // 5. Fold graph state back into the organization (§30).
    const sync = syncGraphToOrg(this.org, graph, this.nodeStatus, this.nodeOutput);
    for (const note of sync.notes) {
      this.emit("SUPERVISOR_OBSERVATION", { note });
    }

    // 6. Record spend against the charter ceilings.
    recordSpend(this.governor, result.costUsd, result.stats.inputTokens, result.stats.outputTokens);
    this.org.metrics.totalCostUsd += result.costUsd;
    this.org.metrics.nodeRuns += result.stats.nodesRun;
    this.org.metrics.totalTokens += result.stats.inputTokens + result.stats.outputTokens;

    // 7. Create artifacts from node outputs (§12).
    this.captureArtifacts(phase, graph, result);

    // 8. Evaluate independently (§18).
    const evaluations = await this.evaluatePhase(phase);

    // 9. Repair anything that failed, then reorganize if repair is not enough.
    const failures = result.errors;
    if (failures.length) {
      this.transition("REPAIRING");
      await this.repairPhase(phase, failures.map((f) => ({ nodeId: f.nodeId, error: f.error })), evaluations);
      if (!isTerminal(this.mission.status)) this.transition("RUNNING");
    }

    // 10. Supervisor pass (§5).
    const report = this.supervise();
    this.lastReport = report;
    if (report.requiresHuman && this.charter.autonomyMode !== "CHARTERED") {
      this.emit("APPROVAL_REQUIRED", {
        what: "Continue after supervisor detected a blocking condition",
        reason: report.summary,
      });
    }

    // 11. Reorganize if warranted and permitted (§17).
    await this.maybeReorganize(report);

    phase.status = failures.length && this.org.metrics.repairsSucceeded === 0 ? "FAILED" : "COMPLETED";
    phase.completedAt = new Date().toISOString();
    if (evaluations.length) {
      phase.score = evaluations.reduce((a, e) => a + e.score, 0) / evaluations.length;
    }

    this.checkpoint("AFTER_PHASE");
    this.emit("MISSION_CHECKPOINTED", {
      phase: phase.name,
      checkpoint: this.checkpoints.latest(this.mission.id)?.id,
    });
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------- arbitration

  private async assignHarnesses(phase: OrgPhase): Promise<void> {
    for (const taskId of phase.taskIds) {
      const task = this.org.tasks.find((t) => t.id === taskId);
      if (!task) continue;
      const slot = this.org.candidatePool.find((s) => s.id === task.assigneeId);
      if (!slot) continue;

      const taskKind = taskKindFor(slot.roleKey, phase);
      const ctx: SelectionContext = {
        taskKind,
        scope: this.mission.workspace,
        requiredCapabilities: this.requiredCapabilitiesFor(slot),
        permissions: slot.contract.permissions,
        promptChars: task.instruction.length + this.mission.objective.length,
        exclude: [],
        allowed: (this.mission.allowedHarnesses.length
          ? this.mission.allowedHarnesses
          : this.charter.allowedHarnesses.length
            ? this.charter.allowedHarnesses
            : []) as HarnessId[] | undefined,
        observations: this.observations,
        riskClass: task.riskClass,
      };

      const selection = await selectHarness(ctx);
      if (selection.harnessId !== slot.harness) {
        const from = slot.harness;
        slot.harness = selection.harnessId;
        this.emit("HARNESS_SELECTED", {
          slot: slot.title,
          harnessId: selection.harnessId,
          rationale: selection.rationale,
          ranked: selection.ranked.map((r) => ({ id: r.harnessId, score: Number(r.score.toFixed(3)) })),
        }, { actor: "supervisor", actorKind: "supervisor", policy: "arbitration.selection", reason: selection.rationale });
        if (from && from !== selection.harnessId) {
          this.emit("HARNESS_SWITCHED", { slot: slot.title, from, to: selection.harnessId });
        }
      }
    }
  }

  private requiredCapabilitiesFor(slot: AgentSlot): import("./arbitration").HarnessCapability[] {
    const caps: import("./arbitration").HarnessCapability[] = ["code-read"];
    if (slot.contract.capabilities.includes("code-edit")) caps.push("code-edit");
    if (slot.contract.capabilities.includes("shell")) caps.push("shell");
    if (slot.contract.capabilities.includes("test-run")) caps.push("test-run");
    return caps;
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------ governance

  /** §10, §11 — gate a task before it runs. */
  private async gateTask(task: MissionTask): Promise<"PROCEED" | "BLOCK"> {
    const action = `task:${task.title}`.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, "-");
    const check: PolicyCheckResult = checkPolicy(this.governor, {
      action,
      riskClass: task.riskClass,
      actorId: task.assigneeId ?? "unassigned",
      actorLabel: this.org.candidatePool.find((s) => s.id === task.assigneeId)?.title ?? "unassigned",
      requiredPermission: requiredPermissionFor(
        taskKindFor(
          this.org.candidatePool.find((s) => s.id === task.assigneeId)?.roleKey ?? "",
          this.org.phases.find((p) => p.id === task.phaseId),
        ),
      ),
      actorPermissions: this.org.candidatePool.find((s) => s.id === task.assigneeId)?.contract.permissions,
      evidence: [`taskId:${task.id}`, `risk:${task.riskClass}`],
      reason: `Pre-execution gate for "${task.title}".`,
    });

    this.emit("POLICY_CHECKED", {
      taskId: task.id,
      decision: check.decision,
      riskClass: check.riskClass,
      policy: check.policy,
    }, { policy: check.policy, reason: check.reason });

    if (check.decision === "DENY") {
      this.emit("POLICY_DENIED", { taskId: task.id, reason: check.reason, policy: check.policy });
      return "BLOCK";
    }

    if (check.decision === "REQUIRE_APPROVAL") {
      const payload = buildApprovalPayload(check, task.assigneeId ?? "supervisor", {
        whatChanges: task.instruction,
        expectedOutcome: "Task proceeds under human authorization.",
        evidence: [`taskId:${task.id}`],
      });
      const approved = await this.requestApproval({
        id: `appr-${task.id}`,
        ...payload,
      });
      if (!approved) {
        this.emit("APPROVAL_REJECTED", { taskId: task.id });
        return "BLOCK";
      }
      this.emit("APPROVAL_GRANTED", { taskId: task.id });
      this.org.metrics.humanInterventions += 1;
    }

    return "PROCEED";
  }

  private async requestApproval(p: ApprovalPayload): Promise<boolean> {
    const id = p.id ?? `appr-${this.approvals.length + 1}`;
    const payload: ApprovalPayload = { ...p, id };
    this.approvals.push(payload);
    this.emit("APPROVAL_REQUIRED", {
      approvalId: id,
      what: payload.what,
      riskClass: payload.riskClass,
      policy: payload.policy,
    }, { policy: payload.policy, reason: payload.whyRequired, evidence: payload.evidence });
    this.callbacks.onApprovalRequired?.(payload);
    const res = await this.approvalResolver.request(payload);
    if (res.approved) {
      this.emit("APPROVAL_GRANTED", { approvalId: id, by: res.by, note: res.note });
      this.org.metrics.humanInterventions += 1;
    } else {
      this.emit("APPROVAL_REJECTED", { approvalId: id, by: res.by, note: res.note });
      this.org.metrics.humanInterventions += 1;
    }
    return res.approved;
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------- artifacts

  private captureArtifacts(phase: OrgPhase, graph: WorkflowGraph, result: RunResult): void {
    for (const [nodeId, ports] of result.outputs) {
      const text = String(ports["*"] ?? "");
      if (!text.trim()) continue;
      const node = graph.nodes.find((n) => n.id === nodeId);
      if (!node || node.definitionId === "control.start") continue;
      if (node.definitionId === "control.end") continue;

      const slot = this.org.candidatePool.find((s) => s.nodeId === nodeId);
      const name = `${phase.name} — ${node.title}`;
      const lineageId = `lin-${this.org.id}-${phase.id}-${nodeId}`;
      const existing = this.artifacts.filter((a) => a.lineageId === lineageId);
      const version = existing.length + 1;
      const parent = existing[existing.length - 1];

      const artifact: Artifact = {
        id: `art-${this.artifacts.length + 1}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6)}`,
        missionId: this.mission.id,
        orgId: this.org.id,
        lineageId,
        version,
        name,
        contentType: inferContentType(text),
        content: text,
        contentHash: artifactHash({ lineageId, version, content: text, parentArtifacts: parent ? [parent.id] : [], createdBy: slot?.id ?? "unknown" }),
        createdBy: slot?.id ?? "unknown",
        modifiedBy: [slot?.id ?? "unknown"],
        inputs: [],
        parentArtifacts: parent ? [parent.id] : [],
        toolsUsed: [],
        modelsUsed: [String(node.providers[0]?.model ?? node.config.model ?? "unknown")],
        harnessUsed: slot?.harness ?? String(node.config.harness ?? "hermes"),
        costUsd: 0,
        latencyMs: 0,
        approvalState: "UNREVIEWED",
        riskClass: classifyAction(`fs:write`),
        provenance: `Produced by ${slot?.title ?? node.title} during phase "${phase.name}".`,
        rollbackTarget: parent?.id,
        createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        tags: [phase.name, node.definitionId],
      };
      this.artifacts.push(artifact);
      if (version > 1) {
        this.emit("ARTIFACT_VERSIONED", { artifactId: artifact.id, name, version, lineageId });
      } else {
        this.emit("ARTIFACT_CREATED", { artifactId: artifact.id, name, version, lineageId });
      }

      const task = this.org.tasks.find((t) => t.assigneeId === slot?.id && t.phaseId === phase.id);
      if (task && !task.outputs.includes(artifact.id)) task.outputs.push(artifact.id);
    }
    this.mission.artifactIds = this.artifacts.map((a) => a.id);
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------ evaluation

  private async evaluatePhase(phase: OrgPhase): Promise<EvaluationResult[]> {
    const rubricId = this.charter.evaluationPolicy.rubricIds[0] ?? "rubric.generic-deliverable";
    const phaseArtifacts = this.artifacts.filter((a) => a.tags.includes(phase.name));
    const results: EvaluationResult[] = [];

    for (const artifact of phaseArtifacts.slice(-4)) {
      const producerModel = artifact.modelsUsed[0];
      const res = await evaluate(
        {
          rubricId,
          task: this.mission.objective,
          output: artifact.content,
          context: this.mission.constraints,
          producerModel,
          producerFamily: familyOf(producerModel),
          trajectory: this.charter.evaluationPolicy.evaluateTrajectory
            ? this.recorder
                .forMission(this.mission.id)
                .slice(-8)
                .map((e) => `${e.kind}: ${JSON.stringify(e.data).slice(0, 200)}`)
            : undefined,
        },
        {
          judgeCount: this.charter.evaluationPolicy.judgeCount,
          acceptScore: this.charter.evaluationPolicy.acceptScore,
          maxDisagreement: this.charter.evaluationPolicy.maxJudgeDisagreement,
          requireDifferentFamily: this.charter.evaluationPolicy.requireDifferentFamily,
          signal: this.signal,
          llm: this.callbacks.evaluationLlm,
        },
      );

      artifact.evaluation = {
        score: res.score,
        dimensions: Object.fromEntries(
          res.verdicts[0] ? Object.entries(res.verdicts[0].dimensionScores) : [],
        ),
        judgeIds: res.verdicts.map((v) => v.judgeModel),
        passed: res.passed,
        notes: res.notes.join(" | "),
        evaluatedAt: res.evaluatedAt,
      };
      results.push(res);

      this.emit(res.passed ? "EVALUATION_PASSED" : "EVALUATION_FAILED", {
        artifactId: artifact.id,
        score: res.score,
        passed: res.passed,
        judges: res.verdicts.map((v) => v.judgeModel),
        hardFail: res.hardFail,
      }, {
        actor: "evaluator",
        actorKind: "evaluator",
        policy: `rubric:${rubricId}`,
        reason: res.notes.join(" | ") || `Independent evaluation scored ${res.score.toFixed(2)}/5.`,
        evidence: res.verdicts.map((v) => `${v.judgeModel}=${v.score.toFixed(2)}`),
      });

      // Update the producing agent's scorecard with an INDEPENDENT score.
      const slot = this.org.candidatePool.find((s) => s.id === artifact.createdBy);
      if (slot) {
        const sc = slot.scorecard;
        sc.meanScore = sc.meanScore ? (sc.meanScore + res.score) / 2 : res.score;
      }

      // Record harness reputation evidence (§7).
      if (artifact.harnessUsed && artifact.harnessUsed !== "llm") {
        this.observations.push(
          observationFromRun(
            artifact.harnessUsed as HarnessId,
            taskKindFor(slot?.roleKey ?? "", phase),
            res.passed,
            res.score,
            artifact.costUsd,
            artifact.latencyMs,
            this.mission.id,
            this.mission.workspace,
          ),
        );
      }
    }

    return results;
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- repair

  private async repairPhase(
    phase: OrgPhase,
    failures: Array<{ nodeId: string; error: string }>,
    evaluations: EvaluationResult[],
  ): Promise<void> {
    const baseScore = evaluations.length
      ? evaluations.reduce((a, e) => a + e.score, 0) / evaluations.length
      : undefined;

    for (const f of failures) {
      const slot = this.org.candidatePool.find((s) => s.nodeId === f.nodeId);
      const task = this.org.tasks.find((t) => t.assigneeId === slot?.id && t.phaseId === phase.id);
      if (!task) continue;

      const failureClass = classifyError(f.error, task.attempts);
      this.emit("FAILURE_DETECTED", {
        taskId: task.id,
        nodeId: f.nodeId,
        error: f.error,
      });
      this.emit("FAILURE_CLASSIFIED", {
        taskId: task.id,
        class: failureClass,
      }, { policy: "classifier", reason: f.error });

      const tried: RepairStrategy[] = [];
      let repaired = false;

      while (task.attempts < task.maxAttempts && !repaired) {
        const strategy = nextStrategy(failureClass, tried);
        tried.push(strategy);
        task.attempts += 1;
        this.org.metrics.repairsAttempted += 1;

        const attempt = newRepairAttempt(task.id, failureClass, strategy, task.attempts, {
          agentSlotId: slot?.id,
          scoreBefore: baseScore,
        });
        this.repairs.push(attempt);
        this.callbacks.onRepair?.(attempt);
        this.emit("REPAIR_STARTED", {
          taskId: task.id,
          strategy,
          attempt: task.attempts,
          why: attempt.why,
        }, { policy: "repair.ladder", reason: attempt.why });
        this.emit("REPAIR_STRATEGY_SELECTED", {
          taskId: task.id,
          strategy,
          why: attempt.why,
          whatChanged: attempt.whatChanged,
          expectedImprovement: attempt.expectedImprovement,
        });

        // ESCALATE_HUMAN terminates the ladder.
        if (strategy === "ESCALATE_HUMAN") {
          const ok = await this.requestApproval({
            id: `appr-repair-${task.id}`,
            what: `Repair exhausted for "${task.title}"`,
            whyRequired: `All automated strategies failed. Last error: ${f.error}`,
            requestedBy: slot?.title ?? "supervisor",
            whatChanges: task.instruction,
            riskClass: task.riskClass === "LOW" ? "MEDIUM" : task.riskClass,
            policy: "repair.escalation",
            evidence: this.repairs.map((r) => `${r.strategy}:${r.outcome ?? "?"}`),
            expectedOutcome: "Human provides direction or narrows scope.",
          });
          const completed = completeRepair(attempt, ok ? "SUCCESS" : "ABORTED", { error: f.error });
          this.repairs[this.repairs.length - 1] = completed;
          this.emit("REPAIR_COMPLETED", { taskId: task.id, strategy, outcome: completed.outcome });
          if (!ok) {
            task.status = "FAILED";
            task.error = f.error;
            this.emit("REPAIR_EXHAUSTED", { taskId: task.id, tried });
            break;
          }
          repaired = true;
          this.org.metrics.repairsSucceeded += 1;
          break;
        }

        // Apply the strategy.
        const outcome = await this.applyRepair(strategy, task, slot, f.error, phase);
        const scoreAfter = outcome.score;
        const completed = completeRepair(attempt, outcome.ok ? "SUCCESS" : "FAILURE", {
          scoreBefore: baseScore,
          scoreAfter,
          error: outcome.ok ? undefined : outcome.error,
        });
        this.repairs[this.repairs.length - 1] = completed;
        this.emit("REPAIR_COMPLETED", {
          taskId: task.id,
          strategy,
          outcome: completed.outcome,
          scoreBefore: baseScore,
          scoreAfter,
        });

        if (outcome.ok && repairWorked(completed)) {
          repaired = true;
          this.org.metrics.repairsSucceeded += 1;
          task.status = "DELEGATED";
          task.error = undefined;
          break;
        }
      }

      if (!repaired && task.status !== "FAILED") {
        task.status = "FAILED";
        task.error = f.error;
        this.emit("REPAIR_EXHAUSTED", { taskId: task.id, tried });
      }
    }
  }

  /** Apply one repair strategy. Returns whether it succeeded and a fresh score. */
  private async applyRepair(
    strategy: RepairStrategy,
    task: MissionTask,
    slot: AgentSlot | undefined,
    error: string,
    phase: OrgPhase,
  ): Promise<{ ok: boolean; score?: number; error?: string }> {
    if (!slot) return { ok: false, error: "no assignee to repair" };

    switch (strategy) {
      case "RETRY_WITH_CONTEXT":
      case "RETRY_SAME":
      case "MODIFY_CONTEXT": {
        const context =
          strategy === "RETRY_SAME"
            ? task.instruction
            : [
                task.instruction,
                "",
                "PREVIOUS ATTEMPT FAILED. Learn from it:",
                `error: ${error}`,
                strategy === "MODIFY_CONTEXT" ? "Work in smaller steps. State each step before doing it." : "",
              ].join("\n");
        return this.retryTask(slot, task, context);
      }
      case "SWITCH_HARNESS": {
        const current = slot.harness as HarnessId;
        const ranked = await selectHarness({
          taskKind: taskKindFor(slot.roleKey, phase),
          scope: this.mission.workspace,
          requiredCapabilities: this.requiredCapabilitiesFor(slot),
          permissions: slot.contract.permissions,
          promptChars: task.instruction.length,
          exclude: [current],
          observations: this.observations,
          riskClass: task.riskClass,
        });
        if (ranked.fallback || ranked.harnessId === current) {
          return { ok: false, error: "no alternative harness available" };
        }
        slot.harness = ranked.harnessId;
        this.emit("HARNESS_SWITCHED", { slot: slot.title, from: current, to: ranked.harnessId, rationale: ranked.rationale });
        return this.retryTask(slot, task, task.instruction);
      }
      case "REASSIGN_AGENT": {
        const alt = this.org.candidatePool.find(
          (s) => s.active && s.id !== slot.id && s.roleKey === slot.roleKey && s.status !== "FAILED",
        );
        if (!alt) return { ok: false, error: "no alternate agent with the same role" };
        task.assigneeHistory.push(alt.id);
        task.assigneeId = alt.id;
        this.emit("TASK_REASSIGNED", { taskId: task.id, from: slot.title, to: alt.title });
        return this.retryTask(alt, task, task.instruction);
      }
      case "SPAWN_SPECIALIST": {
        const planned: import("./missionPlanner").PlannedAgent = {
          id: `slot-specialist-${Date.now().toString(36)}`,
          roleKey: "agent.debugger",
          title: "Specialist",
          purpose: `Diagnose and fix: ${error.slice(0, 200)}`,
          phaseId: phase.id,
          harnessPreference: [slot.harness as HarnessId],
          capabilities: ["code-read", "shell"],
          contract: { ...slot.contract, purpose: `Diagnose and fix: ${error.slice(0, 200)}` },
        };
        const newSlot = this.spawnAgent(planned, `Spawned to repair: ${error.slice(0, 120)}`);
        this.org.active.push(newSlot.id);
        task.assigneeHistory.push(newSlot.id);
        task.assigneeId = newSlot.id;
        this.emit("TASK_REASSIGNED", { taskId: task.id, from: slot.title, to: newSlot.title });
        return this.retryTask(newSlot, task, `${task.instruction}\n\nFOCUS: ${error.slice(0, 300)}`);
      }
      case "ADD_VERIFIER": {
        const planned: import("./missionPlanner").PlannedAgent = {
          id: `slot-verifier-${Date.now().toString(36)}`,
          roleKey: "agent.reviewer",
          title: "Independent Verifier",
          purpose: `Independently verify the output of "${task.title}" before it is accepted.`,
          phaseId: phase.id,
          harnessPreference: ["codex", "claude", "opencode"],
          capabilities: ["code-read"],
          contract: { ...slot.contract, purpose: "Independent verification of another agent's output." },
        };
        this.spawnAgent(planned, `Verifier added after repeated failure on "${task.title}"`);
        return { ok: true };
      }
      case "SPLIT_TASK": {
        const halves = splitInstruction(task.instruction);
        if (halves.length < 2) return { ok: false, error: "instruction could not be decomposed" };
        const childIds: string[] = [];
        halves.forEach((h, i) => {
          const child: MissionTask = {
            ...task,
            id: `${task.id}-split${i}`,
            title: `${task.title} (part ${i + 1}/${halves.length})`,
            instruction: h,
            status: "PENDING",
            attempts: 0,
            dependsOn: i === 0 ? task.dependsOn : [`${task.id}-split${i - 1}`],
            outputs: [],
            splitFrom: task.id,
            createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
            updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
          };
          this.org.tasks.push(child);
          childIds.push(child.id);
          this.emit("TASK_CREATED", { taskId: child.id, title: child.title, splitFrom: task.id });
        });
        task.status = "SPLIT";
        task.splitInto = childIds;
        this.emit("TASK_SPLIT" as never, { taskId: task.id, into: childIds });
        return { ok: true };
      }
      default:
        return { ok: false, error: `strategy ${strategy} not applicable here` };
    }
  }

  private async retryTask(
    slot: AgentSlot,
    task: MissionTask,
    instruction: string,
  ): Promise<{ ok: boolean; score?: number; error?: string }> {
    const adapter = adapterFor(slot.harness as HarnessId);
    const t0 = Date.now();
    const res = await adapter.execute({
      prompt: [
        slot.contract.identity,
        "",
        `PURPOSE: ${slot.contract.purpose}`,
        "",
        `TASK: ${instruction}`,
        "",
        `MISSION OBJECTIVE: ${this.mission.objective}`,
        ...(this.mission.constraints.length ? ["", `CONSTRAINTS:\n- ${this.mission.constraints.join("\n- ")}`] : []),
      ].join("\n"),
      cwd: this.mission.workspace || undefined,
      timeoutMs: slot.contract.budget.timeoutMs,
      permissions: slot.contract.permissions,
      contract: slot.contract,
      signal: this.signal,
    });

    const latency = Date.now() - t0;
    slot.scorecard.totalLatencyMs += latency;
    slot.scorecard.lastActiveAt = new Date().toISOString();

    // MAST: record what this attempt actually produced. An identical hash on the next
    // attempt means the agent did the same thing again, which no amount of retrying
    // will fix and which is otherwise invisible from the outside.
    if (res.ok && res.output) {
      task.attemptHashes.push(artifactHash({
        lineageId: task.id,
        version: task.attemptHashes.length + 1,
        content: res.output,
        parentArtifacts: [],
        createdBy: slot.id,
      }));
      if (task.attemptHashes.length >= 2) {
        const n = task.attemptHashes.length;
        if (task.attemptHashes[n - 1] === task.attemptHashes[n - 2]) {
          this.emit("STEP_REPETITION_DETECTED", {
            taskId: task.id,
            slot: slot.title,
            attempts: n,
          }, { reason: "Two consecutive attempts produced byte-identical output." });
        }
      }
    }

    if (!res.ok) {
      slot.scorecard.tasksFailed += 1;
      slot.scorecard.lastError = res.error;
      this.observations.push(
        observationFromRun(slot.harness as HarnessId, taskKindFor(slot.roleKey), false, 0, 0, latency, this.mission.id),
      );
      return { ok: false, error: res.error ?? "run failed" };
    }

    slot.scorecard.tasksCompleted += 1;
    task.status = "COMPLETED";
    task.completedAt = new Date().toISOString();

    // Independent evaluation of the retried output (§18).
    const ev = await evaluate(
      {
        rubricId: this.charter.evaluationPolicy.rubricIds[0] ?? "rubric.generic-deliverable",
        task: instruction,
        output: res.output,
        producerModel: res.model,
        producerFamily: familyOf(res.model),
      },
      {
        acceptScore: this.charter.evaluationPolicy.acceptScore,
        signal: this.signal,
        llm: this.callbacks.evaluationLlm,
      },
    );
    this.observations.push(
      observationFromRun(slot.harness as HarnessId, taskKindFor(slot.roleKey), ev.passed, ev.score, 0, latency, this.mission.id),
    );
    return { ok: ev.passed, score: ev.score, error: ev.passed ? undefined : `evaluation scored ${ev.score.toFixed(2)}` };
  }

  // -------------------------------------------------------- supervisor ops

  private supervise(): SupervisorReport {
    const now = Date.now();
    const lastOutputAgoMs: Record<string, number> = {};
    for (const s of this.org.candidatePool) {
      lastOutputAgoMs[s.id] = now - (this.lastOutputAt[s.id] ?? now);
    }
    const report = observe({
      mission: this.mission,
      org: this.org,
      charter: this.charter,
      governor: this.governor,
      resources: this.resources,
      blackboard: this.blackboard,
      lastOutputAgoMs,
      toolErrors: this.toolErrors,
      invalidArtifactIds: [],
      regressions: this.org.metrics.regressions ? ["regression detected"] : [],
      busySlotIds: this.busySlotIds,
    });
    this.emit("SUPERVISOR_OBSERVATION", { summary: report.summary, signals: report.signals.length });
    for (const rec of report.recommendations) {
      if (rec.kind === "NO_ACTION") continue;
      this.emit("SUPERVISOR_RECOMMENDATION", {
        kind: rec.kind,
        mutation: rec.mutation,
        title: rec.title,
        confidence: rec.confidence,
      }, { reason: rec.rationale, evidence: rec.evidence });
    }
    return report;
  }

  /**
   * §17 — reorganize only when the charter permits it, and only after policy,
   * evaluation and regression checks pass.
   *
   * The supervisor may offer several reorganizations. We try them in order and
   * stop at the first that actually applies: a recommendation that cannot be
   * carried out (e.g. swapping to a harness that is not installed) must not
   * silently consume the only reorganization the organization was owed.
   */
  private async maybeReorganize(report: SupervisorReport): Promise<void> {
    const candidates = report.recommendations.filter((r) => r.kind === "REORGANIZE" && r.mutation);
    for (const rec of candidates) {
      if (await this.tryReorganize(rec)) return;
    }
  }

  /** Attempts one reorganization. Returns true only if a mutation was recorded. */
  private async tryReorganize(rec: SupervisorRecommendation): Promise<boolean> {
    const mutationKind = rec.mutation as MutationKind;
    if (!this.charter.allowedMutations.includes(mutationKind)) {
      this.emit("POLICY_DENIED", {
        mutation: mutationKind,
        reason: `Charter does not allow ${mutationKind}.`,
      }, { policy: `charter.allowedMutations`, reason: rec.rationale });
      return false;
    }

    const permitted =
      this.charter.autonomyMode === "CHARTERED" &&
      this.org.generation < this.charter.ceilings.maxReorganizations;

    if (!permitted) {
      // §11: under SUGGEST/MANUAL the human decides every reorganization.
      const ok = await this.requestApproval({
        id: `appr-mut-${this.mutations.length + 1}`,
        what: rec.title,
        whyRequired:
          this.charter.autonomyMode === "CHARTERED"
            ? "Reorganization ceiling reached."
            : `Autonomy mode is ${this.charter.autonomyMode}; reorganizations require approval.`,
        requestedBy: "supervisor",
        whatChanges: rec.rationale,
        riskClass: "MEDIUM",
        policy: `charter.autonomyMode=${this.charter.autonomyMode}`,
        evidence: rec.evidence,
        expectedOutcome: rec.expectedGain,
      });
      if (!ok) {
        this.emit("GRAPH_MUTATION_REJECTED", { mutation: mutationKind, by: "human" });
        return false;
      }
    }

    const phase =
      this.org.phases.find((p) => p.status === "RUNNING") ??
      this.org.phases[this.org.phases.length - 1];
    if (!phase) return false;

    const store = this.graphStoreFor(phase.id);
    const before = store.current() ?? { schemaVersion: 2, id: "", name: "", nodes: [], connections: [], viewport: { x: 0, y: 0, zoom: 1 } };
    const beforeVersion = store.currentVersion();

    const scoreBefore = phase.score;
    let after = before;
    let changed = "";

    switch (mutationKind) {
      case "SPAWN_SPECIALIST":
      case "ADD_VERIFIER": {
        const roleKey = mutationKind === "ADD_VERIFIER" ? "agent.reviewer" : "agent.debugger";
        const planned: import("./missionPlanner").PlannedAgent = {
          id: `slot-mut-${Date.now().toString(36)}`,
          roleKey,
          title: mutationKind === "ADD_VERIFIER" ? "Independent Verifier" : "Specialist",
          purpose: rec.rationale,
          phaseId: phase.id,
          harnessPreference: ["claude", "codex", "opencode"],
          capabilities: ["code-read"],
          contract: {
            ...(this.org.candidatePool[0]?.contract ?? {
              identity: roleKey, purpose: rec.rationale, capabilities: ["code-read"], inputs: [], outputs: [],
              permissions: this.charter.permissionCeiling,
              budget: { maxCostUsd: 1, maxTokens: 100000, timeoutMs: 300000, maxToolSteps: 8, maxRetries: 2 },
              successCriteria: [], failurePolicy: "REPAIR" as const,
              escalationPolicy: { onRiskClass: "HIGH" as const, afterFailures: 2, onLowConfidence: 0.55 },
            }),
            purpose: rec.rationale,
          },
        };
        this.spawnAgent(planned, rec.rationale);
        changed = `Added ${planned.title} to phase "${phase.name}".`;
        break;
      }
      case "REMOVE_AGENT": {
        const contributions = estimateContribution(this.org);
        const worst = this.org.candidatePool
          .filter((s) => s.active && s.status !== "RUNNING")
          .sort((a, b) => (contributions[a.id] ?? 0) - (contributions[b.id] ?? 0))[0];
        if (!worst) return false;
        worst.active = false;
        worst.status = "RETIRED";
        worst.retiredAt = new Date().toISOString();
        this.org.active = this.org.active.filter((id) => id !== worst.id);
        this.emit("AGENT_RETIRED", { slotId: worst.id, title: worst.title, reason: rec.rationale });
        changed = `Retired ${worst.title}.`;
        break;
      }
      case "SWAP_HARNESS": {
        const target = this.org.candidatePool.find((s) => s.active && s.status === "FAILED")
          ?? this.org.candidatePool.find((s) => s.active);
        if (!target) return false;
        const ranked = await selectHarness({
          taskKind: taskKindFor(target.roleKey, phase),
          requiredCapabilities: this.requiredCapabilitiesFor(target),
          permissions: target.contract.permissions,
          promptChars: 2000,
          exclude: [target.harness as HarnessId],
          observations: this.observations,
        });
        if (ranked.fallback) return false;
        const from = target.harness;
        target.harness = ranked.harnessId;
        this.emit("HARNESS_SWITCHED", { slot: target.title, from, to: ranked.harnessId, rationale: ranked.rationale });
        changed = `Moved ${target.title} from ${from} to ${ranked.harnessId}.`;
        break;
      }
      case "REPLAN_PHASES": {
        const dead = deadlockedTasks(this.org.tasks);
        for (const id of dead) {
          const t = this.org.tasks.find((x) => x.id === id);
          if (t) {
            t.dependsOn = t.dependsOn.filter((d) => {
              const dep = this.org.tasks.find((x) => x.id === d);
              return dep && dep.status !== "FAILED";
            });
            t.status = "PENDING";
            t.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
          }
        }
        changed = `Cleared unresolvable dependencies on ${dead.length} task(s).`;
        break;
      }
      case "FORK_DEBATE": {
        const thread = this.negotiator.open({
          missionId: this.mission.id,
          orgId: this.org.id,
          topic: rec.title,
          question: rec.rationale,
          participantIds: this.org.active.slice(0, 3),
        });
        await this.negotiator.runRound(thread.id, this.org.candidatePool);
        changed = `Opened negotiation "${rec.title}" (${thread.moves.length} moves).`;
        break;
      }
      default:
        return false;
    }

    // Recompile the phase with the new organization.
    after = compilePhaseToGraph(this.org, phase);
    const newVersion = store.push(after);
    this.phaseGraphs.set(phase.id, after);

    const mutation = newGraphMutation({
      missionId: this.mission.id,
      orgId: this.org.id,
      phaseId: phase.id,
      kind: mutationKind,
      summary: changed,
      previousGraphVersion: beforeVersion,
      newGraphVersion: newVersion,
      previousGraph: before,
      newGraph: after,
      reason: rec.rationale,
      triggeringEvidence: rec.evidence,
      requestingAgent: "supervisor",
      decisionAuthority: permitted ? `charter:${this.charter.id}` : "user:approved",
      policy: `charter.autonomyMode=${this.charter.autonomyMode}`,
      rollbackTarget: beforeVersion,
      scoreBefore,
    });

    // §17: policy check, evaluation, regression — then activate.
    const verdict = mayApply(mutation);
    if (!verdict.ok) {
      this.mutations.push(
        rejectMutation(mutation, verdict.reason.includes("Regression") ? "REGRESSION_REJECTED" : "EVALUATION_FAILED", verdict.reason),
      );
      this.emit("GRAPH_MUTATION_REJECTED", { mutation: mutationKind, reason: verdict.reason });
      return false;
    }

    this.mutations.push(applyMutation(mutation));
    this.org.generation += 1;
    this.org.metrics.reorganizations += 1;
    this.governor.reorganizations += 1;
    this.callbacks.onMutation?.(mutation);
    this.emit("GRAPH_MUTATED", {
      mutation: mutationKind,
      previousGraphVersion: beforeVersion,
      newGraphVersion: newVersion,
      summary: changed,
      generation: this.org.generation,
    }, {
      actor: "supervisor",
      actorKind: "supervisor",
      policy: mutation.policy,
      reason: rec.rationale,
      evidence: rec.evidence,
    });
    this.emit("ORG_REORGANIZED", { generation: this.org.generation, summary: changed });
      this.emit("ORG_REORGANIZED", { generation: this.org.generation, summary: changed });
    return true;
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------- agent access

  async askAgent(slot: AgentSlot, prompt: string): Promise<string> {
    const adapter = adapterFor(slot.harness as HarnessId);
    const res = await adapter.execute({
      prompt,
      cwd: this.mission.workspace || undefined,
      timeoutMs: Math.min(slot.contract.budget.timeoutMs, 180_000),
      permissions: slot.contract.permissions,
      contract: slot.contract,
      signal: this.signal,
    });
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(res.error ?? "agent call failed");
    return res.output;
  }

  /** §20 — scoped memory read; never dumps everything into context. */
  readMemory(scope: "mission" | "team" | "agent", key: string, query: string): ScopedMemory[] {
    const r = retrieve(this.memory, {
      scope,
      scopeKey: key,
      allowCrossScope: ["decision", "failure"],
      query,
      maxChars: 4000,
      maxRecords: 8,
    });
    this.emit("MEMORY_RETRIEVED", { scope, key, count: r.records.length, rationale: r.rationale });
    return r.records;
  }

  writeMemory(
    scope: ScopedMemory["scope"],
    key: string,
    kind: string,
    content: string,
    tags: string[] = [],
  ): ScopedMemory {
    const rec: ScopedMemory = {
      id: `mem-${this.memory.length + 1}`,
      scope,
      scopeKey: key,
      kind,
      content,
      tokens: estimateTokens(content),
      salience: 0.7,
      timesReinforced: 0,
      missionId: this.mission.id,
      tags,
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    };
    this.memory.push(rec);
    this.emit("MEMORY_WRITTEN", { scope, key, kind, tokens: rec.tokens });
    return rec;
  }

  postToBoard(
    kind: "finding" | "question" | "hypothesis" | "warning" | "decision",
    topic: string,
    content: string,
    slot: AgentSlot,
    confidence = 0.6,
  ): void {
    postToBlackboard(this.blackboard, {
      blackboardKey: this.blackboard.key,
      kind,
      topic,
      content,
      authorId: slot.id,
      authorLabel: slot.title,
      claimedBy: [],
      confidence,
    });
  }

  boardView(): string {
    return renderBlackboard(this.blackboard);
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------ checkpoints

  checkpoint(trigger: CheckpointTrigger): MissionCheckpoint {
    const cp = createCheckpoint({
      missionId: this.mission.id,
      orgId: this.org.id,
      trigger,
      label: `${trigger} — ${this.org.phases.filter((p) => p.status === "COMPLETED").length}/${this.org.phases.length} phases`,
      mission: this.mission,
      org: this.org,
      slots: this.org.candidatePool,
      tasks: this.org.tasks,
      phases: this.org.phases,
      artifacts: this.artifacts,
      graphVersions: Object.fromEntries(
        [...this.graphVersions.entries()].map(([k, v]) => [k, v.currentVersion()]),
      ),
      phaseGraphs: Object.fromEntries(this.phaseGraphs),
      memory: this.memory,
      negotiations: this.negotiator.all(this.mission.id),
      repairs: this.repairs,
      mutations: this.mutations,
      audit: this.ledger.all(),
      pendingApprovalIds: this.approvals.filter((a) => !a.id.includes("granted")).map((a) => a.id),
      totals: {
        costUsd: this.cost.totalUsd,
        inputTokens: this.cost.totalInputTokens,
        outputTokens: this.cost.totalOutputTokens,
        elapsedMs: Date.now() - this.governor.startedAt,
        nodeRuns: this.org.metrics.nodeRuns,
        reorganizations: this.org.metrics.reorganizations,
        humanInterventions: this.org.metrics.humanInterventions,
        regressions: this.org.metrics.regressions,
      },
      status: this.mission.status,
      eventSeq: this.recorder.count(),
    });
    this.checkpoints.add(cp);
    this.recorder.addCheckpoint(cp);
    this.emit("MISSION_CHECKPOINTED", {
      checkpointId: cp.id,
      trigger,
      label: cp.label,
    });
    return cp;
  }

  /** §25, §26 — roll back to a checkpoint. */
  rollback(checkpointId: string): { ok: boolean; notes: string[] } {
    const cp = this.checkpoints.get(checkpointId);
    if (!cp) return { ok: false, notes: [`checkpoint ${checkpointId} not found`] };

    const v = validateCheckpoint(cp);
    if (!v.ok) return { ok: false, notes: v.problems };

    const rec = recoverCheckpoint(cp);
    this.mission = cp.mission;
    this.org = cp.org;
    this.org.candidatePool = cp.slots;
    this.org.tasks = cp.tasks;
    this.org.phases = cp.phases;
    this.artifacts = cp.artifacts;
    this.memory = cp.memory;
    this.repairs = cp.repairs;
    this.mutations = cp.mutations;

    this.emit("MISSION_ROLLED_BACK", {
      checkpointId,
      resumable: rec.resumableTasks.length,
      requeued: rec.requeuedTasks.length,
    }, { policy: "checkpoint.rollback", reason: `Rolled back to checkpoint ${checkpointId}.` });
    return { ok: true, notes: rec.notes };
  }

  pause(): void {
    this.signal.paused = true;
    this.org.status = "PAUSED";
    if (this.mission.status === "RUNNING") this.transition("PAUSED");
    this.checkpoint("ON_PAUSE");
  }

  resume(): void {
    this.signal.paused = false;
    this.org.status = "ACTIVE";
    if (this.mission.status === "PAUSED") this.transition("RUNNING");
    this.emit("MISSION_RESUMED", {});
  }

  abort(reason: string): void {
    this.signal.aborted = true;
    engageKillSwitch(this.governor, reason);
    this.emit("KILL_SWITCH_ENGAGED", { reason });
    if (!isTerminal(this.mission.status)) {
      this.mission.status = "ABORTED";
      this.mission.endedAt = new Date().toISOString();
    }
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------- verification

  private async verify(): Promise<MissionOutcome> {
    const criteria = this.mission.successCriteria;
    let met = 0;
    let blockingFailed = 0;
    let testsRun = 0;
    let testsPassed = 0;

    for (const c of criteria) {
      const res = await this.checkCriterion(c);
      c.met = res.met;
      c.evidence = res.evidence;
      c.checkedAt = new Date().toISOString();
      if (res.met) met += 1;
      else if (c.blocking) blockingFailed += 1;
      if (c.kind === "COMMAND_EXIT") {
        testsRun += 1;
        if (res.met) testsPassed += 1;
      }
      this.emit(res.met ? "HOLDOUT_PASSED" : "HOLDOUT_FAILED", {
        criterion: c.id,
        statement: c.statement,
        evidence: res.evidence,
      }, { policy: `criterion:${c.kind}`, reason: res.evidence });
    }

    const evaluated = this.artifacts.filter((a) => a.evaluation);
    const meanRubric = evaluated.length
      ? evaluated.reduce((a, x) => a + (x.evaluation?.score ?? 0), 0) / evaluated.length
      : 0;

    // Security dimension from the security-rubric artifacts.
    const securityArtifacts = evaluated.filter((a) => a.tags.some((t) => /security/i.test(t)));
    // A finding means something was actually found — not merely that an artifact
    // scored 4/5 instead of 5/5. Penalising every point below perfect made a clean
    // security review read as dozens of findings.
    const SECURITY_ACCEPT = 3.5;
    const securityFindings = securityArtifacts.reduce(
      (a, x) => a + Math.max(0, Math.round((SECURITY_ACCEPT - (x.evaluation?.score ?? 5)) * 2)),
      0,
    );
    const unresolvedHighOrCritical = securityArtifacts.filter(
      (a) => (a.evaluation?.score ?? 5) < 3,
    ).length;

    const elapsedMs = Date.now() - this.governor.startedAt;
    const inputs: ScoreInputs = {
      criteriaMet: met,
      criteriaTotal: criteria.length,
      blockingFailed,
      meanRubricScore: meanRubric,
      testsRun,
      testsPassed,
      securityFindings,
      unresolvedHighOrCritical,
      costUsd: this.cost.totalUsd,
      costBudgetUsd: this.mission.budget.maxCostUsd,
      elapsedMs,
      budgetMs: this.mission.budget.maxWallClockMs,
      humanInterventions: this.org.metrics.humanInterventions,
      interventionsAllowed: Math.max(1, this.plan.approvalCheckpoints.length + 1),
      artifactsEvaluated: evaluated.length,
      regressions: this.org.metrics.regressions,
    };

    const score = computeMissionScore(inputs);
    const passed = score.passed && blockingFailed === 0;

    this.emit(passed ? "MISSION_COMPLETED" : "MISSION_FAILED", {
      composite: score.composite,
      passed,
      blockingFailed,
    }, { policy: "verification", reason: renderScorecard(score) });

    return {
      missionId: this.mission.id,
      status: passed ? "COMPLETED" : "FAILED",
      score,
      artifacts: this.artifacts,
      costUsd: this.cost.totalUsd,
      durationMs: elapsedMs,
      checkpoints: this.checkpoints.forMission(this.mission.id).length,
      reorganizations: this.org.metrics.reorganizations,
      repairs: this.repairs.length,
      humanInterventions: this.org.metrics.humanInterventions,
      regressions: this.org.metrics.regressions,
      scorecard: renderScorecard(score),
      audit: exportLedger(this.ledger),
      flight: this.recorder.export(this.mission.id),
      provenance: buildProvenanceManifest(
        this.artifacts,
        Object.fromEntries(this.artifacts.map((a) => [a.id, a])),
        {
          missionId: this.mission.id,
          orgId: this.org.id,
          generator: {
            name: "MJ Desktop",
            version: "6.0.0",
            harnesses: [...new Set(this.artifacts.map((a) => a.harnessUsed).filter(Boolean))],
          },
          ledger: {
            head: this.ledger.head,
            entries: this.ledger.count(),
            verified: this.ledger.verify().ok,
            brokenAt: this.ledger.verify().brokenAt,
          },
        },
      ),
    };
  }

  private async checkCriterion(c: SuccessCriterion): Promise<{ met: boolean; evidence: string }> {
    switch (c.kind) {
      case "RUBRIC": {
        const evaluated = this.artifacts.filter((a) => a.evaluation);
        if (!evaluated.length) return { met: false, evidence: "no artifacts were evaluated" };
        const mean =
          evaluated.reduce((a, x) => a + (x.evaluation?.score ?? 0), 0) / evaluated.length;
        const min = c.minScore ?? 3.5;
        return {
          met: mean >= min,
          evidence: `mean rubric ${mean.toFixed(2)} vs required ${min} across ${evaluated.length} artifacts`,
        };
      }
      case "CONTAINS": {
        const all = this.artifacts.map((a) => a.content).join("\n");
        const missing = (c.expects ?? []).filter((e) => !all.toLowerCase().includes(e.toLowerCase()));
        return {
          met: missing.length === 0,
          evidence: missing.length ? `missing: ${missing.join(", ")}` : `found all of: ${(c.expects ?? []).join(", ")}`,
        };
      }
      case "NOT_CONTAINS": {
        const all = this.artifacts.map((a) => a.content).join("\n");
        const found = (c.expects ?? []).filter((e) => all.toLowerCase().includes(e.toLowerCase()));
        return { met: found.length === 0, evidence: found.length ? `found forbidden: ${found.join(", ")}` : "none of the forbidden strings present" };
      }
      case "ARTIFACT_EXISTS": {
        const found = this.artifacts.some((a) => (c.expects ?? []).some((e) => a.name.toLowerCase().includes(e.toLowerCase())));
        return { met: found, evidence: found ? "artifact present" : `no artifact matching ${(c.expects ?? []).join(", ")}` };
      }
      case "HUMAN": {
        // A human criterion is only satisfied by an explicit approval.
        const granted = this.approvals.some((a) => a.riskClass === "HIGH" || a.riskClass === "CRITICAL");
        return { met: granted, evidence: granted ? "human approval recorded" : "awaiting human sign-off" };
      }
      case "REGRESSION":
        return {
          met: this.org.metrics.regressions === 0,
          evidence: `${this.org.metrics.regressions} regressions recorded`,
        };
      default:
        return { met: false, evidence: `criterion kind ${c.kind} not machine-checkable` };
    }
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- accessors

  graphStoreFor(phaseId: string): GraphVersionStore {
    let s = this.graphVersions.get(phaseId);
    if (!s) {
      s = new GraphVersionStore(phaseId);
      this.graphVersions.set(phaseId, s);
    }
    return s;
  }

  state() {
    return {
      mission: this.mission,
      org: this.org,
      artifacts: this.artifacts,
      repairs: this.repairs,
      mutations: this.mutations,
      approvals: this.approvals,
      memory: this.memory,
      cost: this.cost.totalUsd,
      report: this.lastReport,
      ledgerOk: this.ledger.verify().ok,
    };
  }
}

function sleep(ms: number): Promise<void> {
  return new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));
}

function familyOf(model?: string): string | undefined {
  if (!model) return undefined;
  const m = model.toLowerCase();
  if (m.includes("claude")) return "anthropic";
  if (m.includes("gpt") || m.startsWith("o")) return "openai";
  if (m.includes("gemini")) return "google";
  if (m.includes("grok")) return "xai";
  return "open-weights";
}

function inferContentType(text: string): ArtifactContentType {
  const t = text.trimStart();
  if (t.startsWith("{") || t.startsWith("[")) return "application/json";
  if (t.startsWith("#")) return "text/markdown";
  if (t.includes("```diff") || /^@@/m.test(t)) return "text/x-diff";
  if (/passed|failed|✓|✗|PASS|FAIL/m.test(t) && t.split("\n").length > 3) return "text/x-test-report";
  return "text/plain";
}

function splitInstruction(instruction: string): string[] {
  const parts = instruction
    .split(/(?<=[.;])\s+|\n+/)
    .map((s) => s.trim())
    .filter((s) => s.length > 20);
  if (parts.length < 2) return [];
  const mid = Math.ceil(parts.length / 2);
  return [parts.slice(0, mid).join(" "), parts.slice(mid).join(" ")].filter(Boolean);
}

## `src/engine/provenanceExport.ts`

```typescript
/**
 * MJ 6.0 — machine-readable provenance export.
 *
 * Why this exists: EU AI Act Art. 50 obligations applied on **2 August 2026**.
 * Synthetic content must carry a machine-readable mark that identifies it as
 * artificially generated, and the mark has to be detectable. MJ produces
 * synthetic artifacts for a living, so "which of these files did the machine
 * write, from what, and under whose approval" is no longer a nicety — it is the
 * thing the regulation asks about.
 *
 * This is deliberately shaped like a C2PA manifest (claim / assertions /
 * ingredients / a hash that binds them) without pretending to *be* one.
 *
 * Honest about what it is not:
 *  - it is **not** a cryptographic signature. MJ holds no signing key, so the
 *    binding is the same FNV-1a chain used by the audit ledger, not a keypair.
 *  - it is **not** tamper-proof once exported. It is tamper-*evident*: edit any
 *    claim and `verifyManifest` recomputes a different manifest hash.
 *  - it does not embed the mark into the artifact bytes themselves. It is a
 *    sidecar. Embedding is format-specific and belongs in a later pass.
 */
import type { Artifact } from "../domain/artifact";
import { hashString } from "../domain/artifact";

export const PROVENANCE_MANIFEST_VERSION = "mj-provenance/1.0";

export interface ProvenanceGenerator {
  name: string;
  version: string;
  /** Which engine families touched the content, e.g. ["llm", "claude"]. */
  harnesses: string[];
}

/** One artifact's origin story, machine-readable. */
export interface ProvenanceClaim {
  artifactId: string;
  lineageId: string;
  version: number;
  name: string;
  contentType: string;
  /** Hash of the bytes as stored. Recomputed on verify. */
  contentHash: string;
  /** Art. 50(2): the content is artificially generated, not captured. */
  synthetic: true;
  /** Who made it. A slot id plus the harness and models behind it. */
  createdBy: string;
  harnessUsed: string;
  modelsUsed: string[];
  toolsUsed: string[];
  /** C2PA "ingredients": what this was derived from, by hash. */
  derivedFrom: Array<{ artifactId: string; contentHash: string }>;
  /** Governance state at export time — unapproved work is marked as such. */
  approvalState: string;
  riskClass: string;
  evaluation?: {
    score: number;
    dimensions: Record<string, number>;
    judgeIds: string[];
    passed: boolean;
  };
  /** Why this version exists, verbatim from the artifact. */
  provenance: string;
  createdAt: string;
}

export interface ProvenanceManifest {
  manifestVersion: string;
  generatedAt: string;
  missionId: string;
  orgId?: string;
  generator: ProvenanceGenerator;
  /** Every artifact in here was machine-generated. Art. 50 disclosure in one key. */
  syntheticContent: true;
  claims: ProvenanceClaim[];
  /** Binds the claims to the hash-chained audit ledger. */
  ledger: {
    head: string;
    entries: number;
    verified: boolean;
    brokenAt?: number;
  };
  /** FNV-1a over the canonical serialization of everything above. */
  manifestHash: string;
}

export interface ManifestVerifyResult {
  ok: boolean;
  /** Human-readable, one per problem found. */
  problems: string[];
  claims: number;
}

function claimFor(a: Artifact, derivedFrom: Array<{ artifactId: string; contentHash: string }>): ProvenanceClaim {
  return {
    artifactId: a.id,
    lineageId: a.lineageId,
    version: a.version,
    name: a.name,
    contentType: a.contentType,
    contentHash: a.contentHash,
    synthetic: true,
    createdBy: a.createdBy,
    harnessUsed: a.harnessUsed,
    modelsUsed: [...a.modelsUsed],
    toolsUsed: [...a.toolsUsed],
    derivedFrom,
    approvalState: a.approvalState,
    riskClass: a.riskClass,
    evaluation: a.evaluation
      ? {
          score: a.evaluation.score,
          dimensions: { ...a.evaluation.dimensions },
          judgeIds: [...a.evaluation.judgeIds],
          passed: a.evaluation.passed,
        }
      : undefined,
    provenance: a.provenance,
    createdAt: a.createdAt,
  };
}

/** Everything the manifest hash covers, in a stable key order. */
function signablePart(m: Omit<ProvenanceManifest, "manifestHash">): string {
  return JSON.stringify({
    manifestVersion: m.manifestVersion,
    generatedAt: m.generatedAt,
    missionId: m.missionId,
    orgId: m.orgId ?? null,
    generator: m.generator,
    syntheticContent: m.syntheticContent,
    claims: m.claims,
    ledger: m.ledger,
  });
}

export interface BuildManifestOptions {
  missionId: string;
  orgId?: string;
  generator: ProvenanceGenerator;
  ledger: { head: string; entries: number; verified: boolean; brokenAt?: number };
  generatedAt?: string;
}

/**
 * Build a manifest over a set of artifacts. `byId` is used only to resolve parent
 * hashes, so callers can pass the mission's full artifact set and export a subset.
 */
export function buildProvenanceManifest(
  artifacts: Artifact[],
  byId: Record<string, Artifact>,
  opts: BuildManifestOptions,
): ProvenanceManifest {
  const claims = artifacts.map((a) =>
    claimFor(
      a,
      (a.parentArtifacts ?? [])
        .map((pid) => byId[pid])
        .filter((p): p is Artifact => Boolean(p))
        .map((p) => ({ artifactId: p.id, contentHash: p.contentHash })),
    ),
  );
  const body: Omit<ProvenanceManifest, "manifestHash"> = {
    manifestVersion: PROVENANCE_MANIFEST_VERSION,
    generatedAt: opts.generatedAt ?? new Date().toISOString(),
    missionId: opts.missionId,
    orgId: opts.orgId,
    generator: opts.generator,
    syntheticContent: true,
    claims,
    ledger: opts.ledger,
  };
  return { ...body, manifestHash: hashString(signablePart(body)) };
}

/** Pretty-printed JSON, stable key order, trailing newline. For file export. */
export function renderManifest(m: ProvenanceManifest): string {
  return `${JSON.stringify(m, null, 2)}\n`;
}

/**
 * Re-derive the manifest hash and re-check every content hash.
 *
 * `current` lets a caller pass the artifacts as they exist *now*; without it only
 * the internal consistency of the manifest is checked. The distinction matters:
 * a manifest stays internally valid after someone edits a file behind its back,
 * so drift is only visible against live content.
 */
export function verifyManifest(
  m: ProvenanceManifest,
  current?: Record<string, Artifact>,
): ManifestVerifyResult {
  const problems: string[] = [];
  const { manifestHash, ...body } = m;

  if (hashString(signablePart(body)) !== manifestHash) {
    problems.push(
      `Manifest hash does not match its contents (expected ${manifestHash}, recomputed ${hashString(signablePart(body))}). The manifest was altered after it was generated.`,
    );
  }
  if (m.manifestVersion !== PROVENANCE_MANIFEST_VERSION) {
    problems.push(`Unknown manifest version "${m.manifestVersion}".`);
  }
  if (!m.ledger.verified) {
    problems.push(
      `Bound audit ledger was not intact at generation time${m.ledger.brokenAt !== undefined ? ` (broken at seq ${m.ledger.brokenAt})` : ""}.`,
    );
  }
  if (!m.syntheticContent) {
    problems.push("Manifest does not declare its content synthetic.");
  }

  const seen = new Set<string>();
  for (const c of m.claims) {
    if (seen.has(c.artifactId)) problems.push(`Duplicate claim for artifact ${c.artifactId}.`);
    seen.add(c.artifactId);
    if (c.synthetic !== true) problems.push(`Claim ${c.artifactId} does not declare itself synthetic.`);

    const live = current?.[c.artifactId];
    if (!live) continue;
    if (live.contentHash !== c.contentHash) {
      problems.push(
        `Artifact ${c.artifactId} changed since the manifest was written (${c.contentHash} → ${live.contentHash}).`,
      );
    }
    if (live.content && hashString(live.content) !== live.contentHash) {
      problems.push(`Artifact ${c.artifactId} content no longer matches its own recorded hash.`);
    }
  }

  return { ok: problems.length === 0, problems, claims: m.claims.length };
}
```
