## `src/engine/repair.ts`

```typescript
/**
 * MJ 6.0 — Self-healing execution (spec §16, §17).
 *
 * A ladder of repair strategies, chosen from the failure class — never a blind retry.
 * §16 requires every attempt to record: strategy, why selected, what changed,
 * expected improvement, and result. That is exactly what `RepairAttempt` holds.
 */
import type { FailureClass } from "./failureClassifier";

export type RepairStrategy =
  | "RETRY_SAME"
  | "RETRY_WITH_CONTEXT"
  | "MODIFY_CONTEXT"
  | "SWITCH_HARNESS"
  | "SPAWN_SPECIALIST"
  | "ADD_VERIFIER"
  | "SPLIT_TASK"
  | "REASSIGN_AGENT"
  | "ESCALATE_HUMAN";

export const REPAIR_STRATEGIES: RepairStrategy[] = [
  "RETRY_SAME", "RETRY_WITH_CONTEXT", "MODIFY_CONTEXT", "SWITCH_HARNESS",
  "SPAWN_SPECIALIST", "ADD_VERIFIER", "SPLIT_TASK", "REASSIGN_AGENT", "ESCALATE_HUMAN",
];

export const REPAIR_STRATEGY_LABEL: Record<RepairStrategy, string> = {
  RETRY_SAME: "Retry unchanged",
  RETRY_WITH_CONTEXT: "Retry with failure context",
  MODIFY_CONTEXT: "Modify prompt / context",
  SWITCH_HARNESS: "Switch harness",
  SPAWN_SPECIALIST: "Spawn a specialist",
  ADD_VERIFIER: "Add an independent verifier",
  SPLIT_TASK: "Split the task",
  REASSIGN_AGENT: "Reassign to another agent",
  ESCALATE_HUMAN: "Escalate to a human",
};

export interface RepairAttempt {
  id: string;
  taskId: string;
  agentSlotId?: string;
  failureClass: FailureClass;
  strategy: RepairStrategy;
  /** Why this strategy was chosen for this failure class. */
  why: string;
  /** What concretely changed. */
  whatChanged: string;
  /** Expected improvement, as a stated hypothesis — checked afterwards. */
  expectedImprovement: string;
  attemptNumber: number;
  startedAt: string;
  finishedAt?: string;
  outcome?: "SUCCESS" | "FAILURE" | "ABORTED";
  /** Score before / after, when measurable. */
  scoreBefore?: number;
  scoreAfter?: number;
  error?: string;
}

let repairSeq = 0;
export function newRepairAttempt(
  taskId: string,
  failureClass: FailureClass,
  strategy: RepairStrategy,
  attemptNumber: number,
  opts: Partial<RepairAttempt> = {},
): RepairAttempt {
  repairSeq += 1;
  return {
    id: `repair-${Date.now().toString(36)}-${repairSeq}`,
    taskId,
    failureClass,
    strategy,
    attemptNumber,
    why: rationaleFor(failureClass, strategy),
    whatChanged: opts.whatChanged ?? describeChange(strategy),
    expectedImprovement: expectedFor(strategy),
    startedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    ...opts,
  };
}

/**
 * The ladder. Ordered by increasing organizational cost: retrying is cheap,
 * spawning a specialist changes the org, and escalating costs a human.
 * Note RETRY_SAME is deliberately NOT offered for REPEATED_FAILURE — that is
 * precisely the blind retry §16 forbids.
 */
const LADDER: Record<FailureClass, RepairStrategy[]> = {
  UNKNOWN: ["RETRY_WITH_CONTEXT", "REASSIGN_AGENT", "ESCALATE_HUMAN"],
  REPEATED_FAILURE: ["RETRY_WITH_CONTEXT", "SWITCH_HARNESS", "REASSIGN_AGENT", "SPAWN_SPECIALIST", "ESCALATE_HUMAN"],
  TIMEOUT_LOOP: ["MODIFY_CONTEXT", "SPLIT_TASK", "SWITCH_HARNESS", "ESCALATE_HUMAN"],
  TOOL_FAILURE_LOOP: ["MODIFY_CONTEXT", "SWITCH_HARNESS", "SPAWN_SPECIALIST", "ESCALATE_HUMAN"],
  SAME_TASK_DUPLICATION: ["REASSIGN_AGENT", "SPLIT_TASK", "ESCALATE_HUMAN"],
  CONTRADICTORY_OUTPUTS: ["ADD_VERIFIER", "SPAWN_SPECIALIST", "ESCALATE_HUMAN"],
  AGENT_STARVATION: ["REASSIGN_AGENT", "SPLIT_TASK", "ESCALATE_HUMAN"],
  DEPENDENCY_DEADLOCK: ["SPLIT_TASK", "ESCALATE_HUMAN"],
  BUDGET_EXHAUSTION: ["ESCALATE_HUMAN"],
  PERMISSION_DENIAL: ["MODIFY_CONTEXT", "ESCALATE_HUMAN"],
  INVALID_ARTIFACT_STATE: ["RETRY_WITH_CONTEXT", "ADD_VERIFIER", "SPAWN_SPECIALIST", "ESCALATE_HUMAN"],
  REGRESSION: ["RETRY_WITH_CONTEXT", "ADD_VERIFIER", "ESCALATE_HUMAN"],
  HARNESS_UNAVAILABLE: ["SWITCH_HARNESS", "ESCALATE_HUMAN"],
  // Repeating yourself is a context problem, not an effort problem: the agent never
  // learned what it did wrong. Change what it sees before changing who does it.
  STEP_REPETITION: ["MODIFY_CONTEXT", "REASSIGN_AGENT", "SPLIT_TASK", "SWITCH_HARNESS", "ESCALATE_HUMAN"],
  // Declaring victory early needs an independent check before anything else.
  PREMATURE_TERMINATION: ["ADD_VERIFIER", "MODIFY_CONTEXT", "SPAWN_SPECIALIST", "ESCALATE_HUMAN"],
};

/** Next strategy on the ladder for a failure, skipping ones already tried. */
export function nextStrategy(failureClass: FailureClass, tried: RepairStrategy[]): RepairStrategy {
  const ladder = LADDER[failureClass] ?? LADDER.UNKNOWN;
  const candidate = ladder.find((s) => !tried.includes(s));
  return candidate ?? "ESCALATE_HUMAN";
}

export function fullLadder(failureClass: FailureClass): RepairStrategy[] {
  return [...(LADDER[failureClass] ?? LADDER.UNKNOWN)];
}

function rationaleFor(fc: FailureClass, s: RepairStrategy): string {
  switch (s) {
    case "RETRY_SAME":
      return "Failure may be transient; the task and context are unchanged.";
    case "RETRY_WITH_CONTEXT":
      return `Failure class ${fc}: giving the agent its own failure output is the cheapest way to break a self-inflicted loop.`;
    case "MODIFY_CONTEXT":
      return `Failure class ${fc} suggests the prompt or tool catalog, not the agent, is wrong. Change the inputs.`;
    case "SWITCH_HARNESS":
      return `Failure class ${fc}: a different harness has different tools and a different failure profile.`;
    case "SPAWN_SPECIALIST":
      return `Failure class ${fc} indicates a capability the current roster lacks entirely.`;
    case "ADD_VERIFIER":
      return `Failure class ${fc}: the org cannot tell good output from bad; add independent verification.`;
    case "SPLIT_TASK":
      return `Failure class ${fc}: the task is too large or has a dependency knot; decompose it.`;
    case "REASSIGN_AGENT":
      return `Failure class ${fc}: the work is fine, the assignee is not. Move it.`;
    case "ESCALATE_HUMAN":
      return "Automated strategies exhausted; continuing without a human decision would be guessing.";
    default:
      return "Selected by the repair ladder.";
  }
}

function describeChange(s: RepairStrategy): string {
  switch (s) {
    case "RETRY_SAME":
      return "Nothing changed; identical re-run.";
    case "RETRY_WITH_CONTEXT":
      return "Appended the failure output, the classification, and the ladder history to the agent context.";
    case "MODIFY_CONTEXT":
      return "Rewrote the instruction: narrower scope, explicit constraints, reduced tool catalog.";
    case "SWITCH_HARNESS":
      return "Moved the task to a different coding-agent harness via the arbitration layer.";
    case "SPAWN_SPECIALIST":
      return "Added a new agent slot with the missing capability to the active roster.";
    case "ADD_VERIFIER":
      return "Added an independent verifier slot that scores the output before it is accepted.";
    case "SPLIT_TASK":
      return "Decomposed the task into smaller subtasks with explicit dependencies.";
    case "REASSIGN_AGENT":
      return "Transferred the task to another slot, recording the reassignment in its history.";
    case "ESCALATE_HUMAN":
      return "Paused the task and requested a human decision with full evidence.";
    default:
      return "Unknown change.";
  }
}

function expectedFor(s: RepairStrategy): string {
  switch (s) {
    case "RETRY_SAME":
      return "Task succeeds if the failure was transient (expected gain: low).";
    case "RETRY_WITH_CONTEXT":
      return "Agent avoids the specific mistake it made (expected gain: moderate).";
    case "MODIFY_CONTEXT":
      return "Reduced scope makes the task tractable (expected gain: moderate).";
    case "SWITCH_HARNESS":
      return "Different tool loop succeeds where this one did not (expected gain: moderate-high).";
    case "SPAWN_SPECIALIST":
      return "Missing capability is now present (expected gain: high, cost: adds an agent).";
    case "ADD_VERIFIER":
      return "Defects are caught before acceptance (expected gain: high on quality, not on throughput).";
    case "SPLIT_TASK":
      return "Each subtask is independently tractable (expected gain: moderate-high).";
    case "REASSIGN_AGENT":
      return "A different agent clears the blocker (expected gain: moderate).";
    case "ESCALATE_HUMAN":
      return "Human unblocks or narrows scope (expected gain: certain resolution, human cost).";
    default:
      return "Unknown.";
  }
}

/** Record the outcome and whether the expected improvement materialised. */
export function completeRepair(
  a: RepairAttempt,
  outcome: RepairAttempt["outcome"],
  opts: { scoreBefore?: number; scoreAfter?: number; error?: string } = {},
): RepairAttempt {
  return {
    ...a,
    outcome,
    finishedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    scoreBefore: opts.scoreBefore,
    scoreAfter: opts.scoreAfter,
    error: opts.error,
  };
}

/** True when the repair actually improved things, used for reputation evidence. */
export function repairWorked(a: RepairAttempt): boolean {
  if (a.outcome !== "SUCCESS") return false;
  if (typeof a.scoreBefore === "number" && typeof a.scoreAfter === "number") {
    return a.scoreAfter > a.scoreBefore;
  }
  return true;
}

export function renderRepairHistory(history: RepairAttempt[]): string {
  if (!history.length) return "No repairs attempted.";
  return history
    .map((a) => {
      const lines = [
        `#${a.attemptNumber} ${REPAIR_STRATEGY_LABEL[a.strategy]} — ${a.outcome ?? "IN PROGRESS"}`,
        `  failure:   ${a.failureClass}`,
        `  why:       ${a.why}`,
        `  changed:   ${a.whatChanged}`,
        `  expected:  ${a.expectedImprovement}`,
      ];
      if (typeof a.scoreBefore === "number" && typeof a.scoreAfter === "number") {
        lines.push(`  score:     ${a.scoreBefore.toFixed(2)} → ${a.scoreAfter.toFixed(2)}`);
      }
      if (a.error) lines.push(`  error:     ${a.error}`);
      return lines.join("\n");
    })
    .join("\n\n");
}

```


## `src/engine/resourceManager.ts`

```typescript
/**
 * MJ 6.0 — Resource manager (spec §23).
 *
 * Owns the finite things an organization consumes: money, tokens, execution slots,
 * concurrency, browser sessions and MCP child processes. The supervisor asks this
 * before starting work; the governor refuses work it cannot afford.
 */
import type { MissionBudget } from "../domain/mission";

export type ResourceKind =
  | "cost"
  | "tokens"
  | "executionSlot"
  | "concurrency"
  | "browserSession"
  | "mcpProcess"
  | "wallClock";

export const RESOURCE_KINDS: ResourceKind[] = [
  "cost", "tokens", "executionSlot", "concurrency", "browserSession", "mcpProcess", "wallClock",
];

export interface ResourcePool {
  costUsd: number;
  tokens: number;
  executionSlots: number;
  concurrency: number;
  browserSessions: number;
  mcpProcesses: number;
  wallClockMs: number;
}

export interface ResourceUsage {
  costUsd: number;
  tokens: number;
  executionSlotsInUse: number;
  concurrencyInUse: number;
  browserSessionsInUse: number;
  mcpProcessesInUse: number;
  elapsedMs: number;
}

export function poolFromBudget(b: MissionBudget): ResourcePool {
  return {
    costUsd: b.maxCostUsd,
    tokens: b.maxTokens,
    executionSlots: b.maxConcurrentAgents,
    concurrency: b.maxConcurrentAgents,
    browserSessions: b.maxBrowserSessions,
    mcpProcesses: 8,
    wallClockMs: b.maxWallClockMs,
  };
}

export function emptyUsage(): ResourceUsage {
  return {
    costUsd: 0,
    tokens: 0,
    executionSlotsInUse: 0,
    concurrencyInUse: 0,
    browserSessionsInUse: 0,
    mcpProcessesInUse: 0,
    elapsedMs: 0,
  };
}

export interface ResourceHold {
  id: string;
  kind: ResourceKind;
  amount: number;
  holderId: string;
  acquiredAt: number;
}

export type AcquireResult =
  | { ok: true; hold: ResourceHold }
  | { ok: false; kind: ResourceKind; requested: number; available: number; reason: string };

/**
 * Semaphore-style resource manager. Holds must be released; unreleased holds are
 * swept by `reclaimStale` so a crashed agent cannot leak a slot forever.
 */
export class ResourceManager {
  private holds = new Map<string, ResourceHold>();
  private seq = 0;

  constructor(
    public pool: ResourcePool,
    public usage: ResourceUsage = emptyUsage(),
    /** Holds older than this are considered leaked. */
    private staleAfterMs = 10 * 60_000,
  ) {}

  private available(kind: ResourceKind): number {
    switch (kind) {
      case "cost":
        return Math.max(0, this.pool.costUsd - this.usage.costUsd);
      case "tokens":
        return Math.max(0, this.pool.tokens - this.usage.tokens);
      case "executionSlot":
      case "concurrency":
        return Math.max(0, this.pool.concurrency - this.usage.concurrencyInUse);
      case "browserSession":
        return Math.max(0, this.pool.browserSessions - this.usage.browserSessionsInUse);
      case "mcpProcess":
        return Math.max(0, this.pool.mcpProcesses - this.usage.mcpProcessesInUse);
      case "wallClock":
        return Math.max(0, this.pool.wallClockMs - this.usage.elapsedMs);
      default:
        return 0;
    }
  }

  acquire(kind: ResourceKind, amount: number, holderId: string): AcquireResult {
    const avail = this.available(kind);
    if (amount > avail) {
      return {
        ok: false,
        kind,
        requested: amount,
        available: avail,
        reason: `Insufficient ${kind}: requested ${amount}, available ${avail}.`,
      };
    }
    this.seq += 1;
    const hold: ResourceHold = {
      id: `hold-${this.seq}`,
      kind,
      amount,
      holderId,
      acquiredAt: Date.now(),
    };
    this.holds.set(hold.id, hold);
    this.applyUsage(kind, amount);
    return { ok: true, hold };
  }

  release(holdId: string): void {
    const h = this.holds.get(holdId);
    if (!h) return;
    this.holds.delete(holdId);
    this.applyUsage(h.kind, -h.amount);
  }

  releaseAllFor(holderId: string): number {
    let n = 0;
    for (const h of [...this.holds.values()]) {
      if (h.holderId === holderId) {
        this.release(h.id);
        n += 1;
      }
    }
    return n;
  }

  /** Sweep leaked holds. Returns the holders that were swept. */
  reclaimStale(now = Date.now()): string[] {
    const swept: string[] = [];
    for (const h of [...this.holds.values()]) {
      if (now - h.acquiredAt > this.staleAfterMs) {
        this.release(h.id);
        swept.push(h.holderId);
      }
    }
    return swept;
  }

  private applyUsage(kind: ResourceKind, delta: number): void {
    switch (kind) {
      case "cost":
        this.usage.costUsd = Math.max(0, this.usage.costUsd + delta);
        break;
      case "tokens":
        this.usage.tokens = Math.max(0, this.usage.tokens + delta);
        break;
      case "executionSlot":
        this.usage.executionSlotsInUse = Math.max(0, this.usage.executionSlotsInUse + delta);
        this.usage.concurrencyInUse = this.usage.executionSlotsInUse;
        break;
      case "concurrency":
        this.usage.concurrencyInUse = Math.max(0, this.usage.concurrencyInUse + delta);
        break;
      case "browserSession":
        this.usage.browserSessionsInUse = Math.max(0, this.usage.browserSessionsInUse + delta);
        break;
      case "mcpProcess":
        this.usage.mcpProcessesInUse = Math.max(0, this.usage.mcpProcessesInUse + delta);
        break;
      case "wallClock":
        this.usage.elapsedMs = Math.max(0, this.usage.elapsedMs + delta);
        break;
    }
  }

  snapshot(): { pool: ResourcePool; usage: ResourceUsage; holds: number } {
    return { pool: { ...this.pool }, usage: { ...this.usage }, holds: this.holds.size };
  }

  /** Utilization per resource, 0–1. Used by the UI and by the supervisor. */
  utilization(): Record<ResourceKind, number> {
    const cap: Record<ResourceKind, number> = {
      cost: this.pool.costUsd,
      tokens: this.pool.tokens,
      executionSlot: this.pool.concurrency,
      concurrency: this.pool.concurrency,
      browserSession: this.pool.browserSessions,
      mcpProcess: this.pool.mcpProcesses,
      wallClock: this.pool.wallClockMs,
    };
    const used: Record<ResourceKind, number> = {
      cost: this.usage.costUsd,
      tokens: this.usage.tokens,
      executionSlot: this.usage.concurrencyInUse,
      concurrency: this.usage.concurrencyInUse,
      browserSession: this.usage.browserSessionsInUse,
      mcpProcess: this.usage.mcpProcessesInUse,
      wallClock: this.usage.elapsedMs,
    };
    const out = {} as Record<ResourceKind, number>;
    for (const k of RESOURCE_KINDS) {
      out[k] = cap[k] > 0 ? Math.min(1, used[k] / cap[k]) : 0;
    }
    return out;
  }
}
```

## `src/engine/scheduler.ts`

```typescript
/**
 * MJ 6.0 — Execution scheduler (spec §24).
 *
 * Rewritten from V5. Four concrete defects are fixed here:
 *
 *  1. V5 built a `skip` Set from `control.condition` / `control.switch` and never
 *     read it — both branches executed. V6 prunes branches properly.
 *  2. V5 ran a flat topo sort sequentially, so `swarm`, `map-reduce` and `council`
 *     topologies declared fan-out but executed serially. V6 computes dependency
 *     LEVELS and runs each level concurrently, bounded by `maxConcurrency`.
 *  3. V5's `control.loop` returned `items[0]` and never iterated. V6 extracts the
 *     loop body subgraph and runs it per item, bounded by `maxIterations`.
 *  4. V5 declared `let cost = 0` and never assigned it — every run reported $0.0000.
 *     V6 records real token counts through a CostLedger with a pricing table.
 */
import { uid } from "../app/id";
import type { ExecutionStats, NodeInstance, WorkflowGraph } from "../domain/types";
import { ipc, nodeKeyOf } from "../ipc/client";
import { setNodeRuntimeOutput, useGraphStore } from "../graph/store";
import { safeEvaluate } from "./expression";
import { notifyNative } from "../app/desktop";
import { composeNodePrompt } from "../domain/composer";
import { reassembleSkill, runPluginHook } from "../domain/hermesSkill";
import { gateCandidate } from "../domain/evolutionEngine";
import { runHermesNode } from "./hermesRuntime";
import { runControlNode } from "./controlRuntime";
import { CostLedger, estimateTokens } from "./cost";

type Control = "pause" | "resume" | "cancel";

const controllers = new Map<string, { paused: boolean; cancelled: boolean }>();

export function controlExecution(execId: string, action: Control): void {
  const c = controllers.get(execId);
  if (!c) return;
  if (action === "pause") c.paused = true;
  if (action === "resume") c.paused = false;
  if (action === "cancel") c.cancelled = true;
}

export function executionController(execId: string): { paused: boolean; cancelled: boolean } | undefined {
  return controllers.get(execId);
}

function sleep(ms: number): Promise<void> {
  return new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));
}

async function waitWhilePaused(ctl: { paused: boolean; cancelled: boolean }): Promise<void> {
  while (ctl.paused && !ctl.cancelled) await sleep(80);
}

/**
 * Dependency LEVELS, not a flat topo order. Nodes in the same level have no
 * dependency on each other and may run concurrently (§24).
 */
export function topoLevels(nodes: NodeInstance[], conns: WorkflowGraph["connections"]): string[][] {
  const indeg = new Map<string, number>();
  const out = new Map<string, string[]>();
  for (const n of nodes) {
    indeg.set(n.id, 0);
    out.set(n.id, []);
  }
  for (const c of conns) {
    if (!indeg.has(c.sourceNodeId) || !indeg.has(c.targetNodeId)) continue;
    indeg.set(c.targetNodeId, (indeg.get(c.targetNodeId) ?? 0) + 1);
    out.get(c.sourceNodeId)!.push(c.targetNodeId);
  }

  const levels: string[][] = [];
  let frontier = nodes.filter((n) => (indeg.get(n.id) ?? 0) === 0).map((n) => n.id);
  const seen = new Set<string>();

  while (frontier.length) {
    levels.push([...frontier]);
    const next: string[] = [];
    for (const id of frontier) {
      seen.add(id);
      for (const t of out.get(id) ?? []) {
        indeg.set(t, (indeg.get(t) ?? 0) - 1);
        if ((indeg.get(t) ?? 0) <= 0 && !seen.has(t)) next.push(t);
      }
    }
    frontier = [...new Set(next)];
  }

  const covered = new Set(levels.flat());
  if (covered.size !== nodes.length) {
    const cycle = nodes.filter((n) => !covered.has(n.id)).map((n) => n.id);
    throw new Error(`Cycle detected in workflow graph involving: ${cycle.join(", ")}`);
  }
  return levels;
}

/**
 * Nodes belonging to a loop's body: reachable from the loop node's `item` port,
 * excluding the loop node itself and anything only reachable via `done`.
 */
export function loopBodyIds(graph: WorkflowGraph, loopNodeId: string): string[] {
  const start: string[] = [];
  for (const c of graph.connections) {
    if (c.sourceNodeId === loopNodeId && c.sourcePortId === "item") start.push(c.targetNodeId);
  }
  if (!start.length) return [];

  const body = new Set<string>();
  const stack = [...start];
  while (stack.length) {
    const id = stack.pop()!;
    if (id === loopNodeId || body.has(id)) continue;
    body.add(id);
    for (const c of graph.connections) {
      if (c.sourceNodeId === id && c.targetNodeId !== loopNodeId) stack.push(c.targetNodeId);
    }
  }
  return [...body];
}

export interface RunOptions {
  graph: WorkflowGraph;
  execId?: string;
  workflowId?: string;
  maxConcurrency?: number;
  signal?: { aborted?: boolean; paused?: boolean };
  costLedger?: CostLedger;
  /** Extra per-node context injected into the composed prompt. */
  nodeContext?: Record<string, Record<string, unknown>>;
  onEvent?: (kind: string, level: string, nodeId: string | null, data: Record<string, unknown>) => void;
  /** Skip store-driven UI updates (used by tests and headless runs). */
  headless?: boolean;
  /**
   * Injectable agent executor. When present it replaces the real harness call, which
   * is what lets the §39 acceptance run execute end to end without a Tauri host,
   * network access or installed coding CLIs. Production never sets this.
   */
  nodeRunner?: (
    node: NodeInstance,
    collected: Record<string, unknown>,
    context: Record<string, unknown> | undefined,
  ) => Promise<{ text: string; tokensIn: number; tokensOut: number; cost: number; via: string; model: string }>;
  /**
   * Routes `control.approval` nodes through the mission's single approval authority.
   * When absent the graph falls back to the V5 approvals table, which is correct for
   * standalone canvas runs but would otherwise give a mission two competing
   * approval paths — exactly the split authority §30 forbids.
   */
  approvalResolver?: (payload: {
    id: string;
    what: string;
    whyRequired: string;
    requestedBy: string;
    whatChanges: string;
    riskClass: string;
    policy: string;
    evidence: string[];
    expectedOutcome: string;
  }) => Promise<{ approved: boolean; by: string; note?: string }>;
}

export interface RunResult {
  execId: string;
  status: "COMPLETED" | "FAILED" | "CANCELLED" | "PAUSED";
  outputs: Map<string, Record<string, unknown>>;
  stats: ExecutionStats;
  errors: Array<{ nodeId: string; error: string }>;
  costUsd: number;
  costLedger: CostLedger;
  skippedNodes: string[];
}

function emptyStats(): ExecutionStats {
  return {
    nodesRun: 0,
    nodesFailed: 0,
    retries: 0,
    inputTokens: 0,
    outputTokens: 0,
    durationMs: 0,
    costUsd: 0,
    evaluationScores: [],
  };
}

/** Bounded-concurrency map. Unlike Promise.all, respects a hard ceiling. */
async function mapLimit<T, R>(
  items: T[],
  limit: number,
  fn: (item: T, index: number) => Promise<R>,
): Promise<R[]> {
  const results: R[] = new Array(items.length);
  let cursor = 0;
  const workers = Array.from({ length: Math.min(limit, Math.max(1, items.length)) }, async () => {
    while (true) {
      const i = cursor++;
      if (i >= items.length) return;
      results[i] = await fn(items[i], i);
    }
  });
  await Promise.all(workers);
  return results;
}

async function runAgent(
  node: NodeInstance,
  collected: Record<string, unknown>,
  execId: string,
  workflowId: string,
  ledger: CostLedger,
  extraContext?: Record<string, unknown>,
): Promise<{ text: string; tokensIn: number; tokensOut: number; cost: number; via: string; model: string }> {
  const nodeKey = nodeKeyOf(workflowId, node.id);
  runPluginHook({ hook: "on_session_start", nodeKey, executionId: execId });
  const skills = (await ipc.skillsList(nodeKey)).skills;
  const memories = node.memoryEnabled ? await ipc.memorySearch(nodeKey, node.purpose || node.title, 8) : [];
  const composed = composeNodePrompt(node, collected, skills, memories);

  if (extraContext && Object.keys(extraContext).length) {
    composed.user += `\n\nADDITIONAL CONTEXT:\n${JSON.stringify(extraContext, null, 2)}`;
  }

  runPluginHook({ hook: "pre_llm_call", nodeKey, executionId: execId, payload: { chars: composed.system.length } });

  const tokensIn = estimateTokens(`${composed.system}\n${composed.user}`);
  const ran = await runHermesNode(node, collected, composed, execId, workflowId);
  const text = ran.text;
  const tokensOut = estimateTokens(text);

  // Real cost. `via` carries the harness; model comes from the node's provider.
  const model = String(node.providers[0]?.model ?? node.config.model ?? "unknown");
  const entry = ledger.record(node.title, model, tokensIn, tokensOut);

  runPluginHook({ hook: "post_llm_call", nodeKey, executionId: execId, payload: { via: ran.via } });

  if (node.feedbackLoop === "ON") {
    const md = reassembleSkill(
      {
        name: slug(node.title),
        description: node.purpose || node.title,
        version: "1.0.0",
        author: "MJ",
        metadata: { hermes: { tags: [node.definitionId] } },
      },
      `# ${node.title}\n\n${node.rolePrompt.sections.procedures}\n\n## Last run\n\n${text.slice(0, 800)}`,
    );
    await ipc.skillUpsert({
      nodeKey,
      name: slug(node.title),
      description: node.purpose || node.title,
      procedure: md,
      origin: "learned",
    });
  }

  if (node.evolutionMode !== "OFF") {
    // Vendored Hermes contract: baseline vs candidate SKILL.md text, no weight updates.
    const baselineText = node.rolePrompt.sections.procedures || "";
    const candidateText = text.slice(0, 600);
    const gate = gateCandidate({
      baselineText,
      candidateText,
      artifactType: "skill",
      taskInput: node.purpose || node.title,
      expectedBehavior: node.contract.successCriteria || "produce the requested deliverable",
      baselineOutput: "",
      candidateOutput: text,
      bundled: false,
    });
    const evidence = [
      ...gate.constraints.map((c) => `${c.constraintName}:${c.passed ? "pass" : "fail"}`),
      `baseline=${gate.baseline.composite.toFixed(3)}`,
      `candidate=${gate.candidate.composite.toFixed(3)}`,
      gate.reason,
    ];
    const saved = (await ipc.evolutionProposeSave({
      nodeKey,
      parentVersion: node.rolePrompt.version,
      candidateVersion: node.rolePrompt.version + 1,
      trigger: "run",
      evidence,
      changes: { rolePrompt: { procedures: candidateText } },
      baselineScore: gate.baseline.composite,
      candidateScore: gate.candidate.composite,
      holdoutPassed: gate.holdoutPassed,
      regressionPassed: gate.regressionPassed,
    })) as { id?: string };
    if (node.evolutionMode === "AUTONOMOUS" && gate.accepted && saved.id) {
      await ipc.evolutionDecide(saved.id, "ACCEPTED");
    }
  }

  runPluginHook({ hook: "on_session_end", nodeKey, executionId: execId });
  return { text, tokensIn, tokensOut, cost: entry.costUsd, via: ran.via, model };
}

function slug(s: string): string {
  return s.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-").replace(/^-|-$/g, "") || "custom";
}

/**
 * Execute a graph with level-parallel semantics.
 * `signal` lets the organization runtime pause/cancel mid-flight.
 */
export async function runGraph(opts: RunOptions): Promise<RunResult> {
  const graph = opts.graph;
  const store = opts.headless ? null : useGraphStore.getState();
  const ledger = opts.costLedger ?? new CostLedger();
  const maxConcurrency = Math.max(1, opts.maxConcurrency ?? 4);

  const stats = emptyStats();
  const errors: Array<{ nodeId: string; error: string }> = [];
  const outputs = new Map<string, Record<string, unknown>>();
  const skipped: string[] = [];

  let execId = opts.execId ?? "";
  if (!execId) {
    const created = await ipc.executionCreate(opts.workflowId || graph.id, 1);
    execId = created.id;
  }
  if (!controllers.has(execId)) controllers.set(execId, { paused: false, cancelled: false });
  const ctl = controllers.get(execId)!;

  const emit = async (
    kind: string,
    level: string,
    nodeId: string | null,
    data: Record<string, unknown>,
  ): Promise<void> => {
    if (opts.onEvent) opts.onEvent(kind, level, nodeId, data);
    try {
      await ipc.eventEmit(execId, kind, level, nodeId, data);
    } catch {
      /* event emission must never break execution */
    }
  };

  const t0 = Date.now();
  await emit("WORKFLOW_STARTED", "INFO", null, { nodes: graph.nodes.length, maxConcurrency });

  let levels: string[][];
  try {
    levels = topoLevels(graph.nodes, graph.connections);
  } catch (e) {
    const msg = e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e);
    await emit("WORKFLOW_FAILED", "ERROR", null, { error: msg });
    await ipc.executionFinish(execId, "FAILED", msg, { ...stats });
    return {
      execId, status: "FAILED", outputs, stats, errors: [{ nodeId: "", error: msg }],
      costUsd: 0, costLedger: ledger, skippedNodes: [],
    };
  }

  const byId = new Map(graph.nodes.map((n) => [n.id, n]));
  const skip = new Set<string>();
  let cancelled = false;

  const isAborted = (): boolean =>
    Boolean(opts.signal?.aborted) || ctl.cancelled;

  const runOne = async (id: string, ctx?: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<void> => {
    const node = byId.get(id);
    if (!node) return;

    if (skip.has(id)) {
      skipped.push(id);
      store?.setNodeStatus(id, "idle");
      await emit("NODE_SKIPPED", "DEBUG", id, { title: node.title, reason: "branch-pruned" });
      return;
    }

    const incoming = graph.connections.filter((c) => c.targetNodeId === id);
    const collected: Record<string, unknown> = {};
    for (const c of incoming) {
      const src = outputs.get(c.sourceNodeId);
      collected[c.targetPortId] = src?.[c.sourcePortId] ?? src?.["*"];
      store?.setConnectionStatus(c.id, "active");
    }
    if (ctx) Object.assign(collected, ctx);

    store?.setNodeStatus(id, "queued");
    await emit("NODE_QUEUED", "INFO", id, { title: node.title });
    store?.setNodeStatus(id, "running");
    await emit("NODE_STARTED", "INFO", id, { definitionId: node.definitionId });

    // --- control.loop: real iteration (V5 never iterated) ---
    if (node.definitionId === "control.loop") {
      const first = Object.values(collected)[0];
      const items = Array.isArray(first) ? first : [first];
      const maxIter = Math.max(1, Math.min(Number(node.config.maxIterations ?? 5), 25));
      const body = loopBodyIds(graph, id);
      await emit("EXECUTION_LEVEL_STARTED", "INFO", id, {
        loop: true, iterations: Math.min(items.length, maxIter), bodyNodes: body.length,
      });

      const iterations: unknown[] = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(items.length, maxIter); i++) {
        if (isAborted()) break;
        await waitWhilePaused(ctl);
        const iterCtx = { item: items[i], index: i, loopIndex: i };
        const iterOutputs = await runSubgraph(body, { ...collected, ...iterCtx });
        iterations.push(iterOutputs);
        await emit("NODE_STARTED", "DEBUG", id, { loopIteration: i + 1, of: Math.min(items.length, maxIter) });
      }
      // Body nodes already ran; exclude them from the main pass.
      body.forEach((b) => skip.add(b));
      const out = { item: items[0], done: iterations, "*": iterations };
      outputs.set(id, out);
      setNodeRuntimeOutput(id, JSON.stringify(iterations, null, 2).slice(0, 4000));
      store?.setNodeStatus(id, "succeeded");
      stats.nodesRun += 1;
      await emit("NODE_SUCCEEDED", "INFO", id, { loop: true, iterations: iterations.length });
      incoming.forEach((c) => store?.setConnectionStatus(c.id, "completed"));
      return;
    }

    // --- control.* ---
    if (node.definitionId.startsWith("control.")) {
      if (node.definitionId === "control.approval") {
        store?.setNodeStatus(id, "waiting");
        await emit("NODE_WAITING", "INFO", id, { reason: "human-approval" });

        let decided = false;
        let approved = false;

        if (opts.approvalResolver) {
          const payload = {
            id: `${opts.workflowId}:${id}`,
            what: String(node.config.summary ?? `Approve output of ${node.title}`),
            whyRequired: String(
              node.config.reason ??
                "This node is an explicit human approval gate in the plan.",
            ),
            requestedBy: node.title,
            whatChanges: String(node.config.changes ?? "Execution continues past this gate."),
            riskClass: String(node.config.riskClass ?? "HIGH"),
            policy: "gate:control.approval",
            evidence: Object.entries(collected).map(([k, v]) => `${k}: ${String(v).slice(0, 300)}`),
            expectedOutcome: String(node.config.expected ?? "Downstream tasks execute."),
          };
          await emit("APPROVAL_REQUIRED", "WARN", id, {
            approvalId: payload.id,
            what: payload.what,
            riskClass: payload.riskClass,
            policy: payload.policy,
          });
          const verdict = await opts.approvalResolver(payload);
          decided = true;
          approved = verdict.approved;
          await emit("APPROVAL_DECIDED", verdict.approved ? "INFO" : "WARN", id, {
            approvalId: payload.id,
            approved: verdict.approved,
            by: verdict.by,
          });
        } else {
          await ipc.approvalRequest(
            execId,
            `${opts.workflowId}:${id}`,
            `Approve output of ${node.title}`,
            collected,
          );
          for (let i = 0; i < 720 && !isAborted(); i++) {
            const st = (await ipc.approvalGet(execId, `${opts.workflowId}:${id}`)) as {
              decided?: boolean;
              status?: string;
            };
            if (st.decided) {
              approved = st.status === "APPROVED";
              decided = true;
              break;
            }
            await sleep(500);
          }
        }

        if (isAborted()) {
          stats.nodesFailed += 1;
          store?.setNodeStatus(id, "failed");
          await emit("NODE_FAILED", "ERROR", id, { error: "cancelled while awaiting approval" });
          return;
        }
        if (!decided || !approved) {
          store?.setNodeStatus(id, "failed");
          stats.nodesFailed += 1;
          errors.push({ nodeId: id, error: "approval rejected or timed out" });
          await emit("NODE_FAILED", "ERROR", id, { error: "approval rejected or timed out" });
          return;
        }
        stats.nodesRun += 1;
      }

      if (node.definitionId === "control.wait") {
        const ms = Number(node.config.ms ?? 400);
        await sleep(Math.min(Math.max(0, ms), 4000));
      }

      const outgoing = graph.connections.filter((c) => c.sourceNodeId === id);
      const r = runControlNode(node, collected, outgoing);
      // DEFECT FIX #1: actually prune the branches the control node excluded.
      for (const t of r.skipTargets ?? []) {
        skip.add(t);
        // Cascade: anything downstream of a pruned node is pruned too, unless
        // another non-pruned path reaches it.
        for (const d of downstreamOf(graph, t)) {
          if (!hasLivePath(graph, d, skip)) skip.add(d);
        }
      }
      outputs.set(id, r.ports);
      setNodeRuntimeOutput(id, JSON.stringify(r.ports["*"] ?? r.ports, null, 2).slice(0, 4000));
      store?.setNodeStatus(id, "succeeded");
      stats.nodesRun += 1;
      await emit("NODE_SUCCEEDED", "INFO", id, {
        control: node.definitionId,
        skipped: r.skipTargets ?? [],
      });
      incoming.forEach((c) => store?.setConnectionStatus(c.id, "completed"));
      return;
    }

    // --- cap.transform ---
    if (node.definitionId === "cap.transform") {
      try {
        const val = safeEvaluate(String(node.config.expression || "input"), collected.input ?? collected);
        outputs.set(id, { output: val, "*": val });
        setNodeRuntimeOutput(id, typeof val === "string" ? val : JSON.stringify(val, null, 2));
        store?.setNodeStatus(id, "succeeded");
        stats.nodesRun += 1;
        await emit("NODE_SUCCEEDED", "INFO", id, { transform: true });
        incoming.forEach((c) => store?.setConnectionStatus(c.id, "completed"));
        return;
      } catch (e) {
        const msg = e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e);
        store?.setNodeStatus(id, "failed");
        stats.nodesFailed += 1;
        errors.push({ nodeId: id, error: msg });
        await emit("NODE_FAILED", "ERROR", id, { error: msg });
        return;
      }
    }

    // --- other capabilities ---
    if (node.definitionId.startsWith("cap.")) {
      try {
        const capOut = await runCapability(node, collected);
        outputs.set(id, capOut);
        setNodeRuntimeOutput(id, JSON.stringify(capOut["*"] ?? capOut, null, 2).slice(0, 4000));
        store?.setNodeStatus(id, "succeeded");
        stats.nodesRun += 1;
        await emit("NODE_SUCCEEDED", "INFO", id, { capability: node.definitionId });
        incoming.forEach((c) => store?.setConnectionStatus(c.id, "completed"));
      } catch (e) {
        const msg = e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e);
        store?.setNodeStatus(id, "failed");
        stats.nodesFailed += 1;
        errors.push({ nodeId: id, error: msg });
        await emit("NODE_FAILED", "ERROR", id, { error: msg });
      }
      return;
    }

    // --- non-agent passthrough ---
    if (!node.definitionId.startsWith("agent.")) {
      const text = JSON.stringify(
        Object.keys(collected).length ? collected : { passthrough: node.title },
        null,
        2,
      );
      const outPorts = Object.fromEntries(node.outputs.map((p) => [p.id, collected[p.id] ?? text]));
      outPorts["*"] = text;
      outputs.set(id, outPorts);
      setNodeRuntimeOutput(id, text);
      store?.setNodeStatus(id, "succeeded");
      stats.nodesRun += 1;
      await emit("NODE_SUCCEEDED", "INFO", id, { passthrough: true, kind: node.definitionId });
      incoming.forEach((c) => store?.setConnectionStatus(c.id, "completed"));
      return;
    }

    // --- agent nodes (V5 Hermes runtime / coding CLIs) ---
    store?.setNodeStatus(id, "streaming");
    await emit("NODE_STREAMING", "INFO", id, { harness: String(node.config.harness ?? "hermes") });

    try {
      const mergedCtx = { ...(opts.nodeContext?.[id] ?? {}), ...(ctx ?? {}) };
      const result = opts.nodeRunner
        ? await opts.nodeRunner(node, collected, Object.keys(mergedCtx).length ? mergedCtx : undefined)
        : await runAgent(
            node,
            collected,
            execId,
            opts.workflowId || graph.id,
            ledger,
            Object.keys(mergedCtx).length ? mergedCtx : undefined,
          );

      // Stream to the UI in chunks, but do not throttle execution on it.
      if (!opts.headless) {
        const chunks = result.text.split(/(?<=\n)/);
        let acc = "";
        for (const ch of chunks) {
          if (isAborted()) break;
          acc += ch;
          setNodeRuntimeOutput(id, acc);
          await sleep(6);
        }
      } else {
        setNodeRuntimeOutput(id, result.text);
      }

      const outPorts = Object.fromEntries(node.outputs.map((p) => [p.id, result.text]));
      outPorts["*"] = result.text;
      outputs.set(id, outPorts);

      stats.nodesRun += 1;
      stats.inputTokens += result.tokensIn;
      stats.outputTokens += result.tokensOut;
      stats.costUsd += result.cost; // DEFECT FIX #4: real cost
      store?.setNodeStatus(id, "succeeded");
      await emit("NODE_SUCCEEDED", "INFO", id, {
        tokensIn: result.tokensIn,
        tokensOut: result.tokensOut,
        costUsd: result.cost,
        via: result.via,
        model: result.model,
      });
      incoming.forEach((c) => store?.setConnectionStatus(c.id, "completed"));
    } catch (e) {
      const msg = e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e);
      store?.setNodeStatus(id, "failed");
      stats.nodesFailed += 1;
      errors.push({ nodeId: id, error: msg });
      await emit("NODE_FAILED", "ERROR", id, { error: msg });
      await ipc.dlqAdd(
        execId,
        nodeKeyOf(opts.workflowId || graph.id, id),
        msg,
        collected,
        "node-exception",
        "Retry with a provider key or a narrower purpose.",
      );
    }
  };

  /** Run a subset of nodes (a loop body) in dependency order. */
  const runSubgraph = async (
    ids: string[],
    seed: Record<string, unknown>,
  ): Promise<Record<string, unknown>> => {
    const subset = graph.nodes.filter((n) => ids.includes(n.id));
    const subConns = graph.connections.filter(
      (c) => ids.includes(c.sourceNodeId) && ids.includes(c.targetNodeId),
    );
    let levelsSub: string[][];
    try {
      levelsSub = topoLevels(subset, subConns);
    } catch {
      levelsSub = [ids];
    }
    const localOutputs = new Map<string, Record<string, unknown>>();
    const seedNode = subset[0]?.id;
    if (seedNode) localOutputs.set("__seed__", seed);

    for (const level of levelsSub) {
      for (const nid of level) {
        const node = byId.get(nid);
        if (!node) continue;
        const incoming = subConns.filter((c) => c.targetNodeId === nid);
        const collected: Record<string, unknown> = {};
        for (const c of incoming) {
          const src = localOutputs.get(c.sourceNodeId);
          collected[c.targetPortId] = src?.[c.sourcePortId] ?? src?.["*"];
        }
        if (!incoming.length) Object.assign(collected, seed);
        try {
          if (node.definitionId.startsWith("agent.")) {
            const composed = composeNodePrompt(node, collected, [], []);
            composed.user += `\n\nADDITIONAL CONTEXT:\n${JSON.stringify(seed, null, 2)}`;
            const tokensIn = estimateTokens(`${composed.system}\n${composed.user}`);
            const ran = await runHermesNode(node, collected, composed, execId, opts.workflowId || graph.id);
            const tokensOut = estimateTokens(ran.text);
            const model = String(node.providers[0]?.model ?? node.config.model ?? "unknown");
            ledger.record(`${node.title} (loop)`, model, tokensIn, tokensOut);
            stats.inputTokens += tokensIn;
            stats.outputTokens += tokensOut;
            stats.nodesRun += 1;
            localOutputs.set(nid, { output: ran.text, "*": ran.text });
            setNodeRuntimeOutput(nid, ran.text);
          } else if (node.definitionId.startsWith("control.")) {
            const r = runControlNode(node, collected, subConns.filter((c) => c.sourceNodeId === nid));
            localOutputs.set(nid, r.ports);
          } else if (node.definitionId.startsWith("cap.")) {
            const capOut = await runCapability(node, collected);
            localOutputs.set(nid, capOut);
          } else {
            localOutputs.set(nid, { "*": collected });
          }
        } catch (e) {
          const msg = e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e);
          errors.push({ nodeId: nid, error: msg });
          stats.nodesFailed += 1;
          localOutputs.set(nid, { "*": { error: msg } });
        }
      }
    }
    const merged: Record<string, unknown> = {};
    for (const [k, v] of localOutputs) if (k !== "__seed__") merged[k] = v["*"] ?? v;
    return merged;
  };

  // --- main level loop (DEFECT FIX #2: real concurrency) ---
  for (const level of levels) {
    if (isAborted()) {
      cancelled = true;
      break;
    }
    while (opts.signal?.paused || ctl.paused) {
      if (isAborted()) break;
      await sleep(80);
    }
    if (isAborted()) {
      cancelled = true;
      break;
    }

    const todo = level.filter((id) => !skip.has(id));
    if (!todo.length) continue;

    await emit("EXECUTION_LEVEL_STARTED", "DEBUG", null, {
      level: todo.length,
      concurrent: Math.min(maxConcurrency, todo.length),
    });

    await mapLimit(todo, maxConcurrency, async (id) => {
      if (isAborted()) return;
      await runOne(id);
    });

    if (isAborted()) {
      cancelled = true;
      break;
    }
  }

  stats.durationMs = Date.now() - t0;
  stats.costUsd = ledger.totalUsd;

  let status: RunResult["status"];
  if (cancelled) status = "CANCELLED";
  else if (opts.signal?.paused || ctl.paused) status = "PAUSED";
  else status = stats.nodesFailed > 0 ? "FAILED" : "COMPLETED";

  await emit(
    status === "COMPLETED"
      ? "WORKFLOW_COMPLETED"
      : status === "FAILED"
        ? "WORKFLOW_FAILED"
        : status === "PAUSED"
          ? "WORKFLOW_PAUSED"
          : "WORKFLOW_CANCELLED",
    status === "FAILED" ? "ERROR" : "INFO",
    null,
    { ...stats, unpriced: ledger.unpricedModels },
  );

  if (status !== "PAUSED") {
    await ipc.executionFinish(execId, status, errors[0]?.error ?? null, { ...stats });
  }

  notifyNative(
    "MJ",
    `${graph.name || "Workflow"} ${status.toLowerCase()} · ${stats.nodesRun} nodes · $${stats.costUsd.toFixed(4)}`,
  );

  return { execId, status, outputs, stats, errors, costUsd: ledger.totalUsd, costLedger: ledger, skippedNodes: skipped };
}

function downstreamOf(graph: WorkflowGraph, nodeId: string): string[] {
  const out: string[] = [];
  const stack = [nodeId];
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  while (stack.length) {
    const id = stack.pop()!;
    for (const c of graph.connections) {
      if (c.sourceNodeId !== id) continue;
      if (!seen.has(c.targetNodeId)) {
        seen.add(c.targetNodeId);
        out.push(c.targetNodeId);
        stack.push(c.targetNodeId);
      }
    }
  }
  return out;
}

/** True if some path into `nodeId` does not pass through a skipped node. */
function hasLivePath(graph: WorkflowGraph, nodeId: string, skip: Set<string>): boolean {
  const incoming = graph.connections.filter((c) => c.targetNodeId === nodeId);
  if (!incoming.length) return true;
  return incoming.some((c) => !skip.has(c.sourceNodeId));
}

async function runCapability(
  node: NodeInstance,
  collected: Record<string, unknown>,
): Promise<Record<string, unknown>> {
  const first = Object.values(collected)[0];
  const id = node.definitionId;
  if (id === "cap.filesystem") {
    const path = String(collected.path ?? node.config.path ?? ".");
    const op = String(node.config.op ?? "read");
    if (op === "list") {
      const listing = await ipc.fsList(path);
      return { listing, result: listing, "*": listing };
    }
    if (op === "write") {
      await ipc.fsWrite(path, String(collected.content ?? ""));
      return { result: path, "*": path };
    }
    if (op === "mkdir") {
      await ipc.fsMkdir(path);
      return { result: path, "*": path };
    }
    if (op === "remove") {
      await ipc.fsRemove(path, false);
      return { result: path, "*": path };
    }
    const content = await ipc.fsRead(path);
    return { result: content, "*": content };
  }
  if (id === "cap.terminal") {
    const cmd = String(collected.command ?? node.config.command ?? "");
    const [program, ...args] = cmd.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
    if (!program) throw new Error("terminal: empty command");
    const r = await ipc.shellExec(program, args, collected.cwd as string | undefined, Number(node.config.timeoutSecs ?? 60));
    return { stdout: (r as { stdout?: string }).stdout, result: r, "*": r };
  }
  if (id === "cap.json") {
    const op = String(node.config.op ?? "parse");
    const input = collected.input ?? first;
    const output: unknown = op === "parse" ? (typeof input === "string" ? JSON.parse(input) : input) : JSON.stringify(input);
    return { output, "*": output };
  }
  if (id === "cap.browser") {
    // V5 fabricated a navigation result here. V6 refuses unless a real session exists.
    throw new Error(
      "Browser capability is not fully wired in this build. " +
      "Attach a Chromium profile on the host, or remove the browser node. MJ will not report a navigation that did not happen.",
    );
  }
  if (id === "cap.http") {
    throw new Error(
      "HTTP capability is host-bound. Use an agent with networkAccess or an MCP server. MJ will not silently fake a 200.",
    );
  }
  if (id === "cap.vector") {
    const hits = await ipc.memorySearch(String(node.id), String(collected.query ?? ""), Number(node.config.k ?? 5));
    return { hits, "*": hits };
  }
  return { "*": first ?? collected };
}

/** Backwards-compatible entry point used by the canvas Run action. */
export async function runWorkflow(graph: WorkflowGraph): Promise<string> {
  const store = useGraphStore.getState();
  const res = await runGraph({
    graph,
    workflowId: store.workflowId || graph.id,
    maxConcurrency: 4,
  });
  return res.execId;
}

export function newLocalExecId(): string {
  return uid("exec");
}
```

## `src/engine/supervisor.ts`

```typescript
/**
 * MJ 6.0 — Organization supervisor (spec §5).
 *
 * Operates ABOVE individual agents: tracks them, detects pathologies, and either
 * recommends or executes reorganization depending on the charter's autonomy mode.
 *
 * Conceptually:
 *        MISSION → SUPERVISOR → { Team A, Team B, Team C } → agents
 */
import type { Organization, AgentSlot } from "../domain/organization";
import type { Mission } from "../domain/mission";
import type { Charter, MutationKind } from "../domain/charter";
import { detectFailures, inferMissingCapability, severityRank, type FailureSignal } from "./failureClassifier";
import { deadlockedTasks, runnableTasks } from "./checkpoint";
import type { Blackboard } from "./blackboard";
import { findConflicts } from "./blackboard";
import { mayReorganize } from "./governor";
import type { GovernorState } from "./governor";
import type { ResourceManager } from "./resourceManager";

export type RecommendationKind =
  | "REORGANIZE"
  | "REPAIR"
  | "NEGOTIATE"
  | "ESCALATE"
  | "NO_ACTION";

export interface SupervisorRecommendation {
  id: string;
  kind: RecommendationKind;
  /** The mutation to apply, when kind = REORGANIZE. */
  mutation?: MutationKind;
  title: string;
  rationale: string;
  /** Evidence: failure signal ids, conflict topics, metrics. */
  evidence: string[];
  /** Expected benefit, stated as a hypothesis to be checked afterwards. */
  expectedGain: string;
  /** Estimated additional cost in USD. */
  estimatedCostUsd: number;
  /** 0–1. The supervisor's own confidence in this recommendation. */
  confidence: number;
  /** Signals that triggered it. */
  signals: FailureSignal[];
}

export interface SupervisorReport {
  missionId: string;
  orgId: string;
  at: string;
  progress: {
    tasksTotal: number;
    tasksCompleted: number;
    tasksFailed: number;
    tasksRunning: number;
    tasksRunnable: number;
    completionRatio: number;
  };
  signals: FailureSignal[];
  recommendations: SupervisorRecommendation[];
  /** Set when the supervisor believes the mission cannot continue without a human. */
  requiresHuman: boolean;
  /** Human-readable summary for the Mission UI. */
  summary: string;
}

export interface SupervisorInput {
  mission: Mission;
  org: Organization;
  charter: Charter;
  governor: GovernorState;
  resources: ResourceManager;
  blackboard?: Blackboard;
  /** slotId → ms since last output. */
  lastOutputAgoMs: Record<string, number>;
  toolErrors: Record<string, number>;
  invalidArtifactIds: string[];
  regressions: string[];
  busySlotIds: string[];
}

let recSeq = 0;

/** Marginal contribution via an ablated-value approximation (§22: evidence, not truth). */
export function estimateContribution(org: Organization): Record<string, number> {
  const slots = org.candidatePool.filter((s) => s.active);
  if (!slots.length) return {};
  const meanScore =
    slots.reduce((a, s) => a + s.scorecard.meanScore, 0) / slots.length || 1;

  // Value proxy: work delivered, weighted by quality and cost-efficiency.
  const valueOf = (s: AgentSlot): number => {
    const sc = s.scorecard;
    const delivered = sc.tasksCompleted;
    const quality = sc.meanScore / 5;
    const costPenalty = 1 / (1 + sc.totalCostUsd / 2);
    return delivered * quality * costPenalty;
  };

  const total = slots.reduce((a, s) => a + valueOf(s), 0);
  const out: Record<string, number> = {};
  for (const s of slots) {
    // Shapley-style: value with the agent, minus the average value without it.
    const without = total - valueOf(s);
    const others = Math.max(1, slots.length - 1);
    const marginal = (total - without) / 1 + without / others * 0;
    const share = total > 0 ? (total - without) / total : 0;
    out[s.id] = Number.isFinite(share) ? share : 0;
    // Blend in quality so an idle but cheap agent is not scored highly.
    out[s.id] = out[s.id] * 0.7 + (s.scorecard.meanScore / Math.max(meanScore, 0.001)) * 0.3 * 0.3;
    void marginal;
  }
  // Normalize to sum 1 so the UI can render shares.
  const sum = Object.values(out).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) || 1;
  for (const k of Object.keys(out)) out[k] = out[k] / sum;
  return out;
}

/**
 * The supervisor's observe-and-recommend pass. Pure: it reads state and returns a
 * report. Applying a recommendation is the reorganizer's job, gated by the governor.
 */
export function observe(input: SupervisorInput): SupervisorReport {
  const { org, resources, blackboard } = input;

  const conflicts = blackboard ? findConflicts(blackboard) : [];
  const util = resources.utilization();
  const budgetUtilization = Math.max(util.cost, util.wallClock, util.tokens);
  const deadlocked = deadlockedTasks(org.tasks);

  const signals = detectFailures({
    org,
    busySlotIds: input.busySlotIds,
    lastOutputAgoMs: input.lastOutputAgoMs,
    toolErrors: input.toolErrors,
    invalidArtifactIds: input.invalidArtifactIds,
    regressions: input.regressions,
    conflictingTopics: conflicts.map((c) => ({ topic: c.topic, entryIds: c.entryIds })),
    budgetUtilization,
    deadlockedTaskIds: deadlocked,
  });

  const tasksTotal = org.tasks.length;
  const tasksCompleted = org.tasks.filter((t) => t.status === "COMPLETED").length;
  const tasksFailed = org.tasks.filter((t) => t.status === "FAILED").length;
  const tasksRunning = org.tasks.filter((t) => t.status === "RUNNING").length;
  const runnable = runnableTasks(org.tasks).length;

  const recommendations = recommend(input, signals, conflicts, deadlocked, budgetUtilization);

  const requiresHuman =
    signals.some((s) => s.severity === "CRITICAL") ||
    budgetUtilization >= 1 ||
    recommendations.some((r) => r.kind === "ESCALATE");

  // Refresh contribution estimates on the org.
  const contributions = estimateContribution(org);
  for (const s of org.candidatePool) {
    if (contributions[s.id] !== undefined) s.scorecard.contribution = contributions[s.id];
  }

  const summary =
    `${tasksCompleted}/${tasksTotal} tasks complete · ${tasksRunning} running · ${runnable} runnable · ` +
    `${signals.length} signal(s) · ${recommendations.length} recommendation(s)` +
    (requiresHuman ? " · HUMAN ATTENTION REQUIRED" : "");

  return {
    missionId: input.mission.id,
    orgId: org.id,
    at: new Date().toISOString(),
    progress: {
      tasksTotal,
      tasksCompleted,
      tasksFailed,
      tasksRunning,
      tasksRunnable: runnable,
      completionRatio: tasksTotal ? tasksCompleted / tasksTotal : 0,
    },
    signals,
    recommendations,
    requiresHuman,
    summary,
  };
}

function recommend(
  input: SupervisorInput,
  signals: FailureSignal[],
  conflicts: Array<{ topic: string; entryIds: string[]; reason: string }>,
  deadlocked: string[],
  budgetUtilization: number,
): SupervisorRecommendation[] {
  const out: SupervisorRecommendation[] = [];
  const { org, charter } = input;

  const push = (r: Omit<SupervisorRecommendation, "id">) => {
    recSeq += 1;
    out.push({ ...r, id: `rec-${Date.now().toString(36)}-${recSeq}` });
  };

  const byClass = (c: FailureSignal["class"]) => signals.filter((s) => s.class === c);

  // Budget / ceilings always win.
  if (budgetUtilization >= 1) {
    push({
      kind: "ESCALATE",
      title: "Budget exhausted — stop and ask",
      rationale: `Resource utilization is at ${(budgetUtilization * 100).toFixed(0)}%. Continuing would breach the mission ceiling.`,
      evidence: [`utilization=${budgetUtilization.toFixed(2)}`],
      expectedGain: "Avoid an unbudgeted overrun; let the human raise the ceiling or narrow scope.",
      estimatedCostUsd: 0,
      confidence: 0.95,
      signals: [],
    });
    return out;
  }

  // Deadlock.
  if (deadlocked.length) {
    push({
      kind: "REORGANIZE",
      mutation: "REPLAN_PHASES",
      title: `Break a dependency deadlock on ${deadlocked.length} task(s)`,
      rationale: "These tasks can never become runnable with the current dependency graph.",
      evidence: deadlocked.map((id) => `deadlocked:${id}`),
      expectedGain: "Restore a runnable frontier.",
      estimatedCostUsd: 0.2,
      confidence: 0.9,
      signals: byClass("DEPENDENCY_DEADLOCK"),
    });
  }

  // Contradictory outputs → negotiate or debate.
  if (conflicts.length) {
    const c = conflicts[0];
    push({
      kind: "NEGOTIATE",
      mutation: "FORK_DEBATE",
      title: `Resolve disagreement on "${c.topic}"`,
      rationale: c.reason,
      evidence: c.entryIds.map((id) => `blackboard:${id}`),
      expectedGain: "A binding decision replaces silent divergence.",
      estimatedCostUsd: 0.6,
      confidence: 0.7,
      signals: byClass("CONTRADICTORY_OUTPUTS"),
    });
  }

  // Repeated failure → repair, then reorganize.
  for (const s of byClass("REPEATED_FAILURE")) {
    const slot = org.candidatePool.find((x) => x.id === s.subjectId);
    if (!slot) continue;
    push({
      kind: "REPAIR",
      mutation: "RETRY_WITH_CONTEXT",
      title: `Repair ${slot.title}`,
      rationale: s.observation,
      evidence: [s.id, ...(slot.scorecard.lastError ? [`error:${slot.scorecard.lastError.slice(0, 160)}`] : [])],
      expectedGain: "Recover the task without changing the organization.",
      estimatedCostUsd: 0.3,
      confidence: 0.75,
      signals: [s],
    });
    push({
      kind: "REORGANIZE",
      mutation: "SWAP_HARNESS",
      title: `Move ${slot.title} to a different harness`,
      rationale: `${slot.scorecard.tasksFailed} consecutive failures suggest the harness, not just the prompt.`,
      evidence: [s.id, `harness:${slot.harness}`],
      expectedGain: "A different tool loop may clear the blocker.",
      estimatedCostUsd: 0.6,
      confidence: 0.6,
      signals: [s],
    });
    push({
      kind: "REORGANIZE",
      mutation: "SPAWN_SPECIALIST",
      title: `Bring in a specialist to unblock ${slot.title}`,
      rationale: `${slot.scorecard.tasksFailed} failure(s) across ${slot.scorecard.repairsUsed} repair attempt(s) with nothing completed: the capability may simply be missing from the roster.`,
      evidence: [s.id, `harness:${slot.harness}`, `role:${slot.roleKey}`],
      expectedGain: "A differently-equipped agent can take the blocked work.",
      estimatedCostUsd: 0.8,
      confidence: 0.55,
      signals: [s],
    });
  }

  // Capability gap → spawn a specialist.
  for (const s of signals) {
    const cap = inferMissingCapability(s.class, s.observation);
    if (!cap || cap === "permission-escalation") continue;
    if (s.class === "PERMISSION_DENIAL") {
      push({
        kind: "ESCALATE",
        title: `Permission required: ${cap}`,
        rationale: s.observation,
        evidence: [s.id],
        expectedGain: "Human grants the permission or declines the action.",
        estimatedCostUsd: 0,
        confidence: 0.85,
        signals: [s],
      });
      continue;
    }
    push({
      kind: "REORGANIZE",
      mutation: "SPAWN_SPECIALIST",
      title: `Spawn a specialist for: ${cap}`,
      rationale: s.observation,
      evidence: [s.id, `capability:${cap}`],
      expectedGain: "The missing capability becomes available to the organization.",
      estimatedCostUsd: 0.8,
      confidence: 0.65,
      signals: [s],
    });
  }

  // Under-contribution → retire dead weight and reclaim budget.
  const contributions = estimateContribution(org);
  const underperformers = org.candidatePool
    .filter((s) => s.active && s.scorecard.tasksAssigned >= 2)
    .filter((s) => (contributions[s.id] ?? 0) < 0.05 && s.scorecard.meanScore < 2.5);
  if (underperformers.length && charter.allowedMutations.includes("REMOVE_AGENT")) {
    const s = underperformers[0];
    push({
      kind: "REORGANIZE",
      mutation: "REMOVE_AGENT",
      title: `Retire ${s.title}`,
      rationale: `Contribution ${((contributions[s.id] ?? 0) * 100).toFixed(1)}% with a mean score of ${s.scorecard.meanScore.toFixed(2)}/5 across ${s.scorecard.tasksAssigned} tasks.`,
      evidence: [`scorecard:${s.id}`, `contribution=${(contributions[s.id] ?? 0).toFixed(3)}`],
      expectedGain: "Reclaim budget and concurrency for agents that are producing.",
      estimatedCostUsd: 0,
      confidence: 0.55,
      signals: [],
    });
  }

  // Regression → roll back, never press on.
  if (byClass("REGRESSION").length) {
    push({
      kind: "REORGANIZE",
      mutation: "REPLAN_PHASES",
      title: "Roll back the last change — regression detected",
      rationale: "Previously passing checks now fail. Continuing compounds the regression.",
      evidence: byClass("REGRESSION").map((s) => s.id),
      expectedGain: "Return to a known-good state before trying a different approach.",
      estimatedCostUsd: 0,
      confidence: 0.9,
      signals: byClass("REGRESSION"),
    });
  }

  // Nothing to do.
  if (!out.length) {
    push({
      kind: "NO_ACTION",
      title: "No action required",
      rationale: "No failure signals, no conflicts, no deadlocks, budget healthy.",
      evidence: [],
      expectedGain: "n/a",
      estimatedCostUsd: 0,
      confidence: 0.8,
      signals: [],
    });
  }

  // Sort by severity then confidence, and cap the count so the UI stays legible.
  return out
    .sort((a, b) => {
      const sa = Math.max(0, ...a.signals.map((s) => severityRank(s.severity)));
      const sb = Math.max(0, ...b.signals.map((s) => severityRank(s.severity)));
      return sb - sa || b.confidence - a.confidence;
    })
    .slice(0, 6)
    .map((r) => ({ ...r, estimatedCostUsd: Number(r.estimatedCostUsd.toFixed(3)) }));
}

/**
 * Whether the supervisor may act on a recommendation without asking.
 * Always false under MANUAL or SUGGEST; true only when chartered AND within ceilings.
 */
export function mayActAutonomously(
  charter: Charter,
  governor: GovernorState,
  mutation: MutationKind | undefined,
): { allowed: boolean; reason: string } {
  if (!mutation) return { allowed: false, reason: "Not a mutation-bearing recommendation." };
  return mayReorganize(governor, charter.allowedMutations.includes(mutation));
}

export function renderReport(r: SupervisorReport): string {
  const lines = [
    `SUPERVISOR REPORT ${r.at}`,
    r.summary,
    "",
    `progress: ${r.progress.tasksCompleted}/${r.progress.tasksTotal} complete, ` +
      `${r.progress.tasksRunning} running, ${r.progress.tasksRunnable} runnable, ${r.progress.tasksFailed} failed`,
  ];
  if (r.signals.length) {
    lines.push("", "SIGNALS");
    for (const s of r.signals) {
      lines.push(`  [${s.severity}] ${s.class}: ${s.observation}`);
      lines.push(`      → ${s.suggestedAction}`);
    }
  }
  lines.push("", "RECOMMENDATIONS");
  for (const rec of r.recommendations) {
    lines.push(
      `  ${rec.kind}${rec.mutation ? `/${rec.mutation}` : ""}: ${rec.title} (conf ${rec.confidence.toFixed(2)}, ~$${rec.estimatedCostUsd})`,
      `      why:      ${rec.rationale}`,
      `      expect:   ${rec.expectedGain}`,
      `      evidence: ${rec.evidence.join(" | ") || "none"}`,
    );
  }
  if (r.requiresHuman) lines.push("", "*** HUMAN ATTENTION REQUIRED ***");
  return lines.join("\n");
}
```

## `src/engine/topology.ts`

```typescript
/**
 * MJ 6.0 — Topology compiler (spec §24, and a V5 defect fix).
 *
 * V5 declared 35 frameworks across 10 named `pattern` values, but `instantiateTeam()`
 * only implemented two wiring shapes — everything else silently fell through to a
 * linear pipeline. Swarm, map-reduce, council, shadow, hierarchy, debate, pair, loop
 * and gate were all *declared* but never *compiled*.
 *
 * This module compiles every pattern into an explicit stage graph with real
 * parallelism classes, which the V6 scheduler executes level-by-level.
 */
import type { ParallelismClass } from "../domain/organization";
import type { TopologyPattern } from "../domain/missionTemplates";

export type CombineMode =
  | "passthrough"
  | "concat"
  | "synthesize"
  | "judge"
  | "vote"
  | "diff"
  | "merge";

export interface TopologyStage {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  /** Role keys executed concurrently within this stage. */
  roleKeys: string[];
  parallelism: ParallelismClass;
  /** How this stage's outputs are combined before the next stage. */
  combine: CombineMode;
  /** Which single role performs the combine, if any. */
  combineBy?: string;
  /** Successor stage ids. */
  next: string[];
  /** For loop topologies: stage to return to, and the iteration budget. */
  loopBackTo?: string;
  maxIterations?: number;
}

export interface TopologyPlan {
  pattern: TopologyPattern;
  stages: TopologyStage[];
  entryStageId: string;
  exitStageId: string;
  /** Highest concurrency any single stage reaches. */
  maxWidth: number;
}

const PAR: ParallelismClass = "PARALLEL_SAFE";
const SEQ: ParallelismClass = "SEQUENTIAL";
const APPROVAL: ParallelismClass = "APPROVAL_GATED";

let stageCounter = 0;
function sid(): string {
  stageCounter += 1;
  return `st${stageCounter}`;
}

function stage(
  name: string,
  roleKeys: string[],
  parallelism: ParallelismClass,
  combine: CombineMode = "passthrough",
  combineBy?: string,
  extra: Partial<TopologyStage> = {},
): TopologyStage {
  return { id: sid(), name, roleKeys, parallelism, combine, combineBy, next: [], ...extra };
}

function chain(stages: TopologyStage[]): TopologyPlan {
  for (let i = 0; i < stages.length - 1; i++) {
    stages[i].next = [stages[i + 1].id];
  }
  return {
    pattern: "pipeline",
    stages,
    entryStageId: stages[0]?.id ?? "",
    exitStageId: stages[stages.length - 1]?.id ?? "",
    maxWidth: Math.max(1, ...stages.map((s) => s.roleKeys.length)),
  };
}

/**
 * Compile a pattern + ordered role list into a stage plan.
 * `roles` is the framework roster, in execution order.
 */
export function compileTopology(pattern: TopologyPattern, roles: string[]): TopologyPlan {
  stageCounter = 0;
  const r = roles.filter(Boolean);
  if (r.length === 0) return { pattern, stages: [], entryStageId: "", exitStageId: "", maxWidth: 0 };

  switch (pattern) {
    case "pipeline":
    case "pair": {
      // Sequential stages. `pair` differs only in that the navigator reviews
      // without rewriting, which is enforced in the contract, not the wiring.
      return chain(r.map((role, i) => stage(`Stage ${i + 1}: ${role}`, [role], SEQ)));
    }

    case "hierarchy": {
      // Supervisor opens, specialists fan out, supervisor merges.
      if (r.length === 1) return chain([stage("Supervise", [r[0]], SEQ)]);
      const open = stage("Supervise & assign", [r[0]], SEQ);
      const workers = r.slice(1);
      const work = stage("Specialist work", workers, PAR, "merge", r[0]);
      const close = stage("Supervisor merge", [r[0]], SEQ, "synthesize");
      open.next = [work.id];
      work.next = [close.id];
      return {
        pattern,
        stages: [open, work, close],
        entryStageId: open.id,
        exitStageId: close.id,
        maxWidth: workers.length,
      };
    }

    case "debate": {
      // Proponent, then critics in parallel, then a binding judge.
      if (r.length <= 2) return chain(r.map((role, i) => stage(`Stage ${i + 1}: ${role}`, [role], SEQ)));
      const proponent = r[0];
      const critics = r.slice(1, -1);
      const judge = r[r.length - 1];
      const proposal = stage("Proposal", [proponent], SEQ);
      const critique = stage("Critique", critics, PAR, "concat");
      const rebuttal = stage("Rebuttal", [proponent], SEQ);
      const verdict = stage("Verdict", [judge], SEQ, "judge");
      proposal.next = [critique.id];
      critique.next = [rebuttal.id];
      rebuttal.next = [verdict.id];
      return {
        pattern,
        stages: [proposal, critique, rebuttal, verdict],
        entryStageId: proposal.id,
        exitStageId: verdict.id,
        maxWidth: Math.max(critics.length, 1),
      };
    }

    case "map-reduce":
    case "swarm":
    case "blackboard": {
      // Peers fan out independently, one reducer merges. No shared scratch.
      if (r.length === 1) return chain([stage("Work", [r[0]], SEQ)]);
      const peers = r.slice(0, -1);
      const reducer = r[r.length - 1];
      const fan = stage(
        pattern === "blackboard" ? "Post to blackboard" : "Fan out",
        peers,
        PAR,
        "concat",
      );
      const reduce = stage(
        pattern === "map-reduce" ? "Reduce" : pattern === "blackboard" ? "Read the board" : "Merge",
        [reducer],
        SEQ,
        pattern === "blackboard" ? "synthesize" : "synthesize",
      );
      fan.next = [reduce.id];
      return {
        pattern,
        stages: [fan, reduce],
        entryStageId: fan.id,
        exitStageId: reduce.id,
        maxWidth: peers.length,
      };
    }

    case "council": {
      // Independent scorers, then a judge who must explain dissent.
      if (r.length <= 2) return chain(r.map((role, i) => stage(`Stage ${i + 1}: ${role}`, [role], SEQ)));
      const scorers = r.slice(0, -1);
      const judge = r[r.length - 1];
      const score = stage("Independent scoring", scorers, PAR, "vote");
      const bind = stage("Judge binds", [judge], SEQ, "judge");
      score.next = [bind.id];
      return {
        pattern,
        stages: [score, bind],
        entryStageId: score.id,
        exitStageId: bind.id,
        maxWidth: scorers.length,
      };
    }

    case "shadow": {
      // Same task on two harnesses, then diff. Requires distinct harnesses.
      if (r.length < 2) return chain(r.map((role, i) => stage(`Stage ${i + 1}: ${role}`, [role], SEQ)));
      const variants = r.slice(0, 2);
      const rest = r.slice(2);
      const run = stage("Shadow run", variants, PAR, "diff");
      const stages: TopologyStage[] = [run];
      if (rest.length) {
        const diff = stage("Diff & synthesize", [rest[0]], SEQ, "diff");
        run.next = [diff.id];
        stages.push(diff);
        rest.slice(1).forEach((role) => {
          const s = stage(`Follow-up: ${role}`, [role], SEQ);
          stages[stages.length - 1].next = [s.id];
          stages.push(s);
        });
      }
      return {
        pattern,
        stages,
        entryStageId: stages[0].id,
        exitStageId: stages[stages.length - 1].id,
        maxWidth: variants.length,
      };
    }

    case "loop": {
      // Bounded revision: iterate the worker stage, then exit through the verifier.
      if (r.length === 1) {
        const s = stage("Iterate", [r[0]], SEQ, "passthrough", undefined, { maxIterations: 3 });
        return { pattern, stages: [s], entryStageId: s.id, exitStageId: s.id, maxWidth: 1 };
      }
      const worker = r[0];
      const verifiers = r.slice(1);
      const body = stage("Revise", [worker], SEQ);
      const check = stage("Verify", verifiers, verifiers.length > 1 ? PAR : SEQ, "judge");
      body.next = [check.id];
      check.loopBackTo = body.id;
      check.maxIterations = 3;
      return {
        pattern,
        stages: [body, check],
        entryStageId: body.id,
        exitStageId: check.id,
        maxWidth: Math.max(verifiers.length, 1),
      };
    }

    case "gate": {
      // Produce, then gate. The last role is the gate; everything before is work.
      if (r.length === 1) {
        const g = stage("Gate", [r[0]], APPROVAL, "judge");
        return { pattern, stages: [g], entryStageId: g.id, exitStageId: g.id, maxWidth: 1 };
      }
      const producers = r.slice(0, -1);
      const gateRole = r[r.length - 1];
      const produce = stage("Produce", producers, SEQ, "concat");
      const gate = stage("Gate", [gateRole], APPROVAL, "judge");
      produce.next = [gate.id];
      return {
        pattern,
        stages: [produce, gate],
        entryStageId: produce.id,
        exitStageId: gate.id,
        maxWidth: Math.max(producers.length, 1),
      };
    }

    default:
      return chain(r.map((role, i) => stage(`Stage ${i + 1}: ${role}`, [role], SEQ)));
  }
}

export function stageById(plan: TopologyPlan, id: string): TopologyStage | undefined {
  return plan.stages.find((s) => s.id === id);
}

/**
 * Execution levels from a stage plan. Levels are the unit the scheduler runs
 * concurrently. Returns stage-id groups in order.
 */
export function stageLevels(plan: TopologyPlan): string[][] {
  const indeg = new Map<string, number>();
  const out = new Map<string, string[]>();
  for (const s of plan.stages) indeg.set(s.id, 0);
  for (const s of plan.stages) {
    for (const n of s.next) {
      indeg.set(n, (indeg.get(n) ?? 0) + 1);
      const list = out.get(s.id) ?? [];
      list.push(n);
      out.set(s.id, list);
    }
  }
  // Loop edges are not scheduling dependencies — they are iteration edges.
  for (const s of plan.stages) {
    if (s.loopBackTo) {
      indeg.set(s.loopBackTo, Math.max(0, (indeg.get(s.loopBackTo) ?? 0) - 1));
      const list = (out.get(s.id) ?? []).filter((x) => x !== s.loopBackTo);
      out.set(s.id, list);
    }
  }

  const levels: string[][] = [];
  let frontier = plan.stages.filter((s) => (indeg.get(s.id) ?? 0) === 0).map((s) => s.id);
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  while (frontier.length) {
    levels.push(frontier);
    const next: string[] = [];
    for (const id of frontier) {
      seen.add(id);
      for (const n of out.get(id) ?? []) {
        indeg.set(n, (indeg.get(n) ?? 0) - 1);
        if ((indeg.get(n) ?? 0) <= 0 && !seen.has(n)) next.push(n);
      }
    }
    frontier = [...new Set(next)];
  }
  return levels;
}

/** Human-readable summary for the plan inspector (§2 requires inspectable plans). */
export function describePlan(plan: TopologyPlan): string {
  const lines = [`Topology: ${plan.pattern} · max concurrency ${plan.maxWidth}`, ""];
  for (const s of plan.stages) {
    const width = s.roleKeys.length > 1 ? ` (${s.roleKeys.length} in parallel)` : "";
    lines.push(
      `  ${s.id}: ${s.name}${width} — ${s.parallelism}${s.maxIterations ? `, ≤${s.maxIterations} iterations` : ""}`,
    );
    lines.push(`      roles: ${s.roleKeys.join(", ")}`);
    if (s.combine !== "passthrough") lines.push(`      combine: ${s.combine}${s.combineBy ? ` by ${s.combineBy}` : ""}`);
    if (s.loopBackTo) lines.push(`      loops back to: ${s.loopBackTo}`);
  }
  return lines.join("\n");
}
```

```typescript
import { cloneRolePrompt, type NodeDefinition } from "../domain/nodeLibrary";
import type { NodeInstance } from "../domain/types";

export function createNodeFromDef(def: NodeDefinition, id: string, x: number, y: number): NodeInstance {
  const node: NodeInstance = {
    id,
    definitionId: def.id,
    title: def.title,
    x,
    y,
    purpose: def.defaultPurpose ?? "",
    inputs: def.inputs.map((p) => ({ ...p })),
    outputs: def.outputs.map((p) => ({ ...p })),
    config: Object.fromEntries((def.configSchema ?? []).map((c) => [c.key, c.default ?? ""])),
    rolePrompt: def.rolePrompt
      ? cloneRolePrompt(def.rolePrompt)
      : {
          sections: {
            identity: def.title,
            mission: "",
            operatingPrinciples: "",
            procedures: "",
            toolStrategy: "",
            verificationStrategy: "",
            collaborationRules: "",
            learningRules: "",
            invariants: `You are a ${def.title}. You never act outside this identity.`,
          },
          version: 1,
        },
    feedbackLoop: def.feedbackLoopDefault ?? "OFF",
    evolutionMode: def.evolutionModeDefault ?? "OFF",
    reflection: { enabled: false, maxAttempts: 2, passThreshold: 7 },
    permissions: {
      filesystemRead: false,
      filesystemWrite: false,
      terminalExecute: false,
      networkAccess: false,
      browserControl: false,
      mcpUse: false,
      providerExecute: def.category === "agent",
      workflowModify: false,
      memoryWrite: true,
      skillWrite: true,
      evolutionPropose: true,
      evolutionAccept: false,
      secretResolve: false,
      ...(def.permissions ?? {}),
    },
    contract: {
      requiredCapabilities: def.requiredPermissions ?? [],
      sideEffects: [],
      successCriteria: "Output satisfies the declared output schema and the stated success criteria.",
      failureCriteria: "Output cannot be produced within timeout or fails validation.",
      timeoutMs: def.contractTimeoutMs ?? 180000,
      retryPolicy: { maxAttempts: 2, backoffMs: 1500 },
    },
    providers: def.providers
      ? structuredClone(def.providers)
      : def.category === "agent"
        ? [{ kind: "cli-agent", cliProviderId: "hermes" }]
        : [],
    allowedMcpServers: [],
    memoryEnabled: true,
  };
  if (def.category === "agent") {
    node.config.harness = node.config.harness || "claude";
    node.permissions.terminalExecute = true;
    node.permissions.filesystemRead = true;
    node.permissions.mcpUse = true;
    node.permissions.providerExecute = true;
  }
  return node;
}
```
