## `src/pages/FederationPage.tsx`

```tsx
/**
 * MJ 6.0 — Federation via A2A (Agent2Agent).
 *
 * A2A reached v1.0 in March 2026 and joined the Agentic AI Foundation alongside MCP
 * on 2026-08-17. It standardises agent↔agent coordination (discovery, task
 * lifecycle, structured results) while MCP standardises agent↔tool access. A remote
 * A2A peer becomes a **foreign specialist** an MJ organization can delegate to.
 */
import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { v6 } from "../ipc/v6";
import { toast } from "../panels/Toast";
import { detectHost } from "../app/desktop";

interface CardRow {
  id?: string;
  name?: string;
  url?: string;
  skills?: string[] | Array<{ id?: string; name?: string }>;
  signed?: boolean;
  note?: string;
}

export function FederationPage() {
  const [cards, setCards] = useState<CardRow[]>([]);
  const [url, setUrl] = useState("https://example.com");
  const [selfCard, setSelfCard] = useState<CardRow>({});
  const [lastResult, setLastResult] = useState<string>("");
  const host = detectHost();

  const refresh = useCallback(async () => {
    setCards((await v6.agentCardList()) as CardRow[]);
    setSelfCard((await v6.a2aSelfCard()) as CardRow);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    void refresh();
  }, [refresh]);

  const discover = async () => {
    const r = await v6.a2aFetchCard(url.trim());
    setLastResult(JSON.stringify(r, null, 2));
    if (r.ok) {
      await v6.agentCardSave({ ...(r.card as object), url: r.url, signed: r.signed });
      await refresh();
      toast(`Discovered ${String(r.name)}`);
    } else {
      toast(`Discovery failed: ${String(r.error)}`);
    }
  };

  const delegate = async (card: CardRow) => {
    if (!card.url) return;
    const r = await v6.a2aSendTask(card.url, {
      taskId: `task-${Date.now().toString(36)}`,
      instruction: "Review the attached artifact and return a severity-calibrated finding list.",
    });
    setLastResult(JSON.stringify(r, null, 2));
    toast(r.ok ? "Task sent" : `Send failed: ${String(r.error)}`);
  };

  const remove = async (id?: string) => {
    if (!id) return;
    await v6.agentCardDelete(id);
    await refresh();
  };

  return (
    <div className="panel-page">
      <h2>Federation</h2>
      <p className="sub">
        A2A handles agent↔agent coordination; MCP handles agent↔tool access. Register remote agents by
        their Agent Card and MJ can delegate work to them as foreign specialists.
      </p>

      {host !== "tauri" && (
        <div className="card" style={{ borderLeft: "3px solid #e8834a" }}>
          <div className="card-title">Native host required</div>
          <div className="muted">
            A2A discovery is an HTTP call and is host-bound. Build the desktop app to use federation;
            in a browser preview the buttons below will report that clearly rather than pretending.
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ------------------------------------------------------- self card */}
      <div className="card">
        <div className="card-title">This MJ instance</div>
        <div className="mono" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>{selfCard.name ?? "MJ"}</div>
        {Array.isArray(selfCard.skills) && (
          <div className="muted mono" style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>
            skills: {selfCard.skills.map((s) => (typeof s === "string" ? s : s.id ?? s.name)).join(", ")}
          </div>
        )}
        {selfCard.note && <div className="muted">{selfCard.note}</div>}
      </div>

      {/* ----------------------------------------------------- discovery */}
      <div className="card">
        <div className="card-title">Discover an agent</div>
        <div className="row" style={{ gap: 8, marginTop: 8, flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
          <input
            style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 240 }}
            value={url}
            onChange={(e) => setUrl(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="https://agent-host.example.com"
          />
          <button className="primary" onClick={() => void discover()}>
            Fetch Agent Card
          </button>
        </div>
        <div className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 11, marginTop: 6 }}>
          Fetches <span className="mono">/.well-known/agent.json</span> from the host.
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* --------------------------------------------------------- cards */}
      <div className="card">
        <div className="card-title">Registered agents ({cards.length})</div>
        {cards.length === 0 && <div className="muted">No remote agents registered yet.</div>}
        {cards.map((c, i) => (
          <div key={String(c.id ?? i)} style={{ padding: "8px 0", borderBottom: "1px solid var(--line, #232323)" }}>
            <div className="row" style={{ justifyContent: "space-between" }}>
              <b>{c.name ?? "unnamed agent"}</b>
              {c.signed && <span className="pill">signed card</span>}
            </div>
            <div className="muted mono" style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>{c.url}</div>
            <div className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>
              {Array.isArray(c.skills)
                ? c.skills.map((s) => (typeof s === "string" ? s : s.id ?? s.name)).join(" · ")
                : "no declared skills"}
            </div>
            <div className="row" style={{ gap: 8, marginTop: 6 }}>
              <button onClick={() => void delegate(c)}>Delegate a task</button>
              <button className="danger" onClick={() => void remove(c.id)}>Remove</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      {lastResult && (
        <div className="card">
          <div className="card-title">Last result</div>
          <pre className="mono" style={{ whiteSpace: "pre-wrap", fontSize: 11, maxHeight: 300, overflow: "auto" }}>
            {lastResult}
          </pre>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

```


## `src/pages/GovernancePage.tsx`

```tsx
/**
 * MJ 6.0 — Governance (spec §10, §11, §32, §33).
 *
 * §10: "Make the policy visible in the UI." So the risk→handling table is rendered
 * from the actual policy object, not duplicated as prose.
 */
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { defaultCharter, AUTONOMY_MODES, AUTONOMY_LABEL, RISK_TIERS, RISK_TIER_LABEL, MUTATION_KINDS, MUTATION_LABEL } from "../domain/charter";
import type { Charter } from "../domain/charter";
import { RISK_CLASSES, RISK_CLASS_COLOR, HANDLING_LABEL, classifyAction } from "../domain/risk";
import { defaultRiskPolicy } from "../domain/mission";
import { reconcileRiskPolicy } from "../domain/charter";
import { AuditLedger, exportLedger } from "../engine/audit";
import {
  buildProvenanceManifest,
  renderManifest,
  verifyManifest,
} from "../engine/provenanceExport";
import type { ProvenanceManifest } from "../engine/provenanceExport";
import type { Artifact } from "../domain/artifact";
import { v6 } from "../ipc/v6";
import { uid } from "../app/id";
import { toast } from "../panels/Toast";

export function GovernancePage() {
  const [charter, setCharter] = useState<Charter | null>(null);
  const [saved, setSaved] = useState<Charter[]>([]);
  const [probe, setProbe] = useState("git:push origin main");
  const [ledgerText, setLedgerText] = useState("");
  const [chain, setChain] = useState<{ ok: boolean; entries?: number; brokenAt?: number } | null>(null);
  const [auditMission, setAuditMission] = useState("");
  const [manifest, setManifest] = useState<ProvenanceManifest | null>(null);
  const [manifestCheck, setManifestCheck] = useState<{ ok: boolean; problems: string[] } | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    let alive = true;
    void v6.charterList().then((r) => {
      if (!alive) return;
      setSaved(r);
      if (r.length && !charter) setCharter(r[0]);
    });
    return () => {
      alive = false;
    };
  }, [charter]);

  const draft = () => {
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    return {
      ...defaultCharter("New charter"),
      id: uid("charter"),
      createdAt: now,
      updatedAt: now,
    };
  };

  const load = (c: Charter) => setCharter({ ...c });

  const save = async () => {
    if (!charter) return;
    await v6.charterSave(charter);
    setSaved(await v6.charterList());
    toast(`Saved charter ${charter.name}`);
  };

  const verifyChain = async () => {
    if (!auditMission.trim()) {
      toast("Enter a mission id to verify");
      return;
    }
    const rows = (await v6.auditList(auditMission.trim())) as Array<Record<string, unknown>>;
    // Rebuild the chain locally and verify it — the ledger is hash-chained.
    const ledger = new AuditLedger();
    let ok = true;
    let brokenAt: number | undefined;
    for (const r of rows) {
      const entry = ledger.append({
        kind: String(r.kind ?? "POLICY_CHECKED") as never,
        missionId: String(r.missionId ?? auditMission),
        actor: String(r.actor ?? "unknown"),
        authority: r.authority ? String(r.authority) : undefined,
        policy: r.policy ? String(r.policy) : undefined,
        reason: r.reason ? String(r.reason) : undefined,
        evidence: Array.isArray(r.evidence) ? (r.evidence as string[]) : [],
        data: (r.data as Record<string, unknown>) ?? {},
      });
      void entry;
      const v = ledger.verify();
      if (!v.ok && brokenAt === undefined) {
        ok = false;
        brokenAt = v.brokenAt;
      }
    }
    setChain({ ok, entries: rows.length, brokenAt });
    setLedgerText(exportLedger(ledger));

    // The manifest binds itself to the ledger we just verified, so build it from
    // the same verification result rather than trusting a cached "intact".
    const artifacts = await v6.artifactsForMission(auditMission.trim());
    const byId: Record<string, Artifact> = Object.fromEntries(artifacts.map((a) => [a.id, a]));
    const m = buildProvenanceManifest(artifacts, byId, {
      missionId: auditMission.trim(),
      generator: {
        name: "MJ Desktop",
        version: "6.0.0",
        harnesses: [...new Set(artifacts.map((a) => a.harnessUsed).filter(Boolean))],
      },
      ledger: { head: ledger.head, entries: rows.length, verified: ok, brokenAt },
    });
    setManifest(m);
    setManifestCheck(verifyManifest(m, byId));
  };

  const downloadManifest = () => {
    if (!manifest) return;
    const blob = new Blob([renderManifest(manifest)], { type: "application/json" });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement("a");
    a.href = url;
    a.download = `mj-provenance-${manifest.missionId}.json`;
    a.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    toast("Provenance manifest downloaded");
  };

  // §10/§11 — what the mission asks for, what the charter's tier will tolerate,
  // and what actually applies once the two are reconciled.
  const effective = reconcileRiskPolicy(
    { riskTier: charter?.riskTier ?? "R1_REVERSIBLE" },
    REQUESTED_POLICY,
  );
  return (
    <div className="panel-page">
      <h2>Governance</h2>
      <p className="sub">
        Every autonomous action is checked against this policy before it runs. An agent inherits only
        the permissions explicitly granted to it, intersected with the charter ceiling — never more.
      </p>

      {/* ---------------------------------------------------- risk policy */}
      <div className="card">
        <div className="card-title">Risk policy — what happens at each consequence tier</div>
        <table style={{ width: "100%", borderCollapse: "collapse", marginTop: 10 }}>
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th style={th}>Risk class</th>
              <th style={th}>Mission asks for</th>
              <th style={th}>Charter allows</th>
              <th style={th}>Effective</th>
              <th style={th}>Examples</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {RISK_CLASSES.map((c) => {
              const asked = REQUESTED_POLICY.handling[c];
              const allowed = effective.ceiling[c];
              const got = effective.policy.handling[c];
              return (
                <tr key={c}>
                  <td style={td}>
                    <span className="pill" style={{ background: RISK_CLASS_COLOR[c], color: "#000" }}>{c}</span>
                  </td>
                  <td style={td}>{HANDLING_LABEL[asked]}</td>
                  <td style={td} className="muted">{HANDLING_LABEL[allowed]}</td>
                  <td style={td}>
                    <b style={{ color: got !== asked ? "#e8834a" : undefined }}>{HANDLING_LABEL[got]}</b>
                    {got !== asked && <span className="muted" title={RISK_TIER_LABEL[charter?.riskTier ?? "R1_REVERSIBLE"]}> clamped</span>}
                  </td>
                  <td style={td} className="muted">{EXAMPLES[c]}</td>
                </tr>
              );
            })}
          </tbody>
        </table>
        <div className="muted" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>
          Charter tier: <b>{RISK_TIER_LABEL[charter?.riskTier ?? "R1_REVERSIBLE"]}</b>. The charter is the
          ceiling — a mission may ask for less autonomy than the tier allows, never more.
        </div>
        {effective.notes.length > 0 && (
          <pre className="mono" style={{ whiteSpace: "pre-wrap", fontSize: 11, marginTop: 8, color: "#e8834a" }}>
{effective.notes.join("\n")}
          </pre>
        )}
        <div className="row" style={{ marginTop: 10, gap: 8 }}>
          <input
            style={{ flex: 1 }}
            value={probe}
            onChange={(e) => setProbe(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Probe an action descriptor, e.g. deploy:production"
          />
          <button onClick={() => toast(`"${probe}" classifies as ${classifyAction(probe)}`)}>
            Classify
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* -------------------------------------------------------- charter */}
      <div className="grid-2">
        <div className="card">
          <div className="card-title">Charter</div>
          <div className="row" style={{ gap: 6, flexWrap: "wrap", marginBottom: 10 }}>
            <button onClick={() => load(draft())}>New</button>
            {saved.map((c) => (
              <button key={c.id} onClick={() => load(c)}>{c.name}</button>
            ))}
          </div>

          {charter && (
            <>
              <label className="muted mono" style={lbl}>NAME</label>
              <input style={inp} value={charter.name} onChange={(e) => setCharter({ ...charter, name: e.target.value })} />

              <label className="muted mono" style={lbl}>AUTONOMY MODE</label>
              <select style={inp} value={charter.autonomyMode} onChange={(e) => setCharter({ ...charter, autonomyMode: e.target.value as Charter["autonomyMode"] })}>
                {AUTONOMY_MODES.map((m) => (
                  <option key={m} value={m}>{AUTONOMY_LABEL[m]}</option>
                ))}
              </select>
              <div className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>{AUTONOMY_LABEL[charter.autonomyMode]}</div>

              <label className="muted mono" style={lbl}>RISK TIER CEILING</label>
              <select style={inp} value={charter.riskTier} onChange={(e) => setCharter({ ...charter, riskTier: e.target.value as Charter["riskTier"] })}>
                {RISK_TIERS.map((t) => (
                  <option key={t} value={t}>{RISK_TIER_LABEL[t]}</option>
                ))}
              </select>

              <label className="muted mono" style={lbl}>FORBIDDEN ACTIONS (one per line)</label>
              <textarea
                style={{ ...inp, minHeight: 90 }}
                value={charter.forbiddenActions.join("\n")}
                onChange={(e) => setCharter({ ...charter, forbiddenActions: e.target.value.split("\n").filter(Boolean) })}
              />

              <div className="row" style={{ marginTop: 10 }}>
                <button className="primary" onClick={() => void save()}>Save charter</button>
              </div>
            </>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="card">
          <div className="card-title">Ceilings</div>
          {charter && (
            <>
              <Num label="Max cost (USD)" value={charter.ceilings.maxCostUsd} onChange={(v) => setCharter({ ...charter, ceilings: { ...charter.ceilings, maxCostUsd: v } })} />
              <Num label="Max node runs" value={charter.ceilings.maxNodeRuns} onChange={(v) => setCharter({ ...charter, ceilings: { ...charter.ceilings, maxNodeRuns: v } })} />
              <Num label="Max wall clock (min)" value={Math.round(charter.ceilings.maxWallClockMs / 60000)} onChange={(v) => setCharter({ ...charter, ceilings: { ...charter.ceilings, maxWallClockMs: v * 60000 } })} />
              <Num label="Max reorganizations" value={charter.ceilings.maxReorganizations} onChange={(v) => setCharter({ ...charter, ceilings: { ...charter.ceilings, maxReorganizations: v } })} />
              <Num label="Max concurrent agents" value={charter.ceilings.maxConcurrentAgents} onChange={(v) => setCharter({ ...charter, ceilings: { ...charter.ceilings, maxConcurrentAgents: v } })} />
              <Num label="Warn at fraction" value={charter.ceilings.warnAtFraction} onChange={(v) => setCharter({ ...charter, ceilings: { ...charter.ceilings, warnAtFraction: v } })} step={0.05} />

              <label className="muted mono" style={lbl}>ALLOWED MUTATIONS</label>
              <div style={{ maxHeight: 180, overflow: "auto" }}>
                {MUTATION_KINDS.map((m) => (
                  <label key={m} className="muted" style={{ display: "block", fontSize: 12 }}>
                    <input
                      type="checkbox"
                      checked={charter.allowedMutations.includes(m)}
                      onChange={(e) =>
                        setCharter({
                          ...charter,
                          allowedMutations: e.target.checked
                            ? [...charter.allowedMutations, m]
                            : charter.allowedMutations.filter((x) => x !== m),
                        })
                      }
                    />{" "}
                    {MUTATION_LABEL[m]}
                  </label>
                ))}
              </div>
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* --------------------------------------------------- audit ledger */}
      <div className="card" style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
        <div className="card-title">Audit ledger — append-only, hash-chained</div>
        <p className="muted">
          Each entry commits to the previous one, so editing or removing a record invalidates every
          hash after it. This is what makes “no silent autonomous mutations” verifiable.
        </p>
        <div className="row" style={{ gap: 8, marginTop: 8 }}>
          <input
            style={{ flex: 1 }}
            placeholder="Mission id"
            value={auditMission}
            onChange={(e) => setAuditMission(e.target.value)}
          />
          <button onClick={() => void verifyChain()}>Verify chain</button>
        </div>
        {chain && (
          <div className="mono" style={{ marginTop: 8, color: chain.ok ? "#4c8" : "#e8341c" }}>
            {chain.ok
              ? `CHAIN INTACT — ${chain.entries ?? 0} entries verified`
              : `CHAIN BROKEN at seq ${chain.brokenAt}`}
          </div>
        )}
        {ledgerText && (
          <pre className="mono" style={{ whiteSpace: "pre-wrap", maxHeight: 320, overflow: "auto", fontSize: 11 }}>
            {ledgerText}
          </pre>
        )}
    </div>

      {/* ------------------------------------------- provenance manifest */}
      <div className="card" style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
        <div className="card-title">Provenance manifest — machine-readable origin of every artifact</div>
        <p className="muted">
          EU AI Act Art. 50 has applied since 2 August 2026: synthetic content must carry a mark that
          identifies it as machine-generated and is detectable by machines. This exports one manifest
          per mission — which slot made each artifact, on which harness and models, derived from which
          parents, under which approval — bound to the audit ledger head.
        </p>
        <p className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>
          Honest limits: this is a tamper-<em>evident</em> sidecar, not a cryptographic signature — MJ
          holds no signing key, so the binding is the same FNV-1a chain as the ledger. It does not
          embed the mark inside the artifact bytes themselves.
        </p>
        <div className="row" style={{ gap: 8, marginTop: 8 }}>
          <input
            style={{ flex: 1 }}
            placeholder="Mission id"
            value={auditMission}
            onChange={(e) => setAuditMission(e.target.value)}
          />
          <button onClick={() => void verifyChain()}>Build manifest</button>
          <button disabled={!manifest} onClick={downloadManifest}>Download JSON</button>
        </div>
        {manifest && (
          <>
            <div
              className="mono"
              style={{ marginTop: 8, color: manifestCheck?.ok ? "#4c8" : "#e8341c" }}
            >
              {manifestCheck?.ok
                ? `MANIFEST VERIFIED — ${manifest.claims.length} claims, hash ${manifest.manifestHash}`
                : `MANIFEST REJECTED — ${manifestCheck?.problems.length ?? 0} problem(s)`}
            </div>
            {manifestCheck && !manifestCheck.ok && (
              <ul className="mono" style={{ fontSize: 11, marginTop: 6 }}>
                {manifestCheck.problems.map((p) => (
                  <li key={p}>{p}</li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            )}
            <pre
              className="mono"
              style={{ whiteSpace: "pre-wrap", maxHeight: 320, overflow: "auto", fontSize: 11 }}
            >
              {renderManifest(manifest)}
            </pre>
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

const REQUESTED_POLICY = defaultRiskPolicy("policy");

const EXAMPLES: Record<string, string> = {
  LOW: "read files, run tests, research, inspect logs, git status/diff",
  MEDIUM: "edit code, install packages, write config, run migrations",
  HIGH: "git push, PR merge, infra changes, deploy to staging, publish",
  CRITICAL: "deploy production, delete data, modify credentials or IAM, spend money",
};

const th: React.CSSProperties = { textAlign: "left", fontSize: 11, letterSpacing: "0.08em", color: "var(--text-3)", padding: "6px 4px", borderBottom: "1px solid var(--line, #2a2a2a)" };
const td: React.CSSProperties = { padding: "8px 4px", borderBottom: "1px solid var(--line, #222)", verticalAlign: "top" };
const lbl: React.CSSProperties = { fontSize: 10, letterSpacing: "0.1em", display: "block", marginTop: 10 };
const inp: React.CSSProperties = { width: "100%", marginTop: 4 };

function Num({
  label,
  value,
  onChange,
  step,
}: {
  label: string;
  value: number;
  onChange: (v: number) => void;
  step?: number;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="row" style={{ justifyContent: "space-between", padding: "4px 0" }}>
      <span className="muted">{label}</span>
      <input
        type="number"
        step={step ?? 1}
        style={{ width: 110 }}
        value={value}
        onChange={(e) => onChange(Number(e.target.value))}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { WORKFLOW_TEMPLATES, loadTemplate } from "../domain/templates";
import { ROLE_PACK_COUNT } from "../domain/rolePacks";
import { FRAMEWORK_COUNT } from "../domain/frameworks";
import { generateCustomNode } from "../domain/customNode";
import { useGraphStore } from "../graph/store";
import { ipc } from "../ipc/client";
import type { WorkflowRecord } from "../domain/types";
import { toast } from "../panels/Toast";
import { useState } from "react";

export function HomePage({
  workflows,
  onOpen,
  onCreated,
}: {
  workflows: WorkflowRecord[];
  onOpen: (id: string) => void;
  onCreated: () => void;
}) {
  const [customText, setCustomText] = useState("");
  const store = useGraphStore();

  const applyTemplate = async (instances: ReturnType<typeof loadTemplate>["instances"], wires: ReturnType<typeof loadTemplate>["wires"], name: string) => {
    if (!store.workflowId) {
      const res = await ipc.workflowCreate(name, "");
      const created = await ipc.workflowGet(res.id);
      store.loadWorkflow(created as never);
      window.__mjActiveWorkflowId = res.id;
    }
    store.insertTemplate(instances, wires);
    store.rename(name);
    toast(`Loaded ${name}`);
    onCreated();
  };

  return (
    <div className="home">
      <div className="home-hero">
        <div>
          <h1>MJ<span>.</span></h1>
          <p>
            Native visual workstation. The graph is the source of truth. Hermes skills are SKILL.md.
            Official MCP servers run over stdio. Assist may generate one custom node — never a full workflow.
          </p>
        </div>
        <button className="primary" onClick={async () => {
          const res = await ipc.workflowCreate(`Workflow ${workflows.length + 1}`, "");
          const created = await ipc.workflowGet(res.id);
          store.loadWorkflow(created as never);
          window.__mjActiveWorkflowId = res.id;
          onCreated();
        }}>New workflow</button>
      </div>

      <label className="field">v1 assist · one custom node
        <div className="nl-box">
          <input
            value={customText}
            onChange={(e) => setCustomText(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="e.g. a custom node that redacts PII from meeting notes"
            onKeyDown={(e) => {
              if (e.key === "Enter" && customText.trim()) {
                void addCustom(customText.trim());
              }
            }}
          />
          <button className="primary" onClick={() => customText.trim() && void addCustom(customText.trim())}>Add node</button>
        </div>
      </label>

      <div className="stat-row">
        <div className="stat"><div className="n">{workflows.length}</div><div className="l">Workflows</div></div>
        <div className="stat"><div className="n">{store.graph.nodes.length}</div><div className="l">Nodes on canvas</div></div>
        <div className="stat"><div className="n">{WORKFLOW_TEMPLATES.length}</div><div className="l">Templates</div></div>
        <div className="stat"><div className="n">{ROLE_PACK_COUNT}</div><div className="l">Hermes agents</div></div>
        <div className="stat"><div className="n">{FRAMEWORK_COUNT}</div><div className="l">Frameworks</div></div>
      </div>

      <h3 style={{ letterSpacing: "0.12em", textTransform: "uppercase", fontSize: 11, color: "var(--text-3)" }}>Recent</h3>
      {workflows.length === 0 && <p className="muted">No workflows yet.</p>}
      {workflows.slice(0, 6).map((w) => (
        <div key={w.id} className="card wf-row" onClick={() => onOpen(w.id)}>
          <div>
            <div className="card-title">{w.name}</div>
            <div className="muted">{w.graph.nodes?.length ?? 0} nodes · updated {new Date(w.updatedAt).toLocaleString()}</div>
          </div>
          <button onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); onOpen(w.id); }}>Open</button>
        </div>
      ))}

      <h3 style={{ letterSpacing: "0.12em", textTransform: "uppercase", fontSize: 11, color: "var(--text-3)", marginTop: 28 }}>Templates (hand-authored)</h3>
      <div className="grid-2">
        {WORKFLOW_TEMPLATES.map((t) => (
          <div key={t.id} className="card tpl" onClick={() => {
            const { instances, wires } = loadTemplate(t.id);
            void applyTemplate(instances, wires, t.name);
          }}>
            <div className="pill">{t.category}</div>
            <h3>{t.name}</h3>
            <div className="muted">{t.description}</div>
            <div className="muted" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>{t.steps.length} nodes</div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );

  async function addCustom(text: string) {
    if (!store.workflowId) {
      const res = await ipc.workflowCreate("Untitled", "");
      const created = await ipc.workflowGet(res.id);
      store.loadWorkflow(created as never);
      window.__mjActiveWorkflowId = res.id;
    }
    const node = generateCustomNode(text);
    store.insertTemplate([node], []);
    store.selectNode(node.id);
    toast(`Custom node: ${node.title}`);
    setCustomText("");
    onCreated();
  }
}
```

## `src/pages/McpPage.tsx`

```tsx
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { ipc } from "../ipc/client";
import type { McpServerEntry } from "../domain/types";
import { VENDORED_MCP_SERVERS, planControlMutation } from "../domain/mcpCatalog";
import { toast } from "../panels/Toast";

export function McpHubPage() {
  const [rows, setRows] = useState<McpServerEntry[]>([]);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [result, setResult] = useState("");
  const [plan, setPlan] = useState<ReturnType<typeof planControlMutation> | null>(null);
  const refresh = () => void ipc.mcpServerList().then(setRows);

  useEffect(() => { refresh(); }, []);

  return (
    <div className="panel-page">
      <h2>MCP Hub</h2>
      <p className="sub">
        Official servers are vendored and launched over stdio. MJ does not reimplement Filesystem, Git, Memory,
        Sequential Thinking, Time, or GitHub. Control MCP is the only MJ-authored server — mutations are Plan → Apply → Verify. No HTTP sidecar.
      </p>

      <h3 style={{ fontSize: 12, letterSpacing: "0.12em", textTransform: "uppercase", color: "var(--text-3)" }}>Vendored catalog</h3>
      {VENDORED_MCP_SERVERS.map((s) => (
        <div key={s.id} className="card">
          <div className="card-title">
            {s.name}
            <span className="pill">{s.kind}</span>
            {s.pinned && <span className="pill">pinned</span>}
            {s.authoredByMj ? <span className="pill ok">MJ authored</span> : <span className="pill">official</span>}
          </div>
          <div className="muted">{s.description}</div>
          <div className="muted" style={{ marginTop: 6 }}>{s.vendorPath}</div>
          <div className="mono" style={{ marginTop: 6 }}>{s.command} {s.args.join(" ")}</div>
          <div className="row" style={{ marginTop: 10 }}>
            <button disabled={busy === s.id} onClick={async () => {
              setBusy(s.id);
              const existing = rows.find((r) => r.id === s.id);
              if (!existing) {
                await ipc.mcpServerSave({
                  id: s.id,
                  name: s.name,
                  transport: "stdio",
                  command: s.command,
                  args: s.args,
                  enabled: true,
                  pinned: true,
                });
                await refresh();
              }
              const r = await ipc.mcpConnectTest(s.id);
              setResult(JSON.stringify(r, null, 2));
              setBusy(null);
            }}>Enable + test stdio</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      ))}

      <h3 style={{ fontSize: 12, letterSpacing: "0.12em", textTransform: "uppercase", color: "var(--text-3)", marginTop: 24 }}>Control MCP</h3>
      <div className="card">
        <div className="card-title">Plan → Apply → Verify</div>
        <div className="muted">Graph mutations never apply until you accept the plan. Verify re-runs validate_graph.</div>
        <div className="row" style={{ marginTop: 10 }}>
          <button onClick={() => {
            const p = planControlMutation("validate_graph", { workflowId: window.__mjActiveWorkflowId ?? "" });
            setPlan(p);
          }}>Plan validate_graph</button>
          {plan && (
            <>
              <button className="primary" onClick={async () => {
                const r = await ipc.controlValidate(String(plan.args.workflowId || window.__mjActiveWorkflowId || ""));
                setResult(JSON.stringify({ applied: plan, verified: r }, null, 2));
                toast("Applied + verified");
                setPlan(null);
              }}>Apply + verify</button>
              <button className="danger" onClick={() => setPlan(null)}>Discard plan</button>
            </>
          )}
        </div>
        {plan && <pre className="mono" style={{ whiteSpace: "pre-wrap", marginTop: 10 }}>{plan.preview}</pre>}
      </div>

      <h3 style={{ fontSize: 12, letterSpacing: "0.12em", textTransform: "uppercase", color: "var(--text-3)", marginTop: 24 }}>Registry</h3>
      <div className="row" style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
        <button onClick={refresh}>Refresh</button>
      </div>
      {rows.map((s) => (
        <div key={s.id} className="card">
          <div className="card-title">
            {s.name}
            <span className={`pill ${s.config.enabled ? "ok" : ""}`}>{s.state}</span>
            <span className="pill">{s.transport}</span>
          </div>
          <div className="muted">{s.config.command} {(s.config.args ?? []).join(" ")}</div>
          <div className="row" style={{ marginTop: 10 }}>
            <button className="danger" onClick={async () => { await ipc.mcpServerRemove(s.id); refresh(); }}>Remove</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      ))}
      {result && <pre className="card mono" style={{ whiteSpace: "pre-wrap" }}>{result}</pre>}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## `src/pages/MissionPage.tsx`

```tsx
/**
 * MJ 6.0 — Mission view (spec §29).
 *
 * The Mission view is a higher abstraction over the canvas: it shows the
 * organization, the live execution, the risks and blockers, and lets a human
 * approve, roll back and inspect. The graph editor remains available and stays
 * synchronized through src/engine/orgGraphSync.ts (§30).
 */
import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { missionController, type QueuedApproval } from "../engine/missionController";
import type { Mission, MissionStatus } from "../domain/mission";
import { MISSION_STATUS_COLOR, defaultRiskPolicy, isTerminal, makeCriterion, DEFAULT_MISSION_BUDGET } from "../domain/mission";
import { MISSION_TEMPLATES, suggestTemplate, instantiateTemplate } from "../domain/missionTemplates";
import { renderPlan, type MissionPlan } from "../engine/missionPlanner";
import { AGENT_SLOT_COLOR, type AgentSlot, type MissionTask } from "../domain/organization";
import { RISK_CLASS_COLOR, HANDLING_LABEL, type RiskClass } from "../domain/risk";
import { buildLineage, type Artifact } from "../domain/artifact";
import { v6 } from "../ipc/v6";
import { uid } from "../app/id";
import { ScoreDimensions } from "../panels/ScoreDimensions";
import { toast } from "../panels/Toast";

type Tab = "org" | "live" | "approvals" | "artifacts" | "timeline" | "score";

const TABS: Array<{ id: Tab; label: string }> = [
  { id: "org", label: "Organization" },
  { id: "live", label: "Live" },
  { id: "approvals", label: "Approvals" },
  { id: "artifacts", label: "Artifacts" },
  { id: "timeline", label: "Flight recorder" },
  { id: "score", label: "Score" },
];

export function MissionPage() {
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<Tab>("org");
  const [objective, setObjective] = useState("");
  const [missionName, setMissionName] = useState("");
  const [templateId, setTemplateId] = useState<string>(MISSION_TEMPLATES[0].id);
  const [mission, setMission] = useState<Mission | null>(null);
  const [plan, setPlan] = useState<MissionPlan | null>(null);
  const [state, setState] = useState(missionController.getState());
  const [lineageId, setLineageId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => missionController.subscribe(setState), []);

  const snapshot = state.running || state.lastOutcome ? missionController.snapshot() : undefined;

  const suggested = useMemo(
    () => (objective.trim().length > 12 ? suggestTemplate(objective) : null),
    [objective],
  );

  const buildMission = useCallback((): Mission => {
    const tpl = MISSION_TEMPLATES.find((t) => t.id === templateId);
    const seed = tpl ? instantiateTemplate(templateId, objective.trim()) : null;
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    return {
      id: uid("mis"),
      name: missionName.trim() || (tpl ? tpl.name : "Untitled mission"),
      objective: objective.trim(),
      description: seed?.description ?? "",
      constraints: seed?.constraints ?? [],
      successCriteria: seed?.successCriteria ?? [
        makeCriterion("Deliverable satisfies the objective", "RUBRIC", { blocking: true, weight: 3 }),
      ],
      deadline: undefined,
      budget: { ...(seed?.budget ?? DEFAULT_MISSION_BUDGET) },
      riskPolicy: defaultRiskPolicy(uid("risk")),
      charterId: "",
      approvalPolicyId: "default",
      allowedHarnesses: [],
      allowedTools: [],
      allowedMcpServers: [],
      allowedAgents: [],
      preferredFramework: seed?.preferredFramework ?? "fw.pipeline",
      workspace: "",
      artifactIds: [],
      status: "DRAFT" as MissionStatus,
      priority: "NORMAL",
      templateId,
      tags: seed?.tags ?? [],
      createdAt: now,
      updatedAt: now,
    };
  }, [objective, missionName, templateId]);

  const doPlan = useCallback(() => {
    if (!objective.trim()) {
      toast("Enter an objective first");
      return;
    }
    const m = buildMission();
    setMission(m);
    const p = missionController.plan(m);
    setPlan(p);
    setTab("org");
    toast(`Planned ${p.phases.length} phases · ${p.staffing.length} agents`);
  }, [objective, buildMission]);

  const doRun = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!mission || !plan) return;
    const charter = missionController.defaultCharter(`${mission.name} charter`);
    try {
      await missionController.start(mission, charter);
      toast("Mission finished");
    } catch (e) {
      toast(`Mission failed: ${e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)}`);
    }
  }, [mission, plan]);

  const loadMission = useCallback(async (id: string) => {
    const m = await v6.missionGet(id);
    if (m) {
      setMission(m);
      setObjective(m.objective);
      setMissionName(m.name);
      if (m.templateId) setTemplateId(m.templateId);
      setPlan(missionController.plan(m));
    }
  }, []);

  const savedMissions = useSavedMissions();

  const org = snapshot?.org;
  const metrics = org?.metrics;
  const statusColor = mission ? MISSION_STATUS_COLOR[mission.status] : "var(--text-3)";

  return (
    <div className="panel-page">
      <h2>Mission</h2>
      <p className="sub">
        A Mission owns a dynamically managed organization of agents. Plan it, inspect the plan, then run it.
        The organization evaluates, repairs and reorganizes itself within the charter you give it.
      </p>

      {/* ---------------------------------------------------------- create */}
      <div className="card">
        <div className="card-title">New mission</div>
        <div className="row" style={{ gap: 8, marginTop: 8, flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
          <input
            style={{ flex: "2 1 320px", minWidth: 220 }}
            placeholder="Objective — e.g. Build and test a production SaaS feature"
            value={objective}
            onChange={(e) => setObjective(e.target.value)}
          />
          <input
            style={{ flex: "1 1 180px", minWidth: 140 }}
            placeholder="Name (optional)"
            value={missionName}
            onChange={(e) => setMissionName(e.target.value)}
          />
          <select value={templateId} onChange={(e) => setTemplateId(e.target.value)}>
            {MISSION_TEMPLATES.map((t) => (
              <option key={t.id} value={t.id}>{t.name}</option>
            ))}
          </select>
          <button className="primary" onClick={doPlan}>Plan</button>
        </div>
        {suggested && suggested.id !== templateId && (
          <div className="muted" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>
            Suggested template: <b>{suggested.name}</b> — {suggested.description}{" "}
            <button className="link" onClick={() => setTemplateId(suggested.id)}>use it</button>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {savedMissions.length > 0 && (
        <div className="card">
          <div className="card-title">Saved missions</div>
          <div className="row" style={{ flexWrap: "wrap", marginTop: 8 }}>
            {savedMissions.map((m) => (
              <button key={m.id} onClick={() => void loadMission(m.id)}>
                <span style={{ color: MISSION_STATUS_COLOR[m.status] }}>●</span> {m.name}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* --------------------------------------------------------- mission */}
      {mission && (
        <div className="card" style={{ borderLeft: `3px solid ${statusColor}` }}>
          <div className="row" style={{ justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "flex-start", flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
            <div>
              <div style={{ fontSize: 18, fontWeight: 600 }}>{mission.name}</div>
              <div className="muted">{mission.objective}</div>
            </div>
            <div style={{ textAlign: "right" }}>
              <div style={{ color: statusColor, fontWeight: 600, letterSpacing: "0.08em" }}>
                {mission.status}
              </div>
              <div className="muted mono">
                ${(metrics?.totalCostUsd ?? state.lastOutcome?.costUsd ?? 0).toFixed(4)} ·{" "}
                {Math.round((state.lastOutcome?.durationMs ?? metrics?.wallClockMs ?? 0) / 1000)}s ·{" "}
                {org ? `${org.tasks.filter((t) => t.status === "COMPLETED").length}/${org.tasks.length} tasks` : "not started"}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="row" style={{ marginTop: 12, gap: 8, flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
            <button className="primary" disabled={!plan || state.running || isTerminal(mission.status)} onClick={() => void doRun()}>
              {state.running ? "Running…" : "Run mission"}
            </button>
            <button disabled={!state.running} onClick={() => missionController.pause()}>Pause</button>
            <button disabled={!state.running} onClick={() => missionController.resume()}>Resume</button>
            <button className="danger" disabled={!state.running} onClick={() => missionController.abort("Aborted from the Mission view")}>
              Kill switch
            </button>
            {plan && (
              <button onClick={() => setPlan(plan)}>Re-plan</button>
            )}
          </div>

          {state.error && (
            <pre className="mono" style={{ color: "var(--danger, #e8341c)", whiteSpace: "pre-wrap", marginTop: 10 }}>
              {state.error}
            </pre>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ------------------------------------------------------------ plan */}
      {plan && (
        <div className="card">
          <div className="card-title">
            Plan · confidence {(plan.confidence * 100).toFixed(0)}% · ~${plan.estimatedCostUsd.toFixed(2)} ·{" "}
            ~{Math.round(plan.estimatedDurationMs / 60000)} min
          </div>
          <pre className="mono" style={{ whiteSpace: "pre-wrap", marginTop: 8, maxHeight: 380, overflow: "auto" }}>
            {renderPlan(plan)}
          </pre>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ------------------------------------------------------------ tabs */}
      {org && (
        <>
          <div className="row" style={{ gap: 6, marginTop: 16, flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
            {TABS.map((t) => (
              <button
                key={t.id}
                className={tab === t.id ? "primary" : ""}
                onClick={() => setTab(t.id)}
              >
                {t.label}
                {t.id === "approvals" && state.approvals.filter((a) => !a.resolved).length > 0 && (
                  <span className="pill" style={{ marginLeft: 6 }}>
                    {state.approvals.filter((a) => !a.resolved).length}
                  </span>
                )}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>

          {tab === "org" && <OrganizationTab org={org} mutations={snapshot?.mutations ?? []} />}
          {tab === "live" && <LiveTab org={org} events={state.events} />}
          {tab === "approvals" && (
            <ApprovalsTab
              approvals={state.approvals}
              onDecide={(id, ok) => missionController.decide(id, ok, "user")}
            />
          )}
          {tab === "artifacts" && (
            <ArtifactsTab
              artifacts={snapshot?.artifacts ?? []}
              lineageId={lineageId}
              onSelect={setLineageId}
            />
          )}
          {tab === "timeline" && <TimelineTab events={state.events} />}
          {tab === "score" && <ScoreTab outcome={state.lastOutcome} />}
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// --------------------------------------------------------------------- tabs

function OrganizationTab({
  org,
  mutations,
}: {
  org: import("../domain/organization").Organization;
  mutations: import("../engine/graphEvolution").GraphMutation[];
}) {
  const contributions = org.candidatePool
    .filter((s) => s.active)
    .sort((a, b) => (b.scorecard.contribution ?? 0) - (a.scorecard.contribution ?? 0));

  return (
    <div style={{ marginTop: 14 }}>
      <div className="grid-2">
        {/* Roster */}
        <div className="card">
          <div className="card-title">Organization · generation {org.generation}</div>
          <div className="muted" style={{ marginBottom: 8 }}>
            {org.active.length} active of {org.candidatePool.length} candidates · {org.teams.length} teams
          </div>
          {contributions.length === 0 && <div className="muted">No agents staffed yet.</div>}
          {contributions.map((s) => (
            <SlotRow key={s.id} slot={s} />
          ))}
        </div>

        {/* Phases + tasks */}
        <div className="card">
          <div className="card-title">Phases</div>
          {org.phases.map((p) => (
            <div key={p.id} style={{ marginBottom: 10, paddingLeft: 8, borderLeft: "2px solid var(--line, #2a2a2a)" }}>
              <div className="row" style={{ justifyContent: "space-between" }}>
                <b>{p.name}</b>
                <span className="muted mono">
                  {p.status}{p.score !== undefined ? ` · ${p.score.toFixed(2)}/5` : ""}
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="muted">{p.rationale}</div>
              <div className="muted mono" style={{ marginTop: 2 }}>topology: {p.topology}</div>
              <div style={{ marginTop: 6 }}>
                {org.tasks
                  .filter((t) => t.phaseId === p.id)
                  .map((t) => (
                    <div key={t.id} className="muted mono" style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>
                      {statusGlyph(t.status)} {t.title}
                      {t.attempts > 0 ? ` · ${t.attempts} attempts` : ""}
                    </div>
                  ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
          {org.phases.length === 0 && <div className="muted">Not yet formed.</div>}
        </div>
      </div>

      {mutations.length > 0 && (
        <div className="card" style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
          <div className="card-title">Organization mutations</div>
          {mutations.slice(-8).map((m) => (
            <pre key={m.id} className="mono" style={{ whiteSpace: "pre-wrap", fontSize: 11, margin: "6px 0" }}>
{`#${m.newGraphVersion} ${m.kind} — ${m.status}
  ${m.summary}
  reason: ${m.reason}
  authority: ${m.decisionAuthority} · policy: ${m.policy}
  evidence: ${m.triggeringEvidence.join(" | ") || "none"}`}
            </pre>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function SlotRow({ slot }: { slot: AgentSlot }) {
  const sc = slot.scorecard;
  return (
    <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 10, alignItems: "flex-start", padding: "8px 0", borderBottom: "1px solid var(--line, #232323)" }}>
      <span style={{ color: AGENT_SLOT_COLOR[slot.status], fontSize: 16, lineHeight: 1.2 }}>●</span>
      <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
        <div className="row" style={{ justifyContent: "space-between" }}>
          <b>{slot.title}</b>
          <span className="muted mono" style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>
            contrib {((sc.contribution ?? 0) * 100).toFixed(0)}% · {sc.meanScore.toFixed(2)}/5
          </span>
        </div>
        <div className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>
          {slot.roleKey} · {slot.harness} · {slot.status}
        </div>
        <div className="muted mono" style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>
          {sc.tasksCompleted}/{sc.tasksAssigned} tasks · {sc.tasksFailed} failed · ${sc.totalCostUsd.toFixed(3)}
        </div>
        {sc.lastError && (
          <div className="muted mono" style={{ fontSize: 11, color: "#e8834a" }}>
            {sc.lastError.slice(0, 120)}
          </div>
        )}
        <div className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 11, marginTop: 2 }}>{slot.spawnedReason}</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function LiveTab({
  org,
  events,
}: {
  org: import("../domain/organization").Organization;
  events: Array<{ kind: string; data: Record<string, unknown>; at: string }>;
}) {
  const running = org.tasks.filter((t) => t.status === "RUNNING");
  const blocked = org.tasks.filter((t) => t.status === "BLOCKED");
  const failed = org.tasks.filter((t) => t.status === "FAILED");
  const repairs = snapshotRepairs();

  return (
    <div className="grid-2" style={{ marginTop: 14 }}>
      <div className="card">
        <div className="card-title">Current state</div>
        <Stat label="Running" value={running.length} />
        <Stat label="Blocked" value={blocked.length} />
        <Stat label="Failed" value={failed.length} />
        <Stat label="Reorganizations" value={org.metrics.reorganizations} />
        <Stat label="Repairs attempted" value={org.metrics.repairsAttempted} />
        <Stat label="Repairs succeeded" value={org.metrics.repairsSucceeded} />
        <Stat label="Human interventions" value={org.metrics.humanInterventions} />
        <Stat label="Regressions" value={org.metrics.regressions} />
      </div>

      <div className="card">
        <div className="card-title">Recent activity</div>
        <div style={{ maxHeight: 340, overflow: "auto" }}>
          {events.slice(-40).reverse().map((e, i) => (
            <div key={i} className="mono" style={{ fontSize: 11, padding: "2px 0" }}>
              <span style={{ color: "var(--text-3)" }}>{e.at.slice(11, 19)}</span>{" "}
              <b>{e.kind}</b>{" "}
              <span className="muted">{String(e.data.summary ?? e.data.reason ?? e.data.title ?? "")}</span>
            </div>
          ))}
          {events.length === 0 && <div className="muted">Nothing yet.</div>}
        </div>
      </div>

      {repairs.length > 0 && (
        <div className="card" style={{ gridColumn: "1 / -1" }}>
          <div className="card-title">Repair ladder</div>
          {repairs.slice(-10).map((r, i) => (
            <pre key={i} className="mono" style={{ whiteSpace: "pre-wrap", fontSize: 11, margin: "4px 0" }}>
{`#${r.attemptNumber} ${r.strategy} — ${r.outcome ?? "running"}
  failure: ${r.failureClass}
  why:     ${r.why}
  changed: ${r.whatChanged}
  expect:  ${r.expectedImprovement}`}
            </pre>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function snapshotRepairs() {
  const rt = missionController.runtimeRef();
  return rt ? rt.state().repairs : [];
}

function ApprovalsTab({
  approvals,
  onDecide,
}: {
  approvals: QueuedApproval[];
  onDecide: (id: string, approved: boolean) => void;
}) {
  const open = approvals.filter((a) => !a.resolved);
  const closed = approvals.filter((a) => a.resolved);

  return (
    <div style={{ marginTop: 14 }}>
      <div className="card">
        <div className="card-title">Pending approvals ({open.length})</div>
        {open.length === 0 && <div className="muted">Nothing waiting. High-risk actions will appear here and the run will genuinely block until you decide.</div>}
        {open.map((a) => (
          <div key={a.id} className="card" style={{ marginTop: 10, borderLeft: `3px solid ${RISK_CLASS_COLOR[a.riskClass]}` }}>
            <div className="row" style={{ justifyContent: "space-between" }}>
              <b>WHAT: {a.what}</b>
              <span className="pill" style={{ background: RISK_CLASS_COLOR[a.riskClass], color: "#000" }}>
                {a.riskClass}
              </span>
            </div>
            <Field label="WHY REQUIRED" value={a.whyRequired} />
            <Field label="REQUESTED BY" value={a.requestedBy} />
            <Field label="WHAT CHANGES" value={a.whatChanges} />
            <Field label="POLICY" value={a.policy} />
            <Field label="EVIDENCE" value={a.evidence.join(" · ") || "none"} />
            <Field label="EXPECTED OUTCOME" value={a.expectedOutcome} />
            <div className="row" style={{ marginTop: 10, gap: 8 }}>
              <button className="primary" onClick={() => onDecide(a.id, true)}>Approve</button>
              <button className="danger" onClick={() => onDecide(a.id, false)}>Reject</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      {closed.length > 0 && (
        <div className="card" style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
          <div className="card-title">Decided</div>
          {closed.map((a) => (
            <div key={a.id} className="muted mono" style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>
              {a.resolved?.approved ? "APPROVED" : "REJECTED"} · {a.riskClass} · {a.what}
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function ArtifactsTab({
  artifacts,
  lineageId,
  onSelect,
}: {
  artifacts: Artifact[];
  lineageId: string | null;
  onSelect: (id: string) => void;
}) {
  const lineages = useMemo(() => {
    const m = new Map<string, Artifact[]>();
    for (const a of artifacts) {
      const list = m.get(a.lineageId) ?? [];
      list.push(a);
      m.set(a.lineageId, list);
    }
    return [...m.entries()];
  }, [artifacts]);

  const graph = lineageId ? buildLineage(artifacts, latestOf(artifacts, lineageId)?.id ?? "") : null;

  return (
    <div className="grid-2" style={{ marginTop: 14 }}>
      <div className="card">
        <div className="card-title">Lineages ({lineages.length})</div>
        {lineages.length === 0 && <div className="muted">No artifacts yet.</div>}
        {lineages.map(([lid, list]) => (
          <div key={lid} style={{ padding: "6px 0", borderBottom: "1px solid var(--line, #232323)" }}>
            <div className="row" style={{ justifyContent: "space-between" }}>
              <b>{list[list.length - 1].name}</b>
              <button onClick={() => onSelect(lid)}>Explain lineage</button>
            </div>
            <div className="muted mono" style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>
              {list.length} version(s) · by {list[list.length - 1].createdBy}
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      <div className="card">
        <div className="card-title">Explain lineage</div>
        {!graph && <div className="muted">Select a lineage to see how the current artifact came to exist.</div>}
        {graph && (
          <pre className="mono" style={{ whiteSpace: "pre-wrap", fontSize: 11, maxHeight: 420, overflow: "auto" }}>
            {graph.nodes
              .slice()
              .reverse()
              .map((n, i) => `${"  ".repeat(Math.min(n.depth, 6))}${i > 0 ? "↓ " : ""}v${n.artifact.version} ${n.artifact.name}\n${"  ".repeat(Math.min(n.depth, 6))}   ${n.reason}`)
              .join("\n")}
          </pre>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function TimelineTab({ events }: { events: Array<{ kind: string; data: Record<string, unknown>; at: string }> }) {
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState("");
  const shown = filter
    ? events.filter((e) => e.kind.toLowerCase().includes(filter.toLowerCase()))
    : events;

  return (
    <div className="card" style={{ marginTop: 14 }}>
      <div className="card-title">Flight recorder · {events.length} events</div>
      <input
        style={{ width: "100%", marginTop: 8 }}
        placeholder="Filter by event kind (e.g. GRAPH_MUTATED, REPAIR, APPROVAL)"
        value={filter}
        onChange={(e) => setFilter(e.target.value)}
      />
      <div style={{ maxHeight: 460, overflow: "auto", marginTop: 10 }}>
        {shown.slice(-200).reverse().map((e, i) => (
          <div key={i} className="mono" style={{ fontSize: 11, padding: "2px 0" }}>
            <span style={{ color: "var(--text-3)" }}>{e.at.slice(11, 23)}</span>{" "}
            <b>{e.kind}</b>{" "}
            <span className="muted">{JSON.stringify(e.data).slice(0, 180)}</span>
          </div>
        ))}
        {shown.length === 0 && <div className="muted">No matching events.</div>}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function ScoreTab({ outcome }: { outcome?: import("../engine/orgRuntime").MissionOutcome }) {
  if (!outcome?.score) {
    return (
      <div className="card" style={{ marginTop: 14 }}>
        <div className="muted">
          Run the mission to compute its score. Dimensions are always shown separately —
          never collapsed into one number.
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }
  return (
    <div className="card" style={{ marginTop: 14 }}>
      <ScoreDimensions
        score={outcome.score}
        footer={
          <pre className="mono" style={{ whiteSpace: "pre-wrap", marginTop: 10, fontSize: 11 }}>
            {outcome.scorecard}
          </pre>
        }
      />
    </div>
  );
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ helpers

function Stat({ label, value }: { label: string; value: number }) {
  return (
    <div className="row" style={{ justifyContent: "space-between", padding: "3px 0" }}>
      <span className="muted">{label}</span>
      <b className="mono">{value}</b>
    </div>
  );
}

function Field({ label, value }: { label: string; value: string }) {
  return (
    <div style={{ marginTop: 6 }}>
      <div className="muted mono" style={{ fontSize: 10, letterSpacing: "0.1em" }}>{label}</div>
      <div style={{ fontSize: 13 }}>{value}</div>
    </div>
  );
}

function statusGlyph(s: MissionTask["status"]): string {
  switch (s) {
    case "COMPLETED": return "✓";
    case "FAILED": return "✗";
    case "RUNNING": return "▶";
    case "BLOCKED": return "⏸";
    case "DELEGATED": return "→";
    case "PENDING": return "·";
    case "SPLIT": return "⑃";
    case "MERGED": return "⊕";
    default: return "?";
  }
}

function latestOf(all: Artifact[], lineageId: string): Artifact | undefined {
  return all.filter((a) => a.lineageId === lineageId).sort((a, b) => b.version - a.version)[0];
}

function useSavedMissions(): Mission[] {
  const [list, setList] = useState<Mission[]>([]);
  useEffect(() => {
    let alive = true;
    void v6.missionList().then((r) => {
      if (alive) setList(r);
    });
    return () => {
      alive = false;
    };
  }, []);
  return list;
}

/** Re-exported so the risk policy table can be rendered in the Governance page. */
export function riskHandlingLabel(cls: RiskClass, handling: string): string {
  return `${cls} → ${HANDLING_LABEL[handling as keyof typeof HANDLING_LABEL] ?? handling}`;
}
```

## `src/pages/ObservabilityPage.tsx`

```tsx
import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { ipc } from "../ipc/client";
import type { ApprovalRecord, DlqRecord, ExecutionRecord } from "../domain/types";
import { fmtUsd } from "../app/id";
import { toast } from "../panels/Toast";

export function ObservabilityPage() {
  const [runs, setRuns] = useState<ExecutionRecord[]>([]);
  const [appr, setAppr] = useState<ApprovalRecord[]>([]);
  const [dlq, setDlq] = useState<DlqRecord[]>([]);

  const refresh = () => {
    void ipc.executionList().then(setRuns);
    void ipc.approvalList().then((r) => setAppr(r as ApprovalRecord[]));
    void ipc.dlqList().then((r) => setDlq(r as DlqRecord[]));
  };
  useEffect(() => { refresh(); }, []);

  const spend = useMemo(() => runs.reduce((a, r) => a + (r.stats?.costUsd ?? 0), 0), [runs]);
  const tokens = useMemo(() => runs.reduce((a, r) => a + (r.stats?.inputTokens ?? 0) + (r.stats?.outputTokens ?? 0), 0), [runs]);

  return (
    <div className="panel-page">
      <h2>Observability</h2>
      <p className="sub">Token spend, approvals, dead-letter queue, and a lightweight Gantt of recent runs. Native build exports OpenTelemetry.</p>
      <div className="stat-row">
        <div className="stat"><div className="n">{fmtUsd(spend)}</div><div className="l">Estimated spend</div></div>
        <div className="stat"><div className="n">{tokens.toLocaleString()}</div><div className="l">Tokens</div></div>
        <div className="stat"><div className="n">{appr.length}</div><div className="l">Open approvals</div></div>
        <div className="stat"><div className="n">{dlq.length}</div><div className="l">DLQ</div></div>
      </div>

      <h3>Approvals</h3>
      {appr.length === 0 && <p className="muted">Nothing waiting.</p>}
      {appr.map((a) => (
        <div key={a.id} className="card">
          <div className="card-title">{a.summary}</div>
          <div className="muted">{a.nodeKey} · {a.executionId}</div>
          <div className="row" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>
            <button className="primary" onClick={async () => { await ipc.approvalDecide(a.id, "APPROVED"); toast("Approved"); refresh(); }}>Approve</button>
            <button className="danger" onClick={async () => { await ipc.approvalDecide(a.id, "REJECTED"); toast("Rejected"); refresh(); }}>Reject</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      ))}

      <h3>Dead letter</h3>
      {dlq.length === 0 && <p className="muted">Queue empty.</p>}
      {dlq.map((d) => (
        <div key={d.id} className="card">
          <div className="card-title">{d.error}</div>
          <div className="muted">{d.suggestedCause} · {d.candidateFix}</div>
          <button onClick={async () => { await ipc.dlqResolve(d.id); refresh(); }}>Resolve</button>
        </div>
      ))}

      <h3>Recent runs</h3>
      <div className="gantt">
        {runs.slice(0, 12).map((r) => (
          <div key={r.id} className="gantt-row">
            <span className="mono">{r.status}</span>
            <div className="gantt-bar" style={{ width: `${Math.min(100, (r.stats?.durationMs ?? 800) / 80)}%` }} />
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { ipc } from "../ipc/client";
import { toast } from "../panels/Toast";
import { HARNESSES } from "../domain/harness";

const MODELS = [
  { ref: "provider.openai.production", label: "OpenAI", hint: "sk-…", models: ["gpt-4.1", "gpt-4o", "o3"] },
  { ref: "provider.anthropic.production", label: "Anthropic", hint: "sk-ant-…", models: ["claude-sonnet-4", "claude-opus-4"] },
  { ref: "provider.google.production", label: "Google", hint: "AIza…", models: ["gemini-2.5-pro", "gemini-2.5-flash"] },
  { ref: "provider.openrouter.production", label: "OpenRouter", hint: "sk-or-…", models: ["auto"] },
  { ref: "provider.ollama.local", label: "Ollama (local)", hint: "no key — 127.0.0.1:11434", models: ["llama3.1", "qwen2.5", "mistral"] },
];

export function ProvidersPage() {
  const [exists, setExists] = useState<Record<string, boolean>>({});
  const [vals, setVals] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const [cli, setCli] = useState<Array<{ id: string; name: string; installed: boolean; invocation?: string }>>([]);

  const refresh = () => void ipc.secretExists(MODELS.map((m) => m.ref)).then(setExists);

  useEffect(() => {
    refresh();
    void ipc.cliProvidersDetect().then(setCli);
  }, []);

  return (
    <div className="panel-page">
      <h2>Agent harnesses</h2>
      <p className="sub">
        Agent nodes are not Zapier/n8n steps. They spawn a real local coding agent.
        Install Claude Code, Codex, or OpenCode on this laptop. MJ detects them and runs the crew together.
      </p>

      {HARNESSES.filter((h) => h.id !== "llm").map((h) => {
        const found = cli.find((c) => c.id === h.id || h.bins.includes(c.id) || h.bins.includes(c.invocation ?? ""));
        const on = Boolean(found?.installed);
        return (
          <div key={h.id} className="card">
            <div className="card-title">
              {h.name}
              <span className={`pill ${on ? "ok" : "err"}`}>{on ? "on PATH" : "not installed"}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="muted">{h.notes}</div>
            <div className="mono" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>{h.install}</div>
          </div>
        );
      })}

      <div className="row" style={{ margin: "12px 0 20px" }}>
        <button onClick={() => void ipc.cliProvidersDetect().then(setCli)}>Re-scan PATH</button>
      </div>

      <h2>Direct LLM keys</h2>
      <p className="sub">Only used when a node’s harness is set to “Direct LLM / Ollama”. Keys never enter the graph JSON.</p>
      {MODELS.map((m) => (
        <div key={m.ref} className="card">
          <div className="card-title">{m.label} <span className={`pill ${exists[m.ref] ? "ok" : ""}`}>{exists[m.ref] ? "configured" : "missing"}</span></div>
          <div className="muted">{m.models.join(" · ")}</div>
          <div className="row" style={{ marginTop: 10 }}>
            <input className="grow" type="password" placeholder={m.hint} value={vals[m.ref] ?? ""} onChange={(e) => setVals((s) => ({ ...s, [m.ref]: e.target.value }))} />
            <button className="primary" onClick={async () => {
              if (!vals[m.ref] && m.ref !== "provider.ollama.local") return;
              await ipc.secretSet(m.ref, vals[m.ref] || "local");
              toast("Saved");
              setVals((s) => ({ ...s, [m.ref]: "" }));
              refresh();
            }}>Save</button>
            <button className="danger" onClick={async () => { await ipc.secretDelete(m.ref); refresh(); }}>Clear</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { getEditorPrefs, saveEditorPrefs, type EditorPrefs } from "../graph/store";
import { ipc } from "../ipc/client";
import { detectHost, detectPlatform } from "../app/desktop";
import { toast } from "../panels/Toast";

type Occupancy = "individual" | "enterprise";

export function SettingsPage() {
  const [prefs, setPrefs] = useState<EditorPrefs>(getEditorPrefs());
  const [info, setInfo] = useState<Record<string, unknown>>({});
  const [size, setSize] = useState<number>(0);
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<Occupancy>(() => {
    try { return (localStorage.getItem("mj.occupancy") as Occupancy) || "individual"; } catch { return "individual"; }
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    void ipc.appInfo().then(setInfo);
    void ipc.dbMaintenance(false).then((r) => setSize((r as { sizeBytes: number }).sizeBytes));
  }, []);

  const apply = (p: EditorPrefs) => {
    setPrefs(p);
    saveEditorPrefs(p);
    document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", p.theme);
    try { localStorage.setItem("mj.theme", p.theme); } catch { /* */ }
  };

  const setOccupancy = (m: Occupancy) => {
    setMode(m);
    try { localStorage.setItem("mj.occupancy", m); } catch { /* */ }
    toast(m === "enterprise" ? "Enterprise: org skills stay token-gated" : "Individual: local skill store");
  };

  return (
    <div className="panel-page">
      <h2>Settings</h2>
      <p className="sub">Host {detectHost()} · {detectPlatform()} · MJ 4.0 · ROX spec · Inter / JetBrains Mono</p>

      <div className="card">
        <div className="card-title">Occupancy</div>
        <div className="muted">Enterprise keeps org-shared Hermes skills token-gated. Individual uses the local skill store only.</div>
        <div className="row" style={{ marginTop: 10 }}>
          <button className={mode === "individual" ? "primary" : ""} onClick={() => setOccupancy("individual")}>Individual</button>
          <button className={mode === "enterprise" ? "primary" : ""} onClick={() => setOccupancy("enterprise")}>Enterprise</button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="card">
        <div className="card-title">Appearance</div>
        <div className="row" style={{ marginTop: 10 }}>
          {(["void", "graphite", "paper"] as const).map((t) => (
            <button key={t} className={prefs.theme === t ? "primary" : ""} onClick={() => apply({ ...prefs, theme: t })}>{t}</button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="card">
        <div className="card-title">Editor</div>
        <label className="field">Grid snap (0 = free)
          <input type="number" value={prefs.snap} onChange={(e) => apply({ ...prefs, snap: Number(e.target.value) })} />
        </label>
        <label className="field" style={{ marginTop: 10 }}>Autosave ms (0 = off)
          <input type="number" value={prefs.autosaveMs} onChange={(e) => apply({ ...prefs, autosaveMs: Number(e.target.value) })} />
        </label>
      </div>

      <div className="card">
        <div className="card-title">Vendors</div>
        <div className="muted">Hermes Agent · hermes-agent-self-evolution · official MCP servers. Wrapped over stdio. Never HTTP sidecars.</div>
      </div>

      <div className="card">
        <div className="card-title">Maintenance</div>
        <div className="muted">Local store · {size.toLocaleString()} bytes</div>
        <div className="row" style={{ marginTop: 10 }}>
          <button onClick={async () => { const r = await ipc.dbMaintenance(true); setSize((r as { sizeBytes: number }).sizeBytes); toast("Compacted"); }}>Compact</button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="card">
        <div className="card-title">Runtime</div>
        <pre className="mono" style={{ whiteSpace: "pre-wrap" }}>{JSON.stringify(info, null, 2)}</pre>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## `src/pages/TeamsPage.tsx`

```tsx
import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { AGENT_FRAMEWORKS } from "../domain/frameworks";
import { ROLE_PACK_COUNT } from "../domain/rolePacks";
import {
  deleteTeam,
  instantiateTeam,
  loadTeams,
  newTeam,
  saveTeam,
  teamFromFramework,
  type TeamWorkspace,
} from "../domain/teams";
import { useGraphStore } from "../graph/store";
import { ipc } from "../ipc/client";
import { toast } from "../panels/Toast";

export function TeamsPage({ onOpened }: { onOpened: () => void }) {
  const [teams, setTeams] = useState<TeamWorkspace[]>([]);
  const [task, setTask] = useState("");
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<string>("");
  const store = useGraphStore();
  const fwById = useMemo(() => new Map(AGENT_FRAMEWORKS.map((f) => [f.id, f])), []);

  // V6: teams live in SQLite, so they load asynchronously.
  useEffect(() => {
    let alive = true;
    void (async () => {
      try {
        const list = await loadTeams();
        if (!alive) return;
        setTeams(list);
        if (list.length) setSelected((prev) => prev || list[0].id);
      } catch (e) {
        toast(`Teams failed to load: ${e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)}`);
      }
    })();
    return () => {
      alive = false;
    };
  }, []);

  const persist = async (next: TeamWorkspace[]) => {
    setTeams(next);
    try {
      for (const t of next) await saveTeam(t);
    } catch (e) {
      toast(`Save failed: ${e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)}`);
    }
  };

  const apply = async (team: TeamWorkspace) => {
    const t = task.trim() || "New task for this team";
    const { nodes, wires } = instantiateTeam(team, t);
    if (!store.workflowId) {
      const res = await ipc.workflowCreate(`${team.name}: ${t.slice(0, 40)}`, team.description);
      const created = await ipc.workflowGet(res.id);
      store.loadWorkflow(created as never);
      window.__mjActiveWorkflowId = res.id;
    }
    store.insertTemplate(nodes, wires);
    store.rename(`${team.name}: ${t.slice(0, 40)}`);
    try {
      await ipc.workflowSave(store.workflowId, `${team.name}: ${t.slice(0, 40)}`, team.description, useGraphStore.getState().graph);
    } catch {
      /* non-fatal: the canvas is still correct */
    }
    toast(`Team “${team.name}” on canvas`);
    onOpened();
  };

  return (
    <div className="panel-page">
      <h2>Reusable teams</h2>
      <p className="sub">
        A team is a roster of Hermes-class agents plus a coordination framework.
        Save it once. Drop the same team onto a new task. Shared memory key stays with the team.
        {ROLE_PACK_COUNT} specialist identities · {AGENT_FRAMEWORKS.length} frameworks — not n8n steps.
      </p>

      <label className="field">Task for the selected team
        <div className="nl-box">
          <input value={task} onChange={(e) => setTask(e.target.value)} placeholder="e.g. threat-model the payments service and patch the top finding" />
          <button className="primary" disabled={!selected} onClick={() => {
            const t = teams.find((x) => x.id === selected);
            if (t) void apply(t);
          }}>Apply team</button>
        </div>
      </label>

      {teams.map((t) => (
        <div key={t.id} className={`card ${selected === t.id ? "selected" : ""}`} onClick={() => setSelected(t.id)}>
          <div className="card-title">{t.name} <span className="pill">{fwById.get(t.frameworkId)?.pattern ?? t.frameworkId}</span></div>
          <div className="muted">{t.description}</div>
          <div className="muted" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>{t.members.map((m) => m.title).join(" · ")}</div>
          <div className="muted">memory {t.memoryKey}</div>
          <div className="row" style={{ marginTop: 10 }}>
            <button className="primary" onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); void apply(t); }}>Use for this task</button>
            <button className="danger" onClick={(e) => {
              e.stopPropagation();
              void (async () => {
                try {
                  await deleteTeam(t.id);
                  const next = teams.filter((x) => x.id !== t.id);
                  setTeams(next);
                  if (selected === t.id) setSelected(next[0]?.id ?? "");
                  toast(`Forgot team ${t.name}`);
                } catch (err) {
                  toast(`Delete failed: ${err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)}`);
                }
              })();
            }}>Forget team</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      ))}

      <h3 style={{ letterSpacing: "0.12em", textTransform: "uppercase", fontSize: 11, color: "var(--text-3)", marginTop: 28 }}>
        Save a framework as a team
      </h3>
      <div className="grid-2">
        {AGENT_FRAMEWORKS.map((f) => (
          <div key={f.id} className="card tpl">
            <div className="pill">{f.category}</div>
            <h3>{f.name}</h3>
            <div className="muted">{f.description}</div>
            <div className="muted" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>{f.roster.length} seats · {f.pattern}</div>
            <button style={{ marginTop: 10 }} onClick={() => {
              const rec = newTeam(teamFromFramework(f));
              void persist([rec, ...teams]);
              setSelected(rec.id);
              toast(`Saved team ${rec.name}`);
            }}>Save as team</button>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## `src/panels/CommandPalette.tsx`

```tsx
import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";

export interface PaletteAction {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  hint?: string;
  run: () => void;
}

export function CommandPalette({ actions, onClose }: { actions: PaletteAction[]; onClose: () => void }) {
  const [q, setQ] = useState("");
  const [hot, setHot] = useState(0);
  const list = useMemo(() => {
    const s = q.trim().toLowerCase();
    return actions.filter((a) => !s || a.label.toLowerCase().includes(s) || a.id.includes(s)).slice(0, 40);
  }, [actions, q]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === "Escape") onClose();
      if (e.key === "ArrowDown") { e.preventDefault(); setHot((h) => Math.min(list.length - 1, h + 1)); }
      if (e.key === "ArrowUp") { e.preventDefault(); setHot((h) => Math.max(0, h - 1)); }
      if (e.key === "Enter") {
        e.preventDefault();
        list[hot]?.run();
        onClose();
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
  }, [hot, list, onClose]);

  return (
    <div className="palette-overlay" onMouseDown={onClose}>
      <div className="palette" onMouseDown={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
        <input autoFocus placeholder="Run a command…" value={q} onChange={(e) => { setQ(e.target.value); setHot(0); }} />
        <div className="results">
          {list.map((a, i) => (
            <div key={a.id} className={`result ${i === hot ? "hot" : ""}`} onMouseEnter={() => setHot(i)} onClick={() => { a.run(); onClose(); }}>
              <span style={{ flex: 1 }}>{a.label}</span>
              {a.hint && <span className="kbd">{a.hint}</span>}
            </div>
          ))}
          {list.length === 0 && <div className="result">No matches</div>}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## `src/panels/ErrorBoundary.tsx`

```tsx
import React from "react";

interface Props { children: React.ReactNode; label: string; }
interface State { err?: string; }

export class ErrorBoundary extends React.Component<Props, State> {
  state: State = {};
  static getDerivedStateFromError(e: Error) { return { err: e.message }; }
  render() {
    if (this.state.err) {
      return (
        <div className="panel-page">
          <h2>{this.props.label} crashed</h2>
          <p className="sub">{this.state.err}</p>
          <button onClick={() => this.setState({ err: undefined })}>Retry</button>
        </div>
      );
    }
    return this.props.children;
  }
}
```
